live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|44:4: Therefore the angel tolerated him, without saying one bad word, until the Word of Elohim (God) came who said to Satan, "Go away from here; once before you deceived My servants, and this time you seek to destroy them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|44:5: Were it not for My mercy I would have destroyed you and your hosts from off the earth. But I have had patience with you, until the end of the world."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|44:6: Then Satan fled from before Yahuah (Lord). But the fire went on burning around the cave like a coal-fire the whole day; which was the forty-sixth day Adam and Eve had spent since they came out of the garden.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|44:7: And when Adam and Eve saw that the heat of the fire had somewhat cooled down, they began to walk towards the cave to get into it as they usually did; but they could not, by reason of the heat of the fire.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|44:8: Then they both began crying because of the fire that separated them from the cave, and that came towards them, burning. And they were afraid.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|44:9: Then Adam said to Eve, "See this fire of which we have a portion in us: which formerly yielded to us, but no longer does so, now that we have transgressed the limit of creation, and changed our condition, and our nature is altered. But the fire is not changed in its nature, nor altered from its creation. Therefore it now has power over us; and when we come near it, it scorches our flesh."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|45:1: Then Adam rose and prayed to Elohim (God), saying, "See, this fire has separated us from the cave in which You have commanded us to live; but now, behold, we cannot go into it."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|45:2: Then Elohim (God) heard Adam, and sent him His Word, that said:--
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|45:3: "O Adam, see this fire! How different the flame and heat thereof are from the garden of delights and the good things in it!
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|45:4: When you were under My control, all creatures yielded to you; but after you have transgressed My commandment, they all rise over you."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|45:5: Elohim (God) said again to him, "See, O Adam, how Satan has exalted you! He has deprived you of the Godhead, and of an exalted state like Me, and has not kept his word to you; but has, after all, become your enemy. He is the one who made this fire in which he meant to burn you and Eve.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|45:6: Why, O Adam, has he not kept his agreement with you, not even one day; but has deprived you of the glory that was on you--when you yielded to his command?
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|45:7: Do you think, Adam, that he loved you when he made this agreement with you? Or that he loved you and wished to raise you on high?
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|45:8: But no, Adam, he did not do all that out of love to you; but he wished to make you come out of light into darkness; and from an exalted state to degradation; from glory to abasement; from joy to sorrow; and from rest to fasting and fainting."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|45:9: Elohim (God) also said to Adam, "See this fire kindled by Satan around your cave; see this wonder that surrounds you; and know that it will encompass about both you and your descendants, when you obey his command; that he will plague you with fire; and that you will go down into hell after you are dead.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:13: Then Eve said, "If, indeed, the earth quaked for our sake, and this rock forms a tent over us because of our transgression, then we will be sorry, O Adam, because our punishment will be long.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|45:10: Then you will see the burning of his fire, that will be burning around you and likewise your descendants. You will not be delivered from it until My coming; just like you cannot go into your cave right now because of the great fire around it; not until My Word comes and makes a way for you on the day My covenant is fulfilled.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|45:11: There is no way for you at present to come from this life to rest, not until My Word comes, who is My Word. Then He will make a way for you, and you shall have rest." Then Elohim (God) called with His Word to the fire that burned around the cave, that it split itself in half, until Adam had gone through it. Then the fire parted itself by Elohim's (God's) order, and a way was made for Adam*.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|45:12: And Elohim (God) withdrew His Word from Adam. * Reference: Exodus 14:21,22 and Joshua 3:15-17
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|46:1: Then Adam and Eve began again to come into the cave. And when they came to the way between the fire, Satan blew into the fire like a whirlwind, and caused the burning coal-fire to cover Adam and Eve; so that their bodies were singed; and the coal-fire scorched them*.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|46:2: And from the burning of the fire Adam and Eve screamed, and said, "O Yahuah (Lord), save us! Leave us not to be consumed and plagued by this burning fire; neither require us for having transgressed Your commandment."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|46:3: Then Elohim (God) looked at their bodies, on which Satan had caused fire to burn, and Elohim (God) sent His angel that stayed the burning fire. But the wounds remained on their bodies.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|46:4: And Elohim (God) said to Adam, "See Satan's love for you, who pretended to give you the Godhead and greatness; and, behold, he burns you with fire, and seeks to destroy you from off the earth.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|46:5: Then look at Me, O Adam; I created you, and how many times have I delivered you out of his hand? If not, wouldn't he have destroyed you?"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|46:6: Elohim (God) said again to Eve, "What is that he promised you in the garden, saying, 'As soon as you eat from the tree, your eyes will be opened, and you shall become like gods, knowing good and evil.' But look! He has burnt your bodies with fire, and has made you taste the taste of fire, for the taste of the garden; and has made you see the burning of fire, and the evil of it, and the power it has over you.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|46:7: Your eyes have seen the good he has taken from you, and in truth he has opened your eyes; and you have seen the garden in which you were with Me, and you have also seen the evil that has come over you from Satan. But as to the Godhead he cannot give it to you, neither fulfil his speech to you. No, he was bitter against you and your descendants, that will come after you."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|46:8: And Elohim (God) withdrew His Word form them. * At this time, the garments that Yahuah (Lord) had given them in Genesis 3:21 were burned off so that Adam and Eve were again naked. Reference chapter L whereby Adam and Eve seek garments with which to cover their nakedness..
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|47:1: Then Adam and Eve came into the cave, yet trembling at the fire that had scorched their bodies. So Adam said to Eve:--
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|47:2: "Look, the fire has burnt our flesh in this world; but how will it be when we are dead, and Satan shall punish our souls? Is not our deliverance long and far off, unless Elohim (God) come, and in mercy to us fulfil His promise?"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|47:3: Then Adam and Eve passed into the cave, blessing themselves for coming into it once more. For it was in their thoughts, that they never should enter it, when they saw the fire around it.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|47:4: But as the sun was setting the fire was still burning and nearing Adam and Eve in the cave, so that they could not sleep in it. After the sun had set, they went out of it. This was the forty-seventh day after they came out of the garden.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|47:5: Adam and Eve then came under the top of hill by the garden to sleep, as they were accustomed.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|47:6: And they stood and prayed Elohim (God) to forgive them their sins, and then fell asleep under the summit of the mountain.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|47:7: But Satan, the hater of all good, thought within himself: "Whereas Elohim (God) has promised salvation to Adam by covenant, and that He would deliver him out of all the hardships that have befallen him--but has not promised me by covenant, and will not deliver me out of my hardships; no, since He has promised him that He should make him and his descendants live in the kingdom in which I once was--I will kill Adam.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|47:8: The earth shall be rid of him; and shall be left to me alone; so that when he is dead he may not have any descendants left to inherit the kingdom that shall remain my own realm; Elohim (God) will then be wanting me, and He will restore it to me and my hosts."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:1: After this Satan called to his hosts, all of which came to him, and said to him:--
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:2: "O, our lord, what will you do?"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:3: He then said to them, "You know that this Adam, whom Elohim (God) created out of the dust, is the one who has taken our kingdom, come, let us gather together and kill him; or hurl a rock at him and at Eve, and crush them under it."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:4: When Satan's hosts heard these words, they came to the part of the mountain where Adam and Eve were asleep.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:5: Then Satan and his host took a huge rock, broad and even, and without blemish, thinking within himself, "If there should be a hole in the rock, when it fell on them, the hole in the rock might come over them, and so they would escape and not die."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:6: He then said to his hosts, "Take up this stone, and throw it flat on them, so that it doesn't roll off them to somewhere else. And when you have hurled it, get away from there quickly."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:7: And they did as he told them. But as the rock fell down from the mountain toward Adam and Eve, Elohim (God) commanded the rock to become a dome over them*, that did them no harm. And so it was by Elohim's (God's) order.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:8: But when the rock fell, the whole earth quaked with it**, and was shaken from the size of the rock.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:9: And as it quaked and shook, Adam and Eve awoke from sleep, and found themselves under a dome of rock. But they didn't know what had happened; because when the fell asleep they were under the sky, and not under a dome; and when they saw it, they were afraid.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:10: Then Adam said to Eve, "Wherefore has the mountain bent itself, and the earth quaked and shaken on our account? And why has this rock spread itself over us like a tent?
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:11: Does Elohim (God) intend to plague us and to shut us up in this prison? Or will He close the earth over us?
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:12: He is angry with us for our having come out of the cave, without His order; and for our having done so of our own accord, without consulting Him, when we left the cave and came to this place."
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|13:10: Then therefore were they chastened That they might be sanctified.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:14: But get up and pray to Elohim (God) to let us know concerning this, and what this rock is that is spread over us like a tent."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|48:15: Then Adam stood up and prayed before Yahuah (Lord), to let him know what had brought about this difficult time. And Adam stood praying like that until the morning. * The word "dome" is used here but the text does not specifically suggest that the covering was round--only that it covered them on all sides, however a dome is the most likely shape that would have be able to withstand the impact with the ground. From verse 9 that says "when they saw it" and verse 11 that says "shut us up in this prison", we can conclude that the dome had holes in its sides that were big enough to let in light and air but were too small to allow Adam and Eve to escape. Another conclusion would be that the holes were large but too high up for Adam and Eve to reach, however the former is more likely. ** In verse 7 of the next chapter (XLIX), Elohim (God) tells Adam and Eve that the ground was also lowered under them--"I commanded . . . the rock under you to lower itself".
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|49:1: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came and said:--
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|49:2: "O Adam, who counselled you, when you came out of the cave, to come to this place?"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|49:3: And Adam said to Elohim (God), "O Yahuah (Lord), we came to this place because of the heat of the fire, that came over us inside the cave."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|49:4: Then Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) said to Adam, "O Adam, you dread the heat of fire for one night, but how will it be when you live in hell?
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|49:5: Yet, O Adam, don't be afraid, and don't believe that I have placed this dome of rock over you to plague you with it.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|49:6: It came from Satan, who had promised you the Godhead and majesty. It is he who threw down this rock to kill you under it, and Eve with you, and thus to prevent you from living on the earth.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|49:7: But, in mercy for you, just as that rock was falling down on you, I commanded it to form an dome over you; and the rock under you to lower itself.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|49:8: And this sign, O Adam, will happen to Me at My coming on earth: Satan will raise the people of the Yahudim (Jews) to put Me to death; and they will lay Me in a rock, and seal a large stone over Me, and I shall remain within that rock three days and three nights.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|49:9: But on the third day I shall rise again, and it shall be salvation to you, O Adam, and to your descendants, to believe in Me. But, O Adam, I will not bring you from under this rock until three days and three nights have passed."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|49:10: And Elohim (God) withdrew His Word from Adam.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|49:11: But Adam and Eve lived under the rock three days and three nights, as Elohim (God) had told them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|49:12: And Elohim (God) did so to them because they had left their cave and had come to this same place without Elohim's (God's) order.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|49:13: But, after three days and three nights, Elohim (God) created an opening in the dome of rock and allowed them to get out from under it. Their flesh was dried up, and their eyes and hearts were troubled from crying and sorrow.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|50:1: Then Adam and Eve went forth and came into the Cave of Treasures, and they stood praying in it the whole of that day, until the evening.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|50:2: And this took place at the end of the fifty days after they had left the garden.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|50:3: But Adam and Eve rose again and prayed to Elohim (God) in the cave the whole of that night, and begged for mercy from Him.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|50:4: And when the day dawned, Adam said to Eve, "Come! Let us go and do some work for our bodies."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|50:5: So they went out of the cave, and came to the northern border of the garden, and they looked for something to cover their bodies with*. But they found nothing, and knew not how to do the work. Yet their bodies were stained, and they were speechless from cold and heat.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|50:6: Then Adam stood and asked Elohim (God) to show him something with which to cover their bodies.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|50:7: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) and said to him, "O Adam, take Eve and come to the seashore where you fasted before. There you will find skins of sheep that were left after lions ate the carcasses. Take them and make garments for yourselves, and clothe yourselves with them. * Chapter XLVI, verse 1, says "Satan blew into the fire ... so that their bodies were singed". At this time, the garments that Yahuah (Lord) had given them in Genesis 3:21 were burned off so that Adam and Eve were again naked.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|51:1: When Adam heard these words from Elohim (God), he took Eve and went from the northern end of the garden to the south of it, by the river of water where they once fasted.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|51:2: But as they were going on their way, and before they got there, Satan, the wicked one, had heard the Word of Elohim (God) communing with Adam respecting his covering.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|51:3: It grieved him, and he hastened to the place where the sheep-skins were, with the intention of taking them and throwing them into the sea, or of burning them with fire, so that Adam and Eve would not find them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|51:4: But as he was about to take them, the Word of Elohim (God) came from heaven, and bound him by the side of those skins until Adam and Eve came near him. But as they got closer to him they were afraid of him, and of his hideous look.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|51:5: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam and Eve, and said to them, "This is he who was hidden in the serpent, and who deceived you, and stripped you of the garment of light and glory in which you were.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|51:6: This is he who promised you majesty and divinity. Where, then, is the beauty that was on him? Where is his divinity? Where is his light? Where is the glory that rested on him?
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|51:7: Now his figure is hideous; he is become abominable among angels; and he has come to be called Satan.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|51:8: O Adam, he wished to take from you this earthly garment of sheep-skins, and to destroy it, and not let you be covered with it.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|51:9: What, then, is his beauty that you should have followed him? And what have you gained by obeying him? See his evil works and then look at Me; at Me, your Creator, and at the good deeds I do you.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|51:10: See, I bound him until you came and saw him and beheld his weakness, that no power is left with him."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|51:11: And Elohim (God) released him from his bonds.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|52:1: After this Adam and Eve said no more, but cried before Elohim (God) on account of their creation, and of their bodies that required an earthly covering.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|52:2: Then Adam said to Eve, "O Eve, this is the skin of beasts with which we shall be covered, but when we put it on, behold, we shall be wearing a token of death on our bodies. Just as the owners of these skins have died and have wasted away, so also shall we die and pass away."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|52:3: Then Adam and Eve took the skins, and went back to the Cave of Treasures; and when in it, they stood and prayed as they were accustomed.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|52:4: And they thought how they could make garments of those skins; for they had no skill for it.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|52:5: Then Elohim (God) sent to them His angel to show them how to work it out. And the angel said to Adam, "Go forth, and bring some palm-thorns." Then Adam went out, and brought some, as the angel had commanded him.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|52:6: Then the angel began before them to work out the skins, after the manner of one who prepares a shirt. And he took the thorns and stuck them into the skins, before their eyes.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|52:7: Then the angel again stood up and prayed Elohim (God) that the thorns in those skins should be hidden, so as to be, as it were, sewn with one thread.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|52:8: And so it was, by Elohim's (God's) order; they became garments for Adam and Eve, and He clothed them therewith.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|52:9: From that time the nakedness of their bodies was covered from the sight of each other's eyes.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|52:10: And this happened at the end of the fifty-first day.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|52:11: Then when Adam's and Eve's bodies were covered, they stood and prayed, and sought mercy of Yahuah (Lord), and forgiveness, and gave Him thanks for that He had had mercy on them, and had covered their nakedness. And they ceased not from prayer the whole of that night.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|52:12: Then when the morning dawned at the rising of the sun, they said their prayers after their custom; and then went out of the cave.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|52:13: And Adam said to Eve, "Since we don't know what there is to the west of this cave, let us go out and see it today." Then they came forth and went toward the western border.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|53:1: They were not very far from the cave, when Satan came towards them, and hid himself between them and the cave, under the form of two ravenous lions three days without food, that came towards Adam and Eve, as if to break them in pieces and devour them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|53:2: Then Adam and Eve cried, and prayed Elohim (God) to deliver them from their paws.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|53:3: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to them, and drove away the lions from them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|53:4: And Elohim (God) said to Adam, "O Adam, what do you seek on the western border? And why have you left of thine own accord the eastern border, in which was your living place?
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|53:5: Now then, turn back to your cave, and remain in it, so that Satan won't deceive you or work his purpose over you.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|53:6: For in this western border, O Adam, there will go from you a descendant, that shall replenish it; and that will defile themselves with their sins, and with their yielding to the commands of Satan, and by following his works.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|53:7: Therefore will I bring over them the waters of a flood, and overwhelm them all. But I will deliver what is left of the righteous among them; and I will bring them to a distant land, and the land in which you live now shall remain desolate and without one inhabitant in it.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|53:8: After Elohim (God) had thus spoken to them, they went back to the Cave of Treasures. But their flesh was dried up, and they were weak from fasting and praying, and from the sorrow they felt at having trespassed against Elohim (God).
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|54:1: Then Adam and Eve stood up in the cave and prayed the whole of that night until the morning dawned. And when the sun was risen they both went out of the cave; their heads were wandering from heaviness of sorrow and they didn't know where they were going.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|54:2: And they walked in that condition to the southern border of the garden. And they began to go up that border until they came to the eastern border beyond which there was no more land.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|54:3: And the cherub who guarded the garden was standing at the western gate, and guarding it against Adam and Eve, lest they should suddenly come into the garden. And the cherub turned around, as if to put them to death; according to the commandment Elohim (God) had given him.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|54:4: When Adam and Eve came to the eastern border of the garden--thinking in their hearts that the cherub was not watching--as they were standing by the gate as if wishing to go in, suddenly came the cherub with a flashing sword of fire in his hand; and when he saw them, he went forth to kill them. For he was afraid that Elohim (God) would destroy him if they went into the garden without His order.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|54:5: And the sword of the cherub seemed to shoot flames a distance away from it. But when he raised it over Adam and Eve, the flame of the sword did not flash forth.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|54:6: Therefore the cherub thought that Elohim (God) was favorable to them, and was bringing them back into the garden. And the cherub stood wondering.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|54:7: He could not go up to Heaven to determine Elohim's (God's) order regarding their getting into the garden; he therefore continued to stand by them, unable as he was to part from them; for he was afraid that if they should enter the garden without permission, Elohim (God) would destroy him.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|54:8: When Adam and Eve saw the cherub coming towards them with a flaming sword of fire in his hand, they fell on their faces from fear, and were as dead.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|54:9: At that time the heavens and the earth shook; and another cherubim came down from heaven to the cherub who guarded the garden, and saw him amazed and silent.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|54:10: Then, again, other angels came down close to the place where Adam and Eve were. They were divided between joy and sorrow.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|54:11: They were glad, because they thought that Elohim (God) was favorable to Adam, and wished him to return to the garden; and wished to restore him to the gladness he once enjoyed.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|54:12: But they sorrowed over Adam, because he was fallen like a dead man, he and Eve; and they said in their thoughts, "Adam has not died in this place; but Elohim (God) has put him to death, for his having come to this place, and wishing to get into the garden without His permission."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:1: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam and Eve, and raised them from their dead state, saying to them, "Why did you come up here? Do you intend to go into the garden, from which I brought you out? It cannot be today; but only when the covenant I have made with you is fulfilled."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:2: Then Adam, when he heard the Word of Elohim (God), and the fluttering of the angels whom he did not see, but only heard the sound of them with his ears, he and Eve cried, and said to the angels:--
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:3: "O Spirits, who wait on Elohim (God), look at me, and at my being unable to see you! For when I was in my former bright nature, then I could see you. I sang praises as you do; and my heart was far above you.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|57:9: This is our will and our good pleasure, that we may not leave one of the sons of Adam to inherit our orders in heaven.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:4: But now, that I have transgressed, that bright nature is gone from me, and I am come to this miserable state. And now I have come to this, that I cannot see you, and you do not serve me like you used to do. For I have become animal flesh.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:5: Yet now, O angels of Elohim (God), ask Elohim (God) with me, to restore me to that wherein I was formerly; to rescue me from this misery, and to remove from me the sentence of death He passed on me, for having trespassed against Him."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:6: Then, when the angels heard these words, they all grieved over him; and cursed Satan who had misled Adam, until he came from the garden to misery; from life to death; from peace to trouble; and from gladness to a strange land.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:7: Then the angels said to Adam, "You obeyed Satan, and ignored the Word of Elohim (God) who created you; and you believed that Satan would fulfil all he had promised you.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:8: But now, O Adam, we will make known to you, what came over us though him, before his fall from heaven.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:9: He gathered together his hosts, and deceived them, promising to give them a great kingdom, a divine nature; and other promises he made them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:10: His hosts believed that his word was true, so they yielded to him, and renounced the glory of Elohim (God).
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:11: He then sent for us--according to the orders in which we were--to come under his command, and to accept his vein promise. But we would not, and we did not take his advice.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:12: Then after he had fought with Elohim (God), and had dealt forwardly with Him, he gathered together his hosts, and made war with us. And if it had not been for Elohim's (God's) strength that was with us, we could not have prevailed against him to hurl him from heaven.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:13: But when he fell from among us, there was great joy in heaven, because of his going down from us. For if he had remained in heaven, nothing, not even one angel would have remained in it.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:14: But Elohim (God) in His mercy, drove him from among us to this dark earth; for he had become darkness itself and a worker of unrighteousness.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:15: And he has continued, O Adam, to make war against you, until he tricked you and made you come out of the garden, to this strange land, where all these trials have come to you. And death, which Elohim (God) brought to him, he has also brought to you, O Adam, because you obeyed him, and trespassed against Elohim (God)."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|55:16: Then all the angels rejoiced and praised Elohim (God), and asked Him not to destroy Adam this time, for his having sought to enter the garden; but to bear with him until the fulfillment of the promise; and to help him in this world until he was free from Satan's hand.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|56:1: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam, and said to him:--
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|56:2: "O Adam, look at that garden of joy and at this earth of toil, and behold the garden is full of angels, but look at yourself alone on this earth with Satan whom you obeyed.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|56:3: Yet, if you had submitted, and been obedient to Me, and had kept My Word, you would be with My angels in My garden.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|56:4: But when you transgressed and obeyed Satan, you became his guests among his angels, that are full of wickedness; and you came to this earth, that brings forth to you thorns and thistles.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|56:5: O Adam, ask him who deceived you, to give you the divine nature he promised you, or to make you a garden as I had made for you; or to fill you with that same bright nature with which I had filled you.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|56:6: Ask him to make you a body like the one I made you, or to give you a day of rest as I gave you; or to create within you a reasonable soul, as I created for you; or to take you from here to some other earth than this one which I gave you. But, O Adam, he will not fulfil even one of the things he told you.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|56:7: Acknowledge, then, My favor towards you, and My mercy on you, My creature; that I have not avenged you for your transgression against Me, but in My pity for you I have promised you that at the end of the great five and a half days I will come and save you."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|56:8: Then Elohim (God) said again to Adam and Eve, "Get up, go down from here, before the cherub with a sword of fire in his hand destroys you."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|56:9: But Adam's heart was comforted by Elohim's (God's) words to him, and he worshipped before Him.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|56:10: And Elohim (God) commanded His angels to escort Adam and Eve to the cave with joy, instead of the fear that had come over them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|56:11: Then the angels took up Adam and Eve, and brought them down from the mountain by the garden, with songs and psalms, until they arrived at the cave. There the angels began to comfort and to strengthen them, and then departed from them towards heaven, to their Creator, who had sent them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|56:12: But after the angels had departed from Adam and Eve, Satan came with shamefacedness, and stood at the entrance of the cave in which were Adam and Eve. He then called to Adam, and said, "O Adam, come, let me speak to you."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|56:13: Then Adam came out of the cave, thinking he was one of Elohim's (God's) angels that was come to give him some good counsel.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|57:1: But when Adam came out and saw his hideous figure, he was afraid of him, and said to him, "Who are you?"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|57:2: Then Satan answered and said to him, "It is I, who hid myself within the serpent, and who spoke to Eve, and who enticed her until she obeyed my command. I am he who sent her, using my deceitful speech, to deceive you, until you both ate of the fruit of the tree and abandoned the command of Elohim (God)."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|57:3: But when Adam heard these words from him, he said to him, "Can you make me a garden as Elohim (God) made for me? Or can you clothe me in the same bright nature in which Elohim (God) had clothed me?
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|57:4: Where is the divine nature you promised to give me? Where is that slick speech of yours that you had with us at first, when we were in the garden?"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|57:5: Then Satan said to Adam, "Do you think that when I have promised one something that I would actually deliver it to him or fulfil my word? Of course not. For I myself have never even thought of obtaining what I promised.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|57:6: Therefore I fell, and I made you fall by that for which I myself fell; and with you also, whosoever accepts my counsel, falls thereby.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|57:7: But now, O Adam, because you fell you are under my rule, and I am king over you; because you have obeyed me and have transgressed against your Elohim (God). Neither will there be any deliverance from my hands until the day promised you by your Elohim (God)."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|57:8: Again he said, "Because we do not know the day agreed on with you by your Elohim (God), nor the hour in which you shall be delivered, for that reason we will multiply war and murder on you and your descendants after you.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|57:10: For as to our home, O Adam, it is in burning fire; and we will not stop our evil doing, no, not one day nor one hour. And I, O Adam, shall set you on fire when you come into the cave to live there."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|57:11: When Adam heard these words he cried and mourned, and said to Eve, "Hear what he said; that he won't fulfil any of what he told you in the garden. Did he really then become king over us?
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|57:12: But we will ask Elohim (God), who created us, to deliver us out of his hands."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|58:1: Then Adam and Eve spread their hands before Elohim (God), praying and begging Him to drive Satan away from them so that he can't harm them or force them to deny Elohim (God).
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|58:2: Then Elohim (God) sent to them at once, His angel, who drove away Satan from them. This happened about sunset, on the fifty-third day after they had come out of the garden.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|58:3: Then Adam and Eve went into the cave, and stood up and turned their faces to the ground, to pray to Elohim (God).
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|58:4: But before they prayed Adam said to Eve, "Look, you have seen what temptations have befallen us in this land. Come, let us get up, and ask Elohim (God) to forgive us the sins we have committed; and we will not come out until the end of the day next to the fortieth. And if we die in here, He will save us."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|58:5: Then Adam and Eve got up, and joined together in entreating Elohim (God).
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|58:6: They continued praying like this in the cave; neither did they come out of it, by night or by day, until their prayers went up out of their mouths, like a flame of fire.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|59:1: But Satan, the hater of all good, did not allow them to finish their prayers. For he called to his hosts, and they came, all of them. Then he said to them, "Since Adam and Eve, whom we deceived, have agreed together to pray to Elohim (God) night and day, and to beg Him to deliver them, and since they will not come out of the cave until the end of the fortieth day.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|59:2: And since they will continue their prayers as they have both agreed to do, that He will deliver them out of our hands, and restore them to their former state, see what we shall do to them." And his hosts said to him, "Power is thine, O our lord, to do what you list."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|59:3: Then Satan, great in wickedness, took his hosts and came into the cave, in the thirtieth night of the forty days and one; and he beat Adam and Eve, until he left them dead.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|59:4: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam and Eve, who raised them from their suffering, and Elohim (God) said to Adam, "Be strong, and be not afraid of him who has just come to you."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|59:5: But Adam cried and said, "Where were you, O my Elohim (God), that they should punish me with such blows, and that this suffering should come over us; over me and over Eve, Your handmaiden?"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|59:6: Then Elohim (God) said to him, "O Adam, see, he is lord and master of all you have, he who said, he would give you divinity. Where is this love for you? And where is the gift he promised?
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|59:7: Did it please him just once, O Adam, to come to you, comfort you, strengthen you, rejoice with you, or send his hosts to protect you; because you have obeyed him, and have yielded to his counsel; and have followed his commandment and transgressed Mine?"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|59:8: Then Adam cried before Yahuah (Lord), and said, "O Yahuah (Lord) because I transgressed a little, You have severely punished me in return for it, I ask You to deliver me out of his hands; or else have pity on me, and take my soul out of my body now in this strange land."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|59:9: Then Elohim (God) said to Adam, "If only there had been this sighing and praying before, before you transgressed! Then would you have rest from the trouble in which you are now."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|59:10: But Elohim (God) had patience with Adam, and let him and Eve remain in the cave until they had fulfilled the forty days.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|59:11: But as to Adam and Eve, their strength and flesh withered from fasting and praying, from hunger and thirst; for they had not tasted either food or drink since they left the garden; nor were the functions of their bodies yet settled; and they had no strength left to continue in prayer from hunger, until the end of the next day to the fortieth. They were fallen down in the cave; yet what speech escaped from their mouths, was only in praises.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:1: Then on the eighty-ninth day, Satan came to the cave, clad in a garment of light, and girt about with a bright girdle.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:2: In his hands was a staff of light, and he looked most awful; but his face was pleasant and his speech was sweet.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:3: He thus transformed himself in order to deceive Adam and Eve, and to make them come out of the cave, before they had fulfilled the forty days.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:4: For he said within himself, "Now that when they had fulfilled the forty days' fasting and praying, Elohim (God) would restore them to their former state; but if He did not do so, He would still be favorable to them; and even if He had not mercy on them, would He yet give them something from the garden to comfort them; as already twice before."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:5: Then Satan drew near the cave in this fair appearance, and said:--
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:6: "O Adam, get up, stand up, you and Eve, and come along with me, to a good land; and don't be afraid. I am flesh and bones like you; and at first I was a creature that Elohim (God) created.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:7: And it was so, that when He had created me, He placed me in a garden in the north, on the border of the world.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:8: And He said to me, 'Stay here!' And I remained there according to His Word, neither did I transgress His commandment.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:9: Then He made a slumber to come over me, and He brought you, O Adam, out of my side, but did not make you stay with me.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:10: But Elohim (God) took you in His divine hand, and placed you in a garden to the eastward.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:11: Then I worried about you, for that while Elohim (God) had taken you out of my side, He had not let you stay with me.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:12: But Elohim (God) said to me: 'Do not worry about Adam, whom I brought out of your side; no harm will come to him.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:13: For now I have brought out of his side a help-meet* for him; and I have given him joy by so doing.'"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:14: Then Satan said again, "I did not know how it is you are in this cave, nor anything about this trial that has come over you--until Elohim (God) said to me, 'Behold, Adam has transgressed, he whom I had taken out of your side, and Eve also, whom I took out of his side; and I have driven them out of the garden; I have made them live in a land of sorrow and misery, because they transgressed against Me, and have obeyed Satan. And look, they are in suffering until this day, the eightieth.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|52:4: [But even in the face of these things will I speak.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:15: Then Elohim (God) said to me, 'Get up, go to them, and make them come to your place, and suffer not that Satan come near them, and afflict them. For they are now in great misery; and lie helpless from hunger.'
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:16: He further said to me, 'When you have taken them to yourself, give them to eat of the fruit of the Tree of Life, and give them to drink of the water of peace; and clothe them in a garment of light, and restore them to their former state of grace, and leave them not in misery, for they came from you. But grieve not over them, nor repent of that which has come over them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:17: But when I heard this, I was sorry; and my heart could not patiently bear it for your sake, O my child.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:18: But, O Adam, when I heard the name of Satan, I was afraid, and I said within myself, I will not come out because he might trap me as he did my children, Adam and Eve.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:19: And I said, 'O Elohim (God), when I go to my children, Satan will meet me in the way, and war against me, as he did against them.'
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:20: Then Elohim (God) said to me, 'Fear not; when you find him, hit him with the staff that is in thine hand, and don't be afraid of him, for you are of old standing, and he shall not prevail against you.'
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:21: Then I said, 'O my Lord, I am old, and cannot go. Send Your angels to bring them.'
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:22: But Elohim (God) said to me, 'Angels, verily, are not like them; and they will not consent to come with them. But I have chosen you, because they are your offspring and are like you, and they will listen to what you say.'
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:23: Elohim (God) said further to me, 'If you don't have enough strength to walk, I will send a cloud to carry you and set you down at the entrance of their cave; then the cloud will return and leave you there.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:24: And if they will come with you, I will send a cloud to carry you and them.'
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:25: Then He commanded a cloud, and it bear me up and brought me to you; and then went back.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:26: And now, O my children, Adam and Eve, look at my old gray hair and at my feeble state, and at my coming from that distant place. Come, come with me, to a place of rest."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:27: Then he began to cry and to sob before Adam and Eve, and his tears poured on the ground like water.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:28: And when Adam and Eve raised their eyes and saw his beard, and heard his sweet talk, their hearts softened towards him; they obeyed him, for they believed he was true.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|60:29: And it seemed to them that they were really his offspring, when they saw that his face was like their own; and they trusted him. * The existence of the two words helpmeet and helpmate, meaning exactly the same thing, is a comedy of errors. Elohim's (God's) promise to Adam, as rendered in the King James version of the Bible, was to give him an help meet for him (that is, a helper fit for him). In the 17th century the two words help and meet in this passage were mistaken for one word, applying to Eve, and thus helpmeet came to mean a wife. Then in the 18th century, in a misguided attempt to make sense of the word, the spelling helpmate was introduced. Both errors are now beyond recall, and both spellings are acceptable.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:1: Then he took Adam and Eve by the hand, and began to bring them out of the cave.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:2: But when they had come a little ways out of it, Elohim (God) knew that Satan had overcome them, and had brought them out before the forty days were ended, to take them to some distant place, and to destroy them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:3: Then the Word of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) again came and cursed Satan, and drove him away from them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:4: And Elohim (God) began to speak to Adam and Eve, saying to them, "What made you come out of the cave, to this place?"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:5: Then Adam said to Elohim (God), "Did you create a man before us? For when we were in the cave there suddenly came to us a friendly old man who said to us, 'I am a messenger from Elohim (God) to you, to bring you back to some place of rest.'
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:6: And we believed, O Elohim (God), that he was a messenger from you; and we came out with him; and knew not where we should go with him."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:7: Then Elohim (God) said to Adam, "See, that is the father of evil arts, who brought you and Eve out of the Garden of Delights. And now, indeed, when he saw that you and Eve both joined together in fasting and praying, and that you came not out of the cave before the end of the forty days, he wished to make your purpose vein, to break your mutual bond; to cut off all hope from you, and to drive you to some place where he might destroy you.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:8: Because he couldn't do anything to you unless he showed himself in the likeness of you.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:9: Therefore he came to you with a face like your own, and began to give you tokens as if they were all true.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:10: But because I am merciful and am favorable to you, I did not allow him to destroy you; instead I drove him away from you.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:11: Now, therefore, O Adam, take Eve, and return to your cave, and remain in it until the morning after the fortieth day. And when you come out, go towards the eastern gate of the garden."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:12: Then Adam and Eve worshipped Elohim (God), and praised and blessed Him for the deliverance that had come to them from Him. And they returned towards the cave. This happened in the evening of the thirty-ninth day.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:13: Then Adam and Eve stood up and with a fiery passion, prayed to Elohim (God), to give them strength; for they had become weak because of hunger and thirst and prayer. But they watched the whole of that night praying, until morning.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:14: Then Adam said to Eve, "Get up, let us go towards the eastern gate of the garden as Elohim (God) told us."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:15: And they said their prayers as they were accustomed to do every day; and they left the cave to go near to the eastern gate of the garden.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:16: Then Adam and Eve stood up and prayed, and appealed to Elohim (God) to strengthen them, and to send them something to satisfy their hunger.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:17: But after they finished their prayers, they were too weak to move.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:18: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) again, and said to them, "O Adam, get up, go and bring the two figs here."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|61:19: Then Adam and Eve got up, and went until they came near to the cave.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|62:1: But Satan the wicked was envious, because of the consolation Elohim (God) had given them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|62:2: So he prevented them, and went into the cave and took the two figs, and buried them outside the cave, so that Adam and Eve should not find them. He also had in his thoughts to destroy them.
live.apocalypse-of-abraham|apocalypse-of-abra: Behold, the gods of thy brother Ora, which stand in the holy temple, are more worthy of honour than these of thine.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|62:3: But by Elohim's (God's) mercy, as soon as those two figs were in the ground, Elohim (God) defeated Satan's counsel regarding them; and made them into two fruit trees, that overshadowed the cave. For Satan had buried them on the eastern side of it.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|62:4: Then when the two trees were grown, and were covered with fruit, Satan grieved and mourned, and said, "It would have been better to have left those figs where they were; for now, behold, they have become two fruit trees, whereof Adam will eat all the days of his life. Whereas I had in mind, when I buried them, to destroy them entirely, and to hide them forever.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|62:5: But Elohim (God) has overturned my counsel; and would not that this sacred fruit should perish; and He has made plain my intention, and has defeated the counsel I had formed against His servants."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|62:6: Then Satan went away ashamed because he hadn't thought his plans all the way through.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:1: But Adam and Eve, as they got closer to the cave, saw two fig trees, covered with fruit, and overshadowing the cave.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:2: Then Adam said to Eve, "It seems to me that we have gone the wrong way. When did these two trees grow here? It seems to me that the enemy wishes to lead us the wrong way. Do you suppose that there is another cave besides this one in the earth?
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:3: Yet, O Eve, let us go into the cave, and find in it the two figs; for this is our cave, in which we were. But if we should not find the two figs in it, then it cannot be our cave."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:4: They went then into the cave, and looked into the four corners of it, but found not the two figs.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:5: And Adam cried and said to Eve, "Did we go to the wrong cave, then, O Eve? It seems to me these two fig trees are the two figs that were in the cave." And Eve said, "I, for my part, do not know."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:6: Then Adam stood up and prayed and said, "O Elohim (God), You commanded us to come back to the cave, to take the two figs, and then to return to you.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:7: But now, we have not found them. O Elohim (God), have you taken them, and sown these two trees, or have we gone astray in the earth; or has the enemy deceived us? If it be real, then, O Elohim (God), reveal to us the secret of these two trees and of the two figs."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:8: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam, and said to him, "O Adam, when I sent you to fetch the figs, Satan went before you to the cave, took the figs, and buried them outside, eastward of the cave, thinking to destroy them; and not sowing them with good intent.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:9: Not for his mere sake, then, have these trees grown up at once; but I had mercy on you and I commanded them to grow. And they grew to be two large trees, that you be overshadowed by their branches, and find rest; and that I made you see My power and My marvelous works.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:10: And, also, to show you Satan's meanness, and his evil works, for ever since you came out of the garden, he has not ceased, no, not one day, from doing you some harm. But I have not given him power over you."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:11: And Elohim (God) said, "From now on, O Adam, rejoice on account of the trees, you and Eve; and rest under them when you feel weary. But do not eat any of their fruit or come near them."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:12: Then Adam cried, and said, "O Elohim (God), will You again kill us, or will You drive us away from before Your face, and cut our life from off the face of the earth?
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:13: O Elohim (God), I beg you, if You know that there be in these trees either death or some other evil, as at the first time, root them up from near our cave, and with them; and leave us to die of the heat, of hunger and of thirst.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|63:14: For we know Your marvelous works, O Elohim (God), that they are great, and that by Your power You can bring one thing out of another, without one's wish. For Your power can make rocks to become trees, and trees to become rocks."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|64:1: Then Elohim (God) looked at Adam and at his strength of mind, at his endurance of hunger and thirst, and of the heat. And He changed the two fig trees into two figs, as they were at first, and then said to Adam and to Eve, "Each of you may take one fig." And they took them, as Yahuah (Lord) commanded them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|64:2: And He said to them, "You must now go into the cave and eat the figs, and satisfy your hunger, or else you will die."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|64:3: So, as Elohim (God) commanded them, they went into the cave about sunset. And Adam and Eve stood up and prayed during the setting sun.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|64:4: Then they sat down to eat the figs; but they knew not how to eat them; for they were not accustomed to eat earthly food. They were afraid that if they ate, their stomach would be burdened and their flesh thickened, and their hearts would take to liking earthly food.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|64:5: But while they were thus seated, Elohim (God), out of pity for them, sent them His angel, so they wouldn't perish of hunger and thirst.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|64:6: And the angel said to Adam and Eve, "Elohim (God) says to you that you do not have the strength that would be required to fast until death; eat, therefore, and strengthen your bodies; for you are now animal flesh and cannot subsist without food and drink."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|64:7: Then Adam and Eve took the figs and began to eat of them. But Elohim (God) had put into them a mixture as of savory bread and blood.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|64:8: Then the angel went from Adam and Eve, who ate of the figs until they had satisfied their hunger. Then they put aside what was left; but by the power of Elohim (God), the figs became whole again, because Elohim (God) blessed them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|64:9: After this Adam and Eve got up, and prayed with a joyful heart and renewed strength, and praised and rejoiced abundantly the whole of that night. And this was the end of the eighty-third day.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|65:1: And when it was day, they got up and prayed, after their custom, and then went out of the cave.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|65:2: But they became sick from the food they had eaten because they were not used to it, so they went about in the cave saying to each other:--
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|65:3: "What has our eating caused to happen to us, that we should be in such pain? We are in misery, we shall die! It would have been better for us to have died keeping our bodies pure than to have eaten and defiled them with food."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|65:4: Then Adam said to Eve, "This pain did not come to us in the garden, neither did we eat such bad food there. Do you think, O Eve, that Elohim (God) will plague us through the food that is in us, or that our innards will come out; or that Elohim (God) means to kill us with this pain before He has fulfilled His promise to us?"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|65:5: Then Adam besought Yahuah (Lord) and said, "O Yahuah (Lord), let us not perish through the food we have eaten. O Yahuah (Lord), don't punish us; but deal with us according to Your great mercy, and forsake us not until the day of the promise You have made us."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|65:6: Then Elohim (God) looked at them, and then fitted them for eating food at once; as to this day; so that they should not perish.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|65:7: Then Adam and Eve came back into the cave sorrowful and crying because of the alteration of their bodies. And they both knew from that hour that they were altered beings, that all hope of returning to the garden was now lost; and that they could not enter it.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|65:8: For that now their bodies had strange functions; and all flesh that requires food and drink for its existence, cannot be in the garden.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|65:9: Then Adam said to Eve, "Behold, our hope is now lost; and so is our trust to enter the garden. We no longer belong to the inhabitants of the garden; but from now on we are earthy and of the dust, and of the inhabitants of the earth. We shall not return to the garden, until the day in which Elohim (God) has promised to save us, and to bring us again into the garden, as He promised us."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|65:10: Then they prayed to Elohim (God) that He would have mercy on them; after which, their mind was quieted, their hearts were broken, and their longing was cooled down; and they were like strangers on earth. That night Adam and Eve spent in the cave, where they slept heavily by reason of the food they had eaten.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|66:1: When it was morning, the day after they had eaten food, Adam and Eve prayed in the cave, and Adam said to Eve, "Look, we asked for food of Elohim (God), and He gave it. But now let us also ask Him to give us a drink of water."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|66:2: Then they got up, and went to the bank of the stream of water, that was on the south border of the garden, in which they had before thrown themselves. And they stood on the bank, and prayed to Elohim (God) that He would command them to drink of the water.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|66:3: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam, and said to him, "O Adam, your body has become brutish, and requires water to drink. Take some and drink it, you and Eve, then give thanks and praise."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|66:4: Adam and Eve then went down to the stream and drank from it, until their bodies felt refreshed. After having drunk, they praised Elohim (God), and then returned to their cave, after their former custom. This happened at the end of eighty-three days.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|66:5: Then on the eighty-fourth day, they took the two figs and hung them in the cave, together with the leaves thereof, to be to them a sign and a blessing from Elohim (God). And they placed them there so that if their descendants came there, they would see the wonderful things Elohim (God) had done for them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|66:6: Then Adam and Eve again stood outside the cave, and asked Elohim (God) to show them some food with which they could nourish their bodies.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|66:7: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came and said to him, "O Adam, go down to the westward of the cave until you come to a land of dark soil, and there you shall find food."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|66:8: And Adam obeyed the Word of Elohim (God), took Eve, and went down to a land of dark soil, and found there wheat* growing in the ear and ripe, and figs to eat; and Adam rejoiced over it.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|66:9: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came again to Adam, and said to him, "Take some of this wheat and make yourselves some bread with it, to nourish your body therewith." And Elohim (God) gave Adam's heart wisdom, to work out the corn until it became bread.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|66:10: Adam accomplished all that, until he grew very faint and weary. He then returned to the cave; rejoicing at what he had learned of what is done with wheat, until it is made into bread for one's use. * In this book, the terms 'corn' and 'wheat' are used interchangeably. The reference is possibly used to indicate a type of ancient grain resembling Egyptian Corn also known as Durra. Durra is a wheat-like cereal grain frequently cultivated in dry regions such as Egypt.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|67:1: When Adam and Eve went down to the land of black mud and came near to the wheat Elohim (God) had showed them and saw that it was ripe and ready for reaping, they did not have a sickle to reap it with. So they readied themselves, and began to pull up the wheat by hand, until it was all done.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|67:2: Then they heaped it into a pile; and, faint from heat and from thirst, they went under a shady tree, where the breeze fanned them to sleep.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|67:3: But Satan saw what Adam and Eve had done. And he called his hosts, and said to them, "Since Elohim (God) has shown to Adam and Eve all about this wheat, wherewith to strengthen their bodies--and, look, they have come and made a big pile of it, and faint from the toil are now asleep--come, let us set fire to this heap of corn, and burn it, and let us take that bottle of water that is by them, and empty it out, so that they may find nothing to drink, and we kill them with hunger and thirst.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|67:4: Then, when they wake up from their sleep, and seek to return to the cave, we will come to them in the way, and will lead them astray; so that they die of hunger and thirst; when they may, perhaps, deny Elohim (God), and He destroy them. So shall we be rid of them."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|67:5: Then Satan and his hosts set the wheat on fire and burned it up.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|67:6: But from the heat of the flame Adam and Eve awoke from their sleep, and saw the wheat burning, and the bucket of water by them, poured out.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|67:7: Then they cried and went back to the cave.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|67:8: But as they were going up from below the mountain where they were, Satan and his hosts met them in the form of angels, praising Elohim (God).
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|67:9: Then Satan said to Adam, "O Adam, why are you so pained with hunger and thirst? It seems to me that Satan has burnt up the wheat." And Adam said to him, "Yes."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|67:10: Again Satan said to Adam, "Come back with us; we are angels of Elohim (God). Elohim (God) sent us to you, to show you another field of corn, better than that; and beyond it is a fountain of good water, and many trees, where you shall live near it, and work the corn field to better purpose than that which Satan has consumed."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|67:11: Adam thought that he was true, and that they were angels who talked with him; and he went back with them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|67:12: Then Satan began to lead astray Adam and Eve eight days, until they both fell down as if dead, from hunger, thirst, and faintness. Then he fled with his hosts, and left them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:1: Then Elohim (God) looked at Adam and Eve, and at what had come over them from Satan, and how he had made them perish.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:2: Elohim (God), therefore, sent His Word, and raised up Adam and Eve from their state of death.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:3: Then, Adam, when he was raised, said, "O Elohim (God), You have burnt and taken from us the corn You have given us, and You have emptied out the bucket of water. And You have sent Your angels, who have caused us to lose our way from the corn field. Will You make us perish? If this be from you, O Elohim (God), then take away our souls; but punish us not."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:4: Then Elohim (God) said to Adam, "I did not burn down the wheat, and I did not pour the water out of the bucket, and I did not send My angels to lead you astray.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:5: But it is Satan, your master who did it; he to whom you have subjected yourself; my commandment being meanwhile set aside. He it is, who burnt down the corn, and poured out the water, and who has led you astray; and all the promises he has made you were just a trick, a deception, and a lie.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:6: But now, O Adam, you shall acknowledge My good deeds done to you."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:7: And Elohim (God) told His angels to take Adam and Eve, and to bear them up to the field of wheat, which they found as before, with the bucket full of water.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:8: There they saw a tree, and found on it solid manna; and wondered at Elohim's (God's) power. And the angels commanded them to eat of the manna when they were hungry.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:9: And Elohim (God) admonished Satan with a curse, not to come again, and destroy the field of corn.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:10: Then Adam and Eve took of the corn, and made of it an offering, and took it and offered it up on the mountain, the place where they had offered up their first offering of blood.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:11: And they offered this offering again on the altar they had built at first. And they stood up and prayed, and besought Yahuah (Lord) saying, "Thus, O Elohim (God), when we were in the garden, our praises went up to you, like this offering; and our innocence went up to you like incense. But now, O Elohim (God), accept this offering from us, and don't turn us away, deprived of Your mercy."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:12: Then Elohim (God) said to Adam and Eve, "Since you have made this offering and have offered it to Me, I shall make it My flesh, when I come down on earth to save you; and I shall cause it to be offered continually on an altar, for forgiveness and for mercy, for those who partake of it duly."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:13: And Elohim (God) sent a bright fire over the offering of Adam and Eve, and filled it with brightness, grace, and light; and the Ruach HaKodesh (Holy Spirit) came down on that offering.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:14: Then Elohim (God) commanded an angel to take fire tongs, like a spoon, and with it to take an offering and bring it to Adam and Eve. And the angel did so, as Elohim (God) had commanded him, and offered it to them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:15: And the souls of Adam and Eve were brightened, and their hearts were filled with joy and gladness and with the praises of Elohim (God).
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:16: And Elohim (God) said to Adam, "This shall be to you a custom, to do so, when affliction and sorrow come over you. But your deliverance and your entrance in to the garden, shall not be until the days are fulfilled as agreed between you and Me; were it not so, I would, of My mercy and pity for you, bring you back to My garden and to My favor for the sake of the offering you have just made to My name."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:17: Adam rejoiced at these words which he heard from Elohim (God); and he and Eve worshipped before the altar, to which they bowed, and then went back to the Cave of Treasures.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:18: And this took place at the end of the twelfth day after the eightieth day, from the time Adam and Eve came out of the garden.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:19: And they stood up the whole night praying until morning; and then went out of the cave.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:20: Then Adam said to Eve, with joy of heart, because of the offering they had made to Elohim (God), and that had been accepted of Him, "Let us do this three times every week, on the fourth day Wednesday, on the preparation day Friday, and on the Sabbath Sunday, all the days of our life."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:21: And as they agreed to these words between themselves, Elohim (God) was pleased with their thoughts, and with the resolution they had each taken with the other.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:22: After this, came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam, and said, "O Adam, you have determined beforehand the days in which sufferings shall come over Me, when I am made flesh; for they are the fourth Wednesday, and the preparation day Friday.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:23: But as to the first day, I created in it all things, and I raised the heavens. And, again, through My rising again on this day, will I create joy, and raise them on high, who believe in Me; O Adam, offer this offering, all the days of your life."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:24: Then Elohim (God) withdrew His Word from Adam.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|68:25: But Adam continued to offer this offering thus, every week three times, until the end of seven weeks. And on the first day, which is the fiftieth, Adam made an offering as he was accustomed, and he and Eve took it and came to the altar before Elohim (God), as He had taught them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|69:1: Then Satan, the hater of all good, envious of Adam and of his offering through which he found favor with Elohim (God), hastened and took a sharp stone from among the sharp iron stones; appeared in the form of a man, and went and stood by Adam and Eve.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|69:2: Adam was then offering on the altar, and had begun to pray, with his hands spread before Elohim (God).
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|69:3: Then Satan hastened with the sharp iron stone he had with him, and with it pierced Adam on the right side, from which flowed blood and water, then Adam fell on the altar like a corpse. And Satan fled.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|69:4: Then Eve came, and took Adam and placed him below the altar. And there she stayed, crying over him; while a stream of blood flowed from Adam's side over his offering.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|69:5: But Elohim (God) looked at the death of Adam. He then sent His Word, and raised him up and said to him, "Fulfil your offering, for indeed, Adam, it is worth much, and there is no shortcoming in it."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|69:6: Elohim (God) said further to Adam, "Thus will it also happen to Me, on the earth, when I shall be pierced and blood and water shall flow from My side and run over My body, which is the true offering; and which shall be offered on the altar as a perfect offering."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|69:7: Then Elohim (God) commanded Adam to finish his offering, and when he had ended it he worshipped before Elohim (God), and praised Him for the signs He had showed him.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|69:8: And Elohim (God) healed Adam in one day, which is the end of the seven weeks; and that is the fiftieth day.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|69:9: Then Adam and Eve returned from the mountain, and went into the Cave of Treasures, as they were used to do. This completed for Adam and Eve, one hundred and forty days since their coming out of the garden.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|69:10: Then they both stood up that night and prayed to Elohim (God). And when it was morning, they went out, and went down westward of the cave, to the place where their corn was, and there rested under the shadow of a tree, as they were accustomed.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|69:11: But when there a multitude of beasts came all around them. It was Satan's doing, in his wickedness; in order to wage war against Adam through marriage.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:1: After this Satan, the hater of all good, took the form of an angel, and with him two others, so that they looked like the three angels who had brought to Adam gold, incense, and myrrh.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:2: They passed before Adam and Eve while they were under the tree, and greeted Adam and Eve with fair words that were full of deceit.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:3: But when Adam and Eve saw their pleasant expression, and heard their sweet speech, Adam rose, welcomed them, and brought them to Eve, and they remained all together; Adam's heart the while, being glad because he thought concerning them, that they were the same angels, who had brought him gold, incense, and myrrh.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:4: Because, when they came to Adam the first time, there came over him from them, peace and joy, through their bringing him good tokens; so Adam thought that they had come a second time to give him other tokens for him to rejoice therewith. For he did not know it was Satan; therefore he received them with joy and consorted with them.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:5: Then Satan, the tallest of them, said, "Rejoice, O Adam, and be glad. Look, Elohim (God) has sent us to you to tell you something."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:6: And Adam said, "What is it?" Then Satan answered, "It is a simple thing, yet it is the Word of Elohim (God), will you accept it from us and do it? But if you will not accept it, we will return to Elohim (God), and tell Him that you would not receive His Word."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:7: And Satan said again to Adam, "Don't be afraid and don't tremble; don't you know us?"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:8: But Adam said, "I do not know you."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:9: Then Satan said to him, "I am the angel that brought you gold, and took it to the cave; this other angel is the one that brought you incense; and that third angel, is the one who brought you myrrh when you were on top of the mountain, and who carried you to the cave.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:10: But as to the other angels our fellows, who bare you to the cave, Elohim (God) has not sent them with us this time; for He said to us, 'You will be enough'."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:11: So when Adam heard these words he believed them, and said to these angels, "Speak the Word of Elohim (God), that I may receive it."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:12: And Satan said to him, "Swear, and promise me that you will receive it."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:13: Then Adam said, "I do not know how to swear and promise."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:14: And Satan said to him, "Hold out your hand, and put it inside my hand."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:15: Then Adam held out his hand, and put it into Satan's hand; when Satan said to him, "Say, now--So true as Elohim (God) is living, rational, and speaking, who raised the stars in heaven, and established the dry ground on the waters, and has created me out of the four elements*, and out of the dust of the earth--I will not break my promise, nor renounce my word."
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|70:17: Then Satan said to him, "Look, it is now some time since you came out of the garden, and you know neither wickedness nor evil. But now Elohim (God) says to you, to take Eve who came out of your side, and to marry her so that she will bear you children, to comfort you, and to drive from you trouble and sorrow; now this thing is not difficult, neither is there any scandal in it to you. * See the previous footnote in chapter XXXIV regarding the 'four elements'.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|71:1: But when Adam heard these words from Satan, he sorrowed much, because of his oath and of his promise, and said, "Shall I commit adultery with my flesh and my bones, and shall I sin against myself, for Elohim (God) to destroy me, and to blot me out from off the face of the earth?
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|71:2: Since, when at first, I ate of the tree, He drove me out of the garden into this strange land, and deprived me of my bright nature, and brought death over me. If, then, I should do this, He will cut off my life from the earth, and He will cast me into hell, and will plague me there a long time.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|71:3: But Elohim (God) never spoke the words that you have said; and you are not Elohim's (God's) angels, and you weren't sent from Him. But you are devils that have come to me under the false appearance of angels. Away from me; you cursed of Elohim (God)!"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|71:4: Then those devils fled from before Adam. And he and Eve got up, and returned to the Cave of Treasures, and went into it.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|71:5: Then Adam said to Eve, "If you saw what I did, don't tell anyone; for I sinned against Elohim (God) in swearing by His great name, and I have placed my hand another time into that of Satan." Eve, then, held her peace, as Adam told her.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|71:6: Then Adam got up, and spread his hands before Elohim (God), beseeching and entreating Him with tears, to forgive him what he had done. And Adam remained thus standing and praying forty days and forty nights. He neither ate nor drank until he dropped down on the ground from hunger and thirst.
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|71:7: Then Elohim (God) sent His Word to Adam, who raised him up from where he lay, and said to him, "O Adam, why have you sworn by My name, and why have you made agreement with Satan another time?"
live.adam-eve-conflict|1-adam-eve|71:8: But Adam cried, and said, "O Elohim (God), forgive me, for I did this unwittingly; believing they were Elohim's (God's) angels."
