live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|63:4: "Behold, for lo! Sennacherib is prepared to destroy us, and he will be boastful and uplifted when he has destroyed Zion."
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|63:5: And the Mighty One heard him, for Hezekiah was wise, And He had respect unto his prayer, because he was righteous.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|63:6: And thereupon the Mighty One commanded Ramiel His angel who speaks with thee.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|63:7: And I went forth and destroyed their multitude, the number of whose chiefs only was a hundred and eighty-five thousand, and each one of them had an equal number (at his command).
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|63:8: And at that time I burned their bodies within, but their raiment and arms I preserved outwardly, in order that the still more wonderful deeds of the Mighty One might appear, and that thereby His name might be spoken of throughout the whole earth.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|63:9: And Zion was saved and Jerusalem delivered: Yashar'el (Israel) also was freed from tribulation.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|63:10: And all those who were in the holy land rejoiced, and the name of the Mighty One was glorified so that it was spoken of.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|63:11: These are the bright waters which thou hast seen.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|64:1: 'And the black ninth waters which thou hast seen, this is all the wickedness which was in the days of Manasseh the son of Hezekiah.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|64:2: For he wrought much impiety, and he slew the righteous, and he wrested judgement, and he shed the blood of the innocent, and wedded women he violently polluted, and he overturned the altars, and destroyed their offerings, and drove forth their priests lest they should minister in the sanctuary.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|64:3: And he made an image with five faces: four of them looked to the four winds, and the fifth on the summit of the image as an adversary of the zeal of the Mighty One.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|64:4: And then wrath went forth from the presence of the Mighty One to the intent that Zion should be rooted out, as also it befell in your days.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|64:5: But also against the two tribes and a half went forth a decree that they should also be led away captive, as thou hast now seen.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|64:6: And to such a degree did the impiety of Manasseh increase, that it removed the praise of the El Elyon (Most High) from the sanctuary.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|64:7: On this account Manasseh was at that time named "the impious", and finally his abode was in the fire.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|64:8: For though his prayer was heard with the El Elyon (Most High), finally, when he was cast into the brazen horse and the brazen horse was melted, it served as a sign unto him for the hour.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|64:9: For he had not lived perfectly, for he was not worthy—but that thenceforward he might know by whom finally he should be tormented.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|64:10: For he who is able to benefit is also able to torment.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|65:1: 'Thus, moreover, did Manasseh act impiously, and thought that in his time the Mighty One would not inquire into these things.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|65:2: These are the black ninth waters which thou hast seen.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|66:1: 'And the bright tenth waters which thou hast seen: this is the purity of the generations of Josiah king of Yahudah (Judah), who was the only one at the time who submitted himself to the Mighty One with all his heart and with all his soul.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|66:2: And he cleansed the land from idols, and hallowed all the vessels which had been polluted, and restored the offerings to the altar, and raised the horn of the holy, and exalted the righteous, and honoured all that were wise in understanding, and brought back the priests to their ministry, and destroyed and removed the magicians and enchanters and necromancers from the land.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|66:3: And not only did he slay the impious that were living, but they also took from the sepulchres the bones of the dead and burned them with fire.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|66:4: [And the festivals and the sabbaths he established in their sanctity], and their polluted ones he burnt in the fire, and the lying prophets which deceived the people, these also he burnt in the fire, and the people who listened to them when they were living, he cast them into the brook Cedron, and heaped stones upon them.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|66:5: And he was zealous with zeal for the Mighty One with all his soul, and he alone was firm in the law at that time, so that he left none that was uncircumcised, or that wrought impiety in all the land, all the days of his life.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|66:6: Therefore he shall receive an eternal reward, and he shall be glorified with the Mighty One beyond many at a later time.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|66:7: For on his account and on account of those who are like him were the honourable glories, of which thou wast told before, created and prepared.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|66:8: These are the bright waters which thou hast seen.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|67:1: 'And the black eleventh waters which thou hast seen: this is the calamity which is now befalling Zion.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|67:2: Dost thou think that there is no anguish to the angels in the presence of the Mighty One, That Zion was so delivered up, And that lo! the Gentiles boast in their hearts, And assemble before their idols and say, "She is trodden down who ofttimes trod down, And she has been reduced to servitude who reduced (others)"?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|67:3: Dost thou think that in these things the El Elyon (Most High) rejoices, Or that His name is glorified?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|67:4: [But how will it serve towards His righteous judgement?]
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|67:5: Yet after these things shall the dispersed among the Gentiles be taken hold of by tribulation, And in shame shall they dwell in every place.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|67:6: Because so far as Zion is delivered up And Jerusalem laid waste, Shall idols prosper in the cities of the Gentiles, And the vapour of the smoke of the incense of the righteousness which is by the law is extinguished in Zion, And in the region of Zion in every place lo! there is the smoke of impiety.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|67:7: But the king of Babylon will arise who has now destroyed Zion, And he will boast over the people, And he will speak great things in his heart in the presence of the El Elyon (Most High).
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|67:8: But he also shall fall at last. These are the black waters.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|68:1: 'And the bright twelfth waters which thou hast seen: this is the word.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|68:2: For after these things a time will come when thy people shall fall into distress, so that they shall all run the risk of perishing together.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|68:3: Nevertheless, they will be saved, and their enemies will fall in their presence.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|68:4: And they will have in (due) time much joy.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|68:5: And at that time after a little interval Zion will again be builded, and its offerings will again be restored, and the priests will return to their ministry, and also the Gentiles will come to glorify it.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|68:6: Nevertheless, not fully as in the beginning.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|68:7: But it will come to pass after these things that there will be the fall of many nations.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|68:8: These are the bright waters which thou hast seen.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|69:1: 'For the last waters which thou hast seen which were darker than all that were before them, those which were after the twelfth number, which were collected together, belong to the whole world.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|69:2: For the El Elyon (Most High) made division from the beginning, because He alone knows what will befall.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|69:3: For as to the enormities and the impieties which should be wrought before Him, He foresaw six kinds of them.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|69:4: And of the good works of the righteous which should be accomplished before Him, He foresaw six kinds of them, beyond those which He should work at the consummation of the age.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|69:5: On his account there were not black waters with black, nor bright with bright; for it is the consummation.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|70:1: 'Hear therefore the interpretation of the last black waters which are to come [after the black]: this is the word.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|70:2: Behold! the days come, and it shall be when the time of the age has ripened, And the harvest of its evil and good seeds has come, That the Mighty One will bring upon the earth and its inhabitants and upon its rulers Perturbation of spirit and stupor of heart.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|70:3: And they shall hate one another, And provoke one another to fight, And the mean shall rule over the honourable, And those of low degree shall be extolled above the famous.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|70:4: And the many shall be delivered into the hands of the few, And those who were nothing shall rule over the strong, And the poor shall have abundance beyond the rich, And the impious shall exalt themselves above the heroic.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|70:5: And the wise shall be silent, And the foolish shall speak, Neither shall the thought of men be then confirmed, Nor the counsel of the mighty, Nor shall the hope of those who hope be confirmed.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|70:6: And when those things which were predicted have come to pass, Then shall confusion fall upon all men, And some of them shall fall in battle, And some of them shall perish in anguish,
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|70:7: And some of them shall be destroyed by their own. Then the El Elyon (Most High) will reveal those peoples whom He has prepared before, And they shall come and make war with the leaders that shall then be left.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|70:8: And it shall come to pass that whosoever gets safe out of the war shall die in the earthquake, And whosoever gets safe out of the earthquake shall be burned by the fire, And whosoever gets safe out of the fire shall be destroyed by famine.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|70:9: [And it shall come to pass that whosoever of the victors and the vanquished gets safe out of and escapes all these things aforesaid will be delivered into the hands of My servant Messiah.]
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|70:10: For all the earth shall devour its inhabitants.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|71:1: 'And the holy land shall have mercy on its own, And it shall protect its inhabiters at that time.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|71:2: This is the vision which thou hast seen, and this is the interpretation.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|71:3: For I have come to tell thee these things, because thy prayer has been heard with the El Elyon (Most High).
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|72:1: 'Hear now also regarding the bright lightning which is to come at the consummation after these black (waters): this is the word.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|72:2: After the signs have come, of which thou wast told before, when the nations become turbulent, and the time of My Messiah is come, he shall both summon all the nations, and some of them he shall spare, and some of them he shall slay.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|72:3: These things therefore shall come upon the nations which are to be spared by Him.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|72:4: Every nation, which knows not Yashar'el (Israel) and has not trodden down the seed of Jacob, shall indeed be spared.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|72:5: And this because some out of every nation shall be subjected to thy people.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|73:1: 'And it shall come to pass, when He has brought low everything that is in the world, And has sat down in peace for the age on the throne of His kingdom, That joy shall then be revealed, And rest shall appear.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|73:2: And then healing shall descend in dew, And disease shall withdraw, And anxiety and anguish and lamentation pass from amongst men, And gladness proceed through the whole earth.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|73:3: And no one shall again die untimely, Nor shall any adversity suddenly befall.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|73:4: And judgements, and revilings, and contentions, and revenges, And blood, and passions, and envy, and hatred, And whatsoever things are like these shall go into condemnation when they are removed.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|73:5: For it is these very things which have filled this world with evils, And on account of these the life of man has been greatly troubled.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|73:6: And wild beasts shall come from the forest and minister unto men, And asps and dragons shall come forth from their holes to submit themselves to a little child.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|73:7: And women shall no longer then have pain when they bear, Nor shall they suffer torment when they yield the fruit of the womb.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|74:1: 'And it shall come to pass in those days that the reapers shall not grow weary, Nor those that build be toilworn; For the works shall of themselves speedily advance Together with those who do them in much tranquillity.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|74:2: For that time is the consummation of that which is corruptible, And the beginning of that which is not corruptible.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|74:3: Therefore those things which were predicted shall belong to it: Therefore it is far away from evils, and near to those things which die not.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|74:4: This is the bright lightning which came after the last dark waters.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|75:1: And I answered and said: 'Who can understand, O Yahuah (Lord), Thy goodness? For it is incomprehensible.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|75:2: Or who can search into thy compassions, Which are infinite?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|75:3: Or who can comprehend Thy intelligence?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|75:4: Or who is able to recount the thoughts of Thy mind?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|75:5: Or who of those who are born can hope to come to those things, Unless he is one to whom Thou art merciful and gracious?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|75:6: Because, if assuredly Thou didst not have compassion on man, Those who are under Thy right hand, They could not come to those things, But those who are in the numbers named can be called.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|75:7: But if, indeed, we who exist know wherefore we have come, And submit ourselves to Him who brought us out of Egypt, We shall come again and remember those things which have passed, And shall rejoice regarding that which has been.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|75:8: But if now we know not wherefore we have come, And recognize not the principate of Him who brought us up out of Egypt, We shall come again and seek after those things which have been now, And be grieved with pain because of those things which have befallen.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|76:1: And He answered and said unto me: ['Inasmuch as the revelation of this vision has been interpreted to thee as thou besoughtest], hear the word of the El Elyon (Most High) that thou mayst know what is to befall thee after these things.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|76:2: For thou shalt surely depart from this earth, nevertheless not unto death, but thou shalt be preserved unto the consummation of the times.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|76:3: Go up therefore to the top of that mountain, and there shall pass before thee all the regions of that land, and the figure of the inhabited world, and the top(s) of the mountains, and the depth(s) of the valleys, and the depths of the seas, and the number of the rivers, that thou mayst see what thou art leaving, and whither thou art going.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|76:4: Now this shall befall after forty days. Go now therefore during these days and instruct the people so far as thou art able, that they may learn so as not to die at the last time, but may learn in order that they may live at the last times.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:1: And I, Baruch, went thence and came to the people, and assembled them together from the greatest to the least, and said unto them:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:2: 'Hear, ye children of Yashar'el (Israel), behold how many ye are who remain of the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:3: For to you and to your fathers Yahuah (Lord) gave a law more excellent than to all peoples.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:4: And because your brethren transgressed the commandments of the El Elyon (Most High), He brought vengeance upon you and upon them, And He spared not the former, And the latter also He gave into captivity: And He left not a residue of them, But behold! ye are here with me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:6: If, therefore, ye direct your ways aright, Ye also shall not depart as your brethren departed, But they shall come to you.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:7: For He is merciful whom ye worship, And He is gracious in whom ye hope, And He is true, so that He shall do good and not evil.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:8: Have ye not seen here what has befallen Zion?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:9: Or do ye perchance think that the place had sinned, And that on this account it was overthrown? Or that the land had wrought foolishness, And that therefore it was delivered up?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:10: And know ye not that on account of you who did sin, That which sinned not was overthrown, And, on account of those who wrought wickedly, That which wrought not foolishness was delivered up to (its) enemies?'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:11: And the whole people answered and said unto me: 'So far as we can recall the good things which the Mighty One has done unto us, we do recall them; and those things which we do not remember He in His mercy knows.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:12: Nevertheless, do this for us thy people: write also to our brethren in Babylon an epistle of doctrine and a scroll of hope, that thou mayst confirm them also before thou dost depart from us.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:13: For the shepherds of Yashar'el (Israel) have perished, And the lamps which gave light are extinguished, And the fountains have withheld their stream whence we used to drink.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:14: And we are left in the darkness, And amid the [trees of the forest], And the thirst of the wilderness.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:15: And I answered and said unto them: 'Shepherds and lamps and fountains come from the law: And though we depart, yet the law abideth.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:16: If therefore ye have respect to the law, And are intent upon wisdom, A lamp will not be wanting, And a shepherd will not fail, And a fountain will not dry up.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:17: Nevertheless, as ye said unto me, I will write also unto your brethren in Babylon, and I will send by means of men, and I will write in like manner to the nine tribes and a half, and send by means of a bird.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:18: And it came to pass on the one and twentieth day in the eighth month that I, Baruch, came and sat down under the oak under the shadow of the branches, and no man was with me, but I was alone.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:19: And I wrote these two epistles: one I sent by an eagle to the nine and a half tribes; and the other I sent to those that were at Babylon by means of three men.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:20: And I called the eagle and spake these words unto it:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:21: 'The El Elyon (Most High) hath made thee that thou shouldst be higher than all birds.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:22: And now go and tarry not in (any) place, nor enter a nest, nor settle upon any tree, till thou hast passed over the breadth of the many waters of the river Euphrates, and hast gone to the people that dwell there, and cast down to them this epistle.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:23: Remember, moreover, that, at the time of the deluge, Noah received from a dove the fruit of the olive, when he sent it forth from the ark.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:24: Yea, also the ravens ministered to Elijah, bearing him food, as they had been commanded.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:25: Solomon also, in the time of his kingdom, whithersoever he wished to send or seek for anything, commanded a bird (to go thither), and it obeyed him as he commanded it.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|77:26: And now let it not weary thee, and turn not to the right hand nor the left, but fly and go by a direct way, that thou mayst preserve the command of the Mighty One, according as I said unto thee.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|78:1: These are the words of that epistle which Baruch the son of Neriah sent to the nine and a half tribes, which were across the river Euphrates, in which these things were written.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|78:2: Thus saith Baruch the son of Neriah to the brethren carried into captivity: 'Mercy and peace. I bear in mind, my brethren, the love of Him who created us, who loved us from of old, and never hated us, but above all educated us.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|78:3: And truly I know that behold all we the twelve tribes are bound by one bond, inasmuch as we are born from one father.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|78:4: Wherefore I have been the more careful to leave you the words of this epistle before I die, that ye may be comforted regarding the evils which have come upon you, and that ye may be grieved also regarding the evil that has befallen your brethren; and again, also, that ye may justify His judgement which He has decreed against you that ye should be carried away captive—for what ye have suffered is disproportioned to what ye have done—in order
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|78:5: that, at the last times, ye may be found worthy of your fathers.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|78:6: Therefore, if ye consider that ye have now suffered those things for your good, that ye may not finally be condemned and tormented, then ye will receive eternal hope; if above all ye destroy from your heart vain error, on account of which ye departed hence.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|78:7: For if ye so do these things, He will continually remember you, He who always promised on our behalf to those who were more excellent than we, that He will never forget or forsake us, but with much mercy will gather together again those who were dispersed.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|79:1: Now, my brethren, learn first what befell Zion: how that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up against us.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|79:2: For we have sinned against Him who made us, and we have not kept the commandments which he commanded us, yet he hath not chastened us as we deserved.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|79:3: For what befell you we also suffer in a pre-eminent degree, for it befell us also.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|80:1: And now, my brethren, I make known unto you that when the enemy had surrounded the city, the angels of the El Elyon (Most High) were sent, and they overthrew the fortifications of the strong wall, and they destroyed the firm iron corners, which could not be rooted out.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|80:2: Nevertheless, they hid all the vessels of the sanctuary, lest the enemy should get possession of them.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|80:3: And when they had done these things, they delivered thereupon to the enemy the overthrown wall, and the plundered house, and the burnt temple, and the people who were overcome because they were delivered up, lest the enemy should boast and say: 'Thus by force have we been able to lay waste even the house of the El Elyon (Most High) in war.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|80:4: Your brethren also have they bound and led away to Babylon, and have caused them to dwell there.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|80:5: But we have been left here, being very few.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|80:6: This is the tribulation about which I wrote to you.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|80:7: For assuredly I know that (the consolation of) the inhabitants of Zion consoleth you: so far as ye knew that it was prospered (your consolation) was greater than the tribulation which ye endured in having to depart from it.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|81:1: But regarding consolation, hear ye the word.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|81:2: For I was mourning regarding Zion, and I prayed for mercy from the El Elyon (Most High), and I said:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|81:3: 'How long will these things endure for us? And will these evils come upon us always?'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|81:4: And the Mighty One did according to the multitude of His mercies, And the El Elyon (Most High) according to the greatness of His compassion, And He revealed unto me the word, that I might receive consolation, And He showed me visions that I should not again endure anguish, And He made known to me the mystery of the times, And the advent of the hours he showed me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|82:1: Therefore, my brethren, I have written to you, that ye may comfort yourselves regarding the multitude of your tribulations.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|82:2: For know ye that our Maker will assuredly avenge us on all our enemies, according to all that they have done to us, also that the consummation which the El Elyon (Most High) will make is very nigh, and His mercy that is coming, and the consummation of His judgement, is by no means far off.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|82:3: For lo! we see now the multitude of the prosperity of the Gentiles, Though they act impiously, But they shall be like a vapour:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|82:4: And we behold the multitude of their power, Though they do wickedly, But they shall be made like unto a drop:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|82:5: And we see the firmness of their might, Though they resist the Mighty One every hour, But they shall be accounted as spittle.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|82:6: And we consider the glory of their greatness, Though they do not keep the statutes of the El Elyon (Most High), But as smoke shall they pass away.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|82:7: And we meditate on the beauty of their gracefulness, Though they have to do with pollutions, But as grass that withers shall they fade away.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|82:8: And we consider the strength of their cruelty, Though they remember not the end (thereof), But as a wave that passes shall they be broken.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|82:9: And we remark the boastfulness of their might, Though they deny the beneficence of Elohim (God), who gave (it) to them, But they shall pass away as a passing cloud.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:1: [For the El Elyon (Most High) will assuredly hasten His times, And He will assuredly bring on His hours.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:2: And He will assuredly judge those who are in His world, And will visit in truth all things by means of all their hidden works.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:3: And He will assuredly examine the secret thoughts, And that which is laid up in the secret chambers of all the members of man, And will make (them) manifest in the presence of all with reproof.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:4: Let none therefore of these present things ascend into your hearts, but above all let us be expectant, because that which is promised to us shall come.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:5: And let us not now look unto the delights of the Gentiles in the present, but let us remember what has been promised to us in the end.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:6: For the ends of the times and of the seasons and whatsoever is with them shall assuredly pass by together.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:7: The consummation, moreover, of the age shall then show the great might of its ruler, when all things come to judgement.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:8: Do ye therefore prepare your hearts for that which before ye believed, lest ye come to be in bondage in both worlds, so that ye be led away captive here and be tormented there.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:9: For that which exists now or which has passed away, or which is to come, in all these things, neither is the evil fully evil, nor again the good fully good.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:10: For all healthinesses of this time are turning into diseases,
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:11: And all might of this time is turning into weakness, And all the force of this time is turning into impotence,
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:12: And every energy of youth is turning into old age and consummation, And every beauty of gracefulness of this time is turning faded and hateful,
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:13: And every proud dominion of the present is turning into humiliation and shame,
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:14: And every praise of the glory of this time is turning into the shame of silence, And every vain splendour and insolence of this time is turning into voiceless ruin.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:15: And every delight and joy of this time is turning to worms and corruption,
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:16: And every clamour of the pride of this time is turning into dust and stillness.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:17: And every possession of riches of this time is being turned into Sheol alone,
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:18: And all the rapine of passion of this time is turning into involuntary death, And every passion of the lusts of this time is turning into a judgement of torment.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:19: And every artifice and craftiness of this time is turning into a proof of the truth,
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:20: And every sweetness of unguents of this time is turning into judgement and condemnation,
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:21: And every love of lying is turning to contumely through truth.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|83:22: Since therefore all these things are done now, does anyone think that they will not be avenged? But the consummation of all things will come to the truth.]
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|84:1: Behold! I have therefore made known unto you (these things) whilst I live; for I have said (it) that ye should learn the things that are excellent; for the Mighty One hath commanded me to instruct you: and I will set before you some of the commandments of His judgement before I die.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|84:2: Remember that formerly Moses assuredly called heaven and earth to witness against you and said: 'If ye transgress the law ye shall be dispersed, but if ye keep it ye shall be kept.'
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|84:3: And other things also he used to say unto you when ye the twelve tribes were together in the desert.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|84:4: And after his death ye cast them away from you: on this account there came upon you what had been predicted.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|84:5: And now Moses used to tell you before they befell you, and lo! they have befallen you: for ye have forsaken the law.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|84:6: Lo! I also say unto you after ye have suffered, that if ye obey those things which have been said unto you, ye will receive from the Mighty One whatever has been laid up and reserved for you.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|84:7: Moreover, let this epistle be for a testimony between me and you, that ye may remember the commandments of the Mighty One, and that also there may be to me a defence in the presence of Him who sent me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|84:8: And remember ye the law and Zion, and the holy land and your brethren, and the covenant of your fathers, and forget not the festivals and the sabbaths.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|84:9: And deliver ye this epistle and the traditions of the law to your sons after you, as also your fathers delivered (them) to you.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|84:10: And at all times make request perseveringly and pray diligently with your whole heart that the Mighty One may be reconciled to you, and that He may not reckon the multitude of your sins, but remember the rectitude of your fathers.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|84:11: For if He judge us not according to the multitude of His mercies, woe unto all us who are born.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:1: Know ye, moreover, that in former times and in the generations of old our fathers had helpers, Righteous men and holy prophets:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:2: Nay more, we were in our own land, [And they helped us when we sinned], And they interceded for us with Him who made us, Because they trusted in their works], And the Mighty One heard their prayer and forgave us.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:3: But now the righteous have been gathered, And the prophets have fallen asleep, And we also have gone forth from the land, And Zion has been taken from us, And we have nothing now save the Mighty One and His law.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:4: If therefore we direct and dispose our hearts, We shall receive everything that we lost, And much better things than we lost by many times.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:5: For what we have lost was subject to corruption, And what we shall receive shall not be corruptible.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:6: [Moreover, also, I have written thus to our brethren to Babylon, that to them also I may attest these very things.]
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:7: And let all those things aforesaid be always before your eyes, Because we are still in the spirit and the power of our liberty.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:8: Again, moreover, the El Elyon (Most High) also is long-suffering towards us here, And He hath shown to us that which is to be, And hath not concealed from us what will befall in the end.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|8:1: And those men took me thence, and led me up on to the third heaven, and placed me there; and I looked downwards, and saw the produce of these places, such as has never been known for goodness.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:9: Before therefore judgement exact its own, And truth that which is its due, Let us prepare our soul That we may possess, and not be taken possession of, And that we may hope and not be put to shame, And that we may rest with our fathers, and not be tormented with our enemies.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:10: For the youth of the world is past, And the strength of the creation already exhausted, And the advent of the times is very short, Yea, they have passed by; And the pitcher is near to the cistern, And the ship to the port, And the course of the journey to the city, And life to (its) consummation.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:11: And again prepare your souls, so that when ye sail and ascend from the ship ye may have rest and not be condemned when ye depart.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:12: For lo! when the El Elyon (Most High) will bring to pass all these things, There shall not there be again [a place of repentance, nor] a limit to the times, Nor a duration for the hours, Nor a change of ways, Nor place for prayer, Nor sending of petitions, Nor receiving of knowledge, Nor giving of love, Nor place of repentance for the soul, Nor supplication for offences, Nor intercession of the fathers, Nor prayer of the prophets, Nor help of the righteous.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:13: There there is the sentence of corruption, The way of fire, And the path which bringeth to Gehenna.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:14: On this account there is one law by one, One age and an end for all who are in it.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|85:15: Then He will preserve those whom He can forgive, And at the same time destroy those who are polluted with sins.]
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|86:1: When therefore ye receive this my epistle, read it in your congregations with care.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|86:2: And meditate thereon, above all on the days of your fasts.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|86:3: And bear me in mind by means of this epistle, as I also bear you in mind in it, and always. Fare ye well.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-baruch|87:1: And it came to pass when I had ended all the words of this epistle, and had written it sedulously to its close, that I folded it, and sealed it carefully, and bound it to the neck of the eagle, and dismissed and sent it.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|1:1: There was a wise man, a great artificer, and Yahuah (Lord) conceived love for him and received him, that he should behold the uppermost dwellings and be an eye-witness of the wise and great and inconceivable and immutable realm of El Shaddai (God Almighty), of the very wonderful and glorious and bright and many-eyed station of Yahuah's (Lord’s) servants, and of the inaccessible throne of Yahuah (Lord), and of the degrees and manifestations of the incorporeal hosts, and of the ineffable ministration of the multitude of the elements, and of the various apparition and inexpressible singing of the host of Cherubim, and of the boundless light.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|1:2: At that time, he said, when my one hundred and sixty-fifth year was completed, I begat my son Mathusal.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|1:3: After this too I lived two hundred years and completed of all the years of my life three hundred and sixty-five years.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|1:4: On the first day of the month I was in my house alone and was resting on my bed and slept.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|1:5: And when I was asleep, great distress came up into my heart, and I was weeping with my eyes in sleep, and I could not understand what this distress was, or what would happen to me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|1:6: And there appeared to me two men, exceeding big, so that I never saw such on earth; their faces were shining like the sun, their eyes too were like a burning light, and from their lips was fire coming forth with clothing and singing of various kinds in appearance purple, their wings were brighter than gold, their hands whiter than snow.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|1:7: They were standing at the head of my bed and began to call me by my name.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|1:8: And I arose from my sleep and saw clearly those two men standing in front of me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|1:9: And I saluted them and was seized with fear and the appearance of my face was changed from terror, and those men said to me:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|1:10: Have courage, Enoch, do not fear; the eternal Elohim (God) sent us to you, and lo! You shalt to-day ascend with us into heaven, and you shall tell your sons and all your household all that they shall do without you on earth in your house, and let no one seek you till Yahuah (Lord) return you to them.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|1:11: And I made haste to obey them and went out from my house, and made to the doors, as it was ordered me, and summoned my sons Mathusal and Regim and Gaidad and made known to them all the marvels those men had told me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|2:1: Listen to me, my children, I know not whither I go, or what will befall me; now therefore, my children, I tell you: turn not from Elohim (God) before the face of the vain, who made not Heaven and earth, for these shall perish and those who worship them, and may Yahuah (Lord) make confident your hearts in the fear of him. And now, my children, let no one think to seek me, until Yahuah (Lord) return me to you.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|3:1: It came to pass, when Enoch had told his sons, that the angels took him on to their wings and bore him up on to the first heaven and placed him on the clouds. And there I looked, and again I looked higher, and saw the ether, and they placed me on the first heaven and showed me a very great Sea, greater than the earthly sea.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|4:1: They brought before my face the elders and rulers of the stellar orders, and showed me two hundred angels, who rule the stars and their services to the heavens, and fly with their wings and come round all those who sail.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|5:1: And here I looked down and saw the treasure-houses of the snow, and the angels who keep their terrible store-houses, and the clouds whence they come out and into which they go.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|6:1: They showed me the treasure-house of the dew, like oil of the olive, and the appearance of its form, as of all the flowers of the earth; further many angels guarding the treasure-houses of these things, and how they are made to shut and open.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|7:1: And those men took me and led me up on to the second heaven, and showed me darkness, greater than earthly darkness, and there I saw prisoners hanging, watched, awaiting the great and boundless judgment, and these angels were dark-looking, more than earthly darkness, and incessantly making weeping through all hours.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|7:2: And I said to the men who were with me: Wherefore are these incessantly tortured? They answered me: These are Elohim's (God’s) apostates, who obeyed not Elohim's (God’s) commands, but took counsel with their own will, and turned away with their prince, who also is fastened on the fifth heaven.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|7:3: And I felt great pity for them, and they saluted me, and said to me: Man of Elohim (God), pray for us to Yahuah (Lord); and I answered to them: Who am I, a mortal man, that I should pray for angels? Who knows whither I go, or what will befall me? Or who will pray for me?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|32:1: I said to him: Earth you are, and into the earth whence I took you you shalt go, and I will not ruin you, but send you whence I took you.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|8:2: And I saw all the sweet-flowering trees and beheld their fruits, which were sweet-smelling, and all the foods borne by them bubbling with fragrant exhalation.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|8:3: And in the midst of the trees that of life, in that place whereon Yahuah (Lord) rests, when he goes up into paradise; and this tree is of ineffable goodness and fragrance, and adorned more than every existing thing; and on all sides it is in form gold-looking and vermilion and fire-like and covers all, and it has produce from all fruits.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|8:4: Its root is in the garden at the earth’s end.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|8:5: And paradise is between corruptibility and incorruptibility.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|8:6: And two springs come out which send forth honey and milk, and their springs send forth oil and wine, and they separate into four parts, and go round with quiet course, and go down into the PARADISE OF EDEN, between corruptibility and incorruptibility.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|8:7: And thence they go forth along the earth, and have a revolution to their circle even as other elements.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|8:8: And here there is no unfruitful tree, and every place is blessed.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|8:9: And there are three hundred angels very bright, who keep the garden, and with incessant sweet singing and never-silent voices serve Yahuah (Lord) throughout all days and hours.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|8:10: And I said: How very sweet is this place, and those men said to me:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|9:1: This place, O Enoch, is prepared for the righteous, who endure all manner of offence from those that exasperate their souls, who avert their eyes from iniquity, and make righteous judgment, and give bread to the hungering, and cover the naked with clothing, and raise up the fallen, and help injured orphans, and who walk without fault before the face of Yahuah (Lord), and serve him alone, and for them is prepared this place for eternal inheritance.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|10:1: And those two men led me up on to the Northern side, and showed me there a very terrible place, and there were all manner of tortures in that place: cruel darkness and unillumined gloom, and there is no light there, but murky fire constantly flaming aloft, and there is a fiery river coming forth, and that whole place is everywhere fire, and everywhere there is frost and ice, thirst and shivering, while the bonds are very cruel, and the angels fearful and merciless, bearing angry weapons, merciless torture, and I said:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|10:2: Woe, woe, how very terrible is this place.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|10:3: And those men said to me: This place, O Enoch, is prepared for those who dishonour Elohim (God), who on earth practice sin against nature, which is child-corruption after the sodomitic fashion, magic-making, enchantments and devilish witchcrafts, and who boast of their wicked deeds, stealing, lies, calumnies, envy, rancour, fornication, murder, and who, accursed, steal the souls of men, who, seeing the poor take away their goods and themselves wax rich, injuring them for other men’s goods; who being able to satisfy the empty, made the hungering to die; being able to clothe, stripped the naked; and who knew not their creator, and bowed to the soulless and lifeless gods, who cannot see nor hear, vain gods, who also built hewn images and bow down to unclean handiwork, for all these is prepared this place among these, for eternal inheritance.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|11:1: Those men took me, and led me up on to the fourth heaven, and showed me all the successive goings, and all the rays of the light of sun and moon.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|11:2: And I measure their goings, and compared their light, and saw that the sun’s light is greater than the moon’s.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|11:3: Its circle and the wheels on which it goes always, like the wind going past with very marvellous speed, and day and night it has no rest.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|11:4: Its passage and return are accompanied by four great stars, and each star has under it a thousand stars, to the right of the sun’s wheel, and by four to the left, each having under it a thousand stars, altogether eight thousand, issuing with the sun continually.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|11:5: And by day fifteen myriads of angels attend it, and by night a thousand.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|11:6: And six-winged ones issue with the angels before the sun’s wheel into the fiery flames, and a hundred angels kindle the sun and set it alight.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|12:1: And I looked and saw other flying elements of the sun, whose names are Phoenixes and Chalkydri, marvellous and wonderful, with feet and tails in the form of a lion, and a crocodile’s head, their appearance is empurpled, like the rainbow; their size is nine hundred measures, their wings are like those of angels, each has twelve, and they attend and accompany the sun, bearing heat and dew, as it is ordered them from Elohim (God).
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|12:2: Thus the sun revolves and goes, and rises under the heaven, and its course goes under the earth with the light of its rays incessantly.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|13:1: Those men bore me away to the east, and placed me at the sun’s gates, where the sun goes forth according to the regulation of the seasons and the circuit of the months of the whole year, and the number of the hours day and night.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|13:2: And I saw six gates open, each gate having sixty-one stadia and a quarter of one stadium, and I measured them truly, and understood their size to be so much, through which the sun goes forth, and goes to the west, and is made even, and rises throughout all the months, and turns back again from the six gates according to the succession of the seasons; thus the period of the whole year is finished after the returns of the four seasons.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|14:1: And again those men led me away to the western parts, and showed me six great gates open corresponding to the eastern gates, opposite to where the sun sets, according to the number of the days three hundred and sixty-five and a quarter.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|14:2: Thus again it goes down to the western gates, and draws away its light, the greatness of its brightness, under the earth; for since the crown of its shining is in heaven with Yahuah (Lord), and guarded by four hundred angels, while the sun goes round on wheel under the earth, and stands seven great hours in night, and spends half its course under the earth, when it comes to the eastern approach in the eighth hour of the night, it brings its lights, and the crown of shining, and the sun flames forth more than fire.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|15:1: Then the elements of the sun, called Phoenixes and Chalkydri break into song, therefore every bird flutters with its wings, rejoicing at the giver of light, and they broke into song at the command of Yahuah (Lord).
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|15:2: The giver of light comes to give brightness to the whole world, and the morning guard takes shape, which is the rays of the sun, and the sun of the earth goes out, and receives its brightness to light up the whole face of the earth, and they showed me this calculation of the sun’s going.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|15:3: And the gates which it enters, these are the great gates of the calculation of the hours of the year; for this reason the sun is a great creation, whose circuit lasts twenty-eight years, and begins again from the beginning.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|16:1: Those men showed me the other course, that of the moon, twelve great gates, crowned from west to east, by which the moon goes in and out of the customary times.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|16:2: It goes in at the first gate to the western places of the sun, by the first gates with thirty-one days exactly, by the second gates with thirty-one days exactly, by the third with thirty days exactly, by the fourth with thirty days exactly, by the fifth with thirty-one days exactly, by the sixth with thirty-one days exactly, by the seventh with thirty days exactly, by the eighth with thirty-one days perfectly, by the ninth with thirty-one days exactly, by the tenth with thirty days perfectly, by the eleventh with thirty-one days exactly, by the twelfth with twenty-eight days exactly.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|16:3: And it goes through the western gates in the order and number of the eastern, and accomplishes the three hundred and sixty-five and a quarter days of the solar year, while the lunar year has three hundred fifty-four, and there are wanting to it twelve days of the solar circle, which are the lunar epacts of the whole year.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|16:4: Thus, too, the great circle contains five hundred and thirty-two years.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|16:5: The quarter of a day is omitted for three years, the fourth fulfills it exactly.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|16:6: Therefore they are taken outside of heaven for three years and are not added to the number of days, because they change the time of the years to two new months towards completion, to two others towards diminution.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|16:7: And when the western gates are finished, it returns and goes to the eastern to the lights, and goes thus day and night about the heavenly circles, lower than all circles, swifter than the heavenly winds, and spirits and elements and angels flying; each angel has six wings.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|16:8: It has a sevenfold course in nineteen years.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|17:1: In the midst of the heavens I saw armed soldiers, serving Yahuah (Lord), with tympana and organs, with incessant voice, with sweet voice, with sweet and incessant voice and various singing, which it is impossible to describe, and which astonishes every mind, so wonderful and marvellous is the singing of those angels, and I was delighted listening to it.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|18:1: The men took me on to the fifth heaven and placed me, and there I saw many and countless soldiers, called Grigori, of human appearance, and their size was greater than that of great giants and their faces withered, and the silence of their mouths perpetual, and their was no service on the fifth heaven, and I said to the men who were with me:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|18:2: Wherefore are these very withered and their faces melancholy, and their mouths silent, and wherefore is there no service on this heaven?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|18:3: And they said to me: These are the Grigori, who with their prince Satanail rejected Yahuah (Lord) of light, and after them are those who are held in great darkness on the second heaven, and three of them went down on to earth from Yahuah's (Lord’s) throne, to the place Ermon, and broke through their vows on the shoulder of the hill Ermon and saw the daughters of men how good they are, and took to themselves wives, and befouled the earth with their deeds, who in all times of their age made lawlessness and mixing, and giants are born and marvellous big men and great enmity.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|18:4: And therefore Elohim (God) judged them with great judgment, and they weep for their brethren and they will be punished on Yahuah's (Lord’s) great day.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|18:5: And I said to the Grigori: I saw your brethren and their works, and their great torments, and I prayed for them, but Yahuah (Lord) has condemned them to be under earth till the existing heaven and earth shall end for ever.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|18:6: And I said: Wherefore do you wait, brethren, and do not serve before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, and have not put your services before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, lest you anger your Lord utterly?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|18:7: And they listened to my admonition, and spoke to the four ranks in heaven, and lo! As I stood with those two men four trumpets trumpeted together with great voice, and the Grigori broke into song with one voice, and their voice went up before Yahuah (Lord) pitifully and affectingly.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|19:1: And thence those men took me and bore me up on to the sixth heaven, and there I saw seven bands of angels, very bright and very glorious, and their faces shining more than the sun’s shining, glistening, and there is no difference in their faces, or behaviour, or manner of dress; and these make the orders, and learn the goings of the stars, and the alteration of the moon, or revolution of the sun, and the good government of the world.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|19:2: And when they see evildoing they make commandments and instruction, and sweet and loud singing, and all songs of praise.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|19:3: These are the archangels (1) who are above angels, measure all life in heaven and on earth, and the angels who are appointed over seasons and years, the angels who are over rivers and sea, and who are over the fruits of the earth, and the angels who are over every grass, giving food to all, to every living thing, and the angels who write all the souls of men, and all their deeds, and their lives before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face; in their midst are six Phoenixes and six Cherubim and six six-winged ones continually with one voice singing one voice, and it is not possible to describe their singing, and they rejoice before Yahuah (Lord) at his footstool.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|20:1: And those two men lifted me up thence on to the seventh heaven, and I saw there a very great light, and fiery troops of great archangels (2), incorporeal forces, and dominions, orders and governments, cherubim and seraphim, thrones and many-eyed ones, nine regiments, the Ioanit stations of light, and I became afraid, and began to tremble with great terror, and those men took me, and led me after them, and said to me:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|20:2: Have courage, Enoch, do not fear, and showed me Yahuah (Lord) from afar, sitting on His very high throne. For what is there on the tenth heaven, since Yahuah (Lord) dwells there?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|20:3: On the tenth heaven is Elohim (God), in the Hebrew tongue he is called Aravat (3).
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|20:4: And all the heavenly troops would come and stand on the ten steps according to their rank, and would bow down to Yahuah (Lord), and would again go to their places in joy and felicity, singing songs in the boundless light with small and tender voices, gloriously serving him.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|21:1: And the cherubim and seraphim standing about the throne, the six-winged and many-eyed ones do not depart, standing before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face doing his will, and cover his whole throne, singing with gentle voice before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face: Holy, holy, holy, Yahuah (Lord) Ruler of Sabaoth, heavens and earth are full of Your glory.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|21:2: When I saw all these things, those men said to me: Enoch, thus far is it commanded us to journey with you, and those men went away from me and thereupon I saw them not.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|21:3: And I remained alone at the end of the seventh heaven and became afraid, and fell on my face and said to myself: Woe is me, what has befallen me?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|21:4: And Yahuah (Lord) sent one of his glorious ones, the archangel (4) Gabriel, and he said to me: Have courage, Enoch, do not fear, arise before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face into eternity, arise, come with me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|21:5: And I answered him, and said in myself: My Lord, my soul is departed from me, from terror and trembling, and I called to the men who led me up to this place, on them I relied, and it is with them I go before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|21:6: And Gabriel caught me up, as a leaf caught up by the wind, and placed me before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|21:7: And I saw the eighth heaven, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Muzaloth, changer of the seasons, of drought, and of wet, and of the twelve constellations of the circle of the firmament, which are above the seventh heaven.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|21:8: And I saw the ninth heaven, which is called in Hebrew Kuchavim, where are the heavenly homes of the twelve constellations of the circle of the firmament.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|22:1: On the tenth heaven, which is called Aravoth, I saw the appearance of Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, like iron made to glow in fire, and brought out, emitting sparks, and it burns.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|22:2: Thus in a moment of eternity I saw Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, but Yahuah's (Lord’s) face is ineffable, marvellous and very awful, and very, very terrible.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|22:3: And who am I to tell of Yahuah's (Lord’s) unspeakable being, and of his very wonderful face? And I cannot tell the quantity of his many instructions, and various voices, Yahuah's (Lord's) throne is very great and not made with hands, nor the quantity of those standing round him, troops of cherubim and seraphim, nor their incessant singing, nor his immutable beauty, and who shall tell of the ineffable greatness of his glory.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|22:4: And I fell prone and bowed down to Yahuah (Lord), and Yahuah (Lord) with his lips said to me:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|22:5: Have courage, Enoch, do not fear, arise and stand before my face into eternity.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|22:6: And the archistratege (5) Michael lifted me up, and led me to before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|22:7: And Yahuah (Lord) said to his servants tempting them: Let Enoch stand before my face into eternity, and the glorious ones bowed down to Yahuah (Lord), and said: Let Enoch go according to Your word.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|22:8: And Yahuah (Lord) said to Michael: Go and take Enoch from out of his earthly garments, and anoint him with my sweet ointment, and put him into the garments of My glory.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|22:9: And Michael did thus, as Yahuah (Lord) told him. He anointed me, and dressed me, and the appearance of that ointment is more than the great light, and his ointment is like sweet dew, and its smell mild, shining like the sun’s ray, and I looked at myself, and I was like one of his glorious ones (6).
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|22:10: And Yahuah (Lord) summoned one of his archangels by name Pravuil, whose knowledge was quicker in wisdom than the other archangels, who wrote all the deeds of Yahuah (Lord); and Yahuah (Lord) said to Pravuil: Bring out the books from my store-houses, and a reed of quick-writing, and give it to Enoch, and deliver to him the choice and comforting books out of your hand.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|23:1: And he was telling me all the works of heaven, earth and sea, and all the elements, their passages and goings, and the thunderings of the thunders, the sun and moon, the goings and changes of the stars, the seasons, years, days, and hours, the risings of the wind, the numbers of the angels, and the formation of their songs, and all human things, the tongue of every human song and life, the commandments, instructions, and sweet-voiced singings, and all things that it is fitting to learn.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|23:2: And Pravuil told me: All the things that I have told you, we have written. Sit and write all the souls of mankind, however many of them are born, and the places prepared for them to eternity; for all souls are prepared to eternity, before the formation of the world.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|23:3: And all double thirty days and thirty nights, and I wrote out all things exactly, and wrote three hundred and sixty-six books.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|24:1: And Yahuah (Lord) summoned me, and said to me: Enoch, sit down on my left with Gabriel.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|24:2: And I bowed down to Yahuah (Lord), and Yahuah (Lord) spoke to me: Enoch, beloved, all that you see, all things that are standing finished I tell to you even before the very beginning, all that I created from non-being, and visible things from invisible.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|24:3: Hear, Enoch, and take in these my words, for not to My angels have I told my secret, and I have not told them their rise, nor my endless realm, nor have they understood my creating, which I tell you to-day.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|24:4: For before all things were visible, I alone used to go about in the invisible things, like the sun from east to west, and from west to east.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|24:5: But even the sun has peace in itself, while I found no peace, because I was creating all things, and I conceived the thought of placing foundations, and of creating visible creation.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|25:1: I commanded in the very lowest parts, that visible things should come down from invisible, and Adoil (7) came down very great, and I beheld him, and lo! He had a belly of great light.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|25:2: And I said to him: Become undone, Adoil, and let the visible come out of you.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|25:3: And he came undone, and a great light came out. And I was in the midst of the great light, and as there is born light from light, there came forth a great age, and showed all creation, which I had thought to create.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|25:4: And I saw that it was good.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|25:5: And I placed for myself a throne, and took my seat on it, and said to the light: Go thence up higher and fix yourself high above the throne, and be a foundation to the highest things.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|25:6: And above the light there is nothing else, and then I bent up and looked up from my throne.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|26:1: And I summoned the very lowest a second time, and said: Let Archas (8) come forth hard, and he came forth hard from the invisible.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|26:2: And Archas came forth, hard, heavy, and very red.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|26:3: And I said: Be opened, Archas, and let there be born from you, and he came undone, an age came forth, very great and very dark, bearing the creation of all lower things, and I saw that it was good and said to him:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|26:4: Go thence down below, and make yourself firm, and be a foundation for the lower things, and it happened and he went down and fixed himself, and became the foundation for the lower things, and below the darkness there is nothing else.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|31:6: But I cursed ignorance, but what I had blessed previously, those I did not curse, I cursed not man, nor the earth, nor other creatures, but man’s evil fruit, and his works.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|32:2: Then I can again receive you at My second presence.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|27:1: And I commanded that there should be taken from light and darkness, and I said: Be thick, and it became thus, and I spread it out with the light, and it became water, and I spread it out over the darkness, below the light, and then I made firm the waters, that is to say the bottomless, and I made foundation of light around the water, and created seven circles from inside, and imaged the water like crystal wet and dry, that is to say like glass, and the circumcession of the waters and the other elements, and I showed each one of them its road, and the seven stars each one of them in its heaven, that they go thus, and I saw that it was good.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|27:2: And I separated between light and between darkness, that is to say in the midst of the water hither and thither, and I said to the light, that it should be the day, and to the darkness, that it should be the night, and there was evening and there was morning the first day.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|28:1: And then I made firm the heavenly circle, and made that the lower water which is under heaven collect itself together, into one whole, and that the chaos become dry, and it became so.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|28:2: Out of the waves I created rock hard and big, and from the rock I piled up the dry, and the dry I called earth, and the midst of the earth I called abyss, that is to say the bottomless, I collected the sea in one place and bound it together with a yoke.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|28:3: And I said to the sea: Behold I give you your eternal limits, and you shalt not break loose from your component parts.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|28:4: Thus I made fast the firmament. This day I called me the first-created [Sunday].
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|29:1: And for all the heavenly troops I imaged the image and essence of fire, and my eye looked at the very hard, firm rock, and from the gleam of my eye the lightning received its wonderful nature, which is both fire in water and water in fire, and one does not put out the other, nor does the one dry up the other, therefore the lightning is brighter than the sun, softer than water and firmer than hard rock.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|29:2: And from the rock I cut off a great fire, and from the fire I created the orders of the incorporeal ten troops of angels, and their weapons are fiery and their raiment a burning flame, and I commanded that each one should stand in his order.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|29:3: And one from out the order of angels, having turned away with the order that was under him, conceived an impossible thought, to place his throne higher than the clouds above the earth, that he might become equal in rank to my power.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|29:4: And I threw him out from the height with his angels, and he was flying in the air continuously above the bottomless.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:1: On the third day I commanded the earth to make grow great and fruitful trees, and hills, and seed to sow, and I planted Paradise, and enclosed it, and placed as armed guardians flaming angels, and thus I created renewal.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:2: Then came evening, and came morning the fourth day.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:3: [Wednesday]. On the fourth day I commanded that there should be great lights on the heavenly circles.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:4: On the first uppermost circle I placed the stars, Kruno, and on the second Aphrodit, on the third Aris, on the fifth Zoues, on the sixth Ermis, on the seventh lesser the moon, and adorned it with the lesser stars.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:5: And on the lower I placed the sun for the illumination of day, and the moon and stars for the illumination of night.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:6: The sun that it should go according to each constellation, twelve, and I appointed the succession of the months and their names and lives, their thunderings, and their hour-markings, how they should succeed.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:7: Then evening came and morning came the fifth day.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:8: [Thursday]. On the fifth day I commanded the sea, that it should bring forth fishes, and feathered birds of many varieties, and all animals creeping over the earth, going forth over the earth on four legs, and soaring in the air, male sex and female, and every soul breathing the spirit of life.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:9: And there came evening, and there came morning the sixth day.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:10: [Friday]. On the sixth day I commanded my wisdom to create man from seven consistencies: one, his flesh from the earth; two, his blood from the dew; three, his eyes from the sun; four, his bones from stone; five, his intelligence from the swiftness of the angels and from cloud; six, his veins and his hair from the grass of the earth; seven, his soul from my breath and from the wind.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:11: And I gave him seven natures: to the flesh hearing, the eyes for sight, to the soul smell, the veins for touch, the blood for taste, the bones for endurance, to the intelligence sweetness [enjoyment].
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:12: I conceived a cunning saying to say, I created man from invisible and from visible nature, of both are his death and life and image, he knows speech like some created thing, small in greatness and again great in smallness, and I placed him on earth, a second angel, honourable, great and glorious, and I appointed him as ruler to rule on earth and to have my wisdom, and there was none like him of earth of all my existing creatures.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:13: And I appointed him a name, from the four component parts, from east, from west, from south, from north, and I appointed for him four special stars, and I called his name Adam, and showed him the two ways, the light and the darkness, and I told him:
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:14: This is good, and that bad, that I should learn whether he has love towards me, or hatred, that it be clear which in his race love me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:15: For I have seen his nature, but he has not seen his own nature, therefore through not seeing he will sin worse, and I said After sin what is there but death?
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|30:16: And I put sleep into him and he fell asleep. And I took from him a rib, and created him a wife, that death should come to him by his wife, and I took his last word and called her name mother, that is to say, Eva.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|31:1: Adam has life on earth, and I created a garden in Eden in the east, that he should observe the testament and keep the command.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|31:2: I made the heavens open to him, that he should see the angels singing the song of victory, and the gloomless light.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|31:3: And he was continuously in paradise, and the devil understood that I wanted to create another world, because Adam was lord on earth, to rule and control it.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|31:4: The devil is the evil spirit of the lower places, as a fugitive he made Sotona (9) from the heavens as his name was Satanail (10), thus he became different from the angels, but his nature did not change his intelligence as far as his understanding of righteous and sinful things.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|31:5: And he understood his condemnation and the sin which he had sinned before, therefore he conceived thought against Adam, in such form he entered and seduced Eva, but did not touch Adam.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|32:3: And I blessed all my creatures visible and invisible. And Adam was five and half hours in paradise.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|32:4: And I blessed the seventh day, which is the Sabbath, on which he rested from all his works.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|33:1: And I appointed the eighth day also, that the eighth day should be the first-created after my work, and that the first seven revolve in the form of the seventh thousand, and that at the beginning of the eighth thousand there should be a time of not-counting, endless, with neither years nor months nor weeks nor days nor hours.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|33:2: And now, Enoch, all that I have told you, all that you have understood, all that you have seen of heavenly things, all that you have seen on earth, and all that I have written in books by my great wisdom, all these things I have devised and created from the uppermost foundation to the lower and to the end, and there is no counsellor nor inheritor to my creations.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|33:3: I am self-eternal, not made with hands, and without change.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|33:4: My thought is my counsellor, my wisdom and my word are made, and my eyes observe all things how they stand here and tremble with terror.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|33:5: If I turn away my face, then all things will be destroyed.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|33:6: And apply your mind, Enoch, and know him who is speaking to you, and take thence the books which you yourself have written.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|33:7: And I give you Samuil (11) and Raguil (12), who led you up, and the books, and go down to earth, and tell your sons all that I have told you, and all that you have seen, from the lower heaven up to my throne, and all the troops.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|33:8: For I created all forces, and there is none that resists me or that does not subject himself to me. For all subject themselves to my monarchy, and labour for my sole rule.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|33:9: Give them the books of the handwriting, and they will read them and will know me for the creator of all things, and will understand how there is no other Elohim (God) but me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|33:10: And let them distribute the books of your handwriting–children to children, generation to generation, nations to nations.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|33:11: And I will give you, Enoch, my intercessor, the archistratege Michael, for the handwritings of your fathers Adam, Seth, Enos, Cainan, Mahaleleel, and Jared your father.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|34:1: They have rejected my commandments and my yoke, worthless seed has come up, not fearing Elohim (God), and they would not bow down to me, but have begun to bow down to vain gods, and denied my unity, and have laden the whole earth with untruths, offences, abominable lecheries, namely one with another, and all manner of other unclean wickedness, which are disgusting to relate.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|34:2: And therefore I will bring down a deluge upon the earth and will destroy all men, and the whole earth will crumble together into great darkness.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|35:1: Behold from their seed shall arise another generation, much afterwards, but of them many will be very insatiate.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|35:2: He who raises that generation, shall reveal to them the books of your handwriting, of your fathers, to them to whom he must point out the guardianship of the world, to the faithful men and workers of my pleasure, who do not acknowledge my name in vain.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|35:3: And they shall tell another generation, and those others having read shall be glorified thereafter, more than the first.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|36:1: Now, Enoch, I give you the term of thirty days to spend in your house, and tell your sons and all your household, that all may hear from my face what is told them by you, that they may read and understand, how there is no other Elohim (God) but me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|36:2: And that they may always keep my commandments, and begin to read and take in the books of your handwriting.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|36:3: And after thirty days I shall send my angel for you, and he will take you from earth and from your sons to me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|37:1: And Yahuah (Lord) called upon one of the older angels, terrible and menacing, and placed him by me, in appearance white as snow, and his hands like ice, having the appearance of great frost, and he froze my face, because I could not endure the terror of Yahuah (Lord), just as it is not possible to endure a stove’s fire and the sun’s heat, and the frost of the air.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|37:2: And Yahuah (Lord) said to me: Enoch, if your face be not frozen here, no man will be able to behold your face.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|38:1: And Yahuah (Lord) said to those men who first led me up: Let Enoch go down on to earth with you, and await him till the determined day.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|38:2: And they placed me by night on my bed.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|38:3: And Mathusal expecting my coming, keeping watch by day and by night at my bed, was filled with awe when he heard my coming, and I told him, Let all my household come together, that I tell them everything.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|39:1: Oh my children, my beloved ones, hear the admonition of your father, as much as is according to Yahuah's (Lord’s) will.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|39:2: I have been let come to you to-day, and announce to you, not from my lips, but from Yahuah's (Lord’s) lips, all that is and was and all that is now, and all that will be till judgment-day.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|39:3: For Yahuah (Lord) has let me come to you, you hear therefore the words of my lips, of a man made big for you, but I am one who has seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, like iron made to glow from fire it sends forth sparks and burns.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|39:4: You look now upon my eyes, the eyes of a man big with meaning for you, but I have seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) eyes, shining like the sun’s rays and filling the eyes of man with awe.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|39:5: You see now, my children, the right hand of a man that helps you, but I have seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) right hand filling heaven as he helped me.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|39:6: You see the compass of my work like your own, but I have seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) limitless and perfect compass, which has no end.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|39:7: You hear the words of my lips, as I heard the words of Yahuah (Lord), like great thunder incessantly with hurling of clouds.
live.pseudepigrapha|2-enoch|39:8: And now, my children, hear the discourses of the father of the earth, how fearful and awful it is to come before the face of the ruler of the earth, how much more terrible and awful it is to come before the face of the ruler of heaven, the controller of quick and dead, and of the heavenly troops. Who can endure that endless pain?
