This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The salvation Adam mourns over in 1 Adam and Eve 15:1 is exactly this — the Son manifested to suffer and undo the works of the serpent.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve cried and sorrowed by reason of Elohim's (God's) word to them, that they should not return to the garden until the fulfillment of the days decreed on them; but mostly because Elohim (God) had told them that He should suffer for their salvation.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* The suffering Elohim foretold in 1 Adam and Eve 15:1 is the bruised heel of the woman's seed crushing the serpent's head.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve cried and sorrowed by reason of Elohim's (God's) word to them, that they should not return to the garden until the fulfillment of the days decreed on them; but mostly because Elohim (God) had told them that He should suffer for their salvation.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:20 — *Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,* — Adam hears in 1 Adam and Eve 15:1 of a salvation already foreordained before the world, manifest only in the last times.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve cried and sorrowed by reason of Elohim's (God's) word to them, that they should not return to the garden until the fulfillment of the days decreed on them; but mostly because Elohim (God) had told them that He should suffer for their salvation.
cards.t_text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The promise of 1 Adam and Eve 15:1 — that Elohim should suffer — is kept when the Word takes flesh to suffer for our salvation.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve cried and sorrowed by reason of Elohim's (God's) word to them, that they should not return to the garden until the fulfillment of the days decreed on them; but mostly because Elohim (God) had told them that He should suffer for their salvation.
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Elohim who in 1 Adam and Eve 15:1 told Adam He should suffer for their salvation is the eternal Word, the Logos who speaks with Adam outside the garden.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve cried and sorrowed by reason of Elohim's (God's) word to them, that they should not return to the garden until the fulfillment of the days decreed on them; but mostly because Elohim (God) had told them that He should suffer for their salvation.
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Revelation 22:14 — *Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.* The barred return of 1 Adam and Eve 15:1 ends here, when the way to the tree of life is opened again at the fulfillment of the days.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve cried and sorrowed by reason of Elohim's (God's) word to them, that they should not return to the garden until the fulfillment of the days decreed on them; but mostly because Elohim (God) had told them that He should suffer for their salvation.
cards.t_text: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.

cards.note: Galatians 4:4 — *But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,* — the fulfillment of the days decreed in 1 Adam and Eve 15:1 is the appointed coming of the seed of the woman.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve cried and sorrowed by reason of Elohim's (God's) word to them, that they should not return to the garden until the fulfillment of the days decreed on them; but mostly because Elohim (God) had told them that He should suffer for their salvation.

cards.note: Genesis 3:24 — *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* The flaming sword is why Adam and Eve in 1 Adam and Eve 15:1 may not return until the days decreed are fulfilled.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve cried and sorrowed by reason of Elohim's (God's) word to them, that they should not return to the garden until the fulfillment of the days decreed on them; but mostly because Elohim (God) had told them that He should suffer for their salvation.
cards.t_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

cards.note: Genesis 3:23 — *Therefore Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.* This is the very expulsion 1 Adam and Eve 15:1 weeps over, the LORD's word that they should not return to the garden.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve cried and sorrowed by reason of Elohim's (God's) word to them, that they should not return to the garden until the fulfillment of the days decreed on them; but mostly because Elohim (God) had told them that He should suffer for their salvation.
cards.t_text: Therefore Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

cards.note: Malachi 4:1 -- *For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.* The consuming burning Adam fears in 16:5 is appointed for the wicked, not for the seed Yahuah is keeping.
cards.s_text: "O Yahuah (Lord), plague me not, neither consume me, nor yet take away my life from the earth."
cards.t_text: For, behold, the day comes, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that comes shall burn them up, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.

cards.note: Psalm 121:6 -- *The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.* The very plague Adam dreads from the sun in 16:5 is the harm the keeper of the seed pledges to hold back from His people.
cards.s_text: "O Yahuah (Lord), plague me not, neither consume me, nor yet take away my life from the earth."
cards.t_text: The sun shall not smite you by day, nor the moon by night.

cards.note: Isaiah 41:10 -- *Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy Elohim (God): I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.* Against Adam's cry to be spared in 16:5, Yahuah's word is not destruction but the strengthening 'fear not' He speaks to His own.
cards.s_text: "O Yahuah (Lord), plague me not, neither consume me, nor yet take away my life from the earth."
cards.t_text: Fear you not; for I am with you: be not dismayed; for I am your Elohim (God): I will strengthen you; yea, I will help you; yea, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

cards.note: Genesis 3:8 -- *And they heard the voice of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) amongst the trees of the garden.* The Word who comforted Adam in the night (16:12) is the same voice he once hid from in the garden -- now come outside to seek and steady him.
cards.s_text: But I am Elohim (God) who comforted you in the night."
cards.t_text: And they heard the voice of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) amongst the trees of the garden.

cards.note: John 1:4 -- *In him was life; and the life was the light of men.* The Word who teaches Adam that the sun is but a created light is Himself the true Light of men, the One greater than the lamp Adam feared in 16:11.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, get up on your feet. This sun is not Elohim (God); but it has been created to give light by day, of which I spoke to you in the cave saying, 'that the dawn would come, and there would be light by day.'
cards.t_text: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

cards.note: John 1:1 -- *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word of Elohim who comes to Adam in 16:10 and names Himself Elohim in 16:12 is the eternal Logos John reveals.
cards.s_text: But while he was thinking like this in his heart, the Word of Elohim (God) came to him and said:--
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Psalm 19:1 -- *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork.* The sun preaches the Maker rather than claiming worship -- the lesson the Word presses on Adam in 16:11.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, get up on your feet. This sun is not Elohim (God); but it has been created to give light by day, of which I spoke to you in the cave saying, 'that the dawn would come, and there would be light by day.'
cards.t_text: The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament shows his handywork.

cards.note: Genesis 1:16 -- *And Elohim (God) made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.* The greater light Adam feared in the cave's mouth is the very lamp Elohim made and set in order, exactly as the Word tells him in 16:11.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, get up on your feet. This sun is not Elohim (God); but it has been created to give light by day, of which I spoke to you in the cave saying, 'that the dawn would come, and there would be light by day.'
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.

cards.note: Genesis 1:14 -- *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* The Word's correction in 16:11 simply repeats the creation decree -- the sun is a light made to rule the day, not a god.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, get up on your feet. This sun is not Elohim (God); but it has been created to give light by day, of which I spoke to you in the cave saying, 'that the dawn would come, and there would be light by day.'
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:

cards.note: *And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.* (1 Enoch 41:5). 1 Enoch 41:5 --  Enoch shows the sun as an ordered servant kept under oath, not the god Adam dreaded in 16:3.
cards.s_text: Then Adam began to come out of the cave. And when he came to the mouth of it, and stood and turned his face towards the east, and saw the sunrise in glowing rays, and felt the heat thereof on his body, he was afraid of it, and thought in his heart that this flame came forth to plague him.
cards.t_text: And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 13:2 -- *But deemed either fire, or wind, or the swift air, or the circle of the stars, or the violent water, or the lights of heaven, to be the gods which govern the world.* Wisdom catalogues the same confusion Adam shows in 16:6, mistaking the lights of heaven for the God who made them.
cards.s_text: For he thought the sun was Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: But deemed either fire, or wind, or the swift air, or the circle of the stars, or the violent water, or the lights of heaven, to be the gods which govern the world.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 4:19 -- *And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.* The very error Adam falls into at sunrise -- taking the sun for Elohim -- is the host-of-heaven worship Torah forbids the seed.
cards.s_text: For he thought the sun was Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And lest you lift up your eyes unto heaven, and when you see the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, should be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

cards.note: Genesis 3:14 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:* The serpent's fall from the most exalted of beasts to creeping on its belly in 1 Adam and Eve 17:3 is the literal undoing of this curse spoken in the garden.
cards.s_text: And whereas before the serpent was the most exalted of all beasts, now it was changed and become slippery, and the meanest of them all, and it crept on its breast and went on its belly.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) said unto the serpent, Because you have done this, you are cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon your belly shall you go, and dust shall you eat all the days of your life:

cards.note: Jubilees 3:29 — *And He sent out of the Garden of Eden all flesh that was in the Garden of Eden, and all flesh was scattered according to its kinds, and according to its types to the places which had been created for them.* The beasts fleeing the venomous serpent's home in 1 Adam and Eve 17:6 belongs to this scattering of all flesh out of Eden after the fall.
cards.s_text: And, again, whereas it lived in one beautiful home, to which all other animals came from elsewhere; and where it drank, they drank also of the same; now, after it had become venomous, by reason of Elohim's (God's) curse, all beasts fled from its home, and would not drink of the water it drank; but fled from it.
cards.t_text: And He sent out of the Garden of Eden all flesh that was in the Garden of Eden, and all flesh was scattered according to its kinds, and according to its types to the places which had been created for them.

cards.note: Jubilees 3:28 — *And on that day was closed the mouth of all beasts, and of cattle, and of birds, and of whatever walks, and of whatever moves, so that they could no longer speak: for they had all spoken one with another with one lip and with one tongue.* Jubilees remembers the same change among the beasts that 1 Adam and Eve 17:5 shows — the creature once admired now standing dumb and abhorred.
cards.s_text: And, whereas it had been the most beautiful of all beasts, all of which stood dumb at its beauty, it was now abhorred of them.
cards.t_text: And on that day was closed the mouth of all beasts, and of cattle, and of birds, and of whatever walks, and of whatever moves, so that they could no longer speak: for they had all spoken one with another with one lip and with one tongue.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The serpent that became Satan in 1 Adam and Eve 17:2 is the devil who sinned from the beginning, whose works the Son of Elohim came to destroy.
cards.s_text: But as they went near it, before the western gate, from which Satan came when he deceived Adam and Eve, they found the serpent that became Satan coming at the gate, and sorrowfully licking the dust, and wiggling on its breast on the ground, by reason of the curse that fell on it from Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* The cursed serpent crawling at the gate in 1 Adam and Eve 17:2 stands under this very sentence — the head it raised against the woman is already doomed to be bruised by her seed.
cards.s_text: But as they went near it, before the western gate, from which Satan came when he deceived Adam and Eve, they found the serpent that became Satan coming at the gate, and sorrowfully licking the dust, and wiggling on its breast on the ground, by reason of the curse that fell on it from Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* John names the same identity the book gives in 1 Adam and Eve 17:2 — the serpent that became Satan, the old deceiver cast down to the earth.
cards.s_text: But as they went near it, before the western gate, from which Satan came when he deceived Adam and Eve, they found the serpent that became Satan coming at the gate, and sorrowfully licking the dust, and wiggling on its breast on the ground, by reason of the curse that fell on it from Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: Isaiah 65:25 — *The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent's meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith Yahuah (LORD).* Even in the world to come the serpent still eats dust, the same debasement 1 Adam and Eve 17:4 shows beginning on the first day outside.
cards.s_text: And whereas it was the fairest of all beasts, it had been changed, and was become the ugliest of them all. Instead of feeding on the best food, now it turned to eat the dust. Instead of living, as before, in the best places, now it lived in the dust.
cards.t_text: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, says Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Micah 7:17 — *They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), and shall fear because of thee.* Micah keeps the same emblem of the enemy abased to lick the dust that 1 Adam and Eve 17:2 sets at the western gate.
cards.s_text: But as they went near it, before the western gate, from which Satan came when he deceived Adam and Eve, they found the serpent that became Satan coming at the gate, and sorrowfully licking the dust, and wiggling on its breast on the ground, by reason of the curse that fell on it from Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: They shall lick the dust like a serpent, they shall move out of their holes like worms of the earth: they shall be afraid of Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), and shall fear because of you.

cards.note: Genesis 3:14 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) said unto the serpent, Because thou hast done this, thou art cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon thy belly shalt thou go, and dust shalt thou eat all the days of thy life:* The serpent crawling on its breast and eating dust at the gate in 1 Adam and Eve 17:2 is the very sentence Yahuah pronounced, now seen carried out.
cards.s_text: But as they went near it, before the western gate, from which Satan came when he deceived Adam and Eve, they found the serpent that became Satan coming at the gate, and sorrowfully licking the dust, and wiggling on its breast on the ground, by reason of the curse that fell on it from Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) said unto the serpent, Because you have done this, you are cursed above all cattle, and above every beast of the field; upon your belly shall you go, and dust shall you eat all the days of your life:

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The contrast is sharp: in 1 Adam and Eve 18:5 a true angel of Yahuah delivers Adam and Eve, where elsewhere Satan only counterfeits the angelic to deceive them.
cards.s_text: But Elohim (God) sent an angel who threw the serpent away from them, and raised them up.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The Word silencing the serpent's deceiving speech in 1 Adam and Eve 18:7 foreshadows the Son manifested to destroy the devil's works.
cards.s_text: This time, however, you will be mute, and you and your race will speak no more; because, the first time My creatures were ruined because of you, and this time you tried to kill them."
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: John 1:3 — *All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.* The same Word who made the serpent and gave it speech now removes it in 1 Adam and Eve 18:6-7 — the Maker disposing of His own creature.
cards.s_text: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to the serpent, and said to it, "The first time I made you slick, and made you to go on your belly; but I did not deprive you of speech.
cards.t_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word of Elohim who comes to the serpent and pronounces judgment in 1 Adam and Eve 18:6 is the eternal Word of the prologue.

cards.note: Genesis 3:5 — *For Elohim (God) doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.* Adam's confession that they *tried to become gods like you* in 1 Adam and Eve 22:5 quotes back the serpent's exact lie.

cards.note: Romans 8:19 — *For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of Elohim (God).* The sorrow that came over the land when Adam transgressed in 1 Adam and Eve 22:4 is the bondage all creation waits to be loosed from.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) said to Adam, "So long as you were keeping My commandment, My light and My grace rested on you. But when you transgressed My commandment, sorrow and misery came to you in this land."
cards.t_text: For the earnest expectation of the creature waits for the manifestation of the sons of Elohim (God).

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The light and grace that rested on Adam while he kept the commandment in 1 Adam and Eve 22:4 are restored, full, in the Word made flesh.

cards.note: Romans 8:22 — *For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.* Adam's longing to be taken out to rest in 1 Adam and Eve 22:1 is the first voice of the creation that still groans for deliverance.
cards.s_text: Then Adam said to Elohim (God), "I dry up in the heat, I am faint from walking, and I don't want to be in this world. And I don't know when You will take me out of it to rest."

cards.note: Genesis 3:19 — *In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.* Adam's confession in 1 Adam and Eve 22:3 that in the garden he knew no heat, languor, or trembling is the exact reversal of this sweat-and-dust sentence.
cards.s_text: And Adam said to Elohim (God), "While I was in the garden I knew neither heat, nor languor, neither moving about, nor trembling, nor fear; but now since I came to this land, all this affliction has come over me.
cards.t_text: In the sweat of your face shall you eat bread, till you return unto the ground; for out of it were you taken: for dust you are, and unto dust shall you return.

And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil thing; for Thine is the kingdom and Thou shalt reign in glory forever and forevermore, AMEN.* (1 Adam and Eve 23:9). *And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil: For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, for ever. Amen.* (Matthew 6:13). Adam keeps asking Elohim (God) for more, and the prayer he prays ends on the same petitions Yahusha (Jesus) gives his disciples: do not lead us into temptation, deliver us from the evil, for the kingdom is Yours. The wording is not identical, since Adam's version says the evil thing and has a longer opening, but the shape is the same: a plea for rescue and a confession that the kingdom belongs to Yahuah (the Lord) alone. The first man prays it after the fall, and Matthew records the same cry for those who follow Yahusha (Jesus) now.

cards.s_text: Yet now look at our blood which is offered on these stones, and accept it at our hands, like the praise we used to sing to you at first, when in the garden."

cards.note: Jubilees 6:14 — *And for this law there is no limit of days, for it is for ever. They shall observe it throughout their generations, so that they may continue supplicating on your behalf with blood before the altar; every day and at the time of morning and evening they shall seek forgiveness on your behalf perpetually before Yahuah (God) that they may keep it and not be rooted out.* The standing order "when sorrow comes over you, make Me an offering" in 1 Adam and Eve 24:7 is Jubilees' perpetual blood-supplication before the altar — the same covenant of continual offering across the restored library.

cards.note: Galatians 4:5 — *To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.* The return "into the garden" promised when the days of the covenant are fulfilled (1 Adam and Eve 24:6) is this redemption and adoption — the bound exile of Adam undone in Messiah.

cards.note: Matthew 26:28 — *For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.* The blood the Word promises to make "forgiveness of sins" in 1 Adam and Eve 24:5 is the blood Messiah names at the table — shed for the remission Adam was first promised.
cards.s_text: And as you sued for forgiveness through that blood, so also will I make My blood forgiveness of sins, and erase transgressions in it.
cards.t_text: For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

cards.note: *And as you sued for forgiveness through that blood, so also will I make My blood forgiveness of sins, and erase transgressions in it.* (1 Adam and Eve 24:5). *And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.* (Hebrews 9:22). Adam has shed his blood on an altar and sought forgiveness through it, and the Word of Elohim (God) answers that He will make His own blood the forgiveness of sins. Hebrews states the same necessity plainly: under the law almost everything is cleansed with blood, and without the shedding of blood there is no remission. The law is not set aside here; it is the very ground the promise to Adam stands on, and the one who comes in the flesh of Adam's descendants, Yahusha (Jesus), answers it with His own blood.
cards.s_text: And as you sued for forgiveness through that blood, so also will I make My blood forgiveness of sins, and erase transgressions in it.

cards.t_text: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And Yahuah (LORD) had respect unto Abel and to his offering:

cards.note: Hebrews 13:15 — *By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to Elohim (God) continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.* The 'custom' of offering Adam establishes (25:8) is fulfilled as the continual sacrifice of praise.
cards.s_text: This, then, was the first offering Adam made to Elohim (God); and so it became his custom to do.
cards.t_text: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to Elohim (God) continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.

cards.note: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* Adam's first offering becoming his custom (25:8) is the same primeval worship the seed of Seth carries on.
cards.s_text: This, then, was the first offering Adam made to Elohim (God); and so it became his custom to do.
cards.t_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:20 — *Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,* The salvation covenanted to Adam on the first day outside Eden (25:7) was foreordained before creation itself.
cards.s_text: And the Word of Elohim (God) came to him, and blessed him, and comforted him, and covenanted with him, that He would save him at the end of the days determined for him.
cards.t_text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

cards.note: Galatians 4:4 — *But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,* The 'end of the days determined for him' (25:7) is this appointed fulness in which the Son is sent.
cards.s_text: And the Word of Elohim (God) came to him, and blessed him, and comforted him, and covenanted with him, that He would save him at the end of the days determined for him.
cards.t_text: But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The covenant 'that He would save him at the end of the days' (25:7) is kept when the same Word takes flesh.
cards.s_text: And the Word of Elohim (God) came to him, and blessed him, and comforted him, and covenanted with him, that He would save him at the end of the days determined for him.
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The 'Word of Elohim' who comes, blesses, and covenants with Adam (25:7) is the eternal Logos Himself.
cards.s_text: And the Word of Elohim (God) came to him, and blessed him, and comforted him, and covenanted with him, that He would save him at the end of the days determined for him.
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Psalm 103:8 — *Yahuah (LORD) is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.* Adam appeals to Yahuah's goodness to revive him every time he dies (25:4) — the very plenteous mercy David sings.
cards.s_text: Yet of Your goodness, O Elohim (God), do not get rid of me altogether; but be favorable to me every time I die, and bring me to life.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.

cards.note: 2 Peter 3:9 — *Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.* The God who 'does not want anyone to perish' in Adam's mouth (25:5) is the same longsuffering Yahuah of the last days.
cards.s_text: And thereby it will be made known that You are a merciful Elohim (God), who does not want anyone to perish; who loves not that one should fall; and who does not condemn any one cruelly, badly, and by whole destruction."
cards.t_text: Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

cards.note: Ezekiel 33:11 — *Say unto them, As I live, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn ye, turn ye from your evil ways; for why will ye die, O house of Yashar'el (Israel)?* Adam confesses the very mercy Yahuah will later swear by — that He does not want anyone to perish (25:5).
cards.s_text: And thereby it will be made known that You are a merciful Elohim (God), who does not want anyone to perish; who loves not that one should fall; and who does not condemn any one cruelly, badly, and by whole destruction."
cards.t_text: Say unto them, As I live, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked turn from his way and live: turn you, turn you from your evil ways; for why will you die, O house of Yashar'el (Israel)?

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* Adam grieving over his transgression and his lost light (25:3) stands on this side of the bruising of the same adversary that hounds him.
cards.s_text: But Adam said to Elohim (God), "I was thinking to put an end to myself at once, for having transgressed Your commandments, and for my having come out of the beautiful garden; and for the bright light of which You have deprived me; and for the praises which poured forth from my mouth without ceasing, and for the light that covered me.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The self-slaughter Adam imagines (25:1) is a work of the devil, and the promised Son comes precisely to undo it.
cards.s_text: But Elohim (God) knew that Adam believed he should frequently kill himself and make an offering to Him of his blood.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Adam's drive to spill his own blood (25:1) is the serpent striking at the very seed-bearer Yahuah has sworn to keep.
cards.s_text: But Elohim (God) knew that Adam believed he should frequently kill himself and make an offering to Him of his blood.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Hebrews 6:18 — *That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for Elohim (God) to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:* The forbearing mercy of 1 Adam & Eve 26:8 rests on the immutable promise of an Elohim who cannot lie.
cards.s_text: Therefore Elohim (God) was not angry with them; nor impatient with them; but he was patient and forbearing towards them, as towards the children He had created.
cards.t_text: That by two immutable things, in which it was impossible for Elohim (God) to lie, we might have a strong consolation, who have fled for refuge to lay hold upon the hope set before us:

cards.note: Revelation 22:5 — *And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.* The promised "light that never fails" of 1 Adam & Eve 26:15 is the unfailing light of Elohim in the world to come.
cards.s_text: When, however, the covenant is fulfilled, then shall I show you and your descendants mercy, and bring you into a land of gladness, where there is neither sorrow nor suffering; but abiding joy and gladness, and light that never fails, and praises that never cease; and a beautiful garden that shall never pass away."
cards.t_text: And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) gives them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever.

cards.note: Revelation 21:4 — *And Elohim (God) shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.* The land of gladness with neither sorrow nor suffering promised in 1 Adam & Eve 26:15 is the New Jerusalem where all tears are wiped away.
cards.s_text: When, however, the covenant is fulfilled, then shall I show you and your descendants mercy, and bring you into a land of gladness, where there is neither sorrow nor suffering; but abiding joy and gladness, and light that never fails, and praises that never cease; and a beautiful garden that shall never pass away."
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

cards.note: *Yes, rather, bear long and calm your soul while you live night and day; until the fulfillment of the days, and the time of My covenant is come.* (1 Adam and Eve 26:11). *And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.* (Hebrews 6:15). Elohim (God) tells Adam to bear long and calm his soul until the days of the covenant are fulfilled, and the next verse says He will come and save him. Hebrews says Abraham obtained the promise in just this way, by patiently enduring. The promise does not come by hurry; it comes at the time Elohim (God) has set, to the one who waits for it. Adam is told to wait, and Abraham is shown having done it.
cards.s_text: Yes, rather, bear long and calm your soul while you live night and day; until the fulfillment of the days, and the time of My covenant is come.
cards.t_text: And so, after he had patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

cards.note: John 16:20 — *Verily, verily, I say unto you, That ye shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and ye shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.* The twelve hours of darkness ended by light (1 Adam & Eve 26:16) foreshadow the sorrow turned into joy promised to Messiah's own.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) said again to Adam, "Be patient and enter the cave, for the darkness, of which you were afraid, shall only be twelve hours long; and when ended, light shall come up."
cards.t_text: Verily, verily, I say unto you, That you shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and you shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy.

cards.note: James 5:7 — *Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of Yahusha (Lord). Behold, the husbandman waiteth for the precious fruit of the earth, and hath long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.* The "bear long... until the time of My covenant is come" of 1 Adam & Eve 26:11 is the same patient waiting for the coming of Yahusha (Lord).
cards.s_text: Yes, rather, bear long and calm your soul while you live night and day; until the fulfillment of the days, and the time of My covenant is come.
cards.t_text: Be patient therefore, brethren, unto the coming of the Lord. Behold, the husbandman waits for the precious fruit of the earth, and has long patience for it, until he receive the early and latter rain.

cards.note: Psalms 30:5 — *For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.* The promise that the cave's darkness lasts only twelve hours before light comes (1 Adam & Eve 26:16) is the morning-joy that follows the night of weeping.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) said again to Adam, "Be patient and enter the cave, for the darkness, of which you were afraid, shall only be twelve hours long; and when ended, light shall come up."
cards.t_text: For his anger endures but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.

cards.note: Hebrews 1:2 — *Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;* The Word of Elohim who comes and speaks to Adam in 1 Adam & Eve 26:9 is the Son by whom Elohim made the worlds and now speaks.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam, and said to him, "Adam, as for the sun, if I were to take it and bring it to you, days, hours, years and months would all stop, and the covenant I have made with you, would never be fulfilled.
cards.t_text: Has in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he has appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:20 — *Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,* The Saviour the Word promises Adam in 1 Adam & Eve 26:12 was foreordained from before the world and made manifest in the last times.
cards.s_text: Then shall I come and save you, O Adam, for I do not wish that you be afflicted.
cards.t_text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

cards.note: Galatians 4:4 — *But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,* The "When, however, the covenant is fulfilled" of 1 Adam & Eve 26:15 is the fulness of time when the promised Son of the woman is sent.
cards.s_text: When, however, the covenant is fulfilled, then shall I show you and your descendants mercy, and bring you into a land of gladness, where there is neither sorrow nor suffering; but abiding joy and gladness, and light that never fails, and praises that never cease; and a beautiful garden that shall never pass away."
cards.t_text: But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The Word who came and spoke to Adam in 1 Adam & Eve 26:9-15 is the same Logos who at the fulfilled covenant was made flesh.
cards.s_text: But I cannot alter the covenant that has gone out of My mouth; otherwise I would have brought you back into the garden.
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: Jubilees 3:32 — *And on the new moon of the fourth month, Adam and his wife went forth from the Garden of Eden, and they dwelt in the land of ’Eldâ, in the land of their creation.* Jubilees records the same expulsion and dwelling-place outside Eden that frames Adam and Eve's return to the cave in 1 Adam & Eve 26:1.
cards.s_text: Then Adam took Eve, and they began to return to the Cave of Treasures where they lived. But when they got closer to it and saw it from a distance, heavy sorrow fell on Adam and Eve when they looked at it.
cards.t_text: And on the new moon of the fourth month, Adam and his wife went forth from the Garden of Eden, and they dwelt in the land of ’Eldâ, in the land of their creation.

cards.note: John 8:12 — *Then spake Yahusha (Jesus) again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.* The light from the east that comforted Adam (1 Adam & Eve 26:2) is the Light of the world made flesh, in whom is no darkness.
cards.s_text: Then Adam said to Eve, "When we were on the mountain we were comforted by the Word of Elohim (God) that conversed with us; and the light that came from the east shown over us.
cards.t_text: Then spake Yahusha (Jesus) again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that follows me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The very "Word of Elohim" Adam mourns as hidden in 1 Adam & Eve 26:3 is the eternal Logos who was from the beginning.
cards.s_text: But now the Word of Elohim (God) is hidden from us; and the light that shown over us is so changed as to disappear, and let darkness and sorrow come over us.
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Genesis 3:24 — *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* The cave-prison of 1 Adam & Eve 26:4 is the lived consequence of the driving-out and the barred way of Eden.
cards.s_text: And we are forced to enter this cave which is like a prison, in which darkness covers us, so that we are separated from each other; and you can not see me, neither can I see you."
cards.t_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

cards.note: Psalm 91:11 — *For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.* The angel given charge to guard the cave and depart only when the danger is gone in 1 Adam and Eve 27:15-16 fulfills this promised keeping.
cards.s_text: And the angel left them.
cards.t_text: For he shall give his angels charge over you, to keep you in all your ways.

cards.note: Hebrews 1:14 — *Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?* The true messenger sent to strengthen Adam and Eve in 1 Adam and Eve 27:15 is exactly such a ministering spirit serving the heirs of salvation.
cards.s_text: Then the angel drove away Satan and his hosts from Adam and Eve, and said to them, "Fear not; Elohim (God) who created you, will strengthen you."
cards.t_text: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

cards.note: Psalm 34:7 — *The angel of Yahuah (LORD) encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.* The angel who drives Satan away and bids them fear not in 1 Adam and Eve 27:15 is this delivering guard encamped round about those who fear Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Then the angel drove away Satan and his hosts from Adam and Eve, and said to them, "Fear not; Elohim (God) who created you, will strengthen you."
cards.t_text: The angel of Yahuah (LORD) encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivers them.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 54:6 — *And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah (God) of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.* The hosts Satan marshals in his deceit at the cave in 1 Adam and Eve 27:14 are the same who, subject to Satan and leading men astray, are sealed for the fiery judgment.
cards.s_text: And the angel said to Adam, "This hideous form has been his ever since Elohim (God) made him fall from heaven. He could not have come near you in it; he therefore transformed himself into an angel of light."
cards.t_text: And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.’

cards.note: Isaiah 14:12 — *How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!* The shining angel-of-light counterfeit in 1 Adam and Eve 27:14 masks the morning-star already cast down from heaven.
cards.s_text: And the angel said to Adam, "This hideous form has been his ever since Elohim (God) made him fall from heaven. He could not have come near you in it; he therefore transformed himself into an angel of light."
cards.t_text: How are you fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how are you cut down to the ground, which did weaken the nations!

cards.note: Luke 10:18 — *And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.* The angel's word that Satan's hideous form is his *ever since Elohim (God) made him fall from heaven* in 1 Adam and Eve 27:14 is the very fall Messiah witnessed.
cards.s_text: And the angel said to Adam, "This hideous form has been his ever since Elohim (God) made him fall from heaven. He could not have come near you in it; he therefore transformed himself into an angel of light."
cards.t_text: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The angel stripping Satan to his *own hideous form* in 1 Adam and Eve 27:13 foreshadows the Son manifested to undo his works.
cards.s_text: Then the angel went from Adam and seized Satan at the opening of the cave, and stripped him of the pretense he had assumed, and brought him in his own hideous form to Adam and Eve; who were afraid of him when they saw him.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The serpent of Adam's first fall and the angel-of-light at the cave in 1 Adam and Eve 27:12 are one and the same old serpent who deceives the whole world.
cards.s_text: No sooner had Adam said this, than an angel from Elohim (God) appeared to him in the cave, who said to him, "O Adam, fear not. This is Satan and his hosts; he wishes to deceive you as he deceived you at first. For the first time, he was hidden in the serpent; but this time he is come to you in the likeness of an angel of light; in order that, when you worshipped him, he might enslave you, in the very presence of Elohim (God)."
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The one who *deceived you at first* in 1 Adam and Eve 27:12 is named here the liar and murderer from the beginning.
cards.s_text: No sooner had Adam said this, than an angel from Elohim (God) appeared to him in the cave, who said to him, "O Adam, fear not. This is Satan and his hosts; he wishes to deceive you as he deceived you at first. For the first time, he was hidden in the serpent; but this time he is come to you in the likeness of an angel of light; in order that, when you worshipped him, he might enslave you, in the very presence of Elohim (God)."
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* The angel's word that Satan *was hidden in the serpent* and now strikes again in 1 Adam and Eve 27:12 is the seed-war of Eden continuing against the woman's line.
cards.s_text: No sooner had Adam said this, than an angel from Elohim (God) appeared to him in the cave, who said to him, "O Adam, fear not. This is Satan and his hosts; he wishes to deceive you as he deceived you at first. For the first time, he was hidden in the serpent; but this time he is come to you in the likeness of an angel of light; in order that, when you worshipped him, he might enslave you, in the very presence of Elohim (God)."
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Galatians 1:8 — *But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.* Adam testing whether the shining host is truly *sent by you* in 1 Adam and Eve 27:11 enacts the warning that even an angel of light may bring a curse.
cards.s_text: But, look, we see these hosts that stand at the mouth of the cave; they are in a great light; they sing loud praises. If they are of some other god than You, tell me; and if they are sent by you, inform me of the reason for which You have sent them."
cards.t_text: But though we, or an angel from heaven, preach any other gospel unto you than that which we have preached unto you, let him be accursed.

cards.note: 1 John 4:1 — *Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of Elohim (God): because many false prophets are gone out into the world.* Adam's refusal to trust the host until they prove their sending in 1 Adam and Eve 27:8 is this same proving of the spirits.
cards.s_text: If they were from Elohim (God), they would come into the cave with us, and would tell us why they were sent."
cards.t_text: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of Elohim (God): because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 6:4 — *Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel): Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) is one Yahuah (LORD).* Adam's question whether there is *another god besides You* in 1 Adam and Eve 27:10 is the Shema confessed at the cave generations before it was spoken to Israel.
cards.s_text: "O Yahuah (Lord), is there in the world another god besides You, who created angels and filled them with light, and sent them to keep us, who would come with them?
cards.t_text: Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel): Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) is one Yahuah (LORD):

cards.note: John 1:5 — *And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.* Satan's counterfeit glistening in 1 Adam and Eve 27:4 only apes the true Light that the darkness can neither seize nor mimic at the root.
cards.s_text: And Satan did this, in order that when Adam saw the light, he should think within himself that it was a heavenly light, and that Satan's hosts were angels; and that Elohim (God) had sent them to watch at the cave, and to give him light in the darkness.
cards.t_text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

cards.note: Isaiah 14:13 — *For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of Elohim (God): I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north.* The throne Satan sets at the cave's mouth in 1 Adam and Eve 27:2-3 is the same exalted seat of his first rebellion.
cards.s_text: He began with transforming his hosts; in his hands was a flashing fire, and they were in a great light.
cards.t_text: For you have said in your heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of Elohim (God): I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The very disguise Sha'ul warns of is the apparition Satan raises at the cave in 1 Adam and Eve 27:3-4 to be worshipped as heaven.
cards.s_text: He then placed his throne near the mouth of the cave because he could not enter into it by reason of their prayers. And he shed light into the cave, until the cave glistened over Adam and Eve; while his hosts began to sing praises.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Satan's plot to wipe off their name from the earth at 1 Adam and Eve 28:10 is his strike at the heel, but the head-crushing Seed is already promised.
cards.s_text: But when they came to the mountain to the north of the garden, a very high mountain, without any steps to the top of it, the Devil drew near to Adam and Eve, and made them go up to the top in reality, and not in a vision; wishing, as he did, to throw them down and kill them, and to wipe off their name from the earth; so that this earth should remain to him and his hosts alone.

cards.s_text: But when they came to the mountain to the north of the garden, a very high mountain, without any steps to the top of it, the Devil drew near to Adam and Eve, and made them go up to the top in reality, and not in a vision; wishing, as he did, to throw them down and kill them, and to wipe off their name from the earth; so that this earth should remain to him and his hosts alone.

cards.s_text: But when they came to the mountain to the north of the garden, a very high mountain, without any steps to the top of it, the Devil drew near to Adam and Eve, and made them go up to the top in reality, and not in a vision; wishing, as he did, to throw them down and kill them, and to wipe off their name from the earth; so that this earth should remain to him and his hosts alone.

cards.note: Matthew 4:6 — *And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of Elohim (God), cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.* The devil who marches the first Adam up a high mountain to throw him down at 1 Adam and Eve 28:10 tempts the second Adam to the very same fall.
cards.s_text: But when they came to the mountain to the north of the garden, a very high mountain, without any steps to the top of it, the Devil drew near to Adam and Eve, and made them go up to the top in reality, and not in a vision; wishing, as he did, to throw them down and kill them, and to wipe off their name from the earth; so that this earth should remain to him and his hosts alone.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The words that sink into the hearts of Adam and Eve at 1 Adam and Eve 28:6 are the devil's work, which only the manifested Son undoes.
cards.s_text: These words sank into the heart of Adam and Eve.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Genesis 3:24 — *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* The garden Satan promises to reopen at 1 Adam and Eve 28:5 was sealed by the flaming sword, so his offer is a lie at the very threshold.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) has sent us to take you and bring you to the border of the garden northwards; to the shore of the clear sea, and bathe you and Eve in it, and raise you to your former gladness, that you return again to the garden."
cards.t_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

cards.note: Genesis 3:5 — *For Elohim (God) doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.* Satan's false promise of restoration at 1 Adam and Eve 28:5 is the same overreaching lie he used in the garden, offering by deceit what is not his to give.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) has sent us to take you and bring you to the border of the garden northwards; to the shore of the clear sea, and bathe you and Eve in it, and raise you to your former gladness, that you return again to the garden."
cards.t_text: For Elohim (God) does know that in the day you eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and you shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Adam's trial at 1 Adam and Eve 28:7 is one stroke of the enmity Yahuah set between the serpent and the seed of the woman.
cards.s_text: Yet Elohim (God) withheld His Word from Adam, and did not make him understand at once, but waited to see his strength; whether he would be overcome as Eve was when in the garden, or whether he would prevail.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The deceiver testing Adam at 1 Adam and Eve 28:7 is the liar who has murdered by falsehood from the beginning.
cards.s_text: Yet Elohim (God) withheld His Word from Adam, and did not make him understand at once, but waited to see his strength; whether he would be overcome as Eve was when in the garden, or whether he would prevail.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: Genesis 3:4 — *And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:* The lie that overthrew Eve in the garden is named again at 1 Adam and Eve 28:7, where Yahuah waits to see whether Adam will be overcome as she was.
cards.s_text: Yet Elohim (God) withheld His Word from Adam, and did not make him understand at once, but waited to see his strength; whether he would be overcome as Eve was when in the garden, or whether he would prevail.
cards.t_text: And the serpent said unto the woman, You shall not surely die:

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The host Satan gathers in 1 Adam and Eve 28:1 are the angels cast down with him, and his trade is the deceiving of the whole world.
cards.s_text: But when the crafty Satan saw them, that they were going to the garden, he gathered together his host, and came in appearance on a cloud, intent on deceiving them.
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:3 — *But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).* As Adam and Eve mistake the deceiver for angels of Elohim at 1 Adam and Eve 28:2, Sha'ul warns the same subtilty still corrupts the mind.
cards.s_text: But when Adam and Eve saw him thus in a vision, they thought they were angels of Elohim (God) come to comfort them about having left the garden, or to bring them back again into it.
cards.t_text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The crafty Satan who comes on a cloud at 1 Adam and Eve 28:1 is the same adversary Sha'ul unmasks, working by counterfeit glory.
cards.s_text: But when the crafty Satan saw them, that they were going to the garden, he gathered together his host, and came in appearance on a cloud, intent on deceiving them.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: Matthew 2:11 — *And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.* The golden rods laid up to shine in Adam's cave-night in 1 Adam and Eve 29:7 are the first of the treasure kept against the Saviour's coming — the very gold the magi at last bring to the child.
cards.s_text: This did Elohim (God) in His wisdom in order that these golden rods, being with Adam in the cave, should shine forth with light in the night around him, and put an end to his fear of the darkness.
cards.t_text: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

cards.note: Daniel 12:1 — *And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* The Michael sent to comfort Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 29:6 is the great prince Daniel sees standing for the children of the covenant — the same guardian from the first man to the last trouble.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) considered Adam's thought, and sent the angel Michael as far as the sea that reaches India, to take from there golden rods and bring them to Adam.
cards.t_text: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which stands for the children of your people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time your people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

cards.note: Jude 1:9 — *Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, Yahuah (Lord) rebuke thee.* The angel Michael whom Elohim sends to fetch the golden rods in 1 Adam and Eve 29:6 is the same archangel Jude names contending against the devil — Yahuah's appointed servant against the enemy of Adam's race.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) considered Adam's thought, and sent the angel Michael as far as the sea that reaches India, to take from there golden rods and bring them to Adam.
cards.t_text: Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, Yahuah (Lord) rebuke you.

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The Satan who seeks to deceive Adam and his seed in 1 Adam and Eve 29:4 is the very serpent John names as the deceiver of the whole world.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word from Elohim (God) to Adam, and said to him, "Know you and understand concerning this Satan, that he seeks to deceive you and your descendants after you."

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:* Peter's charge to watchfulness is the practical form of the Word's first-day warning to Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 29:4 — know and understand this Satan who seeks your destruction.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word from Elohim (God) to Adam, and said to him, "Know you and understand concerning this Satan, that he seeks to deceive you and your descendants after you."

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The Word's warning that Satan seeks to deceive Adam and his descendants in 1 Adam and Eve 29:4 unmasks the enemy's one tactic — the false light Paul exposes.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word from Elohim (God) to Adam, and said to him, "Know you and understand concerning this Satan, that he seeks to deceive you and your descendants after you."
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word that comes to Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 29:4 to counsel and warn him is the Logos John names — the same who was with Elohim from the beginning now walking with the first man.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word from Elohim (God) to Adam, and said to him, "Know you and understand concerning this Satan, that he seeks to deceive you and your descendants after you."
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* John names the very work Elohim begins to undo when He curses Satan in 1 Adam and Eve 29:1 — the devil who sins from the beginning meets the Son manifested to destroy his works.
cards.s_text: But when the merciful Elohim (God) saw that Satan wished to kill Adam with his many tricks, and saw that Adam was meek and without guile, Elohim (God) spoke to Satan in a loud voice, and cursed him.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* As Satan and his hosts flee the rebuke in 1 Adam and Eve 29:2, Paul names the end of that same war — the serpent bruised under the feet of the redeemed.
cards.s_text: Then he and his hosts fled, and Adam and Eve remained standing on the top of the mountain, from there they saw below them the wide world, high above which they were. But they saw none of the host which time after time were by them.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: Genesis 3:24 — *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* The cherub who guards the Tree in 1 Adam and Eve 30:7 is the same guardian set at the east of Eden after the expulsion.

cards.note: Matthew 2:11 — *And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.* The gold, incense, and myrrh gathered from the borders of the garden in 1 Adam and Eve 30:6 are the very gifts borne to Bethlehem.

cards.note: Jonah 1:17 — *Now Yahuah (LORD) had prepared a great fish to swallow up Jonah. And Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights.* The three-day sign sealed into Adam's third day in 1 Adam and Eve 31:11 is foreshadowed in Jonah's three days in the deep.

cards.note: Matthew 12:40 — *For as Jonas was three days and three nights in the whale's belly; so shall the Son of Adam be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.* The "three days... in the heart of the earth" foretold to Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 31:11 is the very sign the Son of Adam gives for His burial and rising.
