cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:20 — *Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,* The Saviour promised to Adam on his third day out of the garden was foreordained before the foundation of the world, matching 1 Adam and Eve 31:2.
cards.s_text: For I will come and save you; and kings shall bring me when in the flesh, gold, incense and myrrh; gold as a token of My kingdom; incense as a token of My divinity; and myrrh as a token of My suffering and of My death.
cards.t_text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

cards.note: Galatians 4:4 — *But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,* The promise "I will come and save you" of 1 Adam and Eve 31:2 is kept in the fulness of time, the Saviour come in the flesh.
cards.s_text: For I will come and save you; and kings shall bring me when in the flesh, gold, incense and myrrh; gold as a token of My kingdom; incense as a token of My divinity; and myrrh as a token of My suffering and of My death.
cards.t_text: But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

cards.note: Matthew 2:11 — *And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.* The very three tokens Adam kept in the cave are the gifts the kings bring to the child, exactly as 1 Adam and Eve 31:2 foretold.
cards.s_text: For I will come and save you; and kings shall bring me when in the flesh, gold, incense and myrrh; gold as a token of My kingdom; incense as a token of My divinity; and myrrh as a token of My suffering and of My death.
cards.t_text: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

cards.note: Hebrews 4:16 — *Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.* Adam and Eve standing afar off in the water to obtain mercy reach toward the same throne of grace the gospel opens (1 Adam & Eve 32:7).
cards.s_text: Then Eve went down into the water, as Adam had commanded her. Adam also went down into the water; and they stood praying; and besought Yahuah (Lord) to forgive them their offense, and to restore them to their former state.
cards.t_text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

cards.note: Revelation 22:14 — *Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.* The restoration to their former state that Adam and Eve beseech is fulfilled in the right of entry to the tree of life at the end (1 Adam & Eve 32:7).
cards.s_text: Then Eve went down into the water, as Adam had commanded her. Adam also went down into the water; and they stood praying; and besought Yahuah (Lord) to forgive them their offense, and to restore them to their former state.
cards.t_text: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.

cards.note: Revelation 2:7 — *He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God).* Adam's plea to be taken back to the garden is granted to the overcomer in the restored paradise of Elohim (1 Adam & Eve 32:3).
cards.s_text: But now, get up, let us go to the sea of water we saw at first, and let us stand in it, praying that Elohim (God) will again be favorable to us and take us back to the garden; or give us something; or that He will give us comfort in some other land than this in which we are."
cards.t_text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Jubilees 3:27 — *And on that day on which Adam went forth from the garden, he offered as a sweet savour an offering, frankincense, galbanum, and stacte, and spices in the morning with the rising of the sun from the day when he covered his shame.* Jubilees keeps the same memory of Adam worshipping at the garden's edge that frames his prayers and offerings here (1 Adam & Eve 32:2).
cards.s_text: And when it dawned on the eighth day, Adam said to Eve, "O Eve, we prayed Elohim (God) to give us something from the garden, and He sent his angels who brought us what we had desired.
cards.t_text: And on that day on which Adam went forth from the garden, he offered as a sweet savour an offering, frankincense, galbanum, and stacte, and spices in the morning with the rising of the sun from the day when he covered his shame.

cards.note: Daniel 9:3 — *And I set my face unto Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God), to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:* Adam and Eve's seven-day fast without bread or water in the cave is Daniel's penitential fasting kept in the very first generation (1 Adam & Eve 32:1).
cards.s_text: And Adam and Eve remained in the Cave of Treasures until the seventh day; they neither ate of the fruit the earth, nor drank water.
cards.t_text: And I set my face unto Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God), to seek by prayer and supplications, with fasting, and sackcloth, and ashes:

cards.note: Joel 2:13 — *And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God): for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.* The mercy Adam counts on when he tells Eve to pray for forgiveness is this gracious and merciful Yahuah (1 Adam & Eve 32:5).
cards.s_text: Come, go down into this place, and come not out of it until the end of thirty days, when I shall come to you. And pray to Elohim (God) with burning heart and a sweet voice, to forgive us.
cards.t_text: And rend your heart, and not your garments, and turn unto Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God): for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and repenteth him of the evil.

cards.note: Joel 2:12 — *Therefore also now, saith Yahuah (LORD), turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:* Adam's charge to pray with burning heart, fasting in the cave, is this prophet's call to turn with the whole heart sounded at the dawn of the world (1 Adam & Eve 32:5).
cards.s_text: Come, go down into this place, and come not out of it until the end of thirty days, when I shall come to you. And pray to Elohim (God) with burning heart and a sweet voice, to forgive us.
cards.t_text: Therefore also now, says Yahuah (LORD), turn you even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:

cards.note: Luke 18:13 — *And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, Elohim (God) be merciful to me a sinner.* Adam's charge to pray with burning heart to be forgiven is the publican's posture from the first day outside Eden (1 Adam & Eve 32:5).
cards.s_text: Come, go down into this place, and come not out of it until the end of thirty days, when I shall come to you. And pray to Elohim (God) with burning heart and a sweet voice, to forgive us.
cards.t_text: And the publican, standing afar off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but smote upon his breast, saying, Elohim (God) be merciful to me a sinner.

cards.note: 1 John 1:9 — *If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.* The apostle states as covenant promise what the first parents enact bodily in the water, confessing and beseeking forgiveness (1 Adam & Eve 32:7).
cards.s_text: Then Eve went down into the water, as Adam had commanded her. Adam also went down into the water; and they stood praying; and besought Yahuah (Lord) to forgive them their offense, and to restore them to their former state.
cards.t_text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

cards.note: Psalm 130:4 — *But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.* This is the very thing Adam besought when he asked Yahuah to forgive their offense (1 Adam & Eve 32:7).
cards.s_text: Then Eve went down into the water, as Adam had commanded her. Adam also went down into the water; and they stood praying; and besought Yahuah (Lord) to forgive them their offense, and to restore them to their former state.
cards.t_text: But there is forgiveness with you, that you may be feared.

cards.note: Psalm 130:1 — *Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Yahuah (LORD).* Adam and Eve standing in the deep waters to plead for pardon are the living image of this cry out of the depths (1 Adam & Eve 32:7).
cards.s_text: Then Eve went down into the water, as Adam had commanded her. Adam also went down into the water; and they stood praying; and besought Yahuah (Lord) to forgive them their offense, and to restore them to their former state.
cards.t_text: Out of the depths have I cried unto you, O Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* Every deception of Satan unmasked in 1 Adam & Eve 33:14 moves toward the promised end, when the Elohim of peace bruises Satan underfoot.
cards.s_text: But Adam grieved, and gave her to know it was Satan. He then took her and they both returned to the cave.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* When Adam is given *to know it was Satan* in 1 Adam & Eve 33:14, the deceiver's work is unmasked — the very works the Son of Elohim was manifested to destroy.
cards.s_text: But Adam grieved, and gave her to know it was Satan. He then took her and they both returned to the cave.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The same Word who comes from heaven to rescue Adam in 1 Adam & Eve 33:12 will be made flesh and dwell among men, full of grace and truth.
cards.s_text: But Elohim (God) looked at him and at his misery, and at his being about to breathe his last. And the Word of Elohim (God) came from heaven, raised him out of the water, and said to him, "Go up the high bank to Eve." And when he came up to Eve he said to her, "Who told you to come here?"
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The *Word of Elohim* who *came from heaven* and raised Adam out of the water in 1 Adam & Eve 33:12 is the Logos who was in the beginning with Elohim and was Elohim.
cards.s_text: But Elohim (God) looked at him and at his misery, and at his being about to breathe his last. And the Word of Elohim (God) came from heaven, raised him out of the water, and said to him, "Go up the high bank to Eve." And when he came up to Eve he said to her, "Who told you to come here?"
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Galatians 4:4 — *But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,* The treasures Adam guards in the cave in 1 Adam & Eve 33:7 wait for the appointed time when Elohim sends forth His Son, made of a woman.
cards.s_text: And he said to me, 'Speak to Eve; if she does not come with you, tell her of the sign when we were on the top of the mountain; how Elohim (God) sent his angels who took us and brought us to the Cave of Treasures; and laid the gold on the southern side; incense, on the eastern side; and myrrh on the western side.' Now come to him."
cards.t_text: But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

cards.note: Matthew 2:11 — *And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.* The gold, incense, and myrrh laid up in the Cave of Treasures in 1 Adam & Eve 33:7 are the very three gifts the magi open before the Saviour they were kept for.
cards.s_text: And he said to me, 'Speak to Eve; if she does not come with you, tell her of the sign when we were on the top of the mountain; how Elohim (God) sent his angels who took us and brought us to the Cave of Treasures; and laid the gold on the southern side; incense, on the eastern side; and myrrh on the western side.' Now come to him."
cards.t_text: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The phantom who goes before Eve and then *hid himself from her, and she saw him no more* (1 Adam & Eve 33:9) is that old serpent whose whole work is to deceive the world.
cards.s_text: He went before, and she followed him until they came to Adam. Then Satan hid himself from her, and she saw him no more.
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: 1 Timothy 2:14 — *And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.* That Satan *went not to Adam, but he went to Eve*, who thinking his appearance real *came out of the sea* (1 Adam & Eve 33:8), follows the Eden pattern Sha'ul records — the woman being deceived.
cards.s_text: When Eve hear these words from him, she rejoiced greatly. And thinking Satan's appearance was real, she came out of the sea.
cards.t_text: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman being deceived was in the transgression.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:3 — *But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).* The false "glad tidings of salvation" Satan speaks to Eve in 1 Adam & Eve 33:5 is the same subtle beguiling by which the serpent first deceived her.
cards.s_text: "Peace be to you! Be glad and rejoice! Elohim (God) is favorable to you, and He sent me to Adam. I have brought him the glad tidings of salvation, and of his being filled with bright light as he was at first.
cards.t_text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* When Satan *took the form of an angel of Elohim* to deceive Eve in 1 Adam & Eve 33:4, he is doing the very thing Sha'ul warns of — transforming himself into an angel of light.
cards.s_text: Then the hater of all good, went not to Adam, but he went to Eve, and took the form of an angel of Elohim (God), praising and rejoicing, and said to her:--
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Satan's plot to take Adam and Eve *from under my hand* in 1 Adam & Eve 33:2 is the enmity of Eden working itself out — the serpent striking back at the woman whose seed will bruise his head.
cards.s_text: But he found them standing in the water praying and thought within himself, "Adam and Eve are standing like that in that water praying to Elohim (God) to forgive them their transgression, and to restore them to their former state, and to take them from under my hand.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The hater of all good who hunts Adam and Eve in 1 Adam & Eve 33:1 is the murderer and liar Yahusha says was such from the beginning.
cards.s_text: But Satan, the hater of all good, sought them in the cave, but found them not, although he searched diligently for them.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:* The Satan who *sought them in the cave* and *searched diligently for them* in 1 Adam & Eve 33:1 is Kepha's same prowling lion seeking whom he may devour.
cards.s_text: But Satan, the hater of all good, sought them in the cave, but found them not, although he searched diligently for them.
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: Romans 5:15 — *But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of Elohim (God), and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), hath abounded unto many.* The transgression that stripped Adam's grace in 34:17 is the one offence Sha'ul sets against the abounding gift of the promised Seed.
cards.s_text: But now, O Elohim (God), since we transgressed Your commandment and broke Your law, You have brought us out into a strange land, and have caused suffering, and faintness, hunger and thirst to come over us.
cards.t_text: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of Elohim (God), and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ), has abounded unto many.

cards.note: Genesis 3:23 — *Therefore Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.* Adam's lament that "You have brought us out into a strange land" in 34:17 is this expulsion remembered from outside the gate.
cards.s_text: But now, O Elohim (God), since we transgressed Your commandment and broke Your law, You have brought us out into a strange land, and have caused suffering, and faintness, hunger and thirst to come over us.
cards.t_text: Therefore Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

cards.note: *Then You drew a rib out of my side, and created it after my own likeness and image. Then I awoke; and when I saw her and knew who she was, I said, 'This is bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh; from now on she shall be called woman.'* (1 Adam and Eve 34:14). *And Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) caused a deep sleep to fall upon him, and he slept, and He took for the woman one rib from amongst his ribs, and this rib was the origin of the woman from amongst his ribs, and He built up the flesh in its stead, and built the woman.* (Jubilees 3:5). Adam recalls that he slept, that a rib was drawn from his side, and that he woke to see the woman and name her. Jubilees tells the same event from the other side: Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) caused the deep sleep, took one rib, and built the woman from it. The two accounts agree on the sleep and the rib, and each says what the other leaves out: Adam speaks as the one who slept and woke, and Jubilees speaks of the hand that built her.
cards.s_text: Then You drew a rib out of my side, and created it after my own likeness and image. Then I awoke; and when I saw her and knew who she was, I said, 'This is bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh; from now on she shall be called woman.'
cards.t_text: And Yahuah our Elohim (the LORD our God) caused a deep sleep to fall upon him, and he slept, and He took for the woman one rib from amongst his ribs, and this rib was the origin of the woman from amongst his ribs, and He built up the flesh in its stead, and built the woman.

cards.note: Genesis 2:23 — *And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.* Adam's words in 34:14, "bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh," are this Genesis cry repeated in his prayer.
cards.s_text: Then You drew a rib out of my side, and created it after my own likeness and image. Then I awoke; and when I saw her and knew who she was, I said, 'This is bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh; from now on she shall be called woman.'
cards.t_text: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

cards.note: Genesis 2:21 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;* Adam's memory of the "slumber and a sleep" and the rib drawn from his side in 34:13 is this Genesis act recounted.
cards.s_text: Then, at the end of the third hour of that Friday, O Yahuah (Lord), You caused a slumber and a sleep to come over me, and I slept, and was overwhelmed in sleep.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;

cards.note: Romans 5:14 — *Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.* The death Adam expected in 34:11 reigns onward, yet Adam himself is named the figure of the coming Seed.
cards.s_text: And if You had punished me as You said, with death, I should have died that very moment.
cards.t_text: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

cards.note: *And if You had punished me as You said, with death, I should have died that very moment.* (1 Adam and Eve 34:11). *Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:* (Romans 5:12). Adam looks back on the day he ate and marvels that he was not struck dead on the spot, as the command had said he would be. Paul traces the same line: by one man sin entered into the world, and death came through sin. What Adam says of himself in his own telling, the apostle says of him for all who came after, that the death spoken over the tree reached everyone through the one who ate.
cards.s_text: And if You had punished me as You said, with death, I should have died that very moment.
cards.t_text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

cards.note: Genesis 2:17 — *But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.* Adam's quoted command, "When you eat of it, of death you shall die," is this Genesis word spoken back to Yahuah in 34:10.
cards.s_text: Then it was in that third hour of Friday, in which You created me, and commanded me concerning the tree, to which I was neither to go near, nor to eat thereof; for You said to me in the garden, 'When you eat of it, of death you shall die.'
cards.t_text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you shall not eat of it: for in the day that you eat thereof you shall surely die.

cards.note: Jubilees 3:2 — *And Adam named them all by their respective names, and as he called them, so was their name.* The restored Jubilees carries the same naming Adam rehearses in 34:8, the primeval history shared across the library.
cards.s_text: And Your will was that I should name them all, one by one, with a suitable name. But You gave me understanding and knowledge, and a pure heart and a right mind from you, that I should name them after Thine own mind regarding the naming of them.
cards.t_text: And Adam named them all by their respective names, and as he called them, so was their name.

cards.note: Genesis 2:20 — *And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.* The dominion Adam mourns as now "estranged from me" in 34:9 is the naming-dominion Genesis records him exercising.
cards.s_text: O Elohim (God), You made them obedient to me, and ordered that not one of them break from my sway, according to Your commandment, and to the dominion which You had given me over them. But now they are all estranged from me.
cards.t_text: And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.

cards.note: Genesis 2:19 — *And out of the ground Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.* Adam's plea that Yahuah "brought to me all beasts... that I should name them all" recounts this very bringing.
cards.s_text: And Your will was that I should name them all, one by one, with a suitable name. But You gave me understanding and knowledge, and a pure heart and a right mind from you, that I should name them after Thine own mind regarding the naming of them.
cards.t_text: And out of the ground Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) formed every beast of the field, and every fowl of the air; and brought them unto Adam to see what he would call them: and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 15:47 — *The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is Adonai (Lord) from heaven.* Adam's confession of being made from earth's dust sets the very contrast Sha'ul draws against the heavenly Man.
cards.s_text: Then You spread Your hand and created me out of one element, that of dust of the earth; and You brought me into the garden at the third hour, on a Friday, and informed me of it in the cave.
cards.t_text: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 15:45 — *And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.* The dust-formed Adam of 34:5 is named by Sha'ul as the type whose ruin the last Adam undoes.
cards.s_text: Then You spread Your hand and created me out of one element, that of dust of the earth; and You brought me into the garden at the third hour, on a Friday, and informed me of it in the cave.
cards.t_text: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.

cards.note: Genesis 2:7 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.* Adam's prayer that Yahuah "created me out of one element, that of dust of the earth" simply hands the Genesis formation back to its Maker.
cards.s_text: Then You spread Your hand and created me out of one element, that of dust of the earth; and You brought me into the garden at the third hour, on a Friday, and informed me of it in the cave.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Even as the trials begin in 35:2, the seed-promise already stands as Yahuah's mercy against the serpent.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, when you were in My garden, you knew neither eating nor drinking; neither faintness nor suffering; neither leanness of flesh, nor change; neither did sleep depart from thine eyes. But since you transgressed, and came into this strange land, all these trials are come over you."
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Romans 5:12 — *Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned.* Paul names the same one-man transgression that brought Adam into the strange land of suffering in 35:2.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, when you were in My garden, you knew neither eating nor drinking; neither faintness nor suffering; neither leanness of flesh, nor change; neither did sleep depart from thine eyes. But since you transgressed, and came into this strange land, all these trials are come over you."
cards.t_text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

cards.note: Genesis 3:17 — *And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life.* The trials of the strange land in 35:2 are the curse pronounced over Adam at the fall.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, when you were in My garden, you knew neither eating nor drinking; neither faintness nor suffering; neither leanness of flesh, nor change; neither did sleep depart from thine eyes. cards.note: Genesis 2:17 — *But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.* The transgression named in 35:2 is the breaking of this one command, the door to all the trials.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, when you were in My garden, you knew neither eating nor drinking; neither faintness nor suffering; neither leanness of flesh, nor change; neither did sleep depart from thine eyes. But since you transgressed, and came into this strange land, all these trials are come over you."
cards.t_text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you shall not eat of it: for in the day that you eat thereof you shall surely die.

cards.note: Revelation 22:2 — *In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.* The garden's deathless life of 35:2 returns at the tree of life in the city of Elohim.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, when you were in My garden, you knew neither eating nor drinking; neither faintness nor suffering; neither leanness of flesh, nor change; neither did sleep depart from thine eyes. But since you transgressed, and came into this strange land, all these trials are come over you."
cards.t_text: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

cards.note: Revelation 21:4 — *And Elohim (God) shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.* The no-suffering, no-change estate of the garden in 35:2 is exactly what is restored in the New Jerusalem.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, when you were in My garden, you knew neither eating nor drinking; neither faintness nor suffering; neither leanness of flesh, nor change; neither did sleep depart from thine eyes. But since you transgressed, and came into this strange land, all these trials are come over you."
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

cards.note: Genesis 2:15 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.* The garden of 35:2, free of faintness and suffering, is the very Eden Yahuah first gave Adam to keep.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, when you were in My garden, you knew neither eating nor drinking; neither faintness nor suffering; neither leanness of flesh, nor change; neither did sleep depart from thine eyes. But since you transgressed, and came into this strange land, all these trials are come over you."
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to dress it and to keep it.

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The Word who comforts the exiled Adam in 35:1 will one day take flesh to redeem that exile.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) looked again at Adam and his crying and groaning, and the Word of Elohim (God) came to him, and said to him:--
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: Genesis 3:8 — *And they heard the voice of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) amongst the trees of the garden.* The voice that walked in Eden is the Word who now comes to Adam outside it in 35:1.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) looked again at Adam and his crying and groaning, and the Word of Elohim (God) came to him, and said to him:--
cards.t_text: And they heard the voice of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) amongst the trees of the garden.

cards.note: John 1:3 — *All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.* The same Word who made Adam now stoops to comfort him in his crying and groaning.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) looked again at Adam and his crying and groaning, and the Word of Elohim (God) came to him, and said to him:--
cards.t_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word who comes to Adam in 35:1 is the eternal Logos, Elohim Himself, not a created messenger.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) looked again at Adam and his crying and groaning, and the Word of Elohim (God) came to him, and said to him:--
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Hebrews 1:14 — *Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?* Even as Adam now fears the angels in 1 Adam and Eve 36:5, the angels remain Yahuah's servants sent to minister to the heirs of mercy.
cards.s_text: At first, angels trembled at the presence of Adam and were afraid of him. But now Adam trembled before the angels and was afraid of them.
cards.t_text: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

cards.note: Hebrews 2:7 — *Thou madest him a little lower than the angels; thou crownedst him with glory and honour, and didst set him over the works of thy hands.* The dominion and glory reversed in 1 Adam and Eve 36:5 is the very crown of man Hebrews says is yet to be restored in the Son.
cards.s_text: At first, angels trembled at the presence of Adam and were afraid of him. But now Adam trembled before the angels and was afraid of them.
cards.t_text: You made him a little lower than the angels; you crownedst him with glory and honour, and did set him over the works of your hands:

cards.note: Psalm 8:5 — *For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.* The glory at which angels once trembled in 1 Adam and Eve 36:5 is the crown of man Psalm 8 confesses, now darkened by the fall so that Adam fears them.
cards.s_text: At first, angels trembled at the presence of Adam and were afraid of him. But now Adam trembled before the angels and was afraid of them.
cards.t_text: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and have crowned him with glory and honour.

cards.note: Jubilees 3:21 — *And when she had first covered her shame with fig-leaves, she gave thereof to Adam and he ate, and his eyes were opened, and he saw that he was naked.* Jubilees ties the fig-leaves to the opened eyes of the fall, the same figs the pair recognize in 1 Adam and Eve 36:7.
cards.s_text: And as they took them up in their hands, they looked at them, and knew they were from the trees among which they had hidden themselves.
cards.t_text: And when she had first covered her shame with fig-leaves, she gave thereof to Adam and he ate, and his eyes were opened, and he saw that he was naked.

cards.note: Genesis 3:7 — *And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.* The fig the pair recognize in 1 Adam and Eve 36:7 is the fruit of the same fig-tree whose leaves first covered their shame.
cards.s_text: And as they took them up in their hands, they looked at them, and knew they were from the trees among which they had hidden themselves.
cards.t_text: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

cards.note: Genesis 3:8 — *And they heard the voice of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) amongst the trees of the garden.* 1 Adam and Eve 36:2 names these as the very trees among which they hid, from which the figs are now taken.
cards.s_text: The cherub obeyed the command of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God), and went into the garden and brought two figs on two twigs, each fig hanging to its leaf; they were from two of the trees among which Adam and Eve hid themselves when Elohim (God) went to walk in the garden, and the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam and Eve and said to them, "Adam, Adam, where are you?"
cards.t_text: And they heard the voice of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) amongst the trees of the garden.

cards.note: Hebrews 4:13 — *Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.* Adam's hiding because he is naked in 1 Adam and Eve 36:3 is undone before the Word from whom nothing is hidden.
cards.s_text: And Adam answered, "O Elohim (God), here I am. When I heard the sound of You and Your voice, I hid myself, because I am naked."
cards.t_text: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The book names the One walking and speaking in Eden as "the Word of Elohim" in 1 Adam and Eve 36:2 — the Logos who was from the beginning.
cards.s_text: The cherub obeyed the command of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God), and went into the garden and brought two figs on two twigs, each fig hanging to its leaf; they were from two of the trees among which Adam and Eve hid themselves when Elohim (God) went to walk in the garden, and the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam and Eve and said to them, "Adam, Adam, where are you?"
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Genesis 3:10 — *And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.* Adam's answer in 1 Adam and Eve 36:3 repeats this confession of hearing the voice, fearing, and hiding because naked.
cards.s_text: And Adam answered, "O Elohim (God), here I am. When I heard the sound of You and Your voice, I hid myself, because I am naked."
cards.t_text: And he said, I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.

cards.note: Genesis 3:9 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?* 1 Adam and Eve 36:2 quotes this same call of the Word, "Adam, Adam, where are you?"
cards.s_text: The cherub obeyed the command of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God), and went into the garden and brought two figs on two twigs, each fig hanging to its leaf; they were from two of the trees among which Adam and Eve hid themselves when Elohim (God) went to walk in the garden, and the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam and Eve and said to them, "Adam, Adam, where are you?"

cards.note: Jubilees 3:26 — *And He made for them coats of skin, and clothed them, and sent them forth from the Garden of Eden.* Jubilees carries the same exit from Eden whose threshold the fire-armed cherub guards in 1 Adam and Eve 36:4.
cards.s_text: Then the cherub took two figs and brought them to Adam and Eve. But he threw them to them from a distance; for they might not come near the cherub by reason of their flesh, that could not come near the fire.
cards.t_text: And He made for them coats of skin, and clothed them, and sent them forth from the Garden of Eden.

cards.note: Hebrews 1:14 — *Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?* The cherub obeying Yahuah's command to serve fallen Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 36:2 is exactly this ministering spirit sent for the heir of mercy.
cards.s_text: The cherub obeyed the command of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God), and went into the garden and brought two figs on two twigs, each fig hanging to its leaf; they were from two of the trees among which Adam and Eve hid themselves when Elohim (God) went to walk in the garden, and the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam and Eve and said to them, "Adam, Adam, where are you?"

cards.note: Genesis 3:24 — *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* The cherub with the sword of fire who gives Adam the figs in 1 Adam and Eve 36:1 is the same guardian set at the gate of Eden.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) commanded the cherub, who kept the gate of the garden with a sword of fire in his hand, to take some of the fruit of the fig-tree, and to give it to Adam.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The mercy Adam pleads in 1 Adam & Eve 37:10 is the seed-war's end — the Son manifested to undo the serpent's hour.
cards.s_text: But now, O Yahuah (Lord), behold, we have endured all these days, and have borne sufferings. Make these forty-three days an equivalent for the one hour in which we transgressed."
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Psalm 103:13 — *Like as a father pitieth his children, so Yahuah (LORD) pitieth them that fear him.* The eye of pity Adam appeals to in 1 Adam & Eve 37:7 is the Father's mercy toward those who fear Him.
cards.s_text: O Elohim (God), look at us with an eye of pity, and do not avenge us according to our transgression of Your commandment, in Your presence.
cards.t_text: Like as a father pitieth his children, so Yahuah (LORD) pitieth them that fear him.

cards.note: Psalm 103:10 — *He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.* The very pardon Adam asks for in 1 Adam & Eve 37:7 — not to be avenged according to his transgression.
cards.s_text: O Elohim (God), look at us with an eye of pity, and do not avenge us according to our transgression of Your commandment, in Your presence.
cards.t_text: He has not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

cards.note: Revelation 22:14 — *Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.* The barred Tree of Life of 1 Adam & Eve 37:8 is the inheritance reopened to the commandment-keeping seed.
cards.s_text: O Elohim (God), give us of the fruit of the Tree of Life, that we may eat of it, and live, and turn not to see sufferings and other trouble, in this earth; for You are Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.

cards.note: Revelation 2:7 — *He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God).* The fruit Adam pleads for in 1 Adam & Eve 37:8 is given at last to the overcomer in the restored paradise.
cards.s_text: O Elohim (God), give us of the fruit of the Tree of Life, that we may eat of it, and live, and turn not to see sufferings and other trouble, in this earth; for You are Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Genesis 3:24 — *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* This is the cherub Adam names as keeping the Tree of Life in 1 Adam & Eve 37:9.
cards.s_text: When we transgressed Your commandment, You made us come out of the garden, and sent a cherub to keep the Tree of Life, lest we should eat thereof, and live; and know nothing of faintness after we transgressed.
cards.t_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

cards.s_text: But in the evening You made us come out of it. O Elohim (God), we transgressed against You one hour, and all these trials and sorrows have come over us until this day.
cards.t_text: And He made for them coats of skin, and clothed them, and sent them forth from the Garden of Eden.

cards.note: Genesis 3:23 — *Therefore Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.* This is the coming-out of the garden in the evening that Adam recounts in 1 Adam & Eve 37:5.
cards.s_text: But in the evening You made us come out of it. O Elohim (God), we transgressed against You one hour, and all these trials and sorrows have come over us until this day.

cards.note: Genesis 3:6 — *And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.* The act that stripped the bright nature Adam mourns in 1 Adam & Eve 37:4.
cards.s_text: But Adam began to pray to Elohim (God) and to beseech Him to give him of the fruit of the Tree of Life, saying thus: "O Elohim (God), when we transgressed Your commandment at the sixth hour of Friday, we were stripped of the bright nature we had, and did not continue in the garden after our transgression, more than three hours.

cards.s_text: But Adam began to pray to Elohim (God) and to beseech Him to give him of the fruit of the Tree of Life, saying thus: "O Elohim (God), when we transgressed Your commandment at the sixth hour of Friday, we were stripped of the bright nature we had, and did not continue in the garden after our transgression, more than three hours.

cards.note: Jubilees 3:21–22 — *And when she had first covered her shame with fig-leaves, she gave thereof to Adam and he ate, and his eyes were opened, and he saw that he was naked. And he took fig-leaves and sewed (them) together, and made an apron for himself, and covered his shame.* The same primeval history records the fig-leaf covering that 1 Adam & Eve 37:2 turns away from to seek the Tree of Life.
cards.s_text: Now, therefore, O Eve, let us restrain ourselves and not eat of them, you and I; and let us ask Elohim (God) to give us of the fruit of the Tree of Life."
