cards.note: Genesis 3:7 — *And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.* These are the very fig leaves Adam sees and names in 1 Adam & Eve 37:1 — the covering of the fall.
cards.s_text: Then Adam said to Eve, "Do you not see these figs and their leaves, with which we covered ourselves when we were stripped of our bright nature? But now, we do not know what misery and suffering may come over us from eating them.
cards.t_text: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

cards.note: Hebrews 8:6 — *But now hath he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.* The covenant Adam is told to endure for in 1 Adam and Eve 38:5 is the better covenant the coming Mediator establishes.
cards.s_text: I will not deny your request, neither will I disappoint your hope; therefore, endure until the fulfillment of the covenant I made with you."
cards.t_text: But now has he obtained a more excellent ministry, by how much also he is the mediator of a better covenant, which was established upon better promises.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 1:20 — *For all the promises of Elohim (God) in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of Elohim (God) by us.* The hope the Word promises not to disappoint in 1 Adam and Eve 38:5 is sure because all His promises are Yea and Amen in the Son.
cards.s_text: I will not deny your request, neither will I disappoint your hope; therefore, endure until the fulfillment of the covenant I made with you."
cards.t_text: For all the promises of Elohim (God) in him are yea, and in him Amen, unto the glory of Elohim (God) by us.

cards.note: *"O Adam, as to the fruit on the Tree of Life that you have asked for, I will not give it to you now, but only when the 5500 years are fulfilled. At that time I will give you fruit from the Tree of Life, and you will eat, and live forever, you, and Eve, and your righteous descendants.* (1 Adam and Eve 38:2). *And he lacked seventy years of one thousand years; for one thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens and therefore was it written concerning the tree of knowledge: “On the day that you eat thereof you will die.” For this reason he did not complete the years of this day; for he died during it.* (Jubilees 4:30). Elohim (God) tells Adam that the fruit of the Tree of Life is held back until the 5500 years are fulfilled, and then he and Eve and their righteous descendants will eat and live forever. Jubilees shows how the heavens count such spans: a thousand years are as one day, and Adam, lacking seventy years of a thousand, died within the day of the command about the tree. The long wait Adam is given is counted in these days of the heavens.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, as to the fruit on the Tree of Life that you have asked for, I will not give it to you now, but only when the 5500 years are fulfilled. At that time I will give you fruit from the Tree of Life, and you will eat, and live forever, you, and Eve, and your righteous descendants.
cards.t_text: And he lacked seventy years of one thousand years; for one thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens and therefore was it written concerning the tree of knowledge: “On the day that you eat thereof you will die.” For this reason he did not complete the years of this day; for he died during it.

cards.note: *"O Adam, as to the fruit on the Tree of Life that you have asked for, I will not give it to you now, but only when the 5500 years are fulfilled. At that time I will give you fruit from the Tree of Life, and you will eat, and live forever, you, and Eve, and your righteous descendants.* (1 Adam and Eve 38:2). *But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with Yahuah (Lord) as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.* (2 Peter 3:8). Elohim (God) promises Adam the fruit of the Tree of Life only when the 5500 years are fulfilled, a span counted in thousands. Peter tells his beloved not to be ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with Yahuah (the Lord) as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day. That is the scale on which Elohim (God) speaks when He tells Adam to wait: what looks to Adam like a very long delay is a few days to the one who made him, and the promise is held to its appointed day.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, as to the fruit on the Tree of Life that you have asked for, I will not give it to you now, but only when the 5500 years are fulfilled. At that time I will give you fruit from the Tree of Life, and you will eat, and live forever, you, and Eve, and your righteous descendants.
cards.t_text: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with Yahuah (Lord) as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

cards.note: *"O Adam, as to the fruit on the Tree of Life that you have asked for, I will not give it to you now, but only when the 5500 years are fulfilled. At that time I will give you fruit from the Tree of Life, and you will eat, and live forever, you, and Eve, and your righteous descendants.* (1 Adam and Eve 38:2). *Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.* (Revelation 22:14). Elohim (God) promises Adam, Eve and their righteous descendants that they will eat of the Tree of Life and live forever when the time is fulfilled. The last chapter of Revelation says who has the right to that tree: those who do His commandments, who then enter the city through its gates. The righteous descendants of Adam are the ones who keep the commandments, so the promise at the beginning and the blessing at the end are one promise, and the commandments are the way to it.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, as to the fruit on the Tree of Life that you have asked for, I will not give it to you now, but only when the 5500 years are fulfilled. At that time I will give you fruit from the Tree of Life, and you will eat, and live forever, you, and Eve, and your righteous descendants.
cards.t_text: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.

cards.note: Revelation 2:7 — *He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God).* The deferred fruit of 1 Adam and Eve 38:2 is the overcomer's reward when paradise is restored.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, as to the fruit on the Tree of Life that you have asked for, I will not give it to you now, but only when the 5500 years are fulfilled. At that time I will give you fruit from the Tree of Life, and you will eat, and live forever, you, and Eve, and your righteous descendants.
cards.t_text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Genesis 3:22 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:* The Word's "not now" in 1 Adam and Eve 38:2 echoes the barring of fallen Adam from the tree of life.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, as to the fruit on the Tree of Life that you have asked for, I will not give it to you now, but only when the 5500 years are fulfilled. At that time I will give you fruit from the Tree of Life, and you will eat, and live forever, you, and Eve, and your righteous descendants.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever:

cards.note: Genesis 2:9 — *And out of the ground made Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.* The fruit Adam asks for in 1 Adam and Eve 38:2 is this same Tree of Life set in the midst of Eden.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, as to the fruit on the Tree of Life that you have asked for, I will not give it to you now, but only when the 5500 years are fulfilled. At that time I will give you fruit from the Tree of Life, and you will eat, and live forever, you, and Eve, and your righteous descendants.
cards.t_text: And out of the ground made Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

cards.note: Galatians 4:4 — *But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,* The fulfilled 5500 years of 1 Adam and Eve 38:2 is the fulness of time when the promised Son is sent.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, as to the fruit on the Tree of Life that you have asked for, I will not give it to you now, but only when the 5500 years are fulfilled. At that time I will give you fruit from the Tree of Life, and you will eat, and live forever, you, and Eve, and your righteous descendants.
cards.t_text: But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:20 — *Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,* The Saviour pledged for the end of the 5500 years in 1 Adam and Eve 38:2 was already foreordained before the world was.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, as to the fruit on the Tree of Life that you have asked for, I will not give it to you now, but only when the 5500 years are fulfilled. At that time I will give you fruit from the Tree of Life, and you will eat, and live forever, you, and Eve, and your righteous descendants.
cards.t_text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

cards.note: Hebrews 1:1 — *Elohim (God), who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,* The Word speaking to Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 38:1 is the first of those manifold speakings to the fathers fulfilled at last in the Son.
cards.s_text: After these things the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam, and said to him:--
cards.t_text: Elohim (God), who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The 5500-year promise of 1 Adam and Eve 38:2 is fulfilled when this same Word takes flesh to save Adam's seed.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, as to the fruit on the Tree of Life that you have asked for, I will not give it to you now, but only when the 5500 years are fulfilled. At that time I will give you fruit from the Tree of Life, and you will eat, and live forever, you, and Eve, and your righteous descendants.
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word who comes to speak with Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 38:1 is the eternal Logos, with Elohim and Elohim from the beginning.
cards.s_text: After these things the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam, and said to him:--
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Proverbs 30:8 — *Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:* Adam's prayer to have his hunger met by Elohim's measure in 1 Adam and Eve 39:4 is the wise man's plea for food convenient, not the fruit that profits nothing.
cards.s_text: So Adam cried, and stood praying before Elohim (God), saying, "Satisfy my hunger, without my having to eat this fig; for after I have eaten it, what will it profit me? And what shall I desire and ask of you, O Elohim (God), when it is gone?"
cards.t_text: Remove far from me vanity and lies: give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with food convenient for me:

cards.note: Matthew 6:33 — *But seek ye first the kingdom of Elohim (God), and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.* In 1 Adam and Eve 39:4 Adam seeks Elohim before the fruit, the very order the Messiah commands for those who would be fed.
cards.s_text: So Adam cried, and stood praying before Elohim (God), saying, "Satisfy my hunger, without my having to eat this fig; for after I have eaten it, what will it profit me? And what shall I desire and ask of you, O Elohim (God), when it is gone?"
cards.t_text: But seek you first the kingdom of Elohim (God), and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

cards.note: Matthew 4:4 — *But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of Elohim (God).* Adam asking what the fig will profit him in 1 Adam and Eve 39:4 anticipates the Last Adam who refused the tempter's bread for the word of Elohim.
cards.s_text: So Adam cried, and stood praying before Elohim (God), saying, "Satisfy my hunger, without my having to eat this fig; for after I have eaten it, what will it profit me? And what shall I desire and ask of you, O Elohim (God), when it is gone?"
cards.t_text: But he answered and said, It is written, Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Matthew 6:11 — *Give us this day our daily bread.* The Messiah's pattern prayer is already Adam's heart in 1 Adam and Eve 39:4, asking the Father for daily sustenance instead of seizing it.
cards.s_text: So Adam cried, and stood praying before Elohim (God), saying, "Satisfy my hunger, without my having to eat this fig; for after I have eaten it, what will it profit me? And what shall I desire and ask of you, O Elohim (God), when it is gone?"
cards.t_text: Give us this day our daily bread.

cards.note: Psalm 145:19 — *He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.* Adam who cries and prays in fear before Elohim in 1 Adam and Eve 39:4 is exactly the one whose cry Yahuah promises to hear and save.
cards.s_text: So Adam cried, and stood praying before Elohim (God), saying, "Satisfy my hunger, without my having to eat this fig; for after I have eaten it, what will it profit me? And what shall I desire and ask of you, O Elohim (God), when it is gone?"
cards.t_text: He will fulfil the desire of them that fear him: he also will hear their cry, and will save them.

cards.note: Psalm 145:16 — *Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.* Adam's plea to have his hunger satisfied in 1 Adam and Eve 39:4 looks to the open hand of Yahuah who feeds every living thing, not to the fruit.
cards.s_text: So Adam cried, and stood praying before Elohim (God), saying, "Satisfy my hunger, without my having to eat this fig; for after I have eaten it, what will it profit me? And what shall I desire and ask of you, O Elohim (God), when it is gone?"
cards.t_text: You openest your hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing.

cards.note: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* Adam standing in prayer before Elohim in 1 Adam and Eve 39:4 is the calling on the Name the holy line of Seth would carry down toward Noah.
cards.s_text: So Adam cried, and stood praying before Elohim (God), saying, "Satisfy my hunger, without my having to eat this fig; for after I have eaten it, what will it profit me? And what shall I desire and ask of you, O Elohim (God), when it is gone?"
cards.t_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Genesis 3:17 — *And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;* The curse on eating still presses on Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 39:3, who now eats his bread in sorrow and dread outside the garden.
cards.s_text: But Adam said to Eve, "I am afraid to eat of this fig. I know not what may come over me from it."
cards.t_text: And unto Adam he said, Because you have hearkened unto the voice of your wife, and have eaten of the tree, of which I commanded you, saying, You shall not eat of it: cursed is the ground for your sake; in sorrow shall you eat of it all the days of your life;

cards.note: Genesis 3:6 — *And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.* The first eating ruined them, so in 1 Adam and Eve 39:5 Adam fears what will befall him through this fruit too — the scar of the fall.
cards.s_text: And he said again, "I am afraid to eat of it; for I know not what will befall me through it."
cards.t_text: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.

cards.note: Genesis 2:17 — *But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.* Adam's terror to eat the fig in 1 Adam and Eve 39:3 is the death-sentence of the one forbidden tree haunting every fruit thereafter.
cards.s_text: But Adam said to Eve, "I am afraid to eat of this fig. I know not what may come over me from it."
cards.t_text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you shall not eat of it: for in the day that you eat thereof you shall surely die.

cards.note: Jubilees 3:32 — *And on the new moon of the fourth month, Adam and his wife went forth from the Garden of Eden, and they dwelt in the land of ’Eldâ, in the land of their creation.* The same record sends Adam into the land where his earthy body must now find earthly food (1 Adam & Eve 40:2).
cards.s_text: But when you came to live in this strange land, your animal body could not survive on earth without earthly food, to strengthen it and to restore its powers."
cards.t_text: And on the new moon of the fourth month, Adam and his wife went forth from the Garden of Eden, and they dwelt in the land of ’Eldâ, in the land of their creation.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 15:47 — *The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is Adonai (Lord) from heaven.* Adam’s animal body of earth that must be fed in 1 Adam & Eve 40:2 is the earthy first man, set against the heavenly Second.
cards.s_text: But when you came to live in this strange land, your animal body could not survive on earth without earthly food, to strengthen it and to restore its powers."
cards.t_text: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.

cards.note: Genesis 3:17 — *And unto Adam he said, Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife, and hast eaten of the tree, of which I commanded thee, saying, Thou shalt not eat of it: cursed is the ground for thy sake; in sorrow shalt thou eat of it all the days of thy life;* names the curse that makes the strange land yield only laboured food in 1 Adam & Eve 40:2.
cards.s_text: But when you came to live in this strange land, your animal body could not survive on earth without earthly food, to strengthen it and to restore its powers."
cards.t_text: And unto Adam he said, Because you have hearkened unto the voice of your wife, and have eaten of the tree, of which I commanded you, saying, You shall not eat of it: cursed is the ground for your sake; in sorrow shall you eat of it all the days of your life;

cards.note: Genesis 3:19 — *In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.* The earthly food the animal body now needs in 1 Adam & Eve 40:2 is the very bread of the cursed ground.
cards.s_text: But when you came to live in this strange land, your animal body could not survive on earth without earthly food, to strengthen it and to restore its powers."
cards.t_text: In the sweat of your face shall you eat bread, till you return unto the ground; for out of it were you taken: for dust you are, and unto dust shall you return.

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The deceiver behind Adam’s fall is the same liar from the beginning whose work the dread of 1 Adam & Eve 40:1 betrays.
cards.s_text: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam, and said to him, "O Adam, why didn't you have this dread, or this fasting, or this care before now? And why didn't you have this fear before you transgressed?
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: Genesis 3:10 — *And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.* This is the very fear born of transgression that the Word recalls in 1 Adam & Eve 40:1.
cards.s_text: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam, and said to him, "O Adam, why didn't you have this dread, or this fasting, or this care before now? And why didn't you have this fear before you transgressed?
cards.t_text: And he said, I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.

cards.note: Genesis 2:16 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat:* the one command whose breaking first brought the dread the Word asks after in 1 Adam & Eve 40:1.
cards.s_text: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam, and said to him, "O Adam, why didn't you have this dread, or this fasting, or this care before now? And why didn't you have this fear before you transgressed?
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden you may freely eat:

cards.note: Jubilees 3:32 — *And on the new moon of the fourth month, Adam and his wife went forth from the Garden of Eden, and they dwelt in the land of ’Eldâ, in the land of their creation.* The same primeval history fixes the day the Word withdrew and Adam took up life in the strange land (1 Adam & Eve 40:3).
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) withdrew His Word for Adam.
cards.t_text: And on the new moon of the fourth month, Adam and his wife went forth from the Garden of Eden, and they dwelt in the land of ’Eldâ, in the land of their creation.

cards.note: Hebrews 1:1 — *Elohim (God), who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,* shows the Word speaking to the very first father, Adam, in 1 Adam & Eve 40:1.
cards.s_text: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam, and said to him, "O Adam, why didn't you have this dread, or this fasting, or this care before now? And why didn't you have this fear before you transgressed?
cards.t_text: Elohim (God), who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

cards.note: John 1:3 — *All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.* The same Word who fashioned Adam now comes to instruct him outside the garden (1 Adam & Eve 40:1).
cards.s_text: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam, and said to him, "O Adam, why didn't you have this dread, or this fasting, or this care before now? And why didn't you have this fear before you transgressed?
cards.t_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word who came to Adam in 1 Adam & Eve 40:1 is the eternal Logos, not a mere voice.
cards.s_text: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam, and said to him, "O Adam, why didn't you have this dread, or this fasting, or this care before now? And why didn't you have this fear before you transgressed?
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Jubilees 3:16 — *And he tilled (the garden), and was naked and knew it not, and was not ashamed, and he protected the garden from the birds and beasts and cattle, and gathered its fruit, and ate, and put aside the residue for himself and for his wife and put aside that which was being kept.* The garden-fruit Adam once gathered freely is the same garden he now stands outside of, fasting, in 1 Adam and Eve 41:5.
cards.s_text: "O Eve, come, let us go to the border of the garden looking south; to the place from where the river flows, and is parted into four heads. There we will pray to Elohim (God), and ask Him to give us some of the Water of Life to drink.
cards.t_text: And he tilled (the garden), and was naked and knew it not, and was not ashamed, and he protected the garden from the birds and beasts and cattle, and gathered its fruit, and ate, and put aside the residue for himself and for his wife and put aside that which was being kept.

cards.note: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* The praying and calling on Yahuah in 1 Adam and Eve 41:8 is the first keeping of the way of the seed, before ever the law was given.
cards.s_text: And they stood and prayed before Yahuah (Lord), and asked Him to look at them this once, to forgive them, and to grant them their request.
cards.t_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Genesis 3:7 — *And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.* The fig Adam and Eve lift onto the rods and incense in 1 Adam and Eve 41:1 is the very leaf of their first shame, now offered up to Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Then Adam took the fig, and laid it on the golden rods. Eve also took her fig, and put it on the incense.
cards.t_text: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* Adam's cry for mercy under the curse in 1 Adam and Eve 41:13 rests on the seed-promise that crushes the serpent at last.
cards.s_text: Of Your mercy, O Elohim (God), save me from these plagues and trials, and bring me into another land different from this, if You will not let me live in Your garden." * This is substantiated by Genesis 3:7 whereby the leaves of the fig tree were large enough that Adam and Eve could fashion garments from them.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: Genesis 3:24 — *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* Adam grieves in 1 Adam and Eve 41:6 that Yahuah has not fed him of the Tree of Life — for the way to it is kept by the flaming sword.
cards.s_text: For Elohim (God) has not fed us with the Tree of Life, in order that we may not live. Therefore, we will ask him to give us some of the Water of Life, and to quench our thirst with it, rather than with a drink of water of this land."
cards.t_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

cards.note: Genesis 3:19 — *In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.* Adam's parched, dying flesh in 1 Adam and Eve 41:12 is this very curse worked out in his body.
cards.s_text: But now, O Elohim (God), I am dead; my flesh is parched with thirst. Give me of the Water of Life that I may drink of it and live.
cards.t_text: In the sweat of your face shall you eat bread, till you return unto the ground; for out of it were you taken: for dust you are, and unto dust shall you return.

cards.note: Psalms 36:8 — *They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.* The river of Yahuah's pleasure is the same Water of Life Adam thirsts after in 1 Adam and Eve 41:12.
cards.s_text: But now, O Elohim (God), I am dead; my flesh is parched with thirst. Give me of the Water of Life that I may drink of it and live.
cards.t_text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of your house; and you shall make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

cards.note: Revelation 22:17 — *And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.* The freely-given Water Adam asks for in 1 Adam and Eve 41:6 is held open at last to every thirst.
cards.s_text: For Elohim (God) has not fed us with the Tree of Life, in order that we may not live. Therefore, we will ask him to give us some of the Water of Life, and to quench our thirst with it, rather than with a drink of water of this land."
cards.t_text: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that hears say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

cards.note: Revelation 22:1 — *And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of Elohim (God) and of the Lamb.* The Water of Life Adam mourns in 1 Adam and Eve 41:12 flows again, unbarred, at the end of the seed-war.
cards.s_text: But now, O Elohim (God), I am dead; my flesh is parched with thirst. Give me of the Water of Life that I may drink of it and live.
cards.t_text: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of Elohim (God) and of the Lamb.

cards.note: John 7:37 — *In the last day, that great day of the feast, Yahusha (Jesus) stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.* Adam's parched cry in 1 Adam and Eve 41:12 is the very thirst Yahusha answers with Himself.
cards.s_text: But now, O Elohim (God), I am dead; my flesh is parched with thirst. Give me of the Water of Life that I may drink of it and live.
cards.t_text: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Yahusha (Jesus) stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

cards.note: John 4:14 — *But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.* The Water of Life Adam begs for in 1 Adam and Eve 41:12 is the gift the Messiah Himself names and gives.
cards.s_text: But now, O Elohim (God), I am dead; my flesh is parched with thirst. Give me of the Water of Life that I may drink of it and live.
cards.t_text: But whosoever drinks of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

cards.note: Jubilees 3:12 — *And when she had completed these eighty days we brought her into the Garden of Eden, for it is holier than all the earth besides, and every tree that is planted in it is holy.* The garden Adam now prays toward in 1 Adam and Eve 41:5 is, by Jubilees' witness, the holiest ground on earth — and he is shut outside it.
cards.s_text: "O Eve, come, let us go to the border of the garden looking south; to the place from where the river flows, and is parted into four heads. There we will pray to Elohim (God), and ask Him to give us some of the Water of Life to drink.
cards.t_text: And when she had completed these eighty days we brought her into the Garden of Eden, for it is holier than all the earth besides, and every tree that is planted in it is holy.

cards.note: Genesis 2:9 — *And out of the ground made Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.* The Water of Life Adam seeks in 1 Adam and Eve 41:5 flows from beside the tree of life he has been barred from.
cards.s_text: "O Eve, come, let us go to the border of the garden looking south; to the place from where the river flows, and is parted into four heads. There we will pray to Elohim (God), and ask Him to give us some of the Water of Life to drink.
cards.t_text: And out of the ground made Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

cards.note: Genesis 2:10 — *And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.* The river Adam names in 1 Adam and Eve 41:5 is Eden's own four-headed river, remembered from outside the gate.
cards.s_text: "O Eve, come, let us go to the border of the garden looking south; to the place from where the river flows, and is parted into four heads. There we will pray to Elohim (God), and ask Him to give us some of the Water of Life to drink.
cards.t_text: And a river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from thence it was parted, and became into four heads.

cards.note: Revelation 2:7 — *He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God).* The kingdom-rest the Word pledges to Adam and his righteous seed in 1 Adam & Eve 42:4 is the restored paradise and tree of life.
cards.s_text: Then will I make you go up into the kingdom of heaven, you and your righteous descendants; and I will give you and them the rest you ask for at present.
cards.t_text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God).

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 15:22 — *For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah (Christ) shall all be made alive.* The rest promised when the end of the world is come in 1 Adam & Eve 42:6 is the making-alive of all Adam's race in the last Adam.
cards.s_text: Then will I in mercy save your soul and the souls of the righteous, to give them rest in My garden. And that shall be when the end of the world is come.
cards.t_text: For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah (Christ) shall all be made alive.

cards.note: Genesis 3:19 — *In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.* The sufferings the Word traces to the transgression in 1 Adam & Eve 42:10 are the labour and death decreed at the expulsion.
cards.s_text: But since you transgressed My commandment, all these sufferings have come over you.
cards.t_text: In the sweat of your face shall you eat bread, till you return unto the ground; for out of it were you taken: for dust you are, and unto dust shall you return.

cards.note: Revelation 1:18 — *I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.* The mercy that saves the souls of the righteous in 1 Adam & Eve 42:6 belongs to the One who took the very keys of hell and death.
cards.s_text: Then will I in mercy save your soul and the souls of the righteous, to give them rest in My garden. And that shall be when the end of the world is come.
cards.t_text: I am he that lives, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.

cards.note: Hebrews 2:14 — *Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil.* The shattering of hell's gates in 1 Adam & Eve 42:5 is the destroying of the devil through the Word's own death.
cards.s_text: And if you said, 'Give me of the Water of Life that I may drink and live'--it cannot be this day, but on the day that I shall descend into hell, and break the gates of brass, and bruise in pieces the kingdoms of iron.
cards.t_text: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

cards.note: 1 Peter 3:19 — *By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison.* The descent into hell the Word foretells in 1 Adam & Eve 42:5 is the Messiah's preaching to the imprisoned spirits after the cross.
cards.s_text: And if you said, 'Give me of the Water of Life that I may drink and live'--it cannot be this day, but on the day that I shall descend into hell, and break the gates of brass, and bruise in pieces the kingdoms of iron.
cards.t_text: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* The breaking of brass gates and bruising of iron kingdoms in 1 Adam & Eve 42:5 is the head-bruising of the serpent sworn over Adam at the start.
cards.s_text: And if you said, 'Give me of the Water of Life that I may drink and live'--it cannot be this day, but on the day that I shall descend into hell, and break the gates of brass, and bruise in pieces the kingdoms of iron.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Revelation 22:17 — *And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.* The Water of Life promised to all believing descendants in 1 Adam & Eve 42:8 is offered freely to the end of the world.
cards.s_text: For My blood shall be the Water of Life to you at that time, and not to just you alone, but to all your descendants who shall believe in Me***; that it be to them for rest forever."
cards.t_text: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that hears say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.

cards.note: John 6:54 — *Whoso eateth my flesh, and drinketh my blood, hath eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.* The blood the Word promises to shed in 1 Adam & Eve 42:7 is the drink that gives the eternal life and resurrection Adam was barred from.
cards.s_text: And, again, in regards to the Water of Life you seek, it will not be granted you this day; but on the day that I shall shed My blood on your head* in the land of Golgotha**.
cards.t_text: Whoso eats my flesh, and drinks my blood, has eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

cards.note: *For My blood shall be the Water of Life to you at that time, and not to just you alone, but to all your descendants who shall believe in Me***; that it be to them for rest forever."* (1 Adam and Eve 42:8). *He that believeth on me, as the scripture hath said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.* (John 7:38). The Word of Elohim (God) tells Adam that the Water of Life he seeks will come when His blood is shed, and that it is for Adam's descendants who believe in Him, for rest forever. Yahusha (Jesus) says that whoever believes on Him, as the scripture has said, will have rivers of living water flowing from within. The water promised to Adam's line in the first days is the same water offered to the one who believes in Yahusha (Jesus), and it comes through His blood.
cards.s_text: For My blood shall be the Water of Life to you at that time, and not to just you alone, but to all your descendants who shall believe in Me***; that it be to them for rest forever."
cards.t_text: He that believes on me, as the scripture has said, out of his belly shall flow rivers of living water.

cards.note: John 7:37 — *In the last day, that great day of the feast, Yahusha (Jesus) stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.* The Water of Life withheld from Adam in 1 Adam & Eve 42:7 is the very drink the Messiah later cries out to give.
cards.s_text: And, again, in regards to the Water of Life you seek, it will not be granted you this day; but on the day that I shall shed My blood on your head* in the land of Golgotha**.
cards.t_text: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Yahusha (Jesus) stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

cards.note: Hebrews 4:9 — *There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of Elohim (God).* The true rest the Word names in 1 Adam & Eve 42:2 is the Sabbath-rest of the kingdom, still kept in store for the faithful.
cards.s_text: "O Adam, as to what you said, 'Bring me into a land where there is rest,' it is not another land than this, but it is the kingdom of heaven where alone there is rest.
cards.t_text: There remains therefore a rest to the people of Elohim (God).

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The Word who promises in 1 Adam & Eve 42:4 to bring Adam up into the kingdom will Himself take flesh to do it.
cards.s_text: Then will I make you go up into the kingdom of heaven, you and your righteous descendants; and I will give you and them the rest you ask for at present.
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word who comes down and speaks to Adam in 1 Adam & Eve 42:1 is this same eternal Logos, not a created messenger.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam, and said to him:--
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Hebrews 1:7 — *And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.* The guardian angel of 1 Adam and Eve 43:16 is himself a flame of fire, true fire fencing Satan's counterfeit blaze.
cards.s_text: But by the mercy of Elohim (God) he could not burn the cave, for Elohim (God) sent His angel around the cave to guard it from such a fire, until it went out.
cards.t_text: And of the angels he says, Who makes his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

cards.note: Exodus 14:19 — *And the angel of Elohim (God), which went before the camp of Yashar'el (Israel), removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:* the same angel of Elohim posts himself as a guard, as around the cave in 1 Adam and Eve 43:16.
cards.s_text: But by the mercy of Elohim (God) he could not burn the cave, for Elohim (God) sent His angel around the cave to guard it from such a fire, until it went out.
cards.t_text: And the angel of Elohim (God), which went before the camp of Yashar'el (Israel), removed and went behind them; and the pillar of the cloud went from before their face, and stood behind them:

cards.note: Psalm 91:11 — *For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.* The charge to guard the cave from the fire in 1 Adam and Eve 43:16 is the angelic keeping the Psalm pledges.
cards.s_text: But by the mercy of Elohim (God) he could not burn the cave, for Elohim (God) sent His angel around the cave to guard it from such a fire, until it went out.
cards.t_text: For he shall give his angels charge over you, to keep you in all your ways.

cards.note: Psalm 34:7 — *The angel of Yahuah (LORD) encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.* The angel sent around the cave in 1 Adam and Eve 43:16 is the same encamping deliverer of those who fear Yahuah.
cards.s_text: But by the mercy of Elohim (God) he could not burn the cave, for Elohim (God) sent His angel around the cave to guard it from such a fire, until it went out.
cards.t_text: The angel of Yahuah (LORD) encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivers them.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* The covenant Adam pleads in 1 Adam and Eve 43:12 is the Eden promise of the seed that the kept gifts await.
cards.s_text: Where shall we find Him, to comfort us a second time? Where shall we find Him, that He may think of us, as regards the covenant He has made on our behalf?"
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Matthew 2:11 — *And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.* The gold, incense, and myrrh Adam fears to lose in 1 Adam and Eve 43:11 are the very treasures the magi bring to the promised Saviour.
cards.s_text: O Eve, if we are further alienated from the garden and from Elohim (God), where shall we find Him again, and ask Him to give us gold, incense, myrrh, and some fruit of the fig-tree?
cards.t_text: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The plot to put their souls to death in 1 Adam and Eve 43:10 is the devil's work the Son was manifested to destroy.
cards.s_text: O Eve, if Elohim (God) will bring us into a strange land other than this, in which we find consolation, it must be to put our souls to death, and blot out our name from the face of the earth.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* Against Adam's dread of erasure in 1 Adam and Eve 43:10 stands the certain crushing of the very enemy assaulting the seed.
cards.s_text: O Eve, if Elohim (God) will bring us into a strange land other than this, in which we find consolation, it must be to put our souls to death, and blot out our name from the face of the earth.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* The fear to be blotted from the earth in 1 Adam and Eve 43:10 is the serpent striking at the very seed Eden promised would crush him.
cards.s_text: O Eve, if Elohim (God) will bring us into a strange land other than this, in which we find consolation, it must be to put our souls to death, and blot out our name from the face of the earth.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The one who would cut off their trust in 1 Adam and Eve 43:15 is the same old serpent who deceiveth the whole world.
cards.s_text: So that Adam and Eve should be left in sorrow, and he should cut off their trust in Elohim (God), and make them deny Him.
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:* the prowling adversary who set the cave ablaze in 1 Adam and Eve 43:14 still seeks to devour.
cards.s_text: But that fire was from Satan. For he had gathered trees and dry grasses, and had carried and brought them to the cave, and had set fire to them, in order to consume the cave and what was in it.
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The aim to make Adam and Eve deny Yahuah in 1 Adam and Eve 43:15 is the liar's same first-day work.
cards.s_text: So that Adam and Eve should be left in sorrow, and he should cut off their trust in Elohim (God), and make them deny Him.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* Satan's counterfeit fire apes the cherub's flaming sword, the deceiver dressing his assault as a sign from Elohim in 1 Adam and Eve 43:14.
cards.s_text: But that fire was from Satan. For he had gathered trees and dry grasses, and had carried and brought them to the cave, and had set fire to them, in order to consume the cave and what was in it.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: Genesis 3:24 — *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* The fire that separates Adam and Eve from the cave and afflicts them in 1 Adam and Eve 44:8 echoes the flaming sword that bars the way back to the garden.
cards.s_text: Then they both began crying because of the fire that separated them from the cave, and that came towards them, burning. And they were afraid.
cards.t_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

cards.note: Genesis 3:19 — *In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.* Adam's lament that "our nature is altered" in 1 Adam and Eve 44:9 unfolds the curse spoken in Eden that bound man to the ground and to death.
cards.s_text: Then Adam said to Eve, "See this fire of which we have a portion in us: which formerly yielded to us, but no longer does so, now that we have transgressed the limit of creation, and changed our condition, and our nature is altered. But the fire is not changed in its nature, nor altered from its creation. Therefore it now has power over us; and when we come near it, it scorches our flesh."
cards.t_text: In the sweat of your face shall you eat bread, till you return unto the ground; for out of it were you taken: for dust you are, and unto dust shall you return.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 54:1 — *And I looked and turned to another part of the earth, and saw there a deep valley with burning fire.* The fire that surrounds the cave but cannot reach the seed in 1 Adam and Eve 44:6 foreshadows the valley of burning fire prepared for Satan's hosts that Enoch beheld.
cards.s_text: Then Satan fled from before Yahuah (Lord). But the fire went on burning around the cave like a coal-fire the whole day; which was the forty-sixth day Adam and Eve had spent since they came out of the garden.
cards.t_text: And I looked and turned to another part of the earth, and saw there a deep valley with burning fire.

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:20 — *Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,* The Saviour by whom the seed is kept from the forty-sixth day outside the garden in 1 Adam and Eve 44:6 was foreordained before the world's foundation.
cards.s_text: Then Satan fled from before Yahuah (Lord). But the fire went on burning around the cave like a coal-fire the whole day; which was the forty-sixth day Adam and Eve had spent since they came out of the garden.
cards.t_text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* The enemy driven off at the cave in 1 Adam and Eve 44:6 will at the last be bruised wholly under the feet of the redeemed.
cards.s_text: Then Satan fled from before Yahuah (Lord). But the fire went on burning around the cave like a coal-fire the whole day; which was the forty-sixth day Adam and Eve had spent since they came out of the garden.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Satan's fleeing in 1 Adam and Eve 44:6 is one defeat in the enmity Yahuah set between the serpent and the seed of the woman.
cards.s_text: Then Satan fled from before Yahuah (Lord). But the fire went on burning around the cave like a coal-fire the whole day; which was the forty-sixth day Adam and Eve had spent since they came out of the garden.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Jubilees 10:8–9 — *And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: “Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me, and let them hearken to my voice, and do all that I shall say to them; for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men; for these are for corruption and leading astray before my judgment, for great is the wickedness of the sons of men.” And He said: “Let the tenth part of them remain before him, and let nine parts descend into the place of condemnation.”* The same divine patience that leaves the enemy his hosts "until the end of the world" in 1 Adam and Eve 44:5 lets a remnant of Mastema's spirits remain in Noah's day.
cards.s_text: Were it not for My mercy I would have destroyed you and your hosts from off the earth. But I have had patience with you, until the end of the world."
cards.t_text: And the chief of the spirits, Mastêmâ, came and said: “Yahuah (God), Creator, let some of them remain before me, and let them hearken to my voice, and do all that I shall say to them; for if some of them are not left to me, I shall not be able to execute the power of my will on the sons of men; for these are for corruption and leading astray before my judgment, for great is the wickedness of the sons of men.”

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The destruction withheld by mercy in 1 Adam and Eve 44:5 is appointed for the end, when the Son is manifested to destroy the devil's works.
cards.s_text: Were it not for My mercy I would have destroyed you and your hosts from off the earth. But I have had patience with you, until the end of the world."
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: 2 Peter 3:9 — *Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.* The delayed judgment "until the end of the world" in 1 Adam and Eve 44:5 is Yahuah's longsuffering, not slackness.
cards.s_text: Were it not for My mercy I would have destroyed you and your hosts from off the earth. But I have had patience with you, until the end of the world."
cards.t_text: Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

cards.note: Romans 2:4 — *Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of Elohim (God) leadeth thee to repentance?* The mercy and patience that spare Satan "until the end of the world" in 1 Adam and Eve 44:5 are this forbearance and longsuffering of Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Were it not for My mercy I would have destroyed you and your hosts from off the earth. But I have had patience with you, until the end of the world."
cards.t_text: Or despisest you the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of Elohim (God) leads you to repentance?

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The Satan rebuked at the cave in 1 Adam and Eve 44:4 is the same old serpent who deceiveth the whole world.
cards.s_text: Therefore the angel tolerated him, without saying one bad word, until the Word of Elohim (God) came who said to Satan, "Go away from here; once before you deceived My servants, and this time you seek to destroy them.
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The one who first deceived and now seeks to destroy in 1 Adam and Eve 44:4 is the murderer and liar from the beginning.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The Word's charge that Satan "once before you deceived My servants" in 1 Adam and Eve 44:4 names the disguising deceiver Paul warns of.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word of Elohim who comes and speaks to Satan in 1 Adam and Eve 44:4 is this same Logos who was Elohim from the beginning.
cards.s_text: Therefore the angel tolerated him, without saying one bad word, until the Word of Elohim (God) came who said to Satan, "Go away from here; once before you deceived My servants, and this time you seek to destroy them.
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Genesis 3:24 — *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* The same flaming cherubic guard set over Eden's way now guards the cave-of-treasures in 1 Adam and Eve 44:2.
cards.s_text: And Satan kept on bringing trees and throwing them into the fire, until the flames of the fire rose up on high, and covered the whole cave, thinking, as he did in his own mind, to consume the cave with much fire. But the angel of Yahuah (Lord) was guarding it.
cards.t_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

cards.note: Exodus 3:2 — *And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.* As the bush burned unconsumed, so the angel keeps the cave unconsumed in the fire of 1 Adam and Eve 44:1.
cards.s_text: Yet Adam and Eve were standing and looking at the fire, and unable to come near the cave from their dread of the fire.
cards.t_text: And the angel of Yahuah (LORD) appeared unto him in a flame of fire out of the midst of a bush: and he looked, and, behold, the bush burned with fire, and the bush was not consumed.

cards.note: Psalm 104:4 — *Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:* The guarding angel of 1 Adam and Eve 44:2 is one of these ministers of flame, mastering the very fire Satan kindled.
cards.s_text: And Satan kept on bringing trees and throwing them into the fire, until the flames of the fire rose up on high, and covered the whole cave, thinking, as he did in his own mind, to consume the cave with much fire. But the angel of Yahuah (Lord) was guarding it.

cards.note: Daniel 3:25 — *He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of Elohim (God).* The Word who brings Adam unharmed through the splitting flame is the Son of Elohim who walks with His own in the furnace.
cards.s_text: There is no way for you at present to come from this life to rest, not until My Word comes, who is My Word. Then He will make a way for you, and you shall have rest." cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The "Word" who comforts Adam and is sent "who is My Word" is the eternal Logos, Elohim Himself.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The plague of fire "that will be burning around you" is the work of the devil the Son came to destroy.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) also said to Adam, "See this fire kindled by Satan around your cave; see this wonder that surrounds you; and know that it will encompass about both you and your descendants, when you obey his command; that he will plague you with fire; and that you will go down into hell after you are dead.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* The enemy who encircles Adam's seed with fire is the Satan Yahuah promises to bruise under His people's feet.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* The fire that will "encompass about both you and your descendants" is the serpent's lifelong striking at the seed declared at Eden's gate.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) also said to Adam, "See this fire kindled by Satan around your cave; see this wonder that surrounds you; and know that it will encompass about both you and your descendants, when you obey his command; that he will plague you with fire; and that you will go down into hell after you are dead.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The Satan who exalted and then betrayed Adam outside the garden is the old serpent who deceiveth the whole world to the end.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) said again to him, "See, O Adam, how Satan has exalted you! He has deprived you of the Godhead, and of an exalted state like Me, and has not kept his word to you; but has, after all, become your enemy. He is the one who made this fire in which he meant to burn you and Eve.
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour.* The one who kindled the fire "in which he meant to burn you and Eve" is the same adversary prowling to devour, named here as Adam's enemy.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The deceiver who promised Adam light only to drag him "out of light into darkness" is the very one who disguises his darkness as light.
cards.s_text: But no, Adam, he did not do all that out of love to you; but he wished to make you come out of light into darkness; and from an exalted state to degradation; from glory to abasement; from joy to sorrow; and from rest to fasting and fainting."
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The Word tells Adam Satan never kept his word; Yahusha names that same liar the father of every lie, the enemy from the beginning.

cards.note: Genesis 3:24 — *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* The fire that strips their covering on the way to the cave echoes the flaming sword that barred the way back to Eden.

cards.note: Genesis 2:17 — *But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.* The shame of being "again naked" recalls the death and exposure that the broken commandment first brought upon them.

cards.note: Genesis 3:5 — *For Elohim (God) doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.* Yahuah quotes the serpent's own promise back to Eve and shows that the fire, not the Godhead, was its fulfilment.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) said again to Eve, "What is that he promised you in the garden, saying, 'As soon as you eat from the tree, your eyes will be opened, and you shall become like gods, knowing good and evil.' cards.note: 1 Corinthians 10:13 — *There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but Elohim (God) is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.* The repeated deliverance out of Satan's hand is this faithful Elohim making a way to escape every assault.
cards.s_text: Then look at Me, O Adam; I created you, and how many times have I delivered you out of his hand? If not, wouldn't he have destroyed you?"

cards.note: Psalm 34:19 — *Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but Yahuah (LORD) delivereth him out of them all.* Yahuah's word "how many times have I delivered you out of his hand" is the very mercy this Psalm proclaims over the afflicted righteous.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* Yahuah strips off the disguise — the one who "pretended to give you the Godhead" is the angel of light whose love is a mask for murder.

cards.note: Hebrews 12:29 — *For our Elohim (God) is a consuming fire.* Satan counterfeits with a fire that scorches but cannot consume, while the true consuming fire is Yahuah Himself, who here delivers rather than destroys.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve began again to come into the cave. And when they came to the way between the fire, Satan blew into the fire like a whirlwind, and caused the burning coal-fire to cover Adam and Eve; so that their bodies were singed; and the coal-fire scorched them*.
cards.t_text: For our Elohim (God) is a consuming fire.

cards.note: Psalm 34:7 — *The angel of Yahuah (LORD) encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.* The angel Elohim sends to stay the burning fire is this encamping deliverer who guards them that fear Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) looked at their bodies, on which Satan had caused fire to burn, and Elohim (God) sent His angel that stayed the burning fire. But the wounds remained on their bodies.
cards.t_text: The angel of Yahuah (LORD) encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivers them.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:* Satan blowing the coal-fire to a whirlwind over Adam and Eve is that same prowling adversary seeking to devour the seed of the woman.

cards.s_text: But Satan, the hater of all good, thought within himself: "Whereas Elohim (God) has promised salvation to Adam by covenant, and that He would deliver him out of all the hardships that have befallen him--but has not promised me by covenant, and will not deliver me out of my hardships; no, since He has promised him that He should make him and his descendants live in the kingdom in which I once was--I will kill Adam.

cards.note: Ezekiel 28:15 — *Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.* Satan's grievance over "the kingdom in which I once was" in 1 Adam and Eve 47:7 echoes this fall of the once-perfect anointed one.

cards.t_text: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, till iniquity was found in you.

This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* Adam's plea for forgiven sin in 1 Adam and Eve 47:6 leans on the manifested Son who undoes the devil's works.
cards.s_text: And they stood and prayed Elohim (God) to forgive them their sins, and then fell asleep under the summit of the mountain.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: *And they stood and prayed Elohim (God) to forgive them their sins, and then fell asleep under the summit of the mountain.* (1 Adam and Eve 47:6). *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* (Genesis 4:26). Adam and Eve stand and pray to Elohim (God) to forgive them, and then sleep under the mountain. Genesis marks the line of Seth, and the days of his son Enos, as the time when men began to call upon the name of Yahuah (the LORD). The prayer of Adam and Eve is the same calling, already on their lips: forgiveness sought from Elohim (God) by name, and carried down by the holy seed.

cards.note: Psalm 91:15 — *He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.* Adam's prayer to be let know what has befallen him is met by Yahuah's own promise to answer the one who calls upon Him in trouble.
cards.s_text: Then Adam stood up and prayed before Yahuah (Lord), to let him know what had brought about this difficult time. And Adam stood praying like that until the morning. * The word "dome" is used here but the text does not specifically suggest that the covering was round--only that it covered them on all sides, however a dome is the most likely shape that would have be able to withstand the impact with the ground. From verse 9 that says "when they saw it" and verse 11 that says "shut us up in this prison", we can conclude that the dome had holes in its sides that were big enough to let in light and air but were too small to allow Adam and Eve to escape. Another conclusion would be that the holes were large but too high up for Adam and Eve to reach, however the former is more likely. ** In verse 7 of the next chapter (XLIX), Elohim (God) tells Adam and Eve that the ground was also lowered under them--"I commanded . . . the rock under you to lower itself".
cards.t_text: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I will be with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.

cards.note: Psalm 91:7 — *A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.* Though Satan summons all his hosts to take up the huge rock, the assault cannot come nigh the two Yahuah shelters under the dome.
cards.s_text: Then Satan and his host took a huge rock, broad and even, and without blemish, thinking within himself, "If there should be a hole in the rock, when it fell on them, the hole in the rock might come over them, and so they would escape and not die."

cards.note: Psalm 91:12 — *They shall bear thee up in their hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.* The very stone meant to crush the seed of the woman is the stone Yahuah's keeping turns aside, exactly as the psalm promises the kept ones safety from the stone.
cards.s_text: And they did as he told them. But as the rock fell down from the mountain toward Adam and Eve, Elohim (God) commanded the rock to become a dome over them*, that did them no harm. And so it was by Elohim's (God's) order.

cards.note: Psalm 91:4 — *He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.* The rock Yahuah commands to dome over Adam and Eve unharmed is His covering shelter, His truth made shield and buckler against the enemy's blow.

cards.note: *And he took fig-leaves and sewed (them) together, and made an apron for himself, and covered his shame. And Elohim (God) cursed the serpent, and was wroth with it for ever….* (Jubilees 3:22–23). *After this Satan called to his hosts, all of which came to him, and said to him:--* (1 Adam and Eve 48:1). Jubilees moves in two lines from Adam sewing fig-leaves to the serpent cursed for ever. The First Book of Adam and Eve picks the story up outside the garden, where the same serpent, now named Satan, calls his hosts together to plan against the man he has already brought down. The curse did not end his hostility; it fixed it. The one Elohim (God) was wroth with for ever is the one still gathering his hosts against the sons of Adam, and the later book shows the war continuing where Genesis and Jubilees fall silent.
cards.s_text: After this Satan called to his hosts, all of which came to him, and said to him:--

This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* Satan's murderous design against Adam from the first days outside Eden is the devil who sins from the beginning, whose works the Son came to destroy.

cards.note: Matthew 28:6 — *He is not here: for he is risen, as he said. Come, see the place where Yahusha (Lord) lay.* The third-day rising foretold to Adam is announced at the open rock — risen as He said, the place where He lay now empty, salvation made sure for Adam's descendants.
cards.s_text: But on the third day I shall rise again, and it shall be salvation to you, O Adam, and to your descendants, to believe in Me. But, O Adam, I will not bring you from under this rock until three days and three nights have passed."

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 15:20 — *But now is Messiah (Christ) risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.* The rising that is salvation to Adam and his descendants makes the Messiah the firstfruits, the seed raised first so that the whole seed-line may follow.
cards.s_text: But on the third day I shall rise again, and it shall be salvation to you, O Adam, and to your descendants, to believe in Me. But, O Adam, I will not bring you from under this rock until three days and three nights have passed."

cards.note: *But on the third day I shall rise again, and it shall be salvation to you, O Adam, and to your descendants, to believe in Me. But, O Adam, I will not bring you from under this rock until three days and three nights have passed."* (1 Adam and Eve 49:9). *And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:* (1 Corinthians 15:4). The Word of Elohim (God) tells Adam that on the third day He will rise again, and that it will be salvation to Adam and to his descendants who believe in Him. Paul gives the gospel in the same order: He was buried, and He rose again the third day according to the scriptures. Adam heard it first, under the rock, long before it happened, and Paul's phrase according to the scriptures reaches back to that beginning.
