cards.note: Psalm 130:1 — *Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Yahuah (LORD).* Adam and Eve praying through the whole night and begging for mercy in 1 Adam and Eve 50:3 is this very cry de profundis from the first generation outside Eden.
cards.s_text: But Adam and Eve rose again and prayed to Elohim (God) in the cave the whole of that night, and begged for mercy from Him.
cards.t_text: Out of the depths have I cried unto you, O Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Releasing the now-powerless adversary in 51:11 keeps the long enmity going toward the promised bruising of the serpent's head.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) released him from his bonds.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Hebrews 2:14 — *Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;* That no power is left with the bound Satan in 51:10 anticipates the Son destroying the devil through His own death.
cards.s_text: See, I bound him until you came and saw him and beheld his weakness, that no power is left with him."
cards.t_text: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;

cards.note: Colossians 2:15 — *And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.* Binding the enemy and showing his weakness openly to Adam in 51:10 foreshadows the cross's open triumph over the powers.
cards.s_text: See, I bound him until you came and saw him and beheld his weakness, that no power is left with him."
cards.t_text: And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:* The adversary unmasked as Satan in 51:7 is the prowling devil the saints are warned to watch against.
cards.s_text: Now his figure is hideous; he is become abominable among angels; and he has come to be called Satan.
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The stolen beauty and false divinity exposed in 51:6 is the disguise of light by which Satan still deceives.
cards.s_text: This is he who promised you majesty and divinity. Where, then, is the beauty that was on him? Where is his divinity? Where is his light? Where is the glory that rested on him?
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: Luke 10:18 — *And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.* The one now hideous and abominable among angels in 51:7 is the Satan Yahusha saw fall as lightning.
cards.s_text: Now his figure is hideous; he is become abominable among angels; and he has come to be called Satan.
cards.t_text: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

cards.note: Isaiah 14:12 — *How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!* The lost light and glory the Word asks after in 51:6 is the fall of the son of the morning.
cards.s_text: This is he who promised you majesty and divinity. Where, then, is the beauty that was on him? Where is his divinity? Where is his light? Where is the glory that rested on him?
cards.t_text: How are you fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how are you cut down to the ground, which did weaken the nations!

cards.note: Genesis 3:21 — *Unto Adam also and to his wife did Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) make coats of skins, and clothed them.* The earthly sheep-skin garment Satan would destroy in 51:8 is the very coat of skins Yahuah made to clothe Adam and Eve.
cards.s_text: O Adam, he wished to take from you this earthly garment of sheep-skins, and to destroy it, and not let you be covered with it.
cards.t_text: Unto Adam also and to his wife did Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) make coats of skins, and clothed them.

cards.note: Genesis 3:7 — *And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.* The garment of light lost in 51:5 left the pair naked, sewing their own fig-leaf covering.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam and Eve, and said to them, "This is he who was hidden in the serpent, and who deceived you, and stripped you of the garment of light and glory in which you were.
cards.t_text: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The serpent who deceived and stripped Adam in 51:5 is the one whose works the Son came to destroy.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam and Eve, and said to them, "This is he who was hidden in the serpent, and who deceived you, and stripped you of the garment of light and glory in which you were.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:3 — *But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).* Satan's promise of majesty and divinity in 51:6 is the same subtle beguiling of Eve that still threatens the saints.
cards.s_text: This is he who promised you majesty and divinity. Where, then, is the beauty that was on him? Where is his divinity? Where is his light? Where is the glory that rested on him?
cards.t_text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The deceiver of 51:5 is the liar and murderer from the beginning exposed by Yahusha.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam and Eve, and said to them, "This is he who was hidden in the serpent, and who deceived you, and stripped you of the garment of light and glory in which you were.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The one hidden in the serpent against Adam in 51:5 is named in full as the world-deceiving dragon.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam and Eve, and said to them, "This is he who was hidden in the serpent, and who deceived you, and stripped you of the garment of light and glory in which you were.
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* Binding Satan beside the skins in 51:4 is the first instalment of the promised crushing of the adversary under the seed's feet.
cards.s_text: But as he was about to take them, the Word of Elohim (God) came from heaven, and bound him by the side of those skins until Adam and Eve came near him. But as they got closer to him they were afraid of him, and of his hideous look.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: Hebrews 1:1 — *Elohim (God), who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,* The Word communing with Adam in 51:2 is the same Mighty One who spake to the fathers in every age.
cards.s_text: But as they were going on their way, and before they got there, Satan, the wicked one, had heard the Word of Elohim (God) communing with Adam respecting his covering.
cards.t_text: Elohim (God), who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The same Word who comforts Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 51 would in the fulness of time take flesh to save the seed He here defends.
cards.s_text: But as he was about to take them, the Word of Elohim (God) came from heaven, and bound him by the side of those skins until Adam and Eve came near him. But as they got closer to him they were afraid of him, and of his hideous look.
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word who comes from heaven to bind Satan in 1 Adam and Eve 51:4 is the eternal Word who was with Elohim from the beginning.
cards.s_text: But as he was about to take them, the Word of Elohim (God) came from heaven, and bound him by the side of those skins until Adam and Eve came near him. But as they got closer to him they were afraid of him, and of his hideous look.
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Hebrews 4:16 — *Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.* Adam's bold seeking of mercy and forgiveness in 1 Adam and Eve 52:11 is the throne of grace the redeemed are bidden to come to.
cards.s_text: Then when Adam's and Eve's bodies were covered, they stood and prayed, and sought mercy of Yahuah (Lord), and forgiveness, and gave Him thanks for that He had had mercy on them, and had covered their nakedness. And they ceased not from prayer the whole of that night.
cards.t_text: Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

cards.note: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* Adam's night of seeking mercy and calling on the Name in 1 Adam and Eve 52:11 is the same way of prayer kept down the holy line of Seth.
cards.s_text: Then when Adam's and Eve's bodies were covered, they stood and prayed, and sought mercy of Yahuah (Lord), and forgiveness, and gave Him thanks for that He had had mercy on them, and had covered their nakedness. And they ceased not from prayer the whole of that night.
cards.t_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Genesis 2:25 — *And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.* The covering in 1 Adam and Eve 52:9 is mercy restoring what was lost when shame entered their once-unashamed nakedness.
cards.s_text: From that time the nakedness of their bodies was covered from the sight of each other's eyes.
cards.t_text: And they were both naked, the man and his wife, and were not ashamed.

cards.note: Genesis 3:7 — *And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.* The nakedness covered at last in 1 Adam and Eve 52:9 is the shame their own fig-leaf aprons could not hide in Eden.
cards.s_text: From that time the nakedness of their bodies was covered from the sight of each other's eyes.
cards.t_text: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

cards.note: Genesis 3:21 — *Unto Adam also and to his wife did Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) make coats of skins, and clothed them.* The garments the angel finishes in 1 Adam and Eve 52:8 are the coats Yahuah made and clothed them with in Eden.
cards.s_text: And so it was, by Elohim's (God's) order; they became garments for Adam and Eve, and He clothed them therewith.
cards.t_text: Unto Adam also and to his wife did Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) make coats of skins, and clothed them.

cards.note: Hebrews 1:14 — *Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?* The angel that ministers garments to Adam and Eve in 1 Adam and Eve 52:5 is the ministering spirit sent to the heirs of salvation.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) sent to them His angel to show them how to work it out. And the angel said to Adam, "Go forth, and bring some palm-thorns." Then Adam went out, and brought some, as the angel had commanded him.
cards.t_text: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

cards.note: Psalm 91:11 — *For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.* The angel sent to clothe Adam and Eve in 1 Adam and Eve 52:5 is the charge Yahuah lays on His angels to keep His own.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) sent to them His angel to show them how to work it out. And the angel said to Adam, "Go forth, and bring some palm-thorns." Then Adam went out, and brought some, as the angel had commanded him.
cards.t_text: For he shall give his angels charge over you, to keep you in all your ways.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 15:22 — *For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah (Christ) shall all be made alive.* The Adam who first wears the token of death in 1 Adam and Eve 52:2 is the Adam in whom the promised resurrection will answer it.
cards.s_text: Then Adam said to Eve, "O Eve, this is the skin of beasts with which we shall be covered, but when we put it on, behold, we shall be wearing a token of death on our bodies. Just as the owners of these skins have died and have wasted away, so also shall we die and pass away."
cards.t_text: For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah (Christ) shall all be made alive.

cards.note: Romans 5:12 — *Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:* Sha'ul names the death Adam reads in the skin of beasts in 1 Adam and Eve 52:2.
cards.s_text: Then Adam said to Eve, "O Eve, this is the skin of beasts with which we shall be covered, but when we put it on, behold, we shall be wearing a token of death on our bodies. Just as the owners of these skins have died and have wasted away, so also shall we die and pass away."
cards.t_text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

cards.note: Genesis 2:17 — *But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.* The death Adam now wears on his body in 1 Adam and Eve 52:2 is the sentence first spoken at the tree.
cards.s_text: Then Adam said to Eve, "O Eve, this is the skin of beasts with which we shall be covered, but when we put it on, behold, we shall be wearing a token of death on our bodies. Just as the owners of these skins have died and have wasted away, so also shall we die and pass away."
cards.t_text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you shall not eat of it: for in the day that you eat thereof you shall surely die.

cards.note: Genesis 3:21 — *Unto Adam also and to his wife did Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) make coats of skins, and clothed them.* The very skins Adam mourns as a token of death are the coats Yahuah made for them in 1 Adam and Eve 52:2.
cards.s_text: Then Adam said to Eve, "O Eve, this is the skin of beasts with which we shall be covered, but when we put it on, behold, we shall be wearing a token of death on our bodies. Just as the owners of these skins have died and have wasted away, so also shall we die and pass away."
cards.t_text: Unto Adam also and to his wife did Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) make coats of skins, and clothed them.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:5 — *But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God).* The delivered righteous of 53:7 are embodied in Noah, who alone found grace before the flood.
cards.s_text: Therefore will I bring over them the waters of a flood, and overwhelm them all. But I will deliver what is left of the righteous among them; and I will bring them to a distant land, and the land in which you live now shall remain desolate and without one inhabitant in it.
cards.t_text: But Noah found grace before the eyes of Yahuah (God).

cards.note: 1 Enoch 10:3 — *And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’* The righteous remnant Yahuah will deliver from the flood (53:7) is the preserved seed Enoch is sent to save.
cards.s_text: Therefore will I bring over them the waters of a flood, and overwhelm them all. But I will deliver what is left of the righteous among them; and I will bring them to a distant land, and the land in which you live now shall remain desolate and without one inhabitant in it.
cards.t_text: And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’

cards.note: Genesis 7:1 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Noah, Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.* The promise to deliver what is left of the righteous (53:7) is fulfilled when Yahuah brings righteous Noah and his house into the ark.
cards.s_text: Therefore will I bring over them the waters of a flood, and overwhelm them all. But I will deliver what is left of the righteous among them; and I will bring them to a distant land, and the land in which you live now shall remain desolate and without one inhabitant in it.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Noah, Come you and all your house into the ark; for you have I seen righteous before me in this generation.

cards.note: Genesis 7:4 — *For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.* The waters of a flood that overwhelm them all (53:7) are the very deluge Yahuah brings in Genesis.
cards.s_text: Therefore will I bring over them the waters of a flood, and overwhelm them all. But I will deliver what is left of the righteous among them; and I will bring them to a distant land, and the land in which you live now shall remain desolate and without one inhabitant in it.
cards.t_text: For yet seven days, and I will cause it to rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights; and every living substance that I have made will I destroy from off the face of the earth.

cards.note: Genesis 6:5 — *And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.* The descendants who defile themselves and follow Satan's works (53:6) are the wickedness Genesis names as the cause of the flood.
cards.s_text: For in this western border, O Adam, there will go from you a descendant, that shall replenish it; and that will defile themselves with their sins, and with their yielding to the commands of Satan, and by following his works.
cards.t_text: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* The deception Adam is warned to flee (53:5) is the serpent's standing enmity against the seed.
cards.s_text: Now then, turn back to your cave, and remain in it, so that Satan won't deceive you or work his purpose over you.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:* Adam is told to turn back and remain in the cave (53:5) for the same reason Kepha bids vigilance — the adversary prowls for the unguarded.
cards.s_text: Now then, turn back to your cave, and remain in it, so that Satan won't deceive you or work his purpose over you.
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The warning that Satan would deceive Adam and work his purpose (53:5) names the liar and father of lies.
cards.s_text: Now then, turn back to your cave, and remain in it, so that Satan won't deceive you or work his purpose over you.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Their cry to be delivered from the paws (53:2) leans on the promise that the woman's seed shall bruise the serpent's head.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve cried, and prayed Elohim (God) to deliver them from their paws.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The Word driving the lions from Adam and Eve (53:3) is the Son manifested to destroy the works of the devil.
cards.s_text: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to them, and drove away the lions from them.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The same Word who delivers Adam and Eve (53:3) would at last be made flesh to dwell among us.
cards.s_text: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to them, and drove away the lions from them.
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word of Elohim who comes and drives off the lions in 1 Adam & Eve 53:3 is the eternal Word who was with Elohim from the beginning.
cards.s_text: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to them, and drove away the lions from them.
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Satan's assault under the lions' form (53:1) is the Edenic enmity striking at the woman and her seed.
cards.s_text: They were not very far from the cave, when Satan came towards them, and hid himself between them and the cave, under the form of two ravenous lions three days without food, that came towards Adam and Eve, as if to break them in pieces and devour them.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The lions that come to break Adam and Eve in pieces (53:1) are the murderer from the beginning, hunting to kill.
cards.s_text: They were not very far from the cave, when Satan came towards them, and hid himself between them and the cave, under the form of two ravenous lions three days without food, that came towards Adam and Eve, as if to break them in pieces and devour them.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* Satan hiding under the form of lions in 1 Adam & Eve 53:1 is the same deceiver who transforms his shape to overthrow the faithful.
cards.s_text: They were not very far from the cave, when Satan came towards them, and hid himself between them and the cave, under the form of two ravenous lions three days without food, that came towards Adam and Eve, as if to break them in pieces and devour them.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:* The very lion-shape Satan takes against Adam and Eve in 1 Adam & Eve 53:1 is Kepha's roaring lion seeking whom to devour.
cards.s_text: They were not very far from the cave, when Satan came towards them, and hid himself between them and the cave, under the form of two ravenous lions three days without food, that came towards Adam and Eve, as if to break them in pieces and devour them.
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: Psalm 104:4 — *Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:* The fiery angels coming down to Adam and Eve in 1 Adam and Eve 54:10 are the flaming-fire ministers of Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Then, again, other angels came down close to the place where Adam and Eve were. They were divided between joy and sorrow.
cards.t_text: Who makes his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

cards.note: Hebrews 1:14 — *Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?* The angels glad over Adam's hoped-for return in 1 Adam and Eve 54:11 are ministering spirits sent for the heirs of the promised salvation.
cards.s_text: They were glad, because they thought that Elohim (God) was favorable to Adam, and wished him to return to the garden; and wished to restore him to the gladness he once enjoyed.
cards.t_text: Are they not all ministering spirits, sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation?

cards.note: Hebrews 1:7 — *And of the angels he saith, Who maketh his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.* The cherub of flaming sword and the descending angels of 1 Adam and Eve 54:10 are these flame-of-fire ministers.
cards.s_text: Then, again, other angels came down close to the place where Adam and Eve were. They were divided between joy and sorrow.
cards.t_text: And of the angels he says, Who makes his angels spirits, and his ministers a flame of fire.

cards.note: Matthew 28:4 — *And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.* The keepers becoming as dead men at the angel is the very terror that lays Adam and Eve as dead in 1 Adam and Eve 54:8.
cards.s_text: When Adam and Eve saw the cherub coming towards them with a flaming sword of fire in his hand, they fell on their faces from fear, and were as dead.
cards.t_text: And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men.

cards.note: Matthew 28:2 — *And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of Yahuah (Lord) descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.* The heavens and earth shaking with the descending cherubim in 1 Adam and Eve 54:9 answers the earthquake and the descending angel at the tomb.
cards.s_text: At that time the heavens and the earth shook; and another cherubim came down from heaven to the cherub who guarded the garden, and saw him amazed and silent.
cards.t_text: And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of Yahuah (Lord) descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it.

cards.note: Daniel 10:9 — *Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.* Daniel face-down and strengthless mirrors Adam and Eve fallen on their faces as dead in 1 Adam and Eve 54:8.
cards.s_text: When Adam and Eve saw the cherub coming towards them with a flaming sword of fire in his hand, they fell on their faces from fear, and were as dead.
cards.t_text: Yet heard I the voice of his words: and when I heard the voice of his words, then was I in a deep sleep on my face, and my face toward the ground.

cards.note: Revelation 1:17 — *And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:* Adam and Eve falling as dead before the cherub in 1 Adam and Eve 54:8 is the same collapse of flesh before glory that fells John.
cards.s_text: When Adam and Eve saw the cherub coming towards them with a flaming sword of fire in his hand, they fell on their faces from fear, and were as dead.
cards.t_text: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last:

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* The enmity the stayed sword preserves in 1 Adam and Eve 54:5 ends with Satan crushed under the seed it kept alive.
cards.s_text: And the sword of the cherub seemed to shoot flames a distance away from it. But when he raised it over Adam and Eve, the flame of the sword did not flash forth.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: Psalm 103:13 — *Like as a father pitieth his children, so Yahuah (LORD) pitieth them that fear him.* The favor the cherub perceives toward Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 54:6 is the Father's pity on His dust-made children.
cards.s_text: Therefore the cherub thought that Elohim (God) was favorable to them, and was bringing them back into the garden. And the cherub stood wondering.
cards.t_text: Like as a father pitieth his children, so Yahuah (LORD) pitieth them that fear him.

cards.note: Lamentations 3:22 — *It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.* The cherub's wonder that Elohim is favorable in 1 Adam and Eve 54:6 is exactly the un-consuming mercy of Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Therefore the cherub thought that Elohim (God) was favorable to them, and was bringing them back into the garden. And the cherub stood wondering.
cards.t_text: It is of the LORD’S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* The flame that will not flash forth in 1 Adam and Eve 54:5 is the first mercy that keeps the seed of the woman alive against the serpent.
cards.s_text: And the sword of the cherub seemed to shoot flames a distance away from it. But when he raised it over Adam and Eve, the flame of the sword did not flash forth.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Revelation 22:14 — *Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.* The gate barred by the cherub in 1 Adam and Eve 54:4 is the same way to the tree of life the Lamb opens at the end to the keepers of the commandments.
cards.s_text: When Adam and Eve came to the eastern border of the garden--thinking in their hearts that the cherub was not watching--as they were standing by the gate as if wishing to go in, suddenly came the cherub with a flashing sword of fire in his hand; and when he saw them, he went forth to kill them. For he was afraid that Elohim (God) would destroy him if they went into the garden without His order.
cards.t_text: Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 24:4 — *And amongst them was a tree such as I had never yet smelt, neither was any amongst them nor were others like it: it had a fragrance beyond all fragrance, and its leaves and blooms and wood wither not for ever: and its fruit is beautiful, and its fruit resembles the dates of a palm.* The living tree behind the sword in 1 Adam and Eve 54:4 is this fragrant tree Enoch was shown — the tree no mortal may touch until the great judgement, when it is given to the righteous (1 Enoch 25:4–5).
cards.s_text: When Adam and Eve came to the eastern border of the garden--thinking in their hearts that the cherub was not watching--as they were standing by the gate as if wishing to go in, suddenly came the cherub with a flashing sword of fire in his hand; and when he saw them, he went forth to kill them. For he was afraid that Elohim (God) would destroy him if they went into the garden without His order.
cards.t_text: And amongst them was a tree such as I had never yet smelt, neither was any amongst them nor were others like it: it had a fragrance beyond all fragrance, and its leaves and blooms and wood wither not for ever: and its fruit is beautiful, and its fruit resembles the dates of a palm.

cards.note: *And He made for them coats of skin, and clothed them, and sent them forth from the Garden of Eden.* (Jubilees 3:26). *And the cherub who guarded the garden was standing at the western gate, and guarding it against Adam and Eve, lest they should suddenly come into the garden. And the cherub turned around, as if to put them to death; according to the commandment Elohim (God) had given him.* (1 Adam and Eve 54:3). Jubilees gives the sending out in one verse: coats of skin, clothed, sent forth from the garden. The First Book of Adam and Eve shows what the sending out meant afterward, a cherub standing at the western gate, guarding it against the two of them and turning as if to kill them, because that was the commandment Elohim (God) had given him. They were clothed and shut out in the same hour. The coats were mercy and the sword at the gate was judgment, and both came by commandment from the same hand. There was no sneaking back into the garden; the way back would have to be opened from the inside.
cards.s_text: And the cherub who guarded the garden was standing at the western gate, and guarding it against Adam and Eve, lest they should suddenly come into the garden. And the cherub turned around, as if to put them to death; according to the commandment Elohim (God) had given him.
cards.t_text: And He made for them coats of skin, and clothed them, and sent them forth from the Garden of Eden.

cards.note: Genesis 3:23 — *Therefore Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.* The sending-forth is why Adam and Eve in 1 Adam and Eve 54:2 can only walk the outside border of the garden they once kept.
cards.s_text: And they walked in that condition to the southern border of the garden. And they began to go up that border until they came to the eastern border beyond which there was no more land.
cards.t_text: Therefore Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

cards.note: Genesis 3:24 — *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* This is the original of the cherub and flaming sword that meet Adam at the eastern gate in 1 Adam and Eve 54:3-4.
cards.s_text: And the cherub who guarded the garden was standing at the western gate, and guarding it against Adam and Eve, lest they should suddenly come into the garden. And the cherub turned around, as if to put them to death; according to the commandment Elohim (God) had given him.
cards.t_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The promise Adam is helped to await (55:16) is the manifesting of the Son to destroy the works of the very Satan warring against him.
cards.s_text: Then all the angels rejoiced and praised Elohim (God), and asked Him not to destroy Adam this time, for his having sought to enter the garden; but to bear with him until the fulfillment of the promise; and to help him in this world until he was free from Satan's hand.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* The mercy that bears with Adam *until the fulfillment of the promise* (55:16) ends in Satan bruised under the feet of the seed.
cards.s_text: Then all the angels rejoiced and praised Elohim (God), and asked Him not to destroy Adam this time, for his having sought to enter the garden; but to bear with him until the fulfillment of the promise; and to help him in this world until he was free from Satan's hand.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour.* The adversary who *has continued ... to make war against you* (55:15) is the roaring lion who never ceases his hunt.
cards.s_text: And he has continued, O Adam, to make war against you, until he tricked you and made you come out of the garden, to this strange land, where all these trials have come to you. And death, which Elohim (God) brought to him, he has also brought to you, O Adam, because you obeyed him, and trespassed against Elohim (God)."
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Satan's continued war against Adam (55:15) is the enmity decreed in the garden — the seed-war shown from the first day outside Eden.
cards.s_text: And he has continued, O Adam, to make war against you, until he tricked you and made you come out of the garden, to this strange land, where all these trials have come to you. And death, which Elohim (God) brought to him, he has also brought to you, O Adam, because you obeyed him, and trespassed against Elohim (God)."
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Ezekiel 28:15 — *Thou wast perfect in thy ways from the day that thou wast created, till iniquity was found in thee.* He who *became darkness itself and a worker of unrighteousness* (55:14) was created perfect until iniquity was found in him.
cards.s_text: But Elohim (God) in His mercy, drove him from among us to this dark earth; for he had become darkness itself and a worker of unrighteousness.
cards.t_text: You were perfect in your ways from the day that you were created, till iniquity was found in you.

cards.note: Isaiah 14:12 — *How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!* The one driven down to *this dark earth* who *had become darkness itself* (55:14) is the fallen son of the morning.
cards.s_text: But Elohim (God) in His mercy, drove him from among us to this dark earth; for he had become darkness itself and a worker of unrighteousness.
cards.t_text: How are you fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how are you cut down to the ground, which did weaken the nations!

cards.note: Luke 10:18 — *And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.* Yahusha witnesses the very fall the angels describe to Adam in 55:12-13.
cards.s_text: But when he fell from among us, there was great joy in heaven, because of his going down from us. For if he had remained in heaven, nothing, not even one angel would have remained in it.
cards.t_text: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The fall from among the angels and the joy of heaven (55:13) is the casting down of the old serpent to the earth.
cards.s_text: But when he fell from among us, there was great joy in heaven, because of his going down from us. For if he had remained in heaven, nothing, not even one angel would have remained in it.
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: Revelation 12:7 — *And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels.* The angels' account of being unable to prevail but by Elohim's strength (55:12) is John's war in heaven told from inside the host.
cards.s_text: Then after he had fought with Elohim (God), and had dealt forwardly with Him, he gathered together his hosts, and made war with us. And if it had not been for Elohim's (God's) strength that was with us, we could not have prevailed against him to hurl him from heaven.
cards.t_text: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels fought against the dragon; and the dragon fought and his angels,

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* The hosts who yielded and *renounced the glory of Elohim* (55:10-11) are the angels who left their first estate and are kept for judgment.
cards.s_text: He then sent for us--according to the orders in which we were--to come under his command, and to accept his vein promise. But we would not, and we did not take his advice.
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The hosts *believed that his word was true* (55:10) because his deceit wears the disguise of light.
cards.s_text: His hosts believed that his word was true, so they yielded to him, and renounced the glory of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The deceiver who beguiled his hosts with vain promises (55:9-10) is the liar from the beginning.
cards.s_text: He gathered together his hosts, and deceived them, promising to give them a great kingdom, a divine nature; and other promises he made them.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: Genesis 3:5 — *For Elohim (God) doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.* The very lie of *a divine nature* Satan sold his hosts in 55:9 is the lie he carried down to Eve.
cards.s_text: He gathered together his hosts, and deceived them, promising to give them a great kingdom, a divine nature; and other promises he made them.
cards.t_text: For Elohim (God) does know that in the day you eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and you shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

cards.note: Galatians 4:4 — *But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law.* The covenant Adam must wait to see *fulfilled* (55:1) arrives only in the fulness of time, the long-promised coming of the Saviour.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam and Eve, and raised them from their dead state, saying to them, "Why did you come up here? Do you intend to go into the garden, from which I brought you out? It cannot be today; but only when the covenant I have made with you is fulfilled."
cards.t_text: But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

cards.note: Hebrews 1:3 — *Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high.* The Word who lifts Adam upholds all things and will Himself purge the sin that struck him down.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam and Eve, and raised them from their dead state, saying to them, "Why did you come up here? Do you intend to go into the garden, from which I brought you out? It cannot be today; but only when the covenant I have made with you is fulfilled."
cards.t_text: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The Word who raises Adam from his dead state is the One who will Himself take flesh to fulfil the covenant He names in 55:1.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam and Eve, and raised them from their dead state, saying to them, "Why did you come up here? Do you intend to go into the garden, from which I brought you out? It cannot be today; but only when the covenant I have made with you is fulfilled."
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word who comes to Adam in 1 Adam & Eve 55:1 is the same Logos who was God before the beginning of the world.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam and Eve, and raised them from their dead state, saying to them, "Why did you come up here? Do you intend to go into the garden, from which I brought you out? It cannot be today; but only when the covenant I have made with you is fulfilled."
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The deceiver's renewed assault in 1 Adam & Eve 56:13 is the work the manifested Son comes to destroy.
cards.s_text: Then Adam came out of the cave, thinking he was one of Elohim's (God's) angels that was come to give him some good counsel.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:* Satan returning to the cave's entrance the moment the angels depart (1 Adam & Eve 56:12) is the adversary prowling for whom he may devour.
cards.s_text: But after the angels had departed from Adam and Eve, Satan came with shamefacedness, and stood at the entrance of the cave in which were Adam and Eve. He then called to Adam, and said, "O Adam, come, let me speak to you."
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* Adam mistaking Satan for one of Elohim's angels in 1 Adam & Eve 56:13 is the very transformation Paul warns of.
cards.s_text: Then Adam came out of the cave, thinking he was one of Elohim's (God's) angels that was come to give him some good counsel.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: Genesis 3:23 — *Therefore Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.* The command to "go down from here" in 1 Adam & Eve 56:8 echoes the sending forth from Eden to till the ground.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) said again to Adam and Eve, "Get up, go down from here, before the cherub with a sword of fire in his hand destroys you."
cards.t_text: Therefore Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken.

cards.note: Genesis 3:24 — *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* The cherub with the sword of fire in 1 Adam & Eve 56:8 is the flaming sword set to keep the way to the tree of life.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) said again to Adam and Eve, "Get up, go down from here, before the cherub with a sword of fire in his hand destroys you."
cards.t_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* The empty-handed deceiver of 1 Adam & Eve 56:6 will himself be bruised under foot.
cards.s_text: Ask him to make you a body like the one I made you, or to give you a day of rest as I gave you; or to create within you a reasonable soul, as I created for you; or to take you from here to some other earth than this one which I gave you. But, O Adam, he will not fulfil even one of the things he told you.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* That "he will not fulfil even one of the things he told you" (1 Adam & Eve 56:6) is the liar's nature from the beginning.
cards.s_text: Ask him to make you a body like the one I made you, or to give you a day of rest as I gave you; or to create within you a reasonable soul, as I created for you; or to take you from here to some other earth than this one which I gave you. But, O Adam, he will not fulfil even one of the things he told you.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* The one who deceived Adam in 1 Adam & Eve 56:5 is the serpent under sentence of the seed-promise.
cards.s_text: O Adam, ask him who deceived you, to give you the divine nature he promised you, or to make you a garden as I had made for you; or to fill you with that same bright nature with which I had filled you.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Hebrews 1:3 — *Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;* The Word who pities and promises mercy in 1 Adam & Eve 56:7 is the same Son who purges sins by Himself.
cards.s_text: Acknowledge, then, My favor towards you, and My mercy on you, My creature; that I have not avenged you for your transgression against Me, but in My pity for you I have promised you that at the end of the great five and a half days I will come and save you."
cards.t_text: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:20 — *Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,* The saving promised to Adam in 1 Adam & Eve 56:7 was foreordained before the world, manifested in the last times.
cards.s_text: Acknowledge, then, My favor towards you, and My mercy on you, My creature; that I have not avenged you for your transgression against Me, but in My pity for you I have promised you that at the end of the great five and a half days I will come and save you."
cards.t_text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

cards.note: Galatians 4:4 — *But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,* The "great five and a half days" of 1 Adam & Eve 56:7 is the appointed fulness of time when the Son is sent.
cards.s_text: Acknowledge, then, My favor towards you, and My mercy on you, My creature; that I have not avenged you for your transgression against Me, but in My pity for you I have promised you that at the end of the great five and a half days I will come and save you."
cards.t_text: But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The promise of 1 Adam & Eve 56:7 — "I will come and save you" — is fulfilled when the Word becomes flesh.
cards.s_text: Acknowledge, then, My favor towards you, and My mercy on you, My creature; that I have not avenged you for your transgression against Me, but in My pity for you I have promised you that at the end of the great five and a half days I will come and save you."
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word of Elohim who comes and speaks to Adam in 1 Adam & Eve 56:1 is the eternal Logos.
cards.s_text: Then came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam, and said to him:--
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: John 12:31 — *Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.* Adam's question whether Satan truly became king over them (1 Adam and Eve 57:11) is answered by the casting-out of the prince of this world.
cards.s_text: When Adam heard these words he cried and mourned, and said to Eve, "Hear what he said; that he won't fulfil any of what he told you in the garden. Did he really then become king over us?
cards.t_text: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.

cards.note: Hebrews 2:14 — *Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;* the deliverance out of Satan's hands that Adam asks for in 1 Adam and Eve 57:12, wrought through the death of the Seed.
cards.s_text: But we will ask Elohim (God), who created us, to deliver us out of his hands."
