cards.note: John 1:3 — *All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.* The Word who points Adam to the land of dark soil and its food in 1 Adam and Eve 66:7 is the very One by whom that soil and grain were made.
cards.s_text: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came and said to him, "O Adam, go down to the westward of the cave until you come to a land of dark soil, and there you shall find food."
cards.t_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word of Elohim who speaks to Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 66:3 is the eternal Logos, Himself Elohim, come down to the exile.
cards.s_text: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam, and said to him, "O Adam, your body has become brutish, and requires water to drink. Take some and drink it, you and Eve, then give thanks and praise."
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Revelation 22:1 — *And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of Elohim (God) and of the Lamb.* The stream that refreshed the exiles' bodies in 1 Adam and Eve 66:4 is the shadow of the river of life that flows from the throne in the restored garden.
cards.s_text: Adam and Eve then went down to the stream and drank from it, until their bodies felt refreshed. After having drunk, they praised Elohim (God), and then returned to their cave, after their former custom. This happened at the end of eighty-three days.
cards.t_text: And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of Elohim (God) and of the Lamb.

cards.note: John 4:14 — *But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.* Adam must pray at the stream-bank for a drink (1 Adam and Eve 66:2); the Messiah gives the deeper water that ends thirst forever.
cards.s_text: Then they got up, and went to the bank of the stream of water, that was on the south border of the garden, in which they had before thrown themselves. And they stood on the bank, and prayed to Elohim (God) that He would command them to drink of the water.
cards.t_text: But whosoever drinks of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

cards.note: John 7:37 — *In the last day, that great day of the feast, Yahusha (Jesus) stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.* The Word who commands the first man to take and drink water in 1 Adam and Eve 66:3 is the same who, made flesh, calls every thirsting man to Himself.
cards.s_text: Then the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam, and said to him, "O Adam, your body has become brutish, and requires water to drink. Take some and drink it, you and Eve, then give thanks and praise."
cards.t_text: In the last day, that great day of the feast, Yahusha (Jesus) stood and cried, saying, If any man thirst, let him come unto me, and drink.

cards.note: Genesis 2:7 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.* The dust-formed body of 1 Adam and Eve 66:1 now hungers and thirsts, for the breath that quickened it must be sustained by Yahuah's giving.
cards.s_text: When it was morning, the day after they had eaten food, Adam and Eve prayed in the cave, and Adam said to Eve, "Look, we asked for food of Elohim (God), and He gave it. But now let us also ask Him to give us a drink of water."
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* Though Satan leads them astray eight days and leaves them as dead (1 Adam and Eve 67:12), the seed-promise guarantees Satan bruised under the feet of the redeemed.
cards.s_text: Then Satan began to lead astray Adam and Eve eight days, until they both fell down as if dead, from hunger, thirst, and faintness. Then he fled with his hosts, and left them.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: John 4:14 — *But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.* Satan empties their bottle of water to kill them with thirst (1 Adam and Eve 67:4), but the Word alone gives the water that quenches forever.
cards.s_text: Then, when they wake up from their sleep, and seek to return to the cave, we will come to them in the way, and will lead them astray; so that they die of hunger and thirst; when they may, perhaps, deny Elohim (God), and He destroy them. So shall we be rid of them."
cards.t_text: But whosoever drinks of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

cards.note: Matthew 4:3 — *And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of Elohim (God), command that these stones be made bread.* The plan to break Adam and Eve by hunger until they deny Elohim (1 Adam and Eve 67:4) is the same hunger-lever the tempter pressed against the Son in the wilderness.
cards.s_text: Then, when they wake up from their sleep, and seek to return to the cave, we will come to them in the way, and will lead them astray; so that they die of hunger and thirst; when they may, perhaps, deny Elohim (God), and He destroy them. So shall we be rid of them."
cards.t_text: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If you be the Son of Elohim (God), command that these stones be made bread.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:3 — *But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).* Adam thinking the deceivers true and going back with them (1 Adam and Eve 67:11) is Eve beguiled through subtilty once more.
cards.s_text: Adam thought that he was true, and that they were angels who talked with him; and he went back with them.
cards.t_text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The disguised hosts of 1 Adam and Eve 67:8 are the old serpent and his angels who deceive the whole world.
cards.s_text: But as they were going up from below the mountain where they were, Satan and his hosts met them in the form of angels, praising Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The false promise of a better field and a fountain (1 Adam and Eve 67:10) is the murderer-and-liar from the beginning speaking of his own.
cards.s_text: Again Satan said to Adam, "Come back with us; we are angels of Elohim (God). Elohim (God) sent us to you, to show you another field of corn, better than that; and beyond it is a fountain of good water, and many trees, where you shall live near it, and work the corn field to better purpose than that which Satan has consumed."
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* Satan and his hosts meeting Adam and Eve in the form of angels praising Elohim (1 Adam and Eve 67:8) is the very transformation the apostle warns of.
cards.s_text: But as they were going up from below the mountain where they were, Satan and his hosts met them in the form of angels, praising Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour.* Satan's scheme to slay Adam and Eve by hunger and thirst (1 Adam and Eve 67:3) is the devouring adversary at his oldest work.
cards.s_text: But Satan saw what Adam and Eve had done. And he called his hosts, and said to them, "Since Elohim (God) has shown to Adam and Eve all about this wheat, wherewith to strengthen their bodies--and, look, they have come and made a big pile of it, and faint from the toil are now asleep--come, let us set fire to this heap of corn, and burn it, and let us take that bottle of water that is by them, and empty it out, so that they may find nothing to drink, and we kill them with hunger and thirst.
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: Jubilees 11:11 — *And the prince Mastêmâ sent ravens and birds to devour the seed which was sown in the land, in order to destroy the land, and rob the children of men of their labours. Before they could plough in the seed, the ravens picked (it) from the surface of the ground.* The same adversary who burns Adam's reaped heap (1 Adam and Eve 67:5) is shown again robbing the children of men of their harvest-labour — it ain't new.
cards.s_text: Then Satan and his hosts set the wheat on fire and burned it up.
cards.t_text: And the prince Mastêmâ sent ravens and birds to devour the seed which was sown in the land, in order to destroy the land, and rob the children of men of their labours. Before they could plough in the seed, the ravens picked (it) from the surface of the ground.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Satan's plot to burn the corn and empty the water so as to kill Adam and Eve (1 Adam and Eve 67:3) is the serpent's enmity striking at the seed of the woman from the first days outside Eden.
cards.s_text: But Satan saw what Adam and Eve had done. And he called his hosts, and said to them, "Since Elohim (God) has shown to Adam and Eve all about this wheat, wherewith to strengthen their bodies--and, look, they have come and made a big pile of it, and faint from the toil are now asleep--come, let us set fire to this heap of corn, and burn it, and let us take that bottle of water that is by them, and empty it out, so that they may find nothing to drink, and we kill them with hunger and thirst.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Genesis 3:19 — *In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.* The hand-reaped wheat of 1 Adam and Eve 67:1 is the curse-ground toil of the fall, and Satan strikes at the very bread it yields.
cards.s_text: When Adam and Eve went down to the land of black mud and came near to the wheat Elohim (God) had showed them and saw that it was ripe and ready for reaping, they did not have a sickle to reap it with. So they readied themselves, and began to pull up the wheat by hand, until it was all done.
cards.t_text: In the sweat of your face shall you eat bread, till you return unto the ground; for out of it were you taken: for dust you are, and unto dust shall you return.

cards.note: Jubilees 3:27 — *And on that day on which Adam went forth from the garden, he offered as a sweet savour an offering, frankincense, galbanum, and stacte, and spices in the morning with the rising of the sun from the day when he covered his shame.* The primeval altar-offering of 1 Adam and Eve 68:10 is the same scene Jubilees records — Adam offering a sweet savour outside the garden.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve took of the corn, and made of it an offering, and took it and offered it up on the mountain, the place where they had offered up their first offering of blood.
cards.t_text: And on that day on which Adam went forth from the garden, he offered as a sweet savour an offering, frankincense, galbanum, and stacte, and spices in the morning with the rising of the sun from the day when he covered his shame.

cards.note: Genesis 8:21 — *And Yahuah (LORD) smelled a sweet savour; and Yahuah (LORD) said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake...* The offering Adam raises on the altar in 1 Adam and Eve 68:10 is the sweet savour Yahuah receives, as later from Noah after the flood.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve took of the corn, and made of it an offering, and took it and offered it up on the mountain, the place where they had offered up their first offering of blood.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) smelled a sweet savour; and Yahuah (LORD) said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.

cards.note: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* The prayer and plea for mercy in 1 Adam and Eve 68:11 is the calling on the Name that the seed of Seth carries forward.
cards.s_text: And they offered this offering again on the altar they had built at first. And they stood up and prayed, and besought Yahuah (Lord) saying, "Thus, O Elohim (God), when we were in the garden, our praises went up to you, like this offering; and our innocence went up to you like incense. But now, O Elohim (God), accept this offering from us, and don't turn us away, deprived of Your mercy."
cards.t_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Genesis 4:4 — *And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And Yahuah (LORD) had respect unto Abel and to his offering:* Adam's offering on the mountain in 1 Adam and Eve 68:10 is the same accepted way of approach his son Abel keeps.
cards.s_text: Then Adam and Eve took of the corn, and made of it an offering, and took it and offered it up on the mountain, the place where they had offered up their first offering of blood.
cards.t_text: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And Yahuah (LORD) had respect unto Abel and to his offering:

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:20 — *Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,* The sufferings determined 'beforehand' on Adam's days in 1 Adam and Eve 68:22 belong to the Lamb foreordained before the foundation of the world.
cards.s_text: After this, came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam, and said, "O Adam, you have determined beforehand the days in which sufferings shall come over Me, when I am made flesh; for they are the fourth Wednesday, and the preparation day Friday.
cards.t_text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

cards.note: Galatians 4:4 — *But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,* The Word who says He will be 'made flesh' to suffer in 1 Adam and Eve 68:22 comes in the fulness of time, sent forth and made of a woman.
cards.s_text: After this, came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam, and said, "O Adam, you have determined beforehand the days in which sufferings shall come over Me, when I am made flesh; for they are the fourth Wednesday, and the preparation day Friday.
cards.t_text: But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

cards.note: Mark 16:9 — *Now when Yahusha (Jesus) was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.* The Word's promise to 'create joy' by rising on the first day in 1 Adam and Eve 68:23 is fulfilled when the Messiah rises early on the first day of the week.
cards.s_text: But as to the first day, I created in it all things, and I raised the heavens. And, again, through My rising again on this day, will I create joy, and raise them on high, who believe in Me; O Adam, offer this offering, all the days of your life."
cards.t_text: Now when Yahusha (Jesus) was risen early the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

cards.note: John 19:31 — *The Yahudim (Jews) therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.* The preparation-day suffering and the sabbath of 1 Adam and Eve 68:22 align exactly with the cross and the high sabbath.
cards.s_text: After this, came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam, and said, "O Adam, you have determined beforehand the days in which sufferings shall come over Me, when I am made flesh; for they are the fourth Wednesday, and the preparation day Friday.
cards.t_text: The Yahudim (Jews) therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

cards.note: John 19:14 — *And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he saith unto the Yahudim (Jews), Behold your King!* The 'preparation day Friday' of suffering foretold in 1 Adam and Eve 68:22 is the very preparation on which the King is delivered up.
cards.s_text: After this, came the Word of Elohim (God) to Adam, and said, "O Adam, you have determined beforehand the days in which sufferings shall come over Me, when I am made flesh; for they are the fourth Wednesday, and the preparation day Friday.
cards.t_text: And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he says unto the Yahudim (Jews), Behold your King!

cards.note: Exodus 16:31 — *And the house of Yashar'el (Israel) called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.* The manna on the tree in 1 Adam and Eve 68:8 bears the same heaven-given name later called Manna by the house of Yashar'el.
cards.s_text: There they saw a tree, and found on it solid manna; and wondered at Elohim's (God's) power. And the angels commanded them to eat of the manna when they were hungry.
cards.t_text: And the house of Yashar'el (Israel) called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.

cards.note: Exodus 16:4 — *Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.* The solid manna Adam and Eve find in 1 Adam and Eve 68:8 prefigures the bread from heaven Yahuah rains on Yashar'el in the wilderness.
cards.s_text: There they saw a tree, and found on it solid manna; and wondered at Elohim's (God's) power. And the angels commanded them to eat of the manna when they were hungry.
cards.t_text: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.

cards.note: Hebrews 10:10 — *By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) once for all.* The 'for forgiveness and for mercy' through the offered flesh in 1 Adam and Eve 68:12 is the one sufficient offering of the body of the Messiah.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) said to Adam and Eve, "Since you have made this offering and have offered it to Me, I shall make it My flesh, when I come down on earth to save you; and I shall cause it to be offered continually on an altar, for forgiveness and for mercy, for those who partake of it duly."
cards.t_text: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) once for all.

cards.note: Matthew 26:26 — *And as they were eating, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.* The offering 'make it My flesh' in 1 Adam and Eve 68:12 is fulfilled when the Messiah breaks bread and names it His body.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) said to Adam and Eve, "Since you have made this offering and have offered it to Me, I shall make it My flesh, when I come down on earth to save you; and I shall cause it to be offered continually on an altar, for forgiveness and for mercy, for those who partake of it duly."
cards.t_text: And as they were eating, Yahusha (Jesus) took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

cards.note: John 6:51 — *I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.* The Word's promise to make the offering His flesh in 1 Adam and Eve 68:12 is the living bread He proclaims in the flesh.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) said to Adam and Eve, "Since you have made this offering and have offered it to Me, I shall make it My flesh, when I come down on earth to save you; and I shall cause it to be offered continually on an altar, for forgiveness and for mercy, for those who partake of it duly."
cards.t_text: I am the living bread which came down from heaven: if any man eat of this bread, he shall live for ever: and the bread that I will give is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Satan's assault on Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 68:5 is the serpent striking at the seed of the woman; the enmity of Eden is already at work.
cards.s_text: But it is Satan, your master who did it; he to whom you have subjected yourself; my commandment being meanwhile set aside. He it is, who burnt down the corn, and poured out the water, and who has led you astray; and all the promises he has made you were just a trick, a deception, and a lie.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The false promises exposed in 1 Adam and Eve 68:5 are the deceiver's trade, the same transforming guile Paul warns of.
cards.s_text: But it is Satan, your master who did it; he to whom you have subjected yourself; my commandment being meanwhile set aside. He it is, who burnt down the corn, and poured out the water, and who has led you astray; and all the promises he has made you were just a trick, a deception, and a lie.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* Yahuah unmasks Satan's trickery in 1 Adam and Eve 68:5 with the very charge the Messiah lays against him — a liar from the beginning.
cards.s_text: But it is Satan, your master who did it; he to whom you have subjected yourself; my commandment being meanwhile set aside. He it is, who burnt down the corn, and poured out the water, and who has led you astray; and all the promises he has made you were just a trick, a deception, and a lie.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: John 1:3 — *All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.* The Word who restores life in 1 Adam and Eve 68:2 is the Maker of all, able to raise what He first formed.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God), therefore, sent His Word, and raised up Adam and Eve from their state of death.
cards.t_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word who raises Adam and Eve from death in 1 Adam and Eve 68:2 is the same Logos who was with Elohim in the beginning.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God), therefore, sent His Word, and raised up Adam and Eve from their state of death.
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The devil who sins "from the very beginning" — warring on Adam outside the garden — is the one the Son is manifested to destroy.
cards.s_text: But when there a multitude of beasts came all around them. It was Satan's doing, in his wickedness; in order to wage war against Adam through marriage.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly...* Though Satan wages war on the seed, the promised head-crushing is certain and near.
cards.s_text: But when there a multitude of beasts came all around them. It was Satan's doing, in his wickedness; in order to wage war against Adam through marriage.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: Genesis 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* The corrupt-union stratagem begun here is the same mingling that later defiles the line and brings the flood.
cards.s_text: But when there a multitude of beasts came all around them. It was Satan's doing, in his wickedness; in order to wage war against Adam through marriage.
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Satan's war against Adam "through marriage" is the serpent's enmity striking at the woman's seed, the spine of the whole conflict.
cards.s_text: But when there a multitude of beasts came all around them. It was Satan's doing, in his wickedness; in order to wage war against Adam through marriage.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Acts 2:1 — *And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.* The fiftieth day on which Adam is restored is the very Pentecost on which the Spirit is poured out — the appointed time kept from the beginning.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) healed Adam in one day, which is the end of the seven weeks; and that is the fiftieth day.
cards.t_text: And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place.

cards.note: Leviticus 23:16 — *Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall ye number fifty days; and ye shall offer a new meat offering unto Yahuah (LORD).* Adam's healing "which is the end of the seven weeks; and that is the fiftieth day" is reckoned by the very count that fixes the feast of weeks.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) healed Adam in one day, which is the end of the seven weeks; and that is the fiftieth day.
cards.t_text: Even unto the morrow after the seventh sabbath shall you number fifty days; and you shall offer a new meat offering unto Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Hebrews 9:22 — *And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.* Adam's commanded offering, finished in worship, stands in the way kept from the first altar — the shed blood that points to the perfect offering.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) commanded Adam to finish his offering, and when he had ended it he worshipped before Elohim (God), and praised Him for the signs He had showed him.
cards.t_text: And almost all things are by the law purged with blood; and without shedding of blood is no remission.

cards.note: Hebrews 10:10 — *By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) once for all.* The body offered "on the altar as a perfect offering" that Adam is shown is the once-for-all offering of the Messiah's body.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) said further to Adam, "Thus will it also happen to Me, on the earth, when I shall be pierced and blood and water shall flow from My side and run over My body, which is the true offering; and which shall be offered on the altar as a perfect offering."
cards.t_text: By the which will we are sanctified through the offering of the body of Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) once for all.

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* "Thus will it also happen to Me, on the earth" is the Word foretelling His own incarnation, made flesh to be the true offering.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) said further to Adam, "Thus will it also happen to Me, on the earth, when I shall be pierced and blood and water shall flow from My side and run over My body, which is the true offering; and which shall be offered on the altar as a perfect offering."
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The "Word" Elohim sends to raise Adam is this same Word who was in the beginning, Himself Elohim.
cards.s_text: But Elohim (God) looked at the death of Adam. He then sent His Word, and raised him up and said to him, "Fulfil your offering, for indeed, Adam, it is worth much, and there is no shortcoming in it."
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Isaiah 53:5 — *But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.* As the Word raises and heals the wounded Adam, so His own wounding becomes the healing of the many.
cards.s_text: But Elohim (God) looked at the death of Adam. He then sent His Word, and raised him up and said to him, "Fulfil your offering, for indeed, Adam, it is worth much, and there is no shortcoming in it."
cards.t_text: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

cards.note: Zechariah 12:10 — *And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him...* The One who says "I shall be pierced" to Adam is the very Yahuah whom they look upon, pierced.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) said further to Adam, "Thus will it also happen to Me, on the earth, when I shall be pierced and blood and water shall flow from My side and run over My body, which is the true offering; and which shall be offered on the altar as a perfect offering."
cards.t_text: And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourns for his only son, and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.

cards.note: 1 John 5:6 — *This is he that came by water and blood, even Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ); not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that beareth witness, because the Spirit is truth.* The blood-and-water testimony promised to Adam is the witness John names of the Messiah.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) said further to Adam, "Thus will it also happen to Me, on the earth, when I shall be pierced and blood and water shall flow from My side and run over My body, which is the true offering; and which shall be offered on the altar as a perfect offering."
cards.t_text: This is he that came by water and blood, even Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ); not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit that bears witness, because the Spirit is truth.

cards.note: John 19:34 — *But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.* The Word's words "I shall be pierced and blood and water shall flow from My side" are fulfilled to the letter at the cross.
cards.s_text: Elohim (God) said further to Adam, "Thus will it also happen to Me, on the earth, when I shall be pierced and blood and water shall flow from My side and run over My body, which is the true offering; and which shall be offered on the altar as a perfect offering."
cards.t_text: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The same old serpent, envious of Adam's favour with Elohim, is the deceiver cast down to make war on the woman's seed.
cards.s_text: Then Satan, the hater of all good, envious of Adam and of his offering through which he found favor with Elohim (God), hastened and took a sharp stone from among the sharp iron stones; appeared in the form of a man, and went and stood by Adam and Eve.
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:* The hater of all good hastening to pierce Adam at prayer is this prowling adversary seeking to devour.
cards.s_text: Then Satan hastened with the sharp iron stone he had with him, and with it pierced Adam on the right side, from which flowed blood and water, then Adam fell on the altar like a corpse. And Satan fled.
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* Satan "appeared in the form of a man" to come near the altar — the same disguise by which he assaults the seed throughout this book.
cards.s_text: Then Satan, the hater of all good, envious of Adam and of his offering through which he found favor with Elohim (God), hastened and took a sharp stone from among the sharp iron stones; appeared in the form of a man, and went and stood by Adam and Eve.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: John 19:34 — *But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.* The wound in Adam's right side, blood and water flowing, is the foreshadow of the pierced side of the Messiah at Golgotha.
cards.s_text: Then Satan hastened with the sharp iron stone he had with him, and with it pierced Adam on the right side, from which flowed blood and water, then Adam fell on the altar like a corpse. And Satan fled.
cards.t_text: But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:13 — *For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Messiah (Christ).* Satan's demand for an oath in 1 Adam and Eve 70:12 is the deceitful worker's craft, binding the soul before unveiling the lie.
cards.s_text: And Satan said to him, "Swear, and promise me that you will receive it."
cards.t_text: For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: James 5:12 — *But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest ye fall into condemnation.* That Adam swore thus in 1 Adam and Eve 70:16 is the snare Ya'aqob warns ends in condemnation.
cards.s_text: And Adam swore thus.
cards.t_text: But above all things, my brethren, swear not, neither by heaven, neither by the earth, neither by any other oath: but let your yea be yea; and your nay, nay; lest you fall into condemnation.

cards.note: Matthew 5:37 — *But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.* Adam's elaborate sworn vow in 1 Adam and Eve 70:15 is the 'more than these' that cometh of evil — and the evil one is its author.
cards.s_text: Then Adam held out his hand, and put it into Satan's hand; when Satan said to him, "Say, now--So true as Elohim (God) is living, rational, and speaking, who raised the stars in heaven, and established the dry ground on the waters, and has created me out of the four elements*, and out of the dust of the earth--I will not break my promise, nor renounce my word."
cards.t_text: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these comes of evil.

cards.note: Matthew 5:34 — *But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is Elohim's (God's) throne.* The Messiah's word forbids the very oath Satan extorts from Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 70:12.
cards.s_text: And Satan said to him, "Swear, and promise me that you will receive it."
cards.t_text: But I say unto you, Swear not at all; neither by heaven; for it is Elohim's (God’s) throne:

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil... When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* Adam's belief of the lying messengers in 1 Adam and Eve 70:11 is faith placed in the father of lies who forges the very Word of Elohim.
cards.s_text: So when Adam heard these words he believed them, and said to these angels, "Speak the Word of Elohim (God), that I may receive it."
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: Genesis 3:4 — *And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die.* The bold contradiction of Yahuah's command is the deceiver's craft, now repackaged as a message from Elohim in 1 Adam and Eve 70:6.
cards.s_text: And Adam said, "What is it?" Then Satan answered, "It is a simple thing, yet it is the Word of Elohim (God), will you accept it from us and do it? But if you will not accept it, we will return to Elohim (God), and tell Him that you would not receive His Word."
cards.t_text: And the serpent said unto the woman, You shall not surely die:

cards.note: Genesis 3:1 — *Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath Elohim (God) said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?* The serpent's twisting of the divine word in the garden is the same false 'Word of Elohim' pressed on Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 70:6.
cards.s_text: And Adam said, "What is it?" Then Satan answered, "It is a simple thing, yet it is the Word of Elohim (God), will you accept it from us and do it? But if you will not accept it, we will return to Elohim (God), and tell Him that you would not receive His Word."
cards.t_text: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, has Elohim (God) said, You shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* Adam's gladness at the counterfeit angels of 1 Adam and Eve 70:3 is mercy abused by the liar who was a murderer from the beginning.
cards.s_text: But when Adam and Eve saw their pleasant expression, and heard their sweet speech, Adam rose, welcomed them, and brought them to Eve, and they remained all together; Adam's heart the while, being glad because he thought concerning them, that they were the same angels, who had brought him gold, incense, and myrrh.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: Matthew 2:11 — *And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.* The very treasures Satan boasts of in 1 Adam and Eve 70:9 are the gifts kept against the Messiah's coming and offered at His cradle.
cards.s_text: Then Satan said to him, "I am the angel that brought you gold, and took it to the cave; this other angel is the one that brought you incense; and that third angel, is the one who brought you myrrh when you were on top of the mountain, and who carried you to the cave.
cards.t_text: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour.* Kepha bids the watchfulness Adam lacked when he welcomed the smiling adversary of 1 Adam and Eve 70:2.
cards.s_text: They passed before Adam and Eve while they were under the tree, and greeted Adam and Eve with fair words that were full of deceit.
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The hater of all good who takes the angel's form in 1 Adam and Eve 70:1 is that old serpent who deceiveth the whole world.
cards.s_text: After this Satan, the hater of all good, took the form of an angel, and with him two others, so that they looked like the three angels who had brought to Adam gold, incense, and myrrh.
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:3 — *But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).* The fair words full of deceit of 1 Adam and Eve 70:2 are the same subtilty that beguiled Eve in the garden.
cards.s_text: They passed before Adam and Eve while they were under the tree, and greeted Adam and Eve with fair words that were full of deceit.
cards.t_text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The very disguise Sha'ul names is the one Satan wears in 1 Adam and Eve 70:1, counterfeiting the angels of the gifts.
cards.s_text: After this Satan, the hater of all good, took the form of an angel, and with him two others, so that they looked like the three angels who had brought to Adam gold, incense, and myrrh.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 2:24 — *Nevertheless through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it.* Wisdom names the envy that drives Satan's jealousy against Adam and Eve (1 Adam and Eve 71:14).
cards.s_text: But Satan was jealous of them; and planned to destroy them.
cards.t_text: Nevertheless through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The devil who plans to destroy Adam will himself be undone by the manifested Son (1 Adam and Eve 71:14).
cards.s_text: But Satan was jealous of them; and planned to destroy them.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Satan's jealous plot to destroy Adam and Eve is the enmity Yahuah set against the woman's seed (1 Adam and Eve 71:14).
cards.s_text: But Satan was jealous of them; and planned to destroy them.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: 1 John 1:9 — *If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.* Adam confesses and is forgiven by the faithful Word, the very promise John seals (1 Adam and Eve 71:8-9).
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) forgave Adam, saying to him, "Beware of Satan."
cards.t_text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

cards.note: Hebrews 1:1 — *Elohim (God), who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets.* Elohim's speaking to Adam by His Word is the first of the sundry times He addressed the fathers (1 Adam and Eve 71:7).
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) sent His Word to Adam, who raised him up from where he lay, and said to him, "O Adam, why have you sworn by My name, and why have you made agreement with Satan another time?"
cards.t_text: Elohim (God), who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* The Word that lifts Adam from the dust will one day take flesh to lift the whole race (1 Adam and Eve 71:7).
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) sent His Word to Adam, who raised him up from where he lay, and said to him, "O Adam, why have you sworn by My name, and why have you made agreement with Satan another time?"
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word Elohim sends to raise Adam is the eternal Logos who was with Elohim from the beginning (1 Adam and Eve 71:7).
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) sent His Word to Adam, who raised him up from where he lay, and said to him, "O Adam, why have you sworn by My name, and why have you made agreement with Satan another time?"
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Psalm 32:5 — *I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Yahuah (LORD); and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.* Adam's tearful confession is the very pattern of the penitent David sings (1 Adam and Eve 71:6).
cards.s_text: Then Adam got up, and spread his hands before Elohim (God), beseeching and entreating Him with tears, to forgive him what he had done. And Adam remained thus standing and praying forty days and forty nights. He neither ate nor drank until he dropped down on the ground from hunger and thirst.
cards.t_text: I acknowledged my sin unto you, and my iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto Yahuah (LORD); and you forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

cards.note: Exodus 20:7 — *Thou shalt not take the name of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in vain; for Yahuah (LORD) will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.* Adam fasts in terror precisely because he swore rashly by the great Name (1 Adam and Eve 71:5-6).
cards.s_text: Then Adam got up, and spread his hands before Elohim (God), beseeching and entreating Him with tears, to forgive him what he had done. And Adam remained thus standing and praying forty days and forty nights. He neither ate nor drank until he dropped down on the ground from hunger and thirst.
cards.t_text: You shall not take the name of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) in vain; for Yahuah (LORD) will not hold him guiltless that takes his name in vain.

cards.note: Matthew 4:2 — *And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.* The first Adam fasts forty days in penitence; the last Adam fasts forty days in triumph over the same tempter (1 Adam and Eve 71:6).
cards.s_text: Then Adam got up, and spread his hands before Elohim (God), beseeching and entreating Him with tears, to forgive him what he had done. And Adam remained thus standing and praying forty days and forty nights. He neither ate nor drank until he dropped down on the ground from hunger and thirst.
cards.t_text: And when he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was afterward an hungred.

cards.note: *Then Adam got up, and spread his hands before Elohim (God), beseeching and entreating Him with tears, to forgive him what he had done. And Adam remained thus standing and praying forty days and forty nights. He neither ate nor drank until he dropped down on the ground from hunger and thirst.* (1 Adam and Eve 71:6). *And he was there with Yahuah (LORD) forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.* (Exodus 34:28). Adam stands with his hands spread before Elohim (God), beseeching Him with tears for forgiveness, and for forty days and forty nights he neither eats nor drinks. Moses was with Yahuah (the LORD) forty days and forty nights in the same way, neither eating bread nor drinking water, and wrote the words of the covenant. Both men stand empty in the presence of Elohim (God) for forty days, one seeking forgiveness and the other receiving the covenant.
cards.s_text: Then Adam got up, and spread his hands before Elohim (God), beseeching and entreating Him with tears, to forgive him what he had done. And Adam remained thus standing and praying forty days and forty nights. He neither ate nor drank until he dropped down on the ground from hunger and thirst.
cards.t_text: And he was there with Yahuah (LORD) forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour.* The fled devils only retreat to prowl again, as the lion ever does (1 Adam and Eve 71:4).
cards.s_text: Then those devils fled from before Adam. And he and Eve got up, and returned to the Cave of Treasures, and went into it.
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: James 4:7 — *Submit yourselves therefore to Elohim (God). Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.* Adam's rebuke makes the devils flee, the very pattern James commands (1 Adam and Eve 71:4).
cards.s_text: Then those devils fled from before Adam. And he and Eve got up, and returned to the Cave of Treasures, and went into it.
cards.t_text: Submit yourselves therefore to Elohim (God). Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The deceiver of the whole world is the same serpent who came to Adam in stolen angelic dress (1 Adam and Eve 71:3).
cards.s_text: But Elohim (God) never spoke the words that you have said; and you are not Elohim's (God's) angels, and you weren't sent from Him. But you are devils that have come to me under the false appearance of angels. Away from me; you cursed of Elohim (God)!"
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* Adam discerns the lying spirit behind the counterfeit words 'Elohim never spoke' them (1 Adam and Eve 71:3).
cards.s_text: But Elohim (God) never spoke the words that you have said; and you are not Elohim's (God's) angels, and you weren't sent from Him. But you are devils that have come to me under the false appearance of angels. Away from me; you cursed of Elohim (God)!"
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* Adam exposes the very ruse Paul names: devils wearing the false appearance of angels (1 Adam and Eve 71:3).
cards.s_text: But Elohim (God) never spoke the words that you have said; and you are not Elohim's (God's) angels, and you weren't sent from Him. But you are devils that have come to me under the false appearance of angels. Away from me; you cursed of Elohim (God)!"
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: Jubilees 3:6–7 — *And He awaked Adam out of his sleep and on awaking he rose on the sixth day, and He brought her to him, and he knew her, and said to her: “This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she will be called my wife; because she was taken from her husband.” Therefore shall man and wife be one, and therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and cleave to his wife, and they shall be one flesh.* The one-flesh bond Adam fears the devils will counterfeit by their apparitions (72:24) is the genuine union Yahuah brought Adam from his own side.
cards.s_text: Then again, O Elohim (God), if You separate us from each other, the devils will deceive us with their apparitions that resemble us, and destroy our hearts, and defile our thoughts towards each other. Yet if it is not each of us towards the other, it will, at all events, be through their appearance when the devils come to us in our likeness." Here Adam ended his prayer.
cards.t_text: And He awaked Adam out of his sleep and on awaking he rose on the sixth day, and He brought her to him, and he knew her, and said to her: “This is now bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh; she will be called my wife; because she was taken from her husband.”

cards.note: Hebrews 13:4 — *Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers Elohim (God) will judge.* Adam refuses to let Satan defile with sinful apparitions (72:19) the marriage Scripture calls honourable and undefiled.
cards.s_text: And he answered her, "That I may request Yahuah (Lord) to inform me about marrying you; for I will not do it without His permission or else He will make us perish, you and me. For those devils have set my heart on fire, with thoughts of what they showed us, in their sinful apparitions.
cards.t_text: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers Elohim (God) will judge.

cards.note: Genesis 2:18 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.* The marriage Adam waits on Yahuah to authorize (72:19) is the help meet Yahuah Himself first gave him.
cards.s_text: And he answered her, "That I may request Yahuah (Lord) to inform me about marrying you; for I will not do it without His permission or else He will make us perish, you and me. For those devils have set my heart on fire, with thoughts of what they showed us, in their sinful apparitions.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.

cards.note: Psalm 50:15 — *And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.* Adam and Eve turning to pray in their cave whether the counsel be good (72:20) is the calling-upon Yahuah promises to answer with deliverance.
cards.s_text: Then Eve said to Adam, "Why need we go below the mountain? Let us rather stand up and pray in our cave to Elohim (God), to let us know whether this counsel is good or not."
cards.t_text: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver you, and you shall glorify me.

cards.note: Matthew 4:1 — *Then was Yahusha (Jesus) led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.* Adam tried by the devil's apparition (72:13) prefigures the Last Adam likewise led to be tempted of the same enemy.
cards.s_text: Meanwhile the fire of sin came over Adam, and he thought of committing sin. But he restrained himself, fearing that if he followed this advice of Satan, Elohim (God) would put him to death.
cards.t_text: Then was Yahusha (Jesus) led up of the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted of the devil.

cards.note: Matthew 26:41 — *Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.* Adam standing in prayer through the night against the thoughts in his heart (72:16) lives out the Messiah's counsel to watch and pray against temptation.
cards.s_text: And they both got up and prayed to Elohim (God) that night. Adam remained standing in prayer, yet not knowing how to pray, by reason of the thoughts in his heart regarding his marrying Eve; and he continued so until morning.
cards.t_text: Watch and pray, that you enter not into temptation: the spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

cards.note: James 1:15 — *Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.* Adam restrains himself precisely because he fears the death this lust would bring forth (72:13), the end James names.
cards.s_text: Meanwhile the fire of sin came over Adam, and he thought of committing sin. But he restrained himself, fearing that if he followed this advice of Satan, Elohim (God) would put him to death.
cards.t_text: Then when lust has conceived, it brings forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, brings forth death.

cards.note: James 1:14 — *But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.* The fire of sin that comes over Adam and his thought of committing it (72:13) is exactly the drawing-away and enticing James describes.
cards.s_text: Meanwhile the fire of sin came over Adam, and he thought of committing sin. But he restrained himself, fearing that if he followed this advice of Satan, Elohim (God) would put him to death.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The devil who sins from the beginning is the very plotter of 72:11, and the Son is manifested to undo his works.
cards.s_text: Now, then, if I deceive him to do this thing, and to marry Eve without Elohim's (God's) permission, Elohim (God) will kill him then."
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* Against Satan's design to destroy the first man (72:12) stands the promise that he himself will be bruised underfoot.
cards.s_text: Therefore Satan worked this apparition before Adam and Eve; because he sought to kill him, and to make him disappear from off the face of the earth.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:* The adversary who would have Adam slain (72:11) is the same devourer Kepha warns the saints to watch against.
cards.s_text: Now, then, if I deceive him to do this thing, and to marry Eve without Elohim's (God's) permission, Elohim (God) will kill him then."

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Satan's plot to make Adam disappear from off the earth (72:12) is the serpent striking at the woman's seed declared in Eden.
cards.s_text: Therefore Satan worked this apparition before Adam and Eve; because he sought to kill him, and to make him disappear from off the face of the earth.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The shining maidens are the old serpent who deceiveth the whole world, here at his earliest work on the first man in 1 Adam and Eve 72:1.
cards.s_text: Then Satan, and ten from his hosts, transformed themselves into maidens, unlike any others in the whole world for grace.
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The narrator's verdict that this was a device of Satan to deceive Adam (72:9) is the same liar and murderer the Messiah exposes.
cards.s_text: Then they said to Adam and Eve, "See all our husbands and our children? You should marry Eve, as we have married our husbands, so that you will have children as we have." This was a device of Satan to deceive Adam.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The very transformation Paul names is acted out as Satan and his hosts put on the borrowed grace of maidens to deceive Adam in 1 Adam and Eve 72:1.
cards.s_text: Then Satan, and ten from his hosts, transformed themselves into maidens, unlike any others in the whole world for grace.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* Satan's defeat in 73:9 is one early work of the devil undone, the work the Son was manifested to destroy.
cards.s_text: Thus was Satan's war with Adam defeated.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* The overthrow of Satan's war in 73:9 anticipates the final bruising of Satan promised to the saints.
cards.s_text: Thus was Satan's war with Adam defeated.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Satan's defeated war in 73:9 is the enmity decreed at the fall, the serpent striking in vain at the seed of the woman.
cards.s_text: Thus was Satan's war with Adam defeated.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Hebrews 13:4 — *Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers Elohim (God) will judge.* The angels declare the union after the fast "an act pure and undefiled" in 73:6 — the very honour Scripture sets on the marriage bed.
cards.s_text: Then the angels commanded Adam and Eve to get up and pray forty days and forty nights; when that was done, then Adam was to have sexual intercourse with his wife; for then this would be an act pure and undefiled; so that he would have children who would multiply, and replenish the face of the earth.
cards.t_text: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers Elohim (God) will judge.

cards.note: Genesis 1:28 — *And Elohim (God) blessed them, and Elohim (God) said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.* The angels' purpose that the children "multiply, and replenish the face of the earth" in 73:6 carries forward the Eden blessing.
cards.s_text: Then the angels commanded Adam and Eve to get up and pray forty days and forty nights; when that was done, then Adam was to have sexual intercourse with his wife; for then this would be an act pure and undefiled; so that he would have children who would multiply, and replenish the face of the earth.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) blessed them, and Elohim (God) said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moves upon the earth.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 7:5 — *Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.* The forty days of prayer before Adam comes to Eve in 73:6 is the same set-apart abstinence for prayer that frustrates Satan's temptation.
cards.s_text: Then the angels commanded Adam and Eve to get up and pray forty days and forty nights; when that was done, then Adam was to have sexual intercourse with his wife; for then this would be an act pure and undefiled; so that he would have children who would multiply, and replenish the face of the earth.
cards.t_text: Defraud you not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.

cards.note: Ephesians 5:31 — *For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.* The one-flesh marriage of Adam and Eve in 73:4 is the mystery Paul reads forward to Messiah and His bride.
cards.s_text: Then those angels said to Adam, "Take the gold and give it to Eve as a wedding gift, and promise to marry her; then give her some incense and myrrh as a present; and be you, you and she, one flesh."
cards.t_text: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh.

cards.note: Genesis 2:24 — *Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.* The angels' command that Adam and Eve be "one flesh" in 73:4 enacts the marriage ordinance spoken in Eden.
cards.s_text: Then those angels said to Adam, "Take the gold and give it to Eve as a wedding gift, and promise to marry her; then give her some incense and myrrh as a present; and be you, you and she, one flesh."
cards.t_text: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

cards.note: Matthew 2:11 — *And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.* The gold, incense, and myrrh given to Eve as a wedding gift in 73:4 are the very treasures laid up for the Saviour and brought to Him at His birth.
cards.s_text: Then those angels said to Adam, "Take the gold and give it to Eve as a wedding gift, and promise to marry her; then give her some incense and myrrh as a present; and be you, you and she, one flesh."
cards.t_text: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

cards.note: Hebrews 1:1 — *Elohim (God), who at sundry times and in divers manners spake in time past unto the fathers by the prophets,* He who spoke to the fathers spoke first of all to Adam, the first father, as 73:2 records.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) approved Adam in what he had thought concerning this, and in the prayer he had offered in His presence; and the Word of Elohim (God) came to Adam and said to him, "O Adam, if only you had had this caution at first, before you came out of the garden into this land!"
