cards.note: Genesis 1:28 — *And Elohim (God) blessed them, and Elohim (God) said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.* Adam's wish that Seth's children "replenish the earth, according to Elohim's promise" carries the un-revoked Eden mandate into 2 Adam and Eve 7:2.
cards.s_text: So Adam said to his son Seth, "I wish, 0 my son, that thou wed thy sister Aklia, Abel's sister, that she may bear thee children, who shall replenish the earth, according to Elohim's (God's) promise to us.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) blessed them, and Elohim (God) said unto them, Be fruitful, and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it: and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moves upon the earth.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Adam's dread that "the enemy should appear to him another time, and overcome him" Seth is exactly the serpent striking at the seed of the woman, so guarding that line is guarding the promise of 2 Adam and Eve 7:1.
cards.s_text: WHEN our father Adam saw that Seth was of a perfect heart, he wished him to marry; lest the enemy should appear to him another time, and overcome him.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Genesis 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* The very mingling Adam forbids — Seth's line coming near Cain's — is the corruption that brings on the flood when the lines mix.
cards.s_text: "Then, again, sever thy children and thy children's children from Cain's children; do not let them ever mix with those, nor come near them either in their words or in their deeds."
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: 1 John 3:12 — *Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.* Adam keeps his line from *Cain's children* because Cain is of the wicked one — the seed of the serpent.
cards.s_text: "Then, again, sever thy children and thy children's children from Cain's children; do not let them ever mix with those, nor come near them either in their words or in their deeds."
cards.t_text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* The command to sever Seth's seed from Cain's is the keeping of the enmity between the two seeds set from the first promise.
cards.s_text: "Then, again, sever thy children and thy children's children from Cain's children; do not let them ever mix with those, nor come near them either in their words or in their deeds."
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* The gold's token of *His overcoming Satan, and all our foes* is the promised bruising of Satan under foot.
cards.s_text: "Gold also, as a token of His overcoming Satan, and all our foes; incense as a token that He will rise from the dead, and be exalted above things in heaven and things in the earth; and myrrh, in token that He will drink bitter gall; and feel the pains of hell from Satan.
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: Hebrews 1:2 — *Hath in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he hath appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds.* The incense token of His *being Elohim of heaven and earth* answers the Son by whom the worlds were made.
cards.s_text: "Then, after a long time, the city in which the gold, the incense, and the myrrh are found with my body, shall be plundered. But when it is spoiled, the gold the incense, and the myrrh shall be taken care of with the spoil that is kept; and naught of them shall perish, until the Word of Elohim (God), made man shall come; when kings shall take them, and shall offer to Him, gold in token of His being King; incense, in token of His being Elohim (God) of heaven and earth; and myrrh, in token of His passion.
cards.t_text: Has in these last days spoken unto us by his Son, whom he has appointed heir of all things, by whom also he made the worlds;

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* Adam's *Word of Elohim, made man* is exactly the Word made flesh who dwelt among us.
cards.s_text: "Then, after a long time, the city in which the gold, the incense, and the myrrh are found with my body, shall be plundered. But when it is spoiled, the gold the incense, and the myrrh shall be taken care of with the spoil that is kept; and naught of them shall perish, until the Word of Elohim (God), made man shall come; when kings shall take them, and shall offer to Him, gold in token of His being King; incense, in token of His being Elohim (God) of heaven and earth; and myrrh, in token of His passion.
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The *Word of Elohim made man* whom Adam awaits is the eternal Logos who was Elohim from the beginning.
cards.s_text: "Then, after a long time, the city in which the gold, the incense, and the myrrh are found with my body, shall be plundered. But when it is spoiled, the gold the incense, and the myrrh shall be taken care of with the spoil that is kept; and naught of them shall perish, until the Word of Elohim (God), made man shall come; when kings shall take them, and shall offer to Him, gold in token of His being King; incense, in token of His being Elohim (God) of heaven and earth; and myrrh, in token of His passion.
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Genesis 6:7 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.* The flood Adam foretells overwhelming all creatures is the very judgment Yahuah decrees against the corrupted earth.
cards.s_text: "0 my son, hereafter shall a flood come and overwhelm all creatures, and leave out only eight souls.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.

cards.note: Genesis 7:13 — *In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah's wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark.* The very eight whom the flood would leave out, to bear Adam's body, are named at the door of the ark.
cards.s_text: "But, 0 my son, let those whom it will leave out from among your children at that time, take my body with them out of this cave; and when they have taken it with them, let the oldest among them command his children to lay my body in a ship until the flood has been assuaged, and they come out of the ship.
cards.t_text: In the selfsame day entered Noah, and Shem, and Ham, and Japheth, the sons of Noah, and Noah’s wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, into the ark;

cards.note: 1 Peter 3:20 — *Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of Elohim (God) waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.* Adam's *only eight souls* left out from the flood are the eight the apostle numbers saved in the ark.
cards.s_text: "0 my son, hereafter shall a flood come and overwhelm all creatures, and leave out only eight souls.
cards.t_text: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of Elohim (God) waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

cards.note: Galatians 4:4 — *But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law.* The *days that are coming* when the treasures are offered is the fulness of time when the Son is sent forth.
cards.s_text: He then turned to his son Seth, and to Eve his wife, and ,said to them, "Preserve this gold, this incense, and this myrrh, that Elohim (God) has given us for a sign; for in days that are coming, a flood will overwhelm the whole creation. But those who shall go into the ark shall take with them the gold, the incense, and the myrrh, together with my body; and will lay the gold, the incense, and the myrrh, with my body in the midst of the earth.
cards.t_text: But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:20 — *Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you.* The Saviour for whom Adam kept the gifts was already foreordained, awaiting His manifestation in the fulness of time.
cards.s_text: He then turned to his son Seth, and to Eve his wife, and ,said to them, "Preserve this gold, this incense, and this myrrh, that Elohim (God) has given us for a sign; for in days that are coming, a flood will overwhelm the whole creation. But those who shall go into the ark shall take with them the gold, the incense, and the myrrh, together with my body; and will lay the gold, the incense, and the myrrh, with my body in the midst of the earth.
cards.t_text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

cards.note: Matthew 2:11 — *And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.* The three treasures Adam preserved for a sign are the three gifts the magi lay before the child Messiah.
cards.s_text: He then turned to his son Seth, and to Eve his wife, and ,said to them, "Preserve this gold, this incense, and this myrrh, that Elohim (God) has given us for a sign; for in days that are coming, a flood will overwhelm the whole creation. But those who shall go into the ark shall take with them the gold, the incense, and the myrrh, together with my body; and will lay the gold, the incense, and the myrrh, with my body in the midst of the earth.
cards.t_text: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour.* Adam's charge not to hearken to Satan is the same sober vigilance against the adversary who prowls to destroy.
cards.s_text: "0 Seth, my son, thou knowest this world - that it is full of sorrow, and of weariness; and thou knowest all that has come upon us, from our trials in it I therefore flow command thee in these words: to keep innocency, to be pure and just, and trusting in Elohim (God); and lean not to the discourses of Satan, nor to the apparitions in which he will show himself to thee.
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* Adam's warning against Satan's *apparitions in which he will show himself* is the same deceiver who masks himself as light.
cards.s_text: "0 Seth, my son, thou knowest this world - that it is full of sorrow, and of weariness; and thou knowest all that has come upon us, from our trials in it I therefore flow command thee in these words: to keep innocency, to be pure and just, and trusting in Elohim (God); and lean not to the discourses of Satan, nor to the apparitions in which he will show himself to thee.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: Genesis 5:3 — *And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth.* The genealogy of the kept seed begins exactly where Adam hands down the commandment — through Seth, in Adam's own likeness.
cards.s_text: But keep the commandments that I give thee this day; then give the same to thy son Enos; and let Enos give it to his son Cainan; and Cainan to his son Mahalaleel; so that this commandment abide firm among all your children.
cards.t_text: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:

cards.note: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* The very names Adam binds the commandment to — Seth, then Enos — are the line on whom the calling on the Name begins.
cards.s_text: But keep the commandments that I give thee this day; then give the same to thy son Enos; and let Enos give it to his son Cainan; and Cainan to his son Mahalaleel; so that this commandment abide firm among all your children.
cards.t_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Hebrews 9:27 — *And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment.* Eve asking Elohim to take up Adam's soul to rest in 2 Adam and Eve 9:8 bows to the appointment of death and the judgment that follows it.
cards.s_text: But Eve said to them, "Wait until we have first asked Elohim (God) to accept our offering, and to keep by Him the soul of Adam His servant, and to take it up to rest."
cards.t_text: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 15:22 — *For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah (Christ) shall all be made alive.* The soul of Adam Eve commits to rest in 2 Adam and Eve 9:8 is the very Adam in whom all die, awaiting the making-alive in Messiah.
cards.s_text: But Eve said to them, "Wait until we have first asked Elohim (God) to accept our offering, and to keep by Him the soul of Adam His servant, and to take it up to rest."
cards.t_text: For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah (Christ) shall all be made alive.

cards.note: Job 19:25 — *For I know that my redeemer liveth, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth.* Eve's prayer to keep Adam's soul and take it up to rest in 2 Adam and Eve 9:8 is the same hope of a living Redeemer at the latter day.
cards.s_text: But Eve said to them, "Wait until we have first asked Elohim (God) to accept our offering, and to keep by Him the soul of Adam His servant, and to take it up to rest."
cards.t_text: For I know that my redeemer lives, and that he shall stand at the latter day upon the earth:

cards.note: Genesis 4:4 — *And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And Yahuah (LORD) had respect unto Abel and to his offering.* The altar of Adam where Seth's line offers in 2 Adam and Eve 9:7 keeps the accepted way of offering Abel walked before them.
cards.s_text: Then Seth and his son Enos, and Cainan, the son of Enos, went out and took good offerings to present unto Yahuah (Lord), and they came to the altar upon which Adam offered gifts to Elohim (God), when he did offer.
cards.t_text: And Abel, he also brought of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof. And Yahuah (LORD) had respect unto Abel and to his offering:

cards.note: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* Seth and Enos coming with offerings to call on Yahuah in 2 Adam and Eve 9:7 is the very generation Genesis says began to call upon the Name.
cards.s_text: Then Seth and his son Enos, and Cainan, the son of Enos, went out and took good offerings to present unto Yahuah (Lord), and they came to the altar upon which Adam offered gifts to Elohim (God), when he did offer.
cards.t_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Genesis 5:9 — *And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan.* Cainan the son of Enos who offers in 2 Adam and Eve 9:7 is the next link of the holy seed Genesis records.
cards.s_text: Then Seth and his son Enos, and Cainan, the son of Enos, went out and took good offerings to present unto Yahuah (Lord), and they came to the altar upon which Adam offered gifts to Elohim (God), when he did offer.
cards.t_text: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:

cards.note: Genesis 5:6 — *And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos.* The Seth-and-Enos of the altar in 2 Adam and Eve 9:7 are the kept covenant line Genesis traces from father to son.
cards.s_text: Then Seth and his son Enos, and Cainan, the son of Enos, went out and took good offerings to present unto Yahuah (Lord), and they came to the altar upon which Adam offered gifts to Elohim (God), when he did offer.
cards.t_text: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:

cards.note: Jubilees 4:25 — *And he burnt the incense of the sanctuary, (even) sweet spices, acceptable before Yahuah (God) on the Mount.* The Conflict's spices from the Holy Mountain and the cave's side of the incense in 2 Adam and Eve 9:5 are the same mountain-sanctuary incense kept acceptable before Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Then Seth wound him up well, and embalmed him with plenty of sweet spices, from sacred trees and from the Holy Mountain; and he laid his body on the eastern side of the inside of the cave, the side of the incense; and placed in front of him a lamp - stand kept burning.
cards.t_text: And he burnt the incense of the sanctuary, (even) sweet spices, acceptable before Yahuah (God) on the Mount.

cards.note: Matthew 2:11 — *And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.* The sweet spices of the Holy Mountain that embalm Adam in 2 Adam and Eve 9:5 are the frankincense and myrrh kept against the day they are laid before the promised Saviour.
cards.s_text: Then Seth wound him up well, and embalmed him with plenty of sweet spices, from sacred trees and from the Holy Mountain; and he laid his body on the eastern side of the inside of the cave, the side of the incense; and placed in front of him a lamp - stand kept burning.
cards.t_text: And when they were come into the house, they saw the young child with Mary his mother, and fell down, and worshipped him: and when they had opened their treasures, they presented unto him gifts; gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:30 — *And he lacked seventy years of one thousand years; for one thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens and therefore was it written concerning the tree of knowledge: "On the day that you eat thereof you will die." For this reason he did not complete the years of this day; for he died during it.* The same-day, same-hour symmetry of 2 Adam and Eve 9:4 is Eden's sentence — death within the day of his eating — kept in the heavens' reckoning.
cards.s_text: It was on a Friday, the very day on which he was created, and on which he rested; and the hour at which he died, was the same as that at which he came out of the garden.
cards.t_text: And he lacked seventy years of one thousand years; for one thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens and therefore was it written concerning the tree of knowledge: “On the day that you eat thereof you will die.” For this reason he did not complete the years of this day; for he died during it.

cards.note: Genesis 2:2 — *And on the seventh day Elohim (God) ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.* The Conflict says Adam too rested on the day he was created in 2 Adam and Eve 9:4, sharing the Creator's seventh-day rest.
cards.s_text: It was on a Friday, the very day on which he was created, and on which he rested; and the hour at which he died, was the same as that at which he came out of the garden.
cards.t_text: And on the seventh day Elohim (God) ended his work which he had made; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had made.

cards.note: Genesis 2:7 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.* The Friday of Adam's making in 2 Adam and Eve 9:4 is the day the breath of life first entered him.
cards.s_text: It was on a Friday, the very day on which he was created, and on which he rested; and the hour at which he died, was the same as that at which he came out of the garden.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:29 — *And at the close of the nineteenth jubilee, in the seventh week in the sixth year thereof, Adam died, and all his sons buried him in the land of his creation, and he was the first to be buried in the earth.* The same library: Adam is the first man laid in the ground, as the Conflict mourns him in 2 Adam and Eve 9:3.
cards.s_text: The death of Adam took place at the end of nine hundred and thirty years that he lived upon the earth; on the fifteenth day of Barmudeh, after the reckoning of an epact of the sun, at the ninth hour.
cards.t_text: And at the close of the nineteenth jubilee, in the seventh week in the sixth year thereof, Adam died, and all his sons buried him in the land of his creation, and he was the first to be buried in the earth.

cards.note: Romans 5:14 — *Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.* Adam's death after nine hundred and thirty years in 2 Adam and Eve 9:3 is the first reign of the death that one Man would undo.
cards.s_text: The death of Adam took place at the end of nine hundred and thirty years that he lived upon the earth; on the fifteenth day of Barmudeh, after the reckoning of an epact of the sun, at the ninth hour.
cards.t_text: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

cards.note: Ecclesiastes 12:7 — *Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto Elohim (God) who gave it.* Adam giving up the ghost in 2 Adam and Eve 9:1 is the body to dust and the breath back to its Giver.
cards.s_text: WHEN Adam had ended his commandment to Seth, his limbs were loosened, his hands and feet lost all power, his mouth became dumb, and his tongue ceased altogether to speak. He closed his eyes and gave up the ghost.
cards.t_text: Then shall the dust return to the earth as it was: and the spirit shall return unto Elohim (God) who gave it.

cards.note: Genesis 5:5 — *And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.* The Conflict reckons the identical nine hundred and thirty years for Adam's life in 2 Adam and Eve 9:3.
cards.s_text: The death of Adam took place at the end of nine hundred and thirty years that he lived upon the earth; on the fifteenth day of Barmudeh, after the reckoning of an epact of the sun, at the ninth hour.
cards.t_text: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

cards.note: Genesis 3:19 — *In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.* Adam's loosened limbs and stilled tongue in 2 Adam and Eve 9:1 are the Eden sentence reaching its appointed end.
cards.s_text: WHEN Adam had ended his commandment to Seth, his limbs were loosened, his hands and feet lost all power, his mouth became dumb, and his tongue ceased altogether to speak. He closed his eyes and gave up the ghost.
cards.t_text: In the sweat of your face shall you eat bread, till you return unto the ground; for out of it were you taken: for dust you are, and unto dust shall you return.

cards.note: Hebrews 11:4 — *By faith Abel offered unto Elohim (God) a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, Elohim (God) testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.* Though Abel "died murdered" in 2 Adam & Eve 10:7, his righteous faith yet speaks.
cards.s_text: But Adam was the first whose soul died in the land of Eden, in the Cave of Treasures; for no one died before him, but his son Abel, who died murdered.
cards.t_text: By faith Abel offered unto Elohim (God) a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, Elohim (God) testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaks.

cards.note: 1 John 3:12 — *Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.* Abel who "died murdered" in 2 Adam & Eve 10:7 is the righteous brother slain by the seed of the wicked one.
cards.s_text: But Adam was the first whose soul died in the land of Eden, in the Cave of Treasures; for no one died before him, but his son Abel, who died murdered.
cards.t_text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

cards.note: Genesis 5:5 — *And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.* The note that Adam was the first whose soul died in 2 Adam & Eve 10:7 records the falling of the Edenic sentence Genesis seals with "and he died."
cards.s_text: But Adam was the first whose soul died in the land of Eden, in the Cave of Treasures; for no one died before him, but his son Abel, who died murdered.
cards.t_text: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

cards.note: Jasher 2:1 — *And it was in the hundred and thirtieth year of the life of Adam upon the earth, that he again knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare a son in his likeness and in his image, and she called his name Seth, saying, Because Elohim (God) has appointed me another seed in the place of Abel, for Cain has slain him.* Jasher tells the same appointing that 2 Adam & Eve 10:4 commands Seth to guard — the seed set in Abel's place, kept apart from Cain.
cards.s_text: "But as to thy father Adam, keep thou the commandment he gave thee; and sever thy seed from that of Cain thy brother."
cards.t_text: And it was in the hundred and thirtieth year of the life of Adam upon the earth, that he again knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare a son in his likeness and in his image, and she called his name Seth, saying, Because Elohim (God) has appointed me another seed in the place of Abel, for Cain has slain him.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:7 — *And Adam and his wife mourned for Abel four weeks of years, and in the fourth year of the fifth week they became joyful, and Adam knew his wife again, and she bare him a son, and he called his name Seth; for he said “Elohim (God) has raised up a second seed to us on the earth instead of Abel; for Cain slew him.”* The same primeval witness as 2 Adam & Eve 10:4 — Seth raised up as the second, holy seed after Cain slew Abel.
cards.s_text: "But as to thy father Adam, keep thou the commandment he gave thee; and sever thy seed from that of Cain thy brother."
cards.t_text: And Adam and his wife mourned for Abel four weeks of years, and in the fourth year of the fifth week they became joyful, and Adam knew his wife again, and she bare him a son, and he called his name Seth; for he said “Elohim (God) has raised up a second seed to us on the earth instead of Abel; for Cain slew him.”

cards.note: Jude 1:11 — *Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.* The Word commands Seth to keep clear of Cain's line in 2 Adam & Eve 10:4, the way of Cain that still ends in woe.

cards.note: *Then Enos called his son Cainan and said to him, "See, 0 my son, and set thy heart on thy people, and establish them in righteousness, and in innocence; and stand ministering before the body of our father Adam, all the days of thy life."* (2 Adam and Eve 14:3). *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* (Genesis 4:26). cards.note: 1 Enoch 10:2 — *And said to him: ’Go to Noah and tell him in My Name “Hide thyself!” and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.* The same flood Mahalaleel announces in 16:6 is revealed to Noah by the watcher Uriel.
cards.s_text: "Hear, 0 my son, hereafter there shall come a great destruction upon this earth on account of them; Elohim (God) will be angry with the world, and will destroy them with waters.
cards.t_text: ’Go to Noah and tell him in my name “Hide thyself!” and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it.

cards.note: 2 Peter 2:5 — *And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly.* Peter frames the flood Mahalaleel foresees in 16:6 as judgment on the ungodly out of which the kept seed alone is saved.
cards.s_text: "Hear, 0 my son, hereafter there shall come a great destruction upon this earth on account of them; Elohim (God) will be angry with the world, and will destroy them with waters.
cards.t_text: And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly;

cards.note: Genesis 6:7 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.* Mahalaleel's foretelling of destruction by waters in 16:6 is Yahuah's own sentence on the corrupted earth.
cards.s_text: "Hear, 0 my son, hereafter there shall come a great destruction upon this earth on account of them; Elohim (God) will be angry with the world, and will destroy them with waters.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:15 — *...and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men...* Jubilees sets the mingling Mahalaleel guards against in 16:5 squarely in the days of his own son Jared.
cards.s_text: He then kissed his face, and said to him, "0 Jared, my son, I adjure thee by Him who made heaven and earth, to watch over thy people, and to feed them in righteousness and in innocence; and not to let one of them go down from this Holy Mountain to the children of Cain, lest he perish with them.
cards.t_text: And in the second week of the tenth jubilee Mahalalel took to him to wife Dînâh, the daughter of Barâkî’êl the daughter of his father’s brother, and she bare him a son in the third week in the sixth year, and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men, and that they should do judgment and uprightness on the earth.

cards.note: Genesis 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* Mahalaleel foresees in 16:7 the very mingling of the two lines that Genesis 6 records as the prelude to the flood.
cards.s_text: "But I also know that thy children will not hearken to thee, and that they will go down from this mountain and hold intercourse with the children of Cain, and that they shall perish with them.
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: Jude 1:11 — *Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.* To go down to the children of Cain (2 Adam & Eve 16:5) is to walk “the way of Cain” unto perishing.
cards.s_text: He then kissed his face, and said to him, "0 Jared, my son, I adjure thee by Him who made heaven and earth, to watch over thy people, and to feed them in righteousness and in innocence; and not to let one of them go down from this Holy Mountain to the children of Cain, lest he perish with them.
cards.t_text: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.

cards.note: 1 John 3:12 — *Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.* The children of Cain whom Mahalaleel forbids his people to mingle with are named by their father in 2 Adam & Eve 16:1.
cards.s_text: THEN Mahalaleel stood over his people, and fed them in righteousness and innocence, and watched them to see they held no intercourse with the children of Cain.
cards.t_text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* The angel sent to draw Jared out of the midst of Cain is Yahuah's mercy bruising Satan and keeping the seed, the standing edge of Genesis 3:15.
cards.s_text: "But now I ask Thee, 0 Elohim (God), to deliver me from this race, among whom I am now staying, as Thou didst deliver me from those devils. Send Thy angel to draw me out of the midst of them; for I have not myself power to escape from among them."
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: Matthew 4:10 — *Then saith Yahusha (Jesus) unto him, Get thee hence, Satan: for it is written, Thou shalt worship Yahuah Elohayka (the Lord thy God), and him only shalt thou serve.* The Messiah dismisses the same tempter on a mountain by the word, as Jared's fervent prayer dismisses him from the cave-mountain.
cards.s_text: He then spread his hands and prayed with a fervent heart, and with much weeping, and entreated Elohim (God) to deliver him from their hands.
cards.t_text: Then says Yahusha (Jesus) unto him, Get you hence, Satan: for it is written, You shall worship Yahuah Elohayka (the Lord thy God), and him only shall you serve.

cards.note: James 4:7 — *Submit yourselves therefore to Elohim (God). Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.* That the elder and his companions could not abide in a place of prayer but fled is the very promise James gives — the resisted devil flees.
cards.s_text: No sooner did Jared begin to pray than the elder fled with his companions; for they could not abide in a place of prayer.
cards.t_text: Submit yourselves therefore to Elohim (God). Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 6:9 — *Know ye not that the unrighteous shall not inherit the kingdom of Elohim (God)? Be not deceived: neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor effeminate, nor abusers of themselves with mankind,* Jared's refusal — 'my fathers never did the like' — keeps the very purity Paul says the deceived forfeit the kingdom by losing.
cards.s_text: But when Jared saw them working infamy he wept, and said in his mind, - My fathers never did the like.
cards.t_text: Know you not that the unrighteous shall not inherit the kingdom of Elohim (God)? Be not deceived: neither fornicators, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor effeminate, nor abusers of themselves with mankind,

cards.note: Jude 1:7 — *Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.* The 'infamy' the elder works before Jared is the going after strange flesh that Jude sets forth as the example of judgment.
cards.s_text: Then he spread his hands and took one of the women, and five of his companions did the same before Jared, that he should do as they did.
cards.t_text: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.

cards.note: Genesis 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* The daughters of Cain brought to the fountain are the very daughters of men whose fairness Genesis says drew the holy line down into corruption.
cards.s_text: When those men heard these words of the elder, every one of Cain's sons brought his wife, and another brought his daughter, and so, many women came to them; every one addressing Jared either for himself or for his wife; all alike.
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* The thirty hosts of Satan luring Jared down are of that order of angels who left their estate, reserved for the judgment.
cards.s_text: Satan then appeared to him with thirty men of his hosts, in the form of handsome men; Satan himself being the elder and tallest among them, with a fine beard.
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 6:2 — *And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: 'Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.'* The descent to the daughters below is the same primeval crossing the Watchers made — the seed-war told twice in the same first history.
cards.s_text: "Now, therefore, 0 my son, hearken to my counsel, and go down to them, thou and thy children. Ye will rest from all this suffering in which ye are. But if thou wilt not go down to them, then, arise, take thy children, and come with us to our garden; ye shall live in our beautiful land, and ye shall rest from all this trouble, which thou and thy children are now bearing."
cards.t_text: And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: ‘Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.’

cards.note: 1 John 3:12 — *Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.* Jared's own reckoning that the children of Cain are no kindred of his marks the covenant separation John names — the line of the wicked one kept distinct from the righteous seed.
cards.s_text: He said also in his heart, "As the children of Cain cannot come up to the height of this mountain, and none of them is so handsome as these appear to be; and among these men there is not one of my kindred - they must be strangers."
cards.t_text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

cards.note: Genesis 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* Satan's command to 'go down to them' is the mingling of the two seed-lines that Genesis names as the prelude to the flood Mahalaleel foretold.
cards.s_text: "Now, therefore, 0 my son, hearken to my counsel, and go down to them, thou and thy children. Ye will rest from all this suffering in which ye are. But if thou wilt not go down to them, then, arise, take thy children, and come with us to our garden; ye shall live in our beautiful land, and ye shall rest from all this trouble, which thou and thy children are now bearing."
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The devil who counterfeits Adam and Abel here is the one the promised Son is manifested to destroy.
cards.s_text: Then the elder began to weep, and the rest wept with him; and he said to Jared, "I am Adam whom Elohim (God) made first; and this is Abel my son, who was killed by his brother Cain, into whose heart Satan put to murder him.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Genesis 3:5 — *For Elohim (God) doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.* The false elder's tale of the beautiful land north of the garden is the same promise of a better estate the serpent dangled before Eve.
cards.s_text: Then the elder said to him, "Marvel not, 0 my son; we live in the land north of the garden, which Elohim (God) created before the world. He would not let us live there, but placed us inside the garden, below which ye are now dwelling.
cards.t_text: For Elohim (God) does know that in the day you eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and you shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

cards.note: Genesis 3:4 — *And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die.* The same deceiver who first contradicted Yahuah's word now raises the 'dead' fathers as living glory to contradict death itself and ensnare Jared.
cards.s_text: Then the elder began to weep, and the rest wept with him; and he said to Jared, "I am Adam whom Elohim (God) made first; and this is Abel my son, who was killed by his brother Cain, into whose heart Satan put to murder him.
cards.t_text: And the serpent said unto the woman, You shall not surely die:

cards.note: Revelation 12:8 — *And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.* The 'great beauty' Satan wears is stolen light from the heaven he was cast out of, the same dragon who counterfeits the patriarchs at the cave.
cards.s_text: He came out to them, and found them looking like fine men, full of light, and of great beauty. He wondered at their beauty and at their looks; and thought within himself whether they might not be of the children of Cain.
cards.t_text: And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour.* The beauty that made Jared wonder is the devouring lion's lure, and Jared who arose 'like a lion over his people' is hunted by the false lion.
cards.s_text: He came out to them, and found them looking like fine men, full of light, and of great beauty. He wondered at their beauty and at their looks; and thought within himself whether they might not be of the children of Cain.
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The elder's claim to be Adam comforting his children is the father of lies speaking of his own against the holy line.
cards.s_text: Then the elder began to weep, and the rest wept with him; and he said to Jared, "I am Adam whom Elohim (God) made first; and this is Abel my son, who was killed by his brother Cain, into whose heart Satan put to murder him.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The thirty beautiful men full of light at the cave's mouth are exactly this transformation, the seed-war's oldest disguise worn against Jared.
cards.s_text: Satan then appeared to him with thirty men of his hosts, in the form of handsome men; Satan himself being the elder and tallest among them, with a fine beard.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* The Elohim who *appeared* and *blessed* on the altar (18:14) is the same manifested Son who comes to undo the deceiver's apparitions throughout this book.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) appeared unto Jared on the altar and blessed him and his children, and accepted their offerings; and commanded Jared to take of the sacred fire from the altar, and with it to light the lamp that shed light on the body of Adam.
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: Genesis 8:21 — *And Yahuah (LORD) smelled a sweet savour; and Yahuah (LORD) said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth...* Jared's offering *accepted* on the altar (18:13) is of one savour with Noah's, the covenant mercy that keeps the seed against the curse.
cards.s_text: Then Jared made an offering and offered it up on the altar, as Adam had commanded him. And as he went up to the altar, he prayed to Elohim (God) for mercy and for forgiveness of his sin, concerning the lamp going out.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) smelled a sweet savour; and Yahuah (LORD) said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.

cards.note: Leviticus 6:13 — *The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.* The *sacred fire from the altar* that Jared must never let lapse (18:14) is the unceasing altar-fire Torah later writes into the law — the way kept before Sinai.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) appeared unto Jared on the altar and blessed him and his children, and accepted their offerings; and commanded Jared to take of the sacred fire from the altar, and with it to light the lamp that shed light on the body of Adam.
cards.t_text: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:15 — *And in the second week of the tenth jubilee Mahalalel took to him to wife Dînâh... and she bare him a son... and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers...* The very Jared whom Adam's voice charges (18:10) is named in Jubilees for the days when the Watchers fell — the same primeval seed-war from another witness.
cards.s_text: Then all the voices ceased save the voice of our father Adam, who spake to Jared by the power of Elohim (God), just as one would speak to his fellow, saying, "0 Jared, my son, offer gifts to Elohim (God) for having delivered thee from the hand of Satan; and when thou bringest those offerings, so be it that thou offerest them on the altar on which I did offer. Then also, beware of Satan; for he deluded me many a time with his apparitions, wishing to destroy me, but Elohim (God) delivered me out of his hand.
cards.t_text: And in the second week of the tenth jubilee Mahalalel took to him to wife Dînâh, the daughter of Barâkî’êl the daughter of his father’s brother, and she bare him a son in the third week in the sixth year, and he called his name Jared; for in his days the angels of Yahuah (God) descended on the earth, those who are named the Watchers, that they should instruct the children of men, and that they should do judgment and uprightness on the earth.

cards.note: Romans 16:20 — *And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Lord Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.* Adam bids his people *be on their guard against him* (18:11); Sha'ul gives the end of that guard — the deceiver bruised under the feet of the seed.
cards.s_text: "Command thy people that they be on their guard against him; and never cease to offer up gifts to Elohim (God)."
cards.t_text: And the Elohim (God) of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ) be with you. Amen.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* Satan's *apparitions, wishing to destroy* Adam (18:10) are the serpent's enmity against the seed, declared in the garden from the start.
cards.s_text: Then all the voices ceased save the voice of our father Adam, who spake to Jared by the power of Elohim (God), just as one would speak to his fellow, saying, "0 Jared, my son, offer gifts to Elohim (God) for having delivered thee from the hand of Satan; and when thou bringest those offerings, so be it that thou offerest them on the altar on which I did offer. Then also, beware of Satan; for he deluded me many a time with his apparitions, wishing to destroy me, but Elohim (God) delivered me out of his hand.
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* Adam's charge to *offer gifts to Elohim* on the altar (18:10) is the same calling on the Name kept by Seth's line down to Jared.
cards.s_text: Then all the voices ceased save the voice of our father Adam, who spake to Jared by the power of Elohim (God), just as one would speak to his fellow, saying, "0 Jared, my son, offer gifts to Elohim (God) for having delivered thee from the hand of Satan; and when thou bringest those offerings, so be it that thou offerest them on the altar on which I did offer. Then also, beware of Satan; for he deluded me many a time with his apparitions, wishing to destroy me, but Elohim (God) delivered me out of his hand.
cards.t_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Luke 22:31 — *And Yahusha (Lord) said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan hath desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:* Jared asks to be hidden *from him unto the day of my death* (18:9) — the same sifting hand Messiah warns reaches for His own, met by intercession.
cards.s_text: Then Jared fell upon the bodies and embraced them, and said, "0 my fathers, through your intercession, let Elohim (God) deliver me from the hand of Satan! And I beg you will ask Elohim (God) to keep me and to hide me from him unto the day of my death."
cards.t_text: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat:

cards.note: Hebrews 7:25 — *Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto Elohim (God) by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.* Jared begs his fathers' *intercession* (18:9), which points beyond them to the one Mediator who ever liveth to make it.
cards.s_text: Then Jared fell upon the bodies and embraced them, and said, "0 my fathers, through your intercession, let Elohim (God) deliver me from the hand of Satan! And I beg you will ask Elohim (God) to keep me and to hide me from him unto the day of my death."
cards.t_text: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto Elohim (God) by him, seeing he ever lives to make intercession for them.

cards.note: Revelation 5:8 — *And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.* The fathers *praying for his deliverance* (18:8) are of one company with the prayers of the saints kept in golden vials before the Lamb.
cards.s_text: When Jared heard this he was sorry, and went into the cave; and there found the bodies thrown about, the lamp put out, and the fathers themselves praying for his deliverance from the hand of Satan.
cards.t_text: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and four and twenty elders fell down before the Lamb, having every one of them harps, and golden vials full of odours, which are the prayers of saints.

cards.note: James 4:7 — *Submit yourselves therefore to Elohim (God). Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.* The elders' cry to *deliver our son from the hand of Satan* (18:3) is the same resistance Ya'aqob says puts the deceiver to flight.
cards.s_text: They said also, "Yahuah Elohim (LORD God) of heaven and earth, deliver our son from the hand of Satan, who wrought a great and false apparition before him." They also spake of other matters, by the power of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: Submit yourselves therefore to Elohim (God). Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour:* The devil who *wrought a great and false apparition* against Jared (18:3) is the prowling adversary Kepha says is always hunting the seed.
cards.s_text: But this time when they went into the cave they found not Jared, but they found the lamp put out, and the bodies of the fathers thrown about, and voices came from them by the power of Elohim (God), that said, "Satan in an apparition has deceived our son, wishing to destroy him, as he destroyed our son Cain."
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: 1 John 3:12 — *Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.* The bodies say Satan would destroy Jared *as he destroyed Cain* (18:2) — the same wicked one working the same end down the line.
cards.s_text: But this time when they went into the cave they found not Jared, but they found the lamp put out, and the bodies of the fathers thrown about, and voices came from them by the power of Elohim (God), that said, "Satan in an apparition has deceived our son, wishing to destroy him, as he destroyed our son Cain."
cards.t_text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The very deceit the elders name in 2 Adam & Eve 18:2 is the apparition Sha'ul warns is Satan's standing disguise.
cards.s_text: But this time when they went into the cave they found not Jared, but they found the lamp put out, and the bodies of the fathers thrown about, and voices came from them by the power of Elohim (God), that said, "Satan in an apparition has deceived our son, wishing to destroy him, as he destroyed our son Cain."
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:22 — *And he testified to the Watchers, who had sinned with the daughters of men; for these had begun to unite themselves, so as to be defiled, with the daughters of men, and Enoch testified against (them) all.* Jubilees names the defiling union that the children of Jared enter as they go down to mingle with Cain's children in 2 Adam and Eve 19:8.
cards.s_text: And Jared continued to teach his children eighty years; but after that they began to transgress the commandments he had given them, and to do many things without his counsel. They began to go down from the Holy Mountain one after another, and to mix with the children of Cain, in foul fellowships.
cards.t_text: And he testified to the Watchers, who had sinned with the daughters of men; for these had begun to unite themselves, so as to be defiled, with the daughters of men, and Enoch testified against (them) all.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 6:2 — *And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: 'Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.'* Enoch records the same primeval breach of the seed-lines that begins on the Holy Mountain in 2 Adam and Eve 19:8.
cards.s_text: And Jared continued to teach his children eighty years; but after that they began to transgress the commandments he had given them, and to do many things without his counsel. They began to go down from the Holy Mountain one after another, and to mix with the children of Cain, in foul fellowships.
cards.t_text: And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: ‘Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.’

cards.note: Genesis 6:4 — *There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.* The mingling of the holy seed with Cain's line in 2 Adam and Eve 19:8 is the corruption that fills the earth before the Flood.
cards.s_text: And Jared continued to teach his children eighty years; but after that they began to transgress the commandments he had given them, and to do many things without his counsel. They began to go down from the Holy Mountain one after another, and to mix with the children of Cain, in foul fellowships.
cards.t_text: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

cards.note: Genesis 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* The sons of God descending to mix is the same foul fellowship the children of Jared fall into as they come down from the Holy Mountain in 2 Adam and Eve 19:8.
cards.s_text: And Jared continued to teach his children eighty years; but after that they began to transgress the commandments he had given them, and to do many things without his counsel. They began to go down from the Holy Mountain one after another, and to mix with the children of Cain, in foul fellowships.
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:10–11 — *And Adam knew Eve his wife and she bare yet nine sons. And in the fifth week of the fifth jubilee Seth took 'Azûrâ his sister to be his wife, and in the fourth (year of the sixth week) she bare him Enos.* Jubilees keeps the same holy line of Seth and Enos set against Cain's city, the covenant seed Jared is told to keep separate in 2 Adam and Eve 19:4.
cards.s_text: "Then command again thy people not to hold intercourse with the children of Cain, and not to learn their ways; for I am Elohim (God) who loves not hatred and works of iniquity."
cards.t_text: And in the fifth week of the fifth jubilee Seth took ’Azûrâ his sister to be his wife, and in the fourth (year of the sixth week) she bare him Enos.

cards.note: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* The people kept from Cain's iniquity are the line of Seth that calls on the Name, the holy seed guarded in 2 Adam and Eve 19:4.
cards.s_text: "Then command again thy people not to hold intercourse with the children of Cain, and not to learn their ways; for I am Elohim (God) who loves not hatred and works of iniquity."
cards.t_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: 1 John 3:12 — *Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.* Cain is named of the wicked one, so the charge not to learn his children's ways in 2 Adam and Eve 19:4 is the seed of the woman kept from the seed of the serpent.
cards.s_text: "Then command again thy people not to hold intercourse with the children of Cain, and not to learn their ways; for I am Elohim (God) who loves not hatred and works of iniquity."
cards.t_text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

cards.note: Genesis 3:15 — *And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* The command to keep apart from Cain's children is the enmity of the two seeds set at Eden, guarding the woman's seed in 2 Adam and Eve 19:4.
cards.s_text: "Then command again thy people not to hold intercourse with the children of Cain, and not to learn their ways; for I am Elohim (God) who loves not hatred and works of iniquity."
cards.t_text: And I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your seed and her seed; it shall bruise your head, and you shall bruise his heel.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* Jared is charged to receive an order by true vision and not by apparition, guarding the holy fire against the deceiver's counterfeit light in 2 Adam and Eve 19:3.
cards.s_text: But, 0 Jared, take care of the fire, that it burn bright in the lamp; neither go thou again out of the cave until thou receivest an order through a vision, and not in an apparition, when seen by thee.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: Hebrews 1:3 — *Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;* the true Light the lamp prefigures is the Son whose own purging frees Adam's body from the cave in 2 Adam and Eve 19:2.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) said to Jared, "As to that fire which thou hast taken from the altar to light the lamp withal, let it abide with you to give light to the bodies; and let it not come out of the cave, until the body of Adam comes out of it.
cards.t_text: Who being the brightness of his glory, and the express image of his person, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself purged our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:19 — *But with the precious blood of Messiah (Christ), as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:* the altar-fire kept burning before Adam's body until the appointed coming points to the spotless Lamb whose redemption that fire awaits in 2 Adam and Eve 19:2.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) said to Jared, "As to that fire which thou hast taken from the altar to light the lamp withal, let it abide with you to give light to the bodies; and let it not come out of the cave, until the body of Adam comes out of it.
cards.t_text: But with the precious blood of Messiah (Christ), as of a lamb without blemish and without spot:

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:20 — *Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,* showing the coming explained to the fathers as the 5500 years was settled before the world, exactly the mystery of 2 Adam and Eve 19:1.
cards.s_text: THEN Elohim (God) revealed to him again the promise He had made to Adam; He explained to him the 5500 years, and revealed unto him the mystery of His coming upon the earth.
cards.t_text: Who verily was foreordained before the foundation of the world, but was manifest in these last times for you,

cards.note: John 1:3 — *All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.* The Word who promises His own incarnation to the holy line is the Maker of all, the mystery hidden from Adam's day in 2 Adam and Eve 19:1.
cards.s_text: THEN Elohim (God) revealed to him again the promise He had made to Adam; He explained to him the 5500 years, and revealed unto him the mystery of His coming upon the earth.
cards.t_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The One who reveals to Jared the mystery of His coming is the eternal Word who would Himself come upon the earth in 2 Adam and Eve 19:1.
cards.s_text: THEN Elohim (God) revealed to him again the promise He had made to Adam; He explained to him the 5500 years, and revealed unto him the mystery of His coming upon the earth.
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: Galatians 4:4 — *But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,* the appointed term Elohim explained to Jared as the 5500 years runs out in the sending of the Son in 2 Adam and Eve 19:1.
cards.s_text: THEN Elohim (God) revealed to him again the promise He had made to Adam; He explained to him the 5500 years, and revealed unto him the mystery of His coming upon the earth.
cards.t_text: But when the fulness of the time was come, Elohim (God) sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

cards.note: 1 John 3:10 — *In this the children of Elohim (God) are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever doeth not righteousness is not of Elohim (God), neither he that loveth not his brother.* Jared's two names — 'children of Elohim' or 'children of the devil' — in 2 Adam & Eve 20:27 are the two manifest seeds John sets side by side.
cards.s_text: He again adjured them, saying, "I adjure by the death of our father Adam, and by the blood of Abel, of Seth, of Enos, of Cainan, and of Mahalaleel, to hearken to me, and not to go down from this holy mountain; for the moment you leave it, you will be reft of life and of mercy; and you shall no longer be called 'children of Elohim (God),' but 'children of the devil.'
cards.t_text: In this the children of Elohim (God) are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever does not righteousness is not of Elohim (God), neither he that loves not his brother.

cards.note: 1 John 3:8 — *Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.* Jared's warning that the descenders shall be called 'children of the devil' in 2 Adam & Eve 20:27 is John's same verdict on those of the devil who sins from the beginning.
cards.s_text: He again adjured them, saying, "I adjure by the death of our father Adam, and by the blood of Abel, of Seth, of Enos, of Cainan, and of Mahalaleel, to hearken to me, and not to go down from this holy mountain; for the moment you leave it, you will be reft of life and of mercy; and you shall no longer be called 'children of Elohim (God),' but 'children of the devil.'
cards.t_text: Whoever goes on sinning belongs to the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the very beginning. This is why the Son of Elohim (God) was revealed: to undo the works of the devil.

cards.note: John 1:1 — *In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).* The Word that Elohim sends to Jared in 2 Adam & Eve 20:35 is the eternal Logos who was in the beginning with Elohim.
cards.s_text: Then Elohim (God) sent His Word to Jared, saying, "These thy children, whom thou didst call 'My children,' - behold they have transgressed My commandment, and have gone down to the abode of perdition, and of sin. Send a messenger to those that are left, that they may not go down, and be lost."
cards.t_text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with Elohim (God), and the Word was Elohim (God).

cards.note: 1 Enoch 7:1 — *And all the others together with them took unto themselves wives, and each chose for himself one, and they began to go in unto them and to defile themselves with them, and they taught them charms and enchantments, and the cutting of roots, and made them acquainted with plants.* The fire of sin kindled by the painted daughters of Cain in 2 Adam & Eve 20:31 is the same defiling descent the Watchers made in Enoch.
cards.s_text: And when they looked at the daughters of Cain, at their beautiful figures, and at their hands and feet dyed with colour, and tattooed in ornaments on their faces, the fire of sin was kindled in them.
cards.t_text: And all the others together with them took unto themselves wives, and each chose for himself one, and they began to go in unto them and to defile themselves with them, and they taught them charms and enchantments, and the cutting of roots, and made them acquainted with plants.

cards.note: Genesis 6:5 — *And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.* The defilement that bars the sons of Seth from the holy mountain in 2 Adam & Eve 20:33 is the flood-bringing wickedness Genesis names.
cards.s_text: But after they had thus fallen into this defilement, they returned by the way they had come, and tried to ascend the Holy Mountain. But they could not, because the stones of that holy mountain were of fire flashing before them, by reason of which they could not go up again.
cards.t_text: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

cards.note: Genesis 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* The sons of Seth lusting after the daughters of Cain until they committed abomination in 2 Adam & Eve 20:32 is the very sons-of-God / daughters-of-men mingling of Genesis 6.
cards.s_text: Then Satan made them look most beautiful before the sons of Seth, as he also made the sons of Seth appear of the fairest in the eyes of the daughters of Cain, so that the daughters of Cain lusted after the sons of Seth like ravenous beasts, and the sons of Seth after the daughters of Cain, until they committed abomination with them.
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The lie Satan whispers to Genun in 2 Adam & Eve 20:19 is the father of lies speaking of his own from the beginning.
cards.s_text: Then Satan appeared to him by night, saying, "There is no way for them to come down from the mountain on which they dwell; but when they come to-morrow, say to them, 'Come ye to the western side of the mountain; there you will find the way of a stream of water, that comes down to the foot of the mountain, between two hills; come down that way to us."
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: 1 Peter 5:8 — *Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour.* Genun bethinking himself how to bring the sons of Seth down in 2 Adam & Eve 20:18 is the adversary walking about, seeking whom he may devour.
cards.s_text: But the children of Seth said to them from above, "We don't know the way." Then Genun, the son of Lamech, heard them say they did not know the way, and he bethought himself how he might bring them down.
cards.t_text: Be sober, be vigilant; because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walks about, seeking whom he may devour:

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:3 — *But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).* Satan's night-counsel showing the way down the western stream in 2 Adam & Eve 20:19 is the serpent's same subtilty that beguiled Eve.
cards.s_text: Then Satan appeared to him by night, saying, "There is no way for them to come down from the mountain on which they dwell; but when they come to-morrow, say to them, 'Come ye to the western side of the mountain; there you will find the way of a stream of water, that comes down to the foot of the mountain, between two hills; come down that way to us."
cards.t_text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* The praying, praising children of Seth on the Holy Mountain in 2 Adam & Eve 20:15 are the very line of which Genesis says men began to call on the Name.
cards.s_text: Meanwhile the children of Seth, who were on the Holy Mountain, prayed and praised Elohim (God), in the place of the hosts of angels who had fallen; wherefore Elohim (God) had called them 'angels," because He rejoiced over them greatly.
cards.t_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Jude 1:11 — *Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.* The children of Cain calling up to the holy mountain in 2 Adam & Eve 20:17 are walking — and beckoning others into — the way of Cain that Jude condemns.
cards.s_text: Then the children of Cain looked up from below, and saw the children of Seth, standing in troops on the top of the mountain; and they called to them to come down to them.
cards.t_text: Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core.

cards.note: 1 John 3:12 — *Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.* The sons of Cain who shine in beauty and abomination at the foot of the mountain in 2 Adam & Eve 20:14 are the line of him who was of that wicked one.
cards.s_text: And the sons of Cain who wrought all this, and shone in beauty and gorgeous apparel, gathered together at the foot of the mountain in splendour, with horns and gorgeous dresses, and horse races, committing all manner of abominations.
cards.t_text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* The sweet, heart-ravishing sounds that Satan plays through Genun's instruments in 2 Adam & Eve 20:3 are the adversary disguising death as delight.
cards.s_text: And when he played on them, Satan came into them, so that from among them were heard beautiful and sweet sounds, that ravished the heart.
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 8:1 — *And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.* The Watcher Azazel's curriculum — weaponry, ornament, dyes, painted eyes — is Genun's curriculum verbatim, the same seed-war wearing a new name.
