cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 13:16 — *For he provided for it that it might not fall, knowing that it was unable to help itself; for it is an image, and has need of help:* Abraham's question whether the statue can help his father (6:1) is answered in the deuterocanon: the image cannot help itself, let alone anyone.
cards.s_text: When I, Abraham, however, heard such words from my father, I laughed in my mind and sighed in the grief and in the anger of my soul, and said: "How then can that which is made by him — manufactured statues — be a helper of my father?
cards.t_text: For he provided for it that it might not fall, knowing that it was unable to help itself; for it is an image, and has need of help:

cards.note: Isaiah 44:2 — *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD) that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.* Against the statue that cannot help his father (6:1), Isaiah sets the Maker who forms from the womb and truly helps.
cards.s_text: When I, Abraham, however, heard such words from my father, I laughed in my mind and sighed in the grief and in the anger of my soul, and said: "How then can that which is made by him — manufactured statues — be a helper of my father?
cards.t_text: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) that made you, and formed you from the womb, which will help you; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and you, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.

cards.note: Habakkuk 2:18 — *What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?* Abraham's burnt and profitless Barisat (6:11) is the prophet's dumb idol that profits the maker nothing.
cards.s_text: And lo, his fatness is already withered and perished, he is fallen from the height to the ground, he hath come from great estate to littleness, and the appearance of his countenance hath vanished, and he, Barisat himself, is burnt up by fire and reduced to ashes and is no more; and thou sayest: 'To-day I will make another which to-morrow shall make ready my food.' He hath perished to utter destruction!"
cards.t_text: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof has graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusts therein, to make dumb idols?

cards.note: Isaiah 44:20 — *He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?* Barisat reduced to ashes (6:11) is the very ash the deceived heart feeds on, unable to deliver a single soul.
cards.s_text: And lo, his fatness is already withered and perished, he is fallen from the height to the ground, he hath come from great estate to littleness, and the appearance of his countenance hath vanished, and he, Barisat himself, is burnt up by fire and reduced to ashes and is no more; and thou sayest: 'To-day I will make another which to-morrow shall make ready my food.' He hath perished to utter destruction!"
cards.t_text: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart has turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 13:13 — *And taking the very refuse among those which served to no use, being a crooked piece of wood, and full of knots, has carved it diligently, when he had nothing else to do, and formed it by the skill of his understanding, and fashioned it to the image of a man;* Barisat made into a god by Terah's art (6:10) is the carpenter's refuse-wood shaped into a deity, the same witness in the deuterocanon.
cards.s_text: But thy god Barisat, while he was still, before he had been prepared, rooted up upon the earth and was great and wonderful with the glory of branches and blossom, thou didst hew out with the axe, and by means of thy art he hath been made into a god.
cards.t_text: And taking the very refuse among those which served to no use, being a crooked piece of wood, and full of knots, has carved it diligently, when he had nothing else to do, and formed it by the skill of his understanding, and fashioned it to the image of a man;

cards.note: Jeremiah 10:3 — *For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.* Abraham's axe in 6:10 is Jeremiah's axe; the custom of cutting a god from a tree is one and the same vanity.
cards.s_text: But thy god Barisat, while he was still, before he had been prepared, rooted up upon the earth and was great and wonderful with the glory of branches and blossom, thou didst hew out with the axe, and by means of thy art he hath been made into a god.
cards.t_text: For the customs of the people are vain: for one cutteth a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman, with the axe.

cards.note: Isaiah 44:15 — *Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.* The same wood that warms and bakes is hewn into Barisat the god (6:10), the prophet's exact absurdity.
cards.s_text: But thy god Barisat, while he was still, before he had been prepared, rooted up upon the earth and was great and wonderful with the glory of branches and blossom, thou didst hew out with the axe, and by means of thy art he hath been made into a god.
cards.t_text: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he makes a god, and worshippeth it; he makes it a graven image, and falls down thereto.

cards.note: Isaiah 44:14 — *He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.* The living tree Abraham mourns in 6:10 is Isaiah's forest cedar, nourished by rain before the axe.
cards.s_text: But thy god Barisat, while he was still, before he had been prepared, rooted up upon the earth and was great and wonderful with the glory of branches and blossom, thou didst hew out with the axe, and by means of thy art he hath been made into a god.
cards.t_text: He heweth him down cedars, and takes the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain does nourish it.

cards.note: Jeremiah 10:8 — *But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.* The broken stone that cannot be renewed (6:7) is Jeremiah's vain stock, a doctrine of nothing.
cards.s_text: For behold, Zucheus, the god of thy brother Oron, is more worthy of honour than thy god Merumath, because he is made of gold which is highly valued by people, and when he groweth old in years he will be remodelled; but if your god Merumath is changed or broken, he will not be renewed, because he is a stone; the which is also the case with the god Joavon, who standeth with Zucheus over the other gods.
cards.t_text: But they are altogether brutish and foolish: the stock is a doctrine of vanities.

cards.note: Psalm 115:8 — *They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.* Terah is made foolish (6:5) by the lifeless thing he trusts, exactly as the Psalm warns.
cards.s_text: For behold, Zucheus, the god of thy brother Oron, is more worthy of honour than thy god Merumath, because he is made of gold which is highly valued by people, and when he groweth old in years he will be remodelled; but if your god Merumath is changed or broken, he will not be renewed, because he is a stone; the which is also the case with the god Joavon, who standeth with Zucheus over the other gods.
cards.t_text: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusts in them.

cards.note: Psalm 115:5 — *They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:* The stone Merumath of 6:7 is the Psalm's dumb, blind idol, unable to renew even itself.
cards.s_text: For behold, Zucheus, the god of thy brother Oron, is more worthy of honour than thy god Merumath, because he is made of gold which is highly valued by people, and when he groweth old in years he will be remodelled; but if your god Merumath is changed or broken, he will not be renewed, because he is a stone; the which is also the case with the god Joavon, who standeth with Zucheus over the other gods.
cards.t_text: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

cards.note: Joshua 24:2 — *And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.* Scripture itself records that Abraham's rebuke in 6:5 was aimed at the very idolatry of Terah's house.
cards.s_text: And I answered and said: "O father Terah, whichever of these thou praisest as a god, thou art foolish in thy mind.
cards.t_text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.

cards.note: Romans 1:20 — *For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:* Abraham's plea that Elohim reveal Himself through Himself (7:13) meets Paul's word that the made things already make Him clearly seen.
cards.s_text: Yet may Elohim (God) reveal Himself to us through Himself!"
cards.t_text: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

cards.note: Psalm 19:1 — *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork.* The crimsoned heavens and golden sun Abraham points to in 7:12 are the very handywork the Psalm says declares the Maker's glory.
cards.s_text: Who hath crimsoned the heavens, and made the sun golden, and the moon lustrous, and with it the stars; and hath made the earth dry in the midst of many waters, and set thee in the world.
cards.t_text: The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament shows his handywork.

cards.note: Genesis 1:9 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.* Abraham's praise that the Maker 'hath made the earth dry in the midst of many waters' (7:12) recites the third day of Genesis word for deed.
cards.s_text: Who hath crimsoned the heavens, and made the sun golden, and the moon lustrous, and with it the stars; and hath made the earth dry in the midst of many waters, and set thee in the world.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

cards.note: Jeremiah 10:10 — *But Yahuah (LORD) is the true Elohim (God), he is the living Elohim (God), and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.* The 'Elohim who hath made everything' that Abraham names in 7:9 is Jeremiah's living and true Elohim, set against the gods that did not make the heavens.
cards.s_text: But hear this, Terah my father; for I will make known to thee the Elohim (God) who hath made everything, not these we consider as gods.
cards.t_text: But Yahuah (LORD) is the true Elohim (God), he is the living Elohim (God), and an everlasting king: at his wrath the earth shall tremble, and the nations shall not be able to abide his indignation.

cards.note: Acts 7:2 — *And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The Elohim (God) of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,* Stephen sets the call where this chapter sets it — in Abraham's homeland among the idols, before the going out, the same Elohim Abraham proclaims to Terah in 7:9.
cards.s_text: But hear this, Terah my father; for I will make known to thee the Elohim (God) who hath made everything, not these we consider as gods.
cards.t_text: And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The Elohim (God) of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,

cards.note: Joshua 24:2 — *And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.* Abraham's address to Terah in 7:9 stands at the exact hinge Joshua names — the father served other gods; the son will make known the One who made everything.
cards.s_text: But hear this, Terah my father; for I will make known to thee the Elohim (God) who hath made everything, not these we consider as gods.
cards.t_text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.

cards.note: Isaiah 44:9 — *They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.* The sun whose course is obscured by night and cloud (7:7) profits no more than the carved idol — both are vanity beside the Maker.
cards.s_text: But even it I do not call god, because at night and by clouds its course is obscured.
cards.t_text: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.

cards.note: Genesis 1:16 — *And Elohim (God) made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.* The sun Abraham honours but will not worship (7:6) is a made thing, ruled and set in place by the One who made it.
cards.s_text: I call the sun more worthy of honour than the earth, because it with its rays illumineth the whole world and the different atmospheres.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 4:19 — *And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.* Abraham's refusal to call moon or stars god (7:8) is the very fence Moses sets — the host of heaven serves, it is not served.
cards.s_text: Nor, again, do I call the moon or the stars god, because they also in their season obscure their light at night.
cards.t_text: And lest you lift up your eyes unto heaven, and when you see the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, should be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.

cards.note: Psalm 115:5 — *They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:* What is subjected and perishable, as Abraham says of fire in 7:1, cannot answer or save — the same indictment the Psalm lays on every idol.
cards.s_text: "Behold, the fire is more worthy of honour than all things formed, because even that which is not subjected is subjected unto it, and things easily perishable are mocked by its flames.
cards.t_text: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 13:4 — *But if they were astonished at their power and virtue, let them understand by them, how much mightier he is that made them.* Abraham's refusal to call water 'Elohim' because it is subject to the earth (7:3) is the same reasoning: the power of a thing points past it to the One who made it mightier still.
cards.s_text: But even it I do not call Elohim (God), because it is subjected to the earth under which the water inclineth.
cards.t_text: But if they were astonished at their power and virtue, let them understand by them, how much mightier he is that made them.

cards.note: Wisdom of Solomon 13:2 — *But deemed either fire, or wind, or the swift air, or the circle of the stars, or the violent water, or the lights of heaven, to be the gods which govern the world.* The Apocrypha names the very ladder Abraham climbs in 7:2 — fire, water, the stars — and calls it the error of those who mistook creature for Creator.
cards.s_text: But even more worthy of honour is the water, because it conquereth the fire and satisfieth the earth.
cards.t_text: But deemed either fire, or wind, or the swift air, or the circle of the stars, or the violent water, or the lights of heaven, to be the gods which govern the world.

cards.note: Jasher 12:26 — *And Haran died when they had cast him into the fire, and he was burned to ashes, for his heart was not perfect with Yahuah (the Lord); and those men who cast him into the fire, the flame of the fire spread over them, and they were burned, and twelve men of them died.* The parallel record's fire of Ur consumes the unfaithful while the called one walks free, as the fire takes Terah's house in Apocalypse of Abraham 8:6.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass, when I went out, that before I succeeded in getting out in front of the door of the court, there came a sound of a great thunder and burnt him and his house, and everything whatsoever in his house, down to the ground, forty cubits.
cards.t_text: And Haran died when they had cast him into the fire, and he was burned to ashes, for his heart was not perfect with Yahuah (the Lord); and those men who cast him into the fire, the flame of the fire spread over them, and they were burned, and twelve men of them died.

cards.note: Genesis 19:24 — *Then Yahuah (LORD) rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Yahuah (LORD) out of heaven.* The thunder-fire that consumes Terah's house in Apocalypse of Abraham 8:6 is the same heaven-sent fire of judgment on the cities of the plain.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass, when I went out, that before I succeeded in getting out in front of the door of the court, there came a sound of a great thunder and burnt him and his house, and everything whatsoever in his house, down to the ground, forty cubits.
cards.t_text: Then Yahuah (LORD) rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Yahuah (LORD) out of heaven;

cards.note: Joshua 24:2 — *And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.* Terah's served-gods are the idol-house that burns in Apocalypse of Abraham 8:6.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass, when I went out, that before I succeeded in getting out in front of the door of the court, there came a sound of a great thunder and burnt him and his house, and everything whatsoever in his house, down to the ground, forty cubits.
cards.t_text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 6:17 — *Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith Yahuah (Lord), and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you.* Abraham's "And I went out" is the pattern of separation from the idol-system that the elect are still called to.
cards.s_text: And I went out.
cards.t_text: Wherefore come out from among them, and be you separate, says Yahuah (Lord), and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you,

cards.note: Jubilees 12:22 — *Get you up from your country, and from your kindred and from the house of your father to a land which I shall show you, and I shall make you a great and numerous nation.* The parallel restored record gives the identical call out of the father's house that meets Apocalypse of Abraham 8:4.
cards.s_text: Go out from thy father Terah, and get thee out from the house, that thou also be not slain in the sins of thy father's house."
cards.t_text: And he made an end of speaking and praying, and behold the word of Yahuah (God) was sent to him through me, saying: "Get you up from your country, and from your kindred and from the house of your father to a land which I shall show you, and I shall make you a great and numerous nation.

cards.note: Acts 7:3 — *And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.* Stephen rehearses before the council the same calling-out of Abraham that Apocalypse of Abraham 8:4 records.
cards.s_text: Go out from thy father Terah, and get thee out from the house, that thou also be not slain in the sins of thy father's house."
cards.t_text: And said unto him, Get you out of your country, and from your kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew you.

cards.note: Genesis 12:1 — *Now Yahuah (LORD) had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father’s house, unto a land that I will shew thee.* The "get thee out from the house" of Apocalypse of Abraham 8:4 is the very lekh-lekha that founds the covenant in the Torah.
cards.s_text: Go out from thy father Terah, and get thee out from the house, that thou also be not slain in the sins of thy father's house."
cards.t_text: Now Yahuah (LORD) had said unto Abram, Get you out of your country, and from your kindred, and from your father’s house, unto a land that I will shew you:

cards.note: Jubilees 12:17–19 — *All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of Yahuah (God)... You alone are my Elohim (God)... And You have created all things, And all things that are are the work of Your hands.* The parallel restored record gives Abraham's own confession of the Creator that meets the "I am He" of Apocalypse of Abraham 8:3.
cards.s_text: And He said: "Thou art seeking, in the understanding of thine heart, the Elohim (God) of Gods and the Creator; I am He.
cards.t_text: And a word came into his heart and he said: "All the signs of the stars, and the signs of the moon and of the sun are all in the hand of Yahuah (God). Why do I search (them) out?

cards.note: Isaiah 44:6 — *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD) the King of Yashar'el (Israel), and his redeemer Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no Elohim (God).* The Elohim of gods and Creator who answers Abraham's seeking heart is the One beside whom there is no other.
cards.s_text: And He said: "Thou art seeking, in the understanding of thine heart, the Elohim (God) of Gods and the Creator; I am He.
cards.t_text: Thus says Yahuah (LORD) the King of Yashar'el (Israel), and his redeemer Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no Elohim (God).

cards.note: Isaiah 43:10 — *Ye are my witnesses, saith Yahuah (LORD), and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no Elohim (God) formed, neither shall there be after me.* The "I am He" the LORD speaks to the nations is the very word He speaks to Abraham in Apocalypse of Abraham 8:3.
cards.s_text: And He said: "Thou art seeking, in the understanding of thine heart, the Elohim (God) of Gods and the Creator; I am He.
cards.t_text: You are my witnesses, says Yahuah (LORD), and my servant whom I have chosen: that you may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no Elohim (God) formed, neither shall there be after me.

cards.note: Exodus 3:4 — *And when Yahuah (LORD) saw that he turned aside to see, Elohim (God) called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.* As the One out of the fiery cloud cries "Abraham, Abraham" and is answered "Here am I," so the One in the burning bush cries "Moses, Moses" and is answered the same.
cards.s_text: And I said: "Here am I."
cards.t_text: And when Yahuah (LORD) saw that he turned aside to see, Elohim (God) called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.

cards.note: Genesis 22:1 — *And it came to pass after these things, that Elohim (God) did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.* The doubled call and the ready answer of Apocalypse of Abraham 8:1-2 are the same covenant address Abraham knows on Moriah.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass, while I spake thus to my father Terah in the court of my house, there cometh down the voice of a Mighty One from heaven in a fiery cloud-burst, saying and crying: "Abraham, Abraham!"
cards.t_text: And it came to pass after these things, that Elohim (God) did tempt Abraham, and said unto him, Abraham: and he said, Behold, here I am.

cards.note: Exodus 23:21 — *Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.* The Word by which Yahuah shews Abraham the ages in 9:7 is borne by the angel in whom the Name dwells — the Name-bearing guide of the called-out man.
cards.s_text: But abstain from every form of food that proceedeth out of the fire, and from the drinking of wine, and from anointing thyself with oil, forty days, and then set forth for me the sacrifice which I have commanded thee, in the place which I will shew thee, on a high mountain, and there I will shew thee the ages which have been created and established, made and renewed, by my Word, and I will make known to thee what shall come to pass in them on those who have done evil and practised righteousness in the generation of men."
cards.t_text: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.

cards.note: Exodus 23:20 — *Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.* The angel who bears the Name (the Yahoel of this Apocalypse) brings to the prepared place — the very mountain Abraham is told to go up to in 9:7.
cards.s_text: But abstain from every form of food that proceedeth out of the fire, and from the drinking of wine, and from anointing thyself with oil, forty days, and then set forth for me the sacrifice which I have commanded thee, in the place which I will shew thee, on a high mountain, and there I will shew thee the ages which have been created and established, made and renewed, by my Word, and I will make known to thee what shall come to pass in them on those who have done evil and practised righteousness in the generation of men."
cards.t_text: Behold, I send an Angel before you, to keep you in the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

cards.note: Acts 7:3 — *And said unto him, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.* Stephen rehearses the same shew-thee call before the council — the appointed place Abraham is sent to in 9:7 is the calling out itself.
cards.s_text: But abstain from every form of food that proceedeth out of the fire, and from the drinking of wine, and from anointing thyself with oil, forty days, and then set forth for me the sacrifice which I have commanded thee, in the place which I will shew thee, on a high mountain, and there I will shew thee the ages which have been created and established, made and renewed, by my Word, and I will make known to thee what shall come to pass in them on those who have done evil and practised righteousness in the generation of men."
cards.t_text: And said unto him, Get you out of your country, and from your kindred, and come into the land which I shall shew you.

cards.note: Genesis 12:1 — *Now Yahuah (LORD) had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee.* The 'place which I will shew thee' of 9:7 echoes the first call out of Ur — the land Yahuah shews and does not yet name.
cards.s_text: But abstain from every form of food that proceedeth out of the fire, and from the drinking of wine, and from anointing thyself with oil, forty days, and then set forth for me the sacrifice which I have commanded thee, in the place which I will shew thee, on a high mountain, and there I will shew thee the ages which have been created and established, made and renewed, by my Word, and I will make known to thee what shall come to pass in them on those who have done evil and practised righteousness in the generation of men."
cards.t_text: Now Yahuah (LORD) had said unto Abram, Get you out of your country, and from your kindred, and from your father’s house, unto a land that I will shew you:

cards.note: Romans 4:17 — *(As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even Elohim (God), who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.* The ages which 'shall come to pass' shewn Abraham in 9:7 are seen by the same faith that calls the not-yet as though it already were.
cards.s_text: But abstain from every form of food that proceedeth out of the fire, and from the drinking of wine, and from anointing thyself with oil, forty days, and then set forth for me the sacrifice which I have commanded thee, in the place which I will shew thee, on a high mountain, and there I will shew thee the ages which have been created and established, made and renewed, by my Word, and I will make known to thee what shall come to pass in them on those who have done evil and practised righteousness in the generation of men."
cards.t_text: (As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even Elohim (God), who quickens the dead, and calls those things which be not as though they were.

cards.note: Genesis 15:5 — *And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.* The 'great things which thou hast not seen hitherto' of 9:6 begin with the seed beyond numbering shown at the same sacrifice.
cards.s_text: And in this sacrifice I will lay before thee the ages (to come), and make known to thee what is reserved, and thou shalt see great things which thou hast not seen hitherto; because thou hast loved to search me out, and I have named thee my Friend.
cards.t_text: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if you be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall your seed be.

cards.note: Genesis 15:13 — *And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that thy seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years.* The 'ages (to come)' laid before Abraham in 9:6 are the very foretelling joined to the Genesis covenant — what shall come to pass upon the seed.
cards.s_text: And in this sacrifice I will lay before thee the ages (to come), and make known to thee what is reserved, and thou shalt see great things which thou hast not seen hitherto; because thou hast loved to search me out, and I have named thee my Friend.
cards.t_text: And he said unto Abram, Know of a surety that your seed shall be a stranger in a land that is not theirs, and shall serve them; and they shall afflict them four hundred years;

cards.note: John 15:15 — *Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.* The friend-naming of Abraham in 9:6 — to whom the ages are made known — is the pattern the Master extends to His own, making all things known to friends.
cards.s_text: And in this sacrifice I will lay before thee the ages (to come), and make known to thee what is reserved, and thou shalt see great things which thou hast not seen hitherto; because thou hast loved to search me out, and I have named thee my Friend.
cards.t_text: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knows not what his lord does: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.

cards.note: James 2:23 — *And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed Elohim (God), and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of Elohim (God).* The apostle confirms the same name spoken over Abraham in 9:6 — it ain't new.
cards.s_text: And in this sacrifice I will lay before thee the ages (to come), and make known to thee what is reserved, and thou shalt see great things which thou hast not seen hitherto; because thou hast loved to search me out, and I have named thee my Friend.
cards.t_text: And the scripture was fulfilled which says, Abraham believed Elohim (God), and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of Elohim (God).

cards.note: 2 Chronicles 20:7 — *Art not thou our Elohim (God), who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Yashar'el (Israel), and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?* Jehoshaphat pleads at the throne the very friend-name Abraham is given in 9:6.
cards.s_text: And in this sacrifice I will lay before thee the ages (to come), and make known to thee what is reserved, and thou shalt see great things which thou hast not seen hitherto; because thou hast loved to search me out, and I have named thee my Friend.
cards.t_text: Are not you our Elohim (God), who did drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Yashar'el (Israel), and gave it to the seed of Abraham your friend for ever?

cards.note: Isaiah 41:8 — *But thou, Yashar'el (Israel), art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.* The 'I have named thee my Friend' of 9:6 is the prophet's own title for Abraham, carried down to his chosen seed.
cards.s_text: And in this sacrifice I will lay before thee the ages (to come), and make known to thee what is reserved, and thou shalt see great things which thou hast not seen hitherto; because thou hast loved to search me out, and I have named thee my Friend.
cards.t_text: But you, Yashar'el (Israel), are my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.

cards.note: Isaiah 41:10 — *Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy Elohim (God): I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.* The Helper of 9:4 is the same upholding right hand spoken over Abraham's chosen seed in Isaiah.
cards.s_text: I am a shield over thee, and I am thy helper.
cards.t_text: Fear you not; for I am with you: be not dismayed; for I am your Elohim (God): I will strengthen you; yea, I will help you; yea, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.

cards.note: Genesis 15:1 — *After these things the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am thy shield, and thy exceeding great reward.* The 'fear not... I am a shield over thee' of Apocalypse of Abraham 9:3-4 is the opening of the same covenant vision in Genesis.
cards.s_text: I am a shield over thee, and I am thy helper.
cards.t_text: After these things the word of Yahuah (LORD) came unto Abram in a vision, saying, Fear not, Abram: I am your shield, and your exceeding great reward.

cards.note: Genesis 15:17 — *And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.* The pure sacrifice Abraham is told to set forth in 9:5 is the covenant between the pieces, sealed by the burning lamp that passes through them.
cards.s_text: Go, take me a young heifer of three years old, and a she-goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove and a pigeon, and bring me a pure sacrifice.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.

cards.note: Genesis 15:9 — *And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.* The five creatures of Apocalypse of Abraham 9:5 are the very beasts Yahuah names for the covenant sacrifice in Genesis — it ain't new.
cards.s_text: Go, take me a young heifer of three years old, and a she-goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove and a pigeon, and bring me a pure sacrifice.
cards.t_text: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

cards.note: Genesis 12:1 — *Now Yahuah (LORD) had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee.* The land the Eternal One hath prepared, for which Jaoel comes (Apocalypse of Abraham 10:11), is the land of the first calling-out.
cards.s_text: I have been sent to bless thee now, and the land which the Eternal One, whom thou hast invoked, hath prepared for thee, and for thy sake have I wended my way upon the earth.
cards.t_text: Now Yahuah (LORD) had said unto Abram, Get you out of your country, and from your kindred, and from your father’s house, unto a land that I will shew you:

cards.note: Genesis 15:5 — *And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall thy seed be.* The generation prepared to spring from Abraham (Apocalypse of Abraham 10:16) is the innumerable seed shown as the stars.
cards.s_text: For, lo, I have been appointed to be with thee and with the generation prepared to spring from thee; and with me Michael blesseth thee for ever.
cards.t_text: And he brought him forth abroad, and said, Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if you be able to number them: and he said unto him, So shall your seed be.

cards.note: Genesis 15:9 — *And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.* The sacrifices Jaoel commands Abraham to fulfil (Apocalypse of Abraham 10:15) are the exact heifer, goat, ram, turtledove and pigeon of the Genesis covenant.
cards.s_text: Go, fulfil the sacrifices commanded.
cards.t_text: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 10:8 — *And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.* The corrupting reverence for dead idols burned away in Apocalypse of Abraham 10:10 is the same Azazel-system whose works defile the earth.
cards.s_text: I am the one who was commissioned to set on fire thy father's house together with him, because he displayed reverence for dead idols.
cards.t_text: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’

cards.note: Isaiah 44:15 — *Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.* The wood that becomes a worshipped god is fit only for the fire that consumes the idol-house in Apocalypse of Abraham 10:10.
cards.s_text: I am the one who was commissioned to set on fire thy father's house together with him, because he displayed reverence for dead idols.
cards.t_text: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he makes a god, and worshippeth it; he makes it a graven image, and falls down thereto.

cards.note: Isaiah 44:9 — *They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.* The dead idols Terah reveres (Apocalypse of Abraham 10:10) are the very vanity Isaiah exposes.
cards.s_text: I am the one who was commissioned to set on fire thy father's house together with him, because he displayed reverence for dead idols.
cards.t_text: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.

cards.note: Joshua 24:2 — *And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus saith Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.* Terah's idolatrous house, marked for burning in Apocalypse of Abraham 10:10, is named outright in Israel's own record.
cards.s_text: I am the one who was commissioned to set on fire thy father's house together with him, because he displayed reverence for dead idols.
cards.t_text: And Joshua said unto all the people, Thus says Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel), Your fathers dwelt on the other side of the flood in old time, even Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nachor: and they served other gods.

cards.note: Psalm 74:14 — *Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.* The menace of Leviathan that bows to His command (Apocalypse of Abraham 10:8) is the head Yahuah has already broken.
cards.s_text: I am ordained to restrain the Leviathan, for unto me are subject the attack and menace of every single reptile.
cards.t_text: You brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gave him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

cards.note: Isaiah 27:1 — *In that day Yahuah (LORD) with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.* The Leviathan subject to Jaoel's restraint (Apocalypse of Abraham 10:8) is the very dragon Yahuah judges.
cards.s_text: I am ordained to restrain the Leviathan, for unto me are subject the attack and menace of every single reptile.
cards.t_text: In that day Yahuah (LORD) with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.

cards.note: Ezekiel 1:13 — *As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.* The living creatures of the Cherubim Jaoel restrains (Apocalypse of Abraham 10:7) are the fiery beasts of Ezekiel's chariot.
cards.s_text: I am the one who hath been given to restrain, according to His commandment, the threatening attack of the living creatures of the Cherubim against one another, and to teach those who carry Him the song of the seventh hour of the night of man.
cards.t_text: As for the likeness of the living creatures, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, and like the appearance of lamps: it went up and down among the living creatures; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

cards.note: Exodus 23:20 — *Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.* As that Angel brings Israel to the prepared place, Jaoel is sent to bring Abraham to the land prepared for him in Apocalypse of Abraham 10:11.
cards.s_text: I have been sent to bless thee now, and the land which the Eternal One, whom thou hast invoked, hath prepared for thee, and for thy sake have I wended my way upon the earth.
cards.t_text: Behold, I send an Angel before you, to keep you in the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

cards.note: Exodus 23:21 — *Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.* Jaoel is a power by virtue of the ineffable Name dwelling in him (Apocalypse of Abraham 10:6) — the Name-bearing Angel of Exodus.
cards.s_text: I am called Jaoel by Him who moveth that which existeth with me on the seventh expanse upon the firmament, a power in virtue of the ineffable Name that is dwelling in me.
cards.t_text: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.

cards.note: Isaiah 41:8 — *But thou, Yashar'el (Israel), art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.* The Creator who loveth Abraham (Apocalypse of Abraham 10:4) carries that love into the chosen seed of Israel.
cards.s_text: For, lo, I have been sent to thee to strengthen thee and bless thee in the name of Elohim (God) who loveth thee — the Creator of the celestial and terrestrial.
cards.t_text: But you, Yashar'el (Israel), are my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.

cards.note: 2 Chronicles 20:7 — *Art not thou our Elohim (God), who didst drive out the inhabitants of this land before thy people Yashar'el (Israel), and gavest it to the seed of Abraham thy friend for ever?* Jehoshaphat pleads the same friendship the angel speaks over Abraham in Apocalypse of Abraham 10:3.
cards.s_text: And the angel came, whom He had sent to me, in the likeness of a man, and grasped me by my right hand, and set me up upon my feet, and said to me: "Stand up, Abraham, Friend of Elohim (God) who loveth thee; let not the trembling of man seize thee!
cards.t_text: Are not you our Elohim (God), who did drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Yashar'el (Israel), and gave it to the seed of Abraham your friend for ever?

cards.note: James 2:23 — *And the scripture was fulfilled which saith, Abraham believed Elohim (God), and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of Elohim (God).* The angel hails Abraham by the very name Scripture gives him in Apocalypse of Abraham 10:3.
cards.s_text: And the angel came, whom He had sent to me, in the likeness of a man, and grasped me by my right hand, and set me up upon my feet, and said to me: "Stand up, Abraham, Friend of Elohim (God) who loveth thee; let not the trembling of man seize thee!
cards.t_text: And the scripture was fulfilled which says, Abraham believed Elohim (God), and it was imputed unto him for righteousness: and he was called the Friend of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Joshua 5:14 — *And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of Yahuah (LORD) am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What saith my lord unto his servant?* The captain of Yahuah's host who is worshipped by Joshua is the same Name-bearing angel Abraham follows with "Here am I, thy servant."
cards.s_text: And I said: "Here am I, thy servant."
cards.t_text: And he said, Nay; but as captain of the host of Yahuah (LORD) am I now come. And Joshua fell on his face to the earth, and did worship, and said unto him, What says my lord unto his servant?

cards.note: Acts 7:2 — *And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The Elohim (God) of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran,* The same God of glory who called Abraham out of Mesopotamia now sends His Name-bearing angel to say "Come with me"
cards.s_text: Come with me and I will go with thee, until the sacrifice, visible; but after the sacrifice, invisible for ever.

cards.note: Genesis 15:17 — *And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.* The Presence "visible" at the sacrifice is the smoking furnace and burning lamp that passed between the pieces of Abraham's covenant.
cards.s_text: Come with me and I will go with thee, until the sacrifice, visible; but after the sacrifice, invisible for ever.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass, that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold a smoking furnace, and a burning lamp that passed between those pieces.

cards.note: Genesis 15:9 — *And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.* The "sacrifice" Yahoel leads Abraham toward is this very covenant offering of the heifer, goat, ram, turtledove and pigeon.
cards.s_text: Come with me and I will go with thee, until the sacrifice, visible; but after the sacrifice, invisible for ever.
cards.t_text: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

cards.note: Revelation 10:1 — *And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:* John's mighty angel wears the rainbow on his head exactly as Abraham's angel wears the turban like the rainbow.
cards.s_text: And I rose up and saw him who had grasped me by my right hand and set me up upon my feet; and the appearance of his body was like sapphire, and the look of his countenance like chrysolite, and the hair of his head like snow, and the turban upon his head like the appearance of the rainbow, and the clothing of his garments like purple; and a golden sceptre was in his right hand.
cards.t_text: And I saw another mighty angel come down from heaven, clothed with a cloud: and a rainbow was upon his head, and his face was as it were the sun, and his feet as pillars of fire:

cards.note: Revelation 4:3 — *And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.* The rainbow-turban on Yahoel's head is the rainbow round about the throne John saw — the same covenant-token crowning the glory.
cards.s_text: And I rose up and saw him who had grasped me by my right hand and set me up upon my feet; and the appearance of his body was like sapphire, and the look of his countenance like chrysolite, and the hair of his head like snow, and the turban upon his head like the appearance of the rainbow, and the clothing of his garments like purple; and a golden sceptre was in his right hand.
cards.t_text: And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald.

cards.note: Ezekiel 1:26 — *And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.* The sapphire body of Abraham's angel is the sapphire-stone throne and the man-likeness upon it that Ezekiel beheld.
cards.s_text: And I rose up and saw him who had grasped me by my right hand and set me up upon my feet; and the appearance of his body was like sapphire, and the look of his countenance like chrysolite, and the hair of his head like snow, and the turban upon his head like the appearance of the rainbow, and the clothing of his garments like purple; and a golden sceptre was in his right hand.
cards.t_text: And above the firmament that was over their heads was the likeness of a throne, as the appearance of a sapphire stone: and upon the likeness of the throne was the likeness as the appearance of a man above upon it.

cards.note: Ezekiel 1:28 — *As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of Yahuah (LORD). And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.* Ezekiel falls before the rainbow-glory and hears a voice — Abraham answers that voice, "Here am I, thy servant."
cards.s_text: And I said: "Here am I, thy servant."
cards.t_text: As the appearance of the bow that is in the cloud in the day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness round about. This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of Yahuah (LORD). And when I saw it, I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of one that spake.

cards.note: Daniel 10:10 — *And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.* The angelic hand that raises the fallen prophet is the same hand that grasped Abraham by the right hand and set him upon his feet (11:1).
cards.s_text: And he said: "Let not my look affright thee, nor my speech, that thy soul be not perturbed.
cards.t_text: And, behold, an hand touched me, which set me upon my knees and upon the palms of my hands.

cards.note: Daniel 10:12 — *Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that thou didst set thine heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before thy Elohim (God), thy words were heard, and I am come for thy words.* The "Fear not" to the trembling seer is the very word the angel speaks over Abraham's perturbed soul.
cards.s_text: And he said: "Let not my look affright thee, nor my speech, that thy soul be not perturbed.
cards.t_text: Then said he unto me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that you did set your heart to understand, and to chasten thyself before your Elohim (God), your words were heard, and I am come for your words.

cards.note: Daniel 8:17 — *So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of Adam: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.* As Gabriel calms Daniel's fright before the vision, so Yahoel tells Abraham not to let his look affright him.
cards.s_text: And he said: "Let not my look affright thee, nor my speech, that thy soul be not perturbed.
cards.t_text: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of Adam: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.

cards.note: Revelation 1:14 — *His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;* The snow-white hair of Abraham's guide is the snow-white hair John sees — one continuous vision of the same glorious Lord.
cards.s_text: And I rose up and saw him who had grasped me by my right hand and set me up upon my feet; and the appearance of his body was like sapphire, and the look of his countenance like chrysolite, and the hair of his head like snow, and the turban upon his head like the appearance of the rainbow, and the clothing of his garments like purple; and a golden sceptre was in his right hand.
cards.t_text: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;

cards.note: Daniel 10:6 — *His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.* Daniel by the Hiddekel beholds the same gem-bodied, fire-eyed glory Abraham beholds in his angelic guide.
cards.s_text: And I rose up and saw him who had grasped me by my right hand and set me up upon my feet; and the appearance of his body was like sapphire, and the look of his countenance like chrysolite, and the hair of his head like snow, and the turban upon his head like the appearance of the rainbow, and the clothing of his garments like purple; and a golden sceptre was in his right hand.
cards.t_text: His body also was like the beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his feet like in colour to polished brass, and the voice of his words like the voice of a multitude.

cards.note: Exodus 23:21 — *Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.* Yahoel, the angel of Apocalypse of Abraham 11:1, is precisely the One in whom the Name dwells — the Name-bearer the Torah commanded Israel to obey.
cards.s_text: And I rose up and saw him who had grasped me by my right hand and set me up upon my feet; and the appearance of his body was like sapphire, and the look of his countenance like chrysolite, and the hair of his head like snow, and the turban upon his head like the appearance of the rainbow, and the clothing of his garments like purple; and a golden sceptre was in his right hand.
cards.t_text: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.

cards.note: Exodus 23:20 — *Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.* The angel who grasps Abraham's right hand and leads him is this same sent Angel who goes before to bring the elect into the prepared place.
cards.s_text: And I rose up and saw him who had grasped me by my right hand and set me up upon my feet; and the appearance of his body was like sapphire, and the look of his countenance like chrysolite, and the hair of his head like snow, and the turban upon his head like the appearance of the rainbow, and the clothing of his garments like purple; and a golden sceptre was in his right hand.
cards.t_text: Behold, I send an Angel before you, to keep you in the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

cards.note: Genesis 1:1 — *In the beginning Elohim (God) created the heaven and the earth.* The fulness of the whole world Abraham is promised to gaze upon — heaven, earth, sea, abyss, and the Garden — is the entire creation Moses opens with in the beginning.
cards.s_text: And he said to me: "All these slaughter, and divide the animals into halves, one against the other, but the birds do not sever; and give to the men, whom I will shew thee, standing by thee, for these are the altar upon the Mountain, to offer a sacrifice to the Eternal; but the turtledove and the pigeon give to me, for I will ascend upon the wings of the bird, in order to shew thee in heaven, and on the earth, and in the sea, and in the abyss, and in the under-world, and in the Garden of Eden, and in its rivers and in the fulness of the whole world and its circle — thou shalt gaze in them all."
cards.t_text: In the beginning Elohim (God) created the heaven and the earth.

cards.note: Ezekiel 1:4 — *And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.* The heaven into which Abraham is to ascend is the merkabah-fire Ezekiel saw, the throne-chariot of the living Elohim.
cards.s_text: And he said to me: "All these slaughter, and divide the animals into halves, one against the other, but the birds do not sever; and give to the men, whom I will shew thee, standing by thee, for these are the altar upon the Mountain, to offer a sacrifice to the Eternal; but the turtledove and the pigeon give to me, for I will ascend upon the wings of the bird, in order to shew thee in heaven, and on the earth, and in the sea, and in the abyss, and in the under-world, and in the Garden of Eden, and in its rivers and in the fulness of the whole world and its circle — thou shalt gaze in them all."
cards.t_text: And I looked, and, behold, a whirlwind came out of the north, a great cloud, and a fire infolding itself, and a brightness was about it, and out of the midst thereof as the colour of amber, out of the midst of the fire.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 14:8 — *And the vision was shown to me thus: Behold, in the vision clouds invited me and a mist summoned me, and the course of the stars and the lightnings sped and hastened me, and the winds in the vision caused me to fly and lifted me upward, and bore me into heaven.* As Enoch was lifted by the winds and borne into heaven, so the angel bears Abraham up on the wings of the bird to be shown heaven and earth.
cards.s_text: And he said to me: "All these slaughter, and divide the animals into halves, one against the other, but the birds do not sever; and give to the men, whom I will shew thee, standing by thee, for these are the altar upon the Mountain, to offer a sacrifice to the Eternal; but the turtledove and the pigeon give to me, for I will ascend upon the wings of the bird, in order to shew thee in heaven, and on the earth, and in the sea, and in the abyss, and in the under-world, and in the Garden of Eden, and in its rivers and in the fulness of the whole world and its circle — thou shalt gaze in them all."
cards.t_text: And the vision was shown to me thus: Behold, in the vision clouds invited me and a mist summoned me, and the course of the stars and the lightnings sped and hastened me, and the winds in the vision caused me to fly and lifted me upward, and bore me into heaven.

cards.note: Exodus 23:21 — *Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.* Yahoel, whom Abraham obeys in every word and calls Singer of the Eternal One, is the messenger in whom the Name dwells — his name itself bearing YAH.
cards.s_text: And I said to the angel: "Singer of the Eternal One!
cards.t_text: Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.

cards.note: Exodus 23:20 — *Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.* The angel who leads Abraham up the mountain to the place prepared for the vision is the same sent Angel who goes before to keep the way.
cards.s_text: And we went, the two of us together, forty days and nights, and I ate no bread, and drank no water, because my food was to see the angel who was with me, and his speech — that was my drink.
cards.t_text: Behold, I send an Angel before you, to keep you in the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

cards.note: Romans 4:18 — *Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.* The sacrifice Abraham prepares seals the promise of the seed as the stars, the faith Paul holds up as the father's righteousness.
cards.s_text: And he said to me: "All these slaughter, and divide the animals into halves, one against the other, but the birds do not sever; and give to the men, whom I will shew thee, standing by thee, for these are the altar upon the Mountain, to offer a sacrifice to the Eternal; but the turtledove and the pigeon give to me, for I will ascend upon the wings of the bird, in order to shew thee in heaven, and on the earth, and in the sea, and in the abyss, and in the under-world, and in the Garden of Eden, and in its rivers and in the fulness of the whole world and its circle — thou shalt gaze in them all."
cards.t_text: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations; according to that which was spoken, So shall your seed be.

cards.note: Genesis 15:10 — *And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.* The command to halve the beasts one against the other yet leave the birds unsevered is the very rite of Genesis 15 reenacted on Horeb.
cards.s_text: And he said to me: "All these slaughter, and divide the animals into halves, one against the other, but the birds do not sever; and give to the men, whom I will shew thee, standing by thee, for these are the altar upon the Mountain, to offer a sacrifice to the Eternal; but the turtledove and the pigeon give to me, for I will ascend upon the wings of the bird, in order to shew thee in heaven, and on the earth, and in the sea, and in the abyss, and in the under-world, and in the Garden of Eden, and in its rivers and in the fulness of the whole world and its circle — thou shalt gaze in them all."
cards.t_text: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.

cards.note: Genesis 15:9 — *And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.* The five animals the angel shows Abraham are precisely the five Yahuah named for the covenant cutting between the pieces.
cards.s_text: And I looked round, and lo, there were following us all the prescribed sacrificial animals — the young heifer, and the she-goat, and the ram, and the turtle-dove, and the pigeon.
cards.t_text: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

cards.note: Exodus 3:4 — *And when Yahuah (LORD) saw that he turned aside to see, Elohim (God) called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.* Abraham's reply 'Here am I' to the angel's call is the ready answer of the servant, echoing Moses at the bush on this same mountain.
cards.s_text: I said: "Here am I."
cards.t_text: And when Yahuah (LORD) saw that he turned aside to see, Elohim (God) called unto him out of the midst of the bush, and said, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.

cards.note: Exodus 3:1 — *Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of Elohim (God), even to Horeb.* Abraham is brought to the very Horeb, the Mount of Elohim, where Moses will later stand before the fire of the bush.
cards.s_text: And we came to the Mount of Elohim (God), the glorious Horeb.
cards.t_text: Now Moses kept the flock of Jethro his father in law, the priest of Midian: and he led the flock to the backside of the desert, and came to the mountain of Elohim (God), even to Horeb.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 19:3 — *And I, Enoch, alone saw the vision, the ends of all things: and no man shall see as I have seen.* As Enoch alone saw the vision of the ends of all things, so Abraham is fed only by the angel's speech, sustained by the sight he is about to be given.
cards.s_text: And we went, the two of us together, forty days and nights, and I ate no bread, and drank no water, because my food was to see the angel who was with me, and his speech — that was my drink.
cards.t_text: And I, Enoch, alone saw the vision, the ends of all things: and no man shall see as I have seen.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 9:9 — *When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which Yahuah (LORD) made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:* the identical phrasing of Abraham's abstinence marks his ascent as a covenant-mountain ordeal like Moses' own.
cards.s_text: And we went, the two of us together, forty days and nights, and I ate no bread, and drank no water, because my food was to see the angel who was with me, and his speech — that was my drink.
cards.t_text: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which Yahuah (LORD) made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:

cards.note: Exodus 34:28 — *And he was there with Yahuah (LORD) forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.* Abraham's forty-day fast without bread or water on Horeb is the same mountain-fast Moses kept before the covenant was written.
cards.s_text: And we went, the two of us together, forty days and nights, and I ate no bread, and drank no water, because my food was to see the angel who was with me, and his speech — that was my drink.
cards.t_text: And he was there with Yahuah (LORD) forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

cards.note: Zechariah 3:3 — *Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.* The mortality transferred to Azazel in Apocalypse of Abraham 13:15 answers to the filthy garments stripped from the righteous who stands before the angel.
cards.s_text: For, behold, the vesture which in heaven was formerly thine hath been set aside for him, and the mortality which was his hath been transferred to thee."
cards.t_text: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and stood before the angel.

cards.note: Zechariah 3:4 — *And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused thine iniquity to pass from thee, and I will clothe thee with change of raiment.* The heavenly vesture set aside for Abraham in Apocalypse of Abraham 13:15 is the change of raiment the LORD puts upon the chosen one before the angel.
cards.s_text: For, behold, the vesture which in heaven was formerly thine hath been set aside for him, and the mortality which was his hath been transferred to thee."
cards.t_text: And he answered and spake unto those that stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy garments from him. And unto him he said, Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with change of raiment.

cards.note: Luke 10:19 — *Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.* The righteous kept out of the unclean one's hand in Apocalypse of Abraham 13:10 are given power over all the power of the enemy.
cards.s_text: Because thou hast chosen and loved this for the dwelling-place of thine uncleanness, therefore the eternal mighty Yahuah (Lord) made thee a dweller upon the earth, and through thee every evil spirit of lies, and through thee wrath and trials for the generations of ungodly men; for Elohim (God), the Eternal, Mighty One, hath not permitted that the bodies of the righteous should be in thy hand, in order that thereby the life of the righteous and the destruction of the unclean may be assured.
cards.t_text: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

cards.note: James 4:7 — *Submit yourselves therefore to Elohim (God). Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.* That the tempter has no leave to play upon the righteous (Apocalypse of Abraham 13:12) is the devil who flees when resisted.
cards.s_text: For it hath not been given to thee to play the tempter in regard to all the righteous.
cards.t_text: Submit yourselves therefore to Elohim (God). Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

cards.note: Zechariah 3:2 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Satan, Yahuah (LORD) rebuke thee, O Satan; even Yahuah (LORD) that hath chosen Jerusalem rebuke thee: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?* The angel's "Depart from this man!" in Apocalypse of Abraham 13:13 is the LORD's rebuke of the accuser who resists the chosen.
cards.s_text: Depart from this man!
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Satan, Yahuah (LORD) rebuke you, O Satan; even Yahuah (LORD) that has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you: is not this a brand plucked out of the fire?

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The adversary made a dweller upon the earth in Apocalypse of Abraham 13:10 is the dragon cast down to the earth with his angels.
cards.s_text: Because thou hast chosen and loved this for the dwelling-place of thine uncleanness, therefore the eternal mighty Yahuah (Lord) made thee a dweller upon the earth, and through thee every evil spirit of lies, and through thee wrath and trials for the generations of ungodly men; for Elohim (God), the Eternal, Mighty One, hath not permitted that the bodies of the righteous should be in thy hand, in order that thereby the life of the righteous and the destruction of the unclean may be assured.
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* That Azazel's lot is on the earth and not in heaven (Apocalypse of Abraham 13:9) is the angels who left their first habitation, reserved unto judgment.
cards.s_text: For Abraham's lot is in heaven, but thine upon the earth.
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 10:4 — *And again Yahuah (God) said to Raphael: 'Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.* Azazel made a dweller upon the earth in Apocalypse of Abraham 13:10 is the same Watcher bound and cast into the desert-darkness.
cards.s_text: Because thou hast chosen and loved this for the dwelling-place of thine uncleanness, therefore the eternal mighty Yahuah (Lord) made thee a dweller upon the earth, and through thee every evil spirit of lies, and through thee wrath and trials for the generations of ungodly men; for Elohim (God), the Eternal, Mighty One, hath not permitted that the bodies of the righteous should be in thy hand, in order that thereby the life of the righteous and the destruction of the unclean may be assured.
cards.t_text: And again Yahuah (Lord) said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 10:8 — *And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.* The ungodliness named in Apocalypse of Abraham 13:7 is the same Watcher to whom the earth's corruption and all sin are ascribed.
cards.s_text: And he said: "This is ungodliness, this is Azazel."
cards.t_text: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’

cards.note: Leviticus 16:10 — *But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before Yahuah (LORD), to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.* The disgrace pronounced on Azazel in Apocalypse of Abraham 13:8 is the sending-away of the uncleanness-bearing goat into the wilderness.
cards.s_text: And he said to it: "Disgrace upon thee, Azazel!
cards.t_text: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before Yahuah (LORD), to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.

cards.note: Leviticus 16:8 — *And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for Yahuah (LORD), and the other lot for the scapegoat.* The naming of Azazel in Apocalypse of Abraham 13:7 reaches straight back to the lot of the scapegoat cast on the day of atonement.
cards.s_text: And he said: "This is ungodliness, this is Azazel."
cards.t_text: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for Yahuah (LORD), and the other lot for the scapegoat.

cards.note: Genesis 15:11 — *And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.* The unclean bird Abraham drives off in Apocalypse of Abraham 13:3 is the same fowl that came down upon the covenant carcases and was driven away in Genesis.
cards.s_text: And there flew an unclean bird down upon the carcasses, and I drove it away.
cards.t_text: And when the fowls came down upon the carcases, Abram drove them away.

cards.note: Genesis 15:10 — *And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.* That the angel takes the birds whole in Apocalypse of Abraham 13:1 keeps faith with Abram dividing the beasts but not the birds.
cards.s_text: And I did everything according to the commandment of the angel, and gave the angels, who had come to us, the divided animals, but the angel took the birds.
cards.t_text: And he took unto him all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid each piece one against another: but the birds divided he not.

cards.note: Genesis 15:9 — *And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.* The divided animals and the birds of Apocalypse of Abraham 13:1 are the very covenant offering Yahuah commanded Abram to take.
cards.s_text: And I did everything according to the commandment of the angel, and gave the angels, who had come to us, the divided animals, but the angel took the birds.
cards.t_text: And he said unto him, Take me an heifer of three years old, and a she goat of three years old, and a ram of three years old, and a turtledove, and a young pigeon.

cards.note: Zechariah 3:1 — *And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of Yahuah (LORD), and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.* The accuser stands to resist before the angel of Yahuah, exactly as Azazel stands before Abraham and the angel — and in both the adversary is rebuked, not answered (14:10).
cards.s_text: I did what was commanded me by the angel; and however much he spake to me, I answered him nothing whatsoever.
cards.t_text: And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of Yahuah (LORD), and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.

cards.note: Exodus 23:20 — *Behold, I send an Angel before thee, to keep thee in the way, and to bring thee into the place which I have prepared.* The sent angel who keeps and leads is the same office as the guide who commands and teaches Abraham every word in 14:5,10.
cards.s_text: On this account, by thy perdition disappear from me.'" And I uttered the words which the angel had taught me.
cards.t_text: Behold, I send an Angel before you, to keep you in the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

cards.note: Exodus 23:21 — *Beware of him, and obey his voice, provoke him not; for he will not pardon your transgressions: for my name is in him.* The angel who teaches Abraham the word of rebuke (14:5) is the Name-bearing angel — Yahoel — in whom the very Name dwells.
