cards.note: Daniel 7:10 — *...the judgment was set, and the books were opened.* The places prepared to eternity for every soul that Enoch writes in 2 Enoch 23:2 are recorded in the same heavenly books Daniel saw opened at the judgment.
cards.s_text: And Pravuil told me: All the things that I have told you, we have written. Sit and write all the souls of mankind, however many of them are born, and the places prepared for them to eternity; for all souls are prepared to eternity, before the formation of the world.
cards.t_text: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

cards.note: Exodus 24:4 — *And Moses wrote all the words of Yahuah (LORD), and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).* Enoch writing out all things exactly in 2 Enoch 23:3 stands in the line of Moses, who wrote all the words of Yahuah.
cards.s_text: And all double thirty days and thirty nights, and I wrote out all things exactly, and wrote three hundred and sixty-six books.
cards.t_text: And Moses wrote all the words of Yahuah (LORD), and rose up early in the morning, and builded an altar under the hill, and twelve pillars, according to the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: Malachi 3:16 — *...and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.* Enoch writing all the souls and the places prepared for them in 2 Enoch 23:2 is the book of remembrance Malachi says is written before Him.
cards.s_text: And Pravuil told me: All the things that I have told you, we have written. Sit and write all the souls of mankind, however many of them are born, and the places prepared for them to eternity; for all souls are prepared to eternity, before the formation of the world.
cards.t_text: Then they that feared Yahuah (LORD) spake often one to another: and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.

cards.note: Colossians 1:16 — *For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible... all things were created by him, and for him.* The making of visible from invisible in 2 Enoch 24:4 is the creating of things visible and invisible Paul confesses.
cards.s_text: For before all things were visible, I alone used to go about in the invisible things, like the sun from east to west, and from west to east.
cards.t_text: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

cards.note: John 1:3 — *All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.* That He alone made all the visible things in 2 Enoch 24:2 is the witness of John, that all things were made by Him.
cards.s_text: And I bowed down to Yahuah (Lord), and Yahuah (Lord) spoke to me: Enoch, beloved, all that you see, all things that are standing finished I tell to you even before the very beginning, all that I created from non-being, and visible things from invisible.
cards.t_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

cards.note: Romans 4:17 — *...even Elohim (God), who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.* Creating all from non-being in 2 Enoch 24:2 is the God Paul names who calls the things that be not as though they were.
cards.s_text: And I bowed down to Yahuah (Lord), and Yahuah (Lord) spoke to me: Enoch, beloved, all that you see, all things that are standing finished I tell to you even before the very beginning, all that I created from non-being, and visible things from invisible.
cards.t_text: (As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even Elohim (God), who quickens the dead, and calls those things which be not as though they were.

cards.note: Hebrews 11:3 — *Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of Elohim (God), so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.* God creating the visible from the invisible in 2 Enoch 24:2 is the worlds framed by His word, the seen not made of things which appear.
cards.s_text: And I bowed down to Yahuah (Lord), and Yahuah (Lord) spoke to me: Enoch, beloved, all that you see, all things that are standing finished I tell to you even before the very beginning, all that I created from non-being, and visible things from invisible.
cards.t_text: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of Elohim (God), so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

cards.note: Hebrews 11:3 — *Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of Elohim (God), so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.* The great light and the age that came forth from the invisible in 2 Enoch 25:3 are the worlds framed by His word, the seen not made of things which appear.
cards.s_text: And he came undone, and a great light came out. And I was in the midst of the great light, and as there is born light from light, there came forth a great age, and showed all creation, which I had thought to create.
cards.t_text: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of Elohim (God), so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

cards.note: Psalms 33:9 — *For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.* The visible coming out of the invisible at the Lord's spoken command in 2 Enoch 25:2 is the spoken creation of the Psalm: He spake, and it was done.
cards.s_text: And I said to him: Become undone, Adoil, and let the visible come out of you.
cards.t_text: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

cards.note: Genesis 1:4 — *And Elohim (God) saw the light, that it was good: and Elohim (God) divided the light from the darkness.* Enoch's record that "I saw that it was good" in 2 Enoch 25:4 is the very verdict Moses sets down over the first light.
cards.s_text: And I saw that it was good.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) saw the light, that it was good: and Elohim (God) divided the light from the darkness.

cards.note: Genesis 1:3 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be light: and there was light.* The great light commanded to come out of the invisible in 2 Enoch 25:2-3 is the light Elohim called forth on the first day.
cards.s_text: And he came undone, and a great light came out. And I was in the midst of the great light, and as there is born light from light, there came forth a great age, and showed all creation, which I had thought to create.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let there be light: and there was light.

cards.note: Colossians 1:17 — *And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.* The lower foundation made firm to uphold the lower things in 2 Enoch 26:4 is the holding-together of all things by Him that Paul confesses.
cards.s_text: Go thence down below, and make yourself firm, and be a foundation for the lower things, and it happened and he went down and fixed himself, and became the foundation for the lower things, and below the darkness there is nothing else.
cards.t_text: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.

cards.note: Romans 4:17 — *...even Elohim (God), who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.* Archas called forth hard from the invisible in 2 Enoch 26:1 is the God Paul names who calls the things that be not as though they were.
cards.s_text: And I summoned the very lowest a second time, and said: Let Archas (8) come forth hard, and he came forth hard from the invisible.
cards.t_text: (As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even Elohim (God), who quickens the dead, and calls those things which be not as though they were.

cards.note: Genesis 1:2 — *And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of Elohim (God) moved upon the face of the waters.* The great, dark age that came forth bearing the lower creation in 2 Enoch 26:3 is the formless, dark deep at the beginning of Moses' account.
cards.s_text: And I said: Be opened, Archas, and let there be born from you, and he came undone, an age came forth, very great and very dark, bearing the creation of all lower things, and I saw that it was good and said to him:
cards.t_text: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of Elohim (God) moved upon the face of the waters.

cards.note: Genesis 1:5 — *And Elohim (God) called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.* The Lord's naming of day and night and "there was evening and there was morning the first day" is word for word the close of Genesis' first day.
cards.s_text: And I separated between light and between darkness, that is to say in the midst of the water hither and thither, and I said to the light, that it should be the day, and to the darkness, that it should be the night, and there was evening and there was morning the first day.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.

cards.note: Genesis 1:4 — *And Elohim (God) saw the light, that it was good: and Elohim (God) divided the light from the darkness.* The separating of light from darkness in 2 Enoch 27:2 is the dividing Moses records on the first day.
cards.s_text: And I separated between light and between darkness, that is to say in the midst of the water hither and thither, and I said to the light, that it should be the day, and to the darkness, that it should be the night, and there was evening and there was morning the first day.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) saw the light, that it was good: and Elohim (God) divided the light from the darkness.

cards.note: Psalms 33:6 — *By the word of Yahuah (LORD) were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.* The Lord's spreading out and making firm of the waters is the heavens made by His word, as the psalmist confesses.
cards.s_text: And I commanded that there should be taken from light and darkness, and I said: Be thick, and it became thus, and I spread it out with the light, and it became water, and I spread it out over the darkness, below the light, and then I made firm the waters, that is to say the bottomless, and I made foundation of light around the water, and created seven circles from inside, and imaged the water like crystal wet and dry, that is to say like glass, and the circumcession of the waters and the other elements, and I showed each one of them its road, and the seven stars each one of them in its heaven, that they go thus, and I saw that it was good.
cards.t_text: By the word of Yahuah (LORD) were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

cards.note: Genesis 1:2 — *And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of Elohim (God) moved upon the face of the waters.* The bottomless waters the Lord makes firm in 2 Enoch 27:1 are the deep over which the Spirit moved at the first.
cards.s_text: And I commanded that there should be taken from light and darkness, and I said: Be thick, and it became thus, and I spread it out with the light, and it became water, and I spread it out over the darkness, below the light, and then I made firm the waters, that is to say the bottomless, and I made foundation of light around the water, and created seven circles from inside, and imaged the water like crystal wet and dry, that is to say like glass, and the circumcession of the waters and the other elements, and I showed each one of them its road, and the seven stars each one of them in its heaven, that they go thus, and I saw that it was good.
cards.t_text: And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of Elohim (God) moved upon the face of the waters.

cards.note: Psalms 33:9 — *For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.* The sea holding to the bound it was given answers the psalmist's word that what He commands stands fast.
cards.s_text: And I said to the sea: Behold I give you your eternal limits, and you shalt not break loose from your component parts.
cards.t_text: For he spake, and it was done; he commanded, and it stood fast.

cards.note: Psalms 33:7 — *He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.* The eternal limit and yoke set upon the sea in 2 Enoch 28:3 is the gathering of the waters the psalmist sings.
cards.s_text: And I said to the sea: Behold I give you your eternal limits, and you shalt not break loose from your component parts.
cards.t_text: He gathers the waters of the sea together as an heap: he lays up the depth in storehouses.

cards.note: Genesis 1:10 — *And Elohim (God) called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and Elohim (God) saw that it was good.* The Lord's calling the dry "earth" and gathering the sea in one place is the naming Genesis records.
cards.s_text: Out of the waves I created rock hard and big, and from the rock I piled up the dry, and the dry I called earth, and the midst of the earth I called abyss, that is to say the bottomless, I collected the sea in one place and bound it together with a yoke.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters called he Seas: and Elohim (God) saw that it was good.

cards.note: Genesis 1:9 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.* The gathering of the lower water and the appearing of the dry in 2 Enoch 28:1-2 is the third day's command in Moses.
cards.s_text: Out of the waves I created rock hard and big, and from the rock I piled up the dry, and the dry I called earth, and the midst of the earth I called abyss, that is to say the bottomless, I collected the sea in one place and bound it together with a yoke.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let the waters under the heaven be gathered together unto one place, and let the dry land appear: and it was so.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 18:15 — *And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.* 1 Enoch's bound transgressor-host is the same rebellion in heaven 2 Enoch sees thrown down.
cards.s_text: And I threw him out from the height with his angels, and he was flying in the air continuously above the bottomless.
cards.t_text: And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.* The casting out "with his angels" matches John's vision of the dragon and his angels cast to the earth.
cards.s_text: And I threw him out from the height with his angels, and he was flying in the air continuously above the bottomless.
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: Luke 10:18 — *And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.* The Messiah's own testimony names the fall 2 Enoch 29:4 describes — the rebel cast from the height.
cards.s_text: And I threw him out from the height with his angels, and he was flying in the air continuously above the bottomless.
cards.t_text: And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.

cards.note: Isaiah 14:15 — *Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.* The throwing of the rebel out from the height answers the prophet's word that the proud one is brought down.
cards.s_text: And I threw him out from the height with his angels, and he was flying in the air continuously above the bottomless.
cards.t_text: Yet you shall be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.

cards.note: Isaiah 14:13 — *For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of Elohim (God): I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north.* The rebel's thought in 2 Enoch 29:3 to set his throne higher and be equal to the Lord's power is the boast Isaiah lays bare.
cards.s_text: And one from out the order of angels, having turned away with the order that was under him, conceived an impossible thought, to place his throne higher than the clouds above the earth, that he might become equal in rank to my power.
cards.t_text: For you have said in your heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of Elohim (God): I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:

cards.note: Jubilees 2:2 — *For on the first day He created the heavens which are above and the earth and the waters and all the spirits which serve before Him–the angels of the presence, and the angels of sanctification, and the angels of the spirit of fire...* Jubilees lists the very hosts 2 Enoch sees imaged from fire, all created on the first day.
cards.s_text: And from the rock I cut off a great fire, and from the fire I created the orders of the incorporeal ten troops of angels, and their weapons are fiery and their raiment a burning flame, and I commanded that each one should stand in his order.
cards.t_text: For on the first day He created the heavens which are above and the earth and the waters and all the spirits which serve before Him–the angels of the presence, and the angels of sanctification, and the angels of the spirit of fire and the angels of the spirit of the winds, and the angels of the spirit of the clouds, and of darkness, and of snow and of hail and of hoar frost, and the angels of the voices and of the thunder and of the lightning, and the angels of the spirits of cold and of heat, and of winter and of spring and of autumn and of summer, and of all the spirits of His creatures which are in the heavens and on the earth, (He created) the abysses and the darkness, eventide (and night), and the light, dawn and day, which He has prepared in the knowledge of His heart.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 69:16 — *And these are the secrets of this oath... And they are strong through his oath: And the heaven was suspended before the world was created, And for ever.* The hosts standing in their fiery order rest on the same created foundation 1 Enoch confesses, suspended by Him before the world was.
cards.s_text: And from the rock I cut off a great fire, and from the fire I created the orders of the incorporeal ten troops of angels, and their weapons are fiery and their raiment a burning flame, and I commanded that each one should stand in his order.
cards.t_text: And these are the secrets of this oath... And they are strong through his oath: And the heaven was suspended before the world was created, And for ever.

cards.note: John 1:3 — *All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.* The making of the angelic troops confirms that not any thing, in heaven or earth, was made apart from the Word.
cards.s_text: And from the rock I cut off a great fire, and from the fire I created the orders of the incorporeal ten troops of angels, and their weapons are fiery and their raiment a burning flame, and I commanded that each one should stand in his order.
cards.t_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

cards.note: Colossians 1:16 — *For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him.* The orders of angels imaged from fire in 2 Enoch 29:2 are among the invisible thrones and powers Paul says were all created by Him.
cards.s_text: And from the rock I cut off a great fire, and from the fire I created the orders of the incorporeal ten troops of angels, and their weapons are fiery and their raiment a burning flame, and I commanded that each one should stand in his order.
cards.t_text: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:

cards.note: Genesis 2:22 — *And the rib, which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.* The wife created from Adam's rib, called mother, is the woman Genesis makes from the rib.
cards.s_text: And I put sleep into him and he fell asleep. And I took from him a rib, and created him a wife, that death should come to him by his wife, and I took his last word and called her name mother, that is to say, Eva.
cards.t_text: And the rib, which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

cards.note: Genesis 2:21 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof.* The sleep put into Adam and the rib taken in 2 Enoch 30:16 is the deep sleep and the rib of Genesis.
cards.s_text: And I put sleep into him and he fell asleep. And I took from him a rib, and created him a wife, that death should come to him by his wife, and I took his last word and called her name mother, that is to say, Eva.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;

cards.note: Romans 5:12 — *Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned.* The Lord's word "After sin what is there but death?" is the very death Paul says entered by one man's sin.
cards.s_text: For I have seen his nature, but he has not seen his own nature, therefore through not seeing he will sin worse, and I said After sin what is there but death?
cards.t_text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

cards.note: Ecclesiastes 7:29 — *Lo, this only have I found, that Elohim (God) hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.* The two ways shown to Adam, with man made good and left to choose, is the upright man and his self-sought inventions the preacher names.
cards.s_text: And I appointed him a name, from the four component parts, from east, from west, from south, from north, and I appointed for him four special stars, and I called his name Adam, and showed him the two ways, the light and the darkness, and I told him:
cards.t_text: Lo, this only have I found, that Elohim (God) has made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.

cards.note: Psalms 8:6 — *Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet.* The dominion appointed to man in 2 Enoch 30:12 is the rule the psalmist sings, all things put under his feet.
cards.s_text: I conceived a cunning saying to say, I created man from invisible and from visible nature, of both are his death and life and image, he knows speech like some created thing, small in greatness and again great in smallness, and I placed him on earth, a second angel, honourable, great and glorious, and I appointed him as ruler to rule on earth and to have my wisdom, and there was none like him of earth of all my existing creatures.
cards.t_text: You made him to have dominion over the works of your hands; you have put all things under his feet:

cards.note: Psalms 8:5 — *For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.* Man named "a second angel, honourable, great and glorious" echoes the psalmist's man crowned with glory and honour, a little lower than the angels.
cards.s_text: I conceived a cunning saying to say, I created man from invisible and from visible nature, of both are his death and life and image, he knows speech like some created thing, small in greatness and again great in smallness, and I placed him on earth, a second angel, honourable, great and glorious, and I appointed him as ruler to rule on earth and to have my wisdom, and there was none like him of earth of all my existing creatures.
cards.t_text: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and have crowned him with glory and honour.

cards.note: Genesis 1:26 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth.* The Lord appointing man "as ruler to rule on earth" in 2 Enoch 30:12 is the image-bearing dominion Genesis grants.
cards.s_text: I conceived a cunning saying to say, I created man from invisible and from visible nature, of both are his death and life and image, he knows speech like some created thing, small in greatness and again great in smallness, and I placed him on earth, a second angel, honourable, great and glorious, and I appointed him as ruler to rule on earth and to have my wisdom, and there was none like him of earth of all my existing creatures.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth.

cards.note: Genesis 2:7 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.* Beneath 2 Enoch's seven components — flesh from the earth, soul from my breath — is the dust-formed, breath-quickened man Moses records.
cards.s_text: [Friday]. On the sixth day I commanded my wisdom to create man from seven consistencies: one, his flesh from the earth; two, his blood from the dew; three, his eyes from the sun; four, his bones from stone; five, his intelligence from the swiftness of the angels and from cloud; six, his veins and his hair from the grass of the earth; seven, his soul from my breath and from the wind.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

cards.note: Genesis 1:21 — *And Elohim (God) created great whales, and every living creature that moveth, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and Elohim (God) saw that it was good.* The living creatures and feathered birds, male and female, every soul breathing life, are the swarming kinds Genesis records.
cards.s_text: [Thursday]. On the fifth day I commanded the sea, that it should bring forth fishes, and feathered birds of many varieties, and all animals creeping over the earth, going forth over the earth on four legs, and soaring in the air, male sex and female, and every soul breathing the spirit of life.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) created great whales, and every living creature that moves, which the waters brought forth abundantly, after their kind, and every winged fowl after his kind: and Elohim (God) saw that it was good.

cards.note: Genesis 1:20 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that hath life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.* The sea bringing forth fishes and birds on the fifth day is the fifth day's command in Moses.
cards.s_text: [Thursday]. On the fifth day I commanded the sea, that it should bring forth fishes, and feathered birds of many varieties, and all animals creeping over the earth, going forth over the earth on four legs, and soaring in the air, male sex and female, and every soul breathing the spirit of life.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let the waters bring forth abundantly the moving creature that has life, and fowl that may fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven.

cards.note: Genesis 1:16 — *And Elohim (God) made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.* The sun for the day and the moon and stars for the night in 2 Enoch 30:5 are the two great lights and the stars of Genesis.
cards.s_text: And on the lower I placed the sun for the illumination of day, and the moon and stars for the illumination of night.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.

cards.note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years.* The great lights set on the fourth day in 2 Enoch 30:3-6, marking months and seasons, are the lights Moses appoints for signs and seasons.
cards.s_text: [Wednesday]. On the fourth day I commanded that there should be great lights on the heavenly circles.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world.* The fugitive Satanail of 2 Enoch 31:4 is the old serpent John names the Devil and Satan, the deceiver of the world.
cards.s_text: The devil is the evil spirit of the lower places, as a fugitive he made Sotona (9) from the heavens as his name was Satanail (10), thus he became different from the angels, but his nature did not change his intelligence as far as his understanding of righteous and sinful things.
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:3 — *But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).* Paul names the very beguiling of Eve that 2 Enoch 31:5 records — the serpent's subtilty against the woman.
cards.s_text: And he understood his condemnation and the sin which he had sinned before, therefore he conceived thought against Adam, in such form he entered and seduced Eva, but did not touch Adam.
cards.t_text: But I fear, lest by any means, as the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Messiah (Christ).

cards.note: Genesis 3:1 — *Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath Elohim (God) said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?* The devil who entered and seduced Eve in 2 Enoch 31:5 is the subtil serpent who first spoke to the woman in Eden.
cards.s_text: And he understood his condemnation and the sin which he had sinned before, therefore he conceived thought against Adam, in such form he entered and seduced Eva, but did not touch Adam.
cards.t_text: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, has Elohim (God) said, You shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

cards.note: Genesis 2:17 — *But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.* The testament and command Adam must keep is the one forbidden tree and its warning of death in Moses.
cards.s_text: Adam has life on earth, and I created a garden in Eden in the east, that he should observe the testament and keep the command.
cards.t_text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you shall not eat of it: for in the day that you eat thereof you shall surely die.

cards.note: Genesis 2:16 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat.* The command Adam is set to keep is the charge Yahuah Elohim gave the man in the garden.
cards.s_text: Adam has life on earth, and I created a garden in Eden in the east, that he should observe the testament and keep the command.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden you may freely eat:

cards.note: Genesis 2:8 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.* The garden created in Eden in the east in 2 Enoch 31:1 is the garden eastward in Eden Moses records.
cards.s_text: Adam has life on earth, and I created a garden in Eden in the east, that he should observe the testament and keep the command.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.

cards.note: Jubilees 2:1 — *...how in six days Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) finished all His works and all that He created, and kept Sabbath on the seventh day and hallowed it for all ages, and appointed it as a sign for all His works.* Jubilees seals the same seventh-day Sabbath 2 Enoch blesses, hallowed for all ages as a sign.
cards.s_text: And I blessed the seventh day, which is the Sabbath, on which he rested from all his works.
cards.t_text: And the angel of the presence spake to Moses according to the word of Yahuah (God), saying: Write the complete history of the creation, how in six days Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) finished all His works and all that He created, and kept Sabbath on the seventh day and hallowed it for all ages, and appointed it as a sign for all His works.

cards.note: Hebrews 4:4 — *For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And Elohim (God) did rest the seventh day from all his works.* The Sabbath rest at the close of creation is the seventh-day rest Hebrews recalls and carries forward to the people of Elohim.
cards.s_text: And I blessed the seventh day, which is the Sabbath, on which he rested from all his works.
cards.t_text: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And Elohim (God) did rest the seventh day from all his works.

cards.note: Genesis 2:3 — *And Elohim (God) blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which Elohim (God) created and made.* The Lord blessing the seventh day, the Sabbath of rest, in 2 Enoch 32:4 is the seventh day Moses blessed and sanctified at creation.
cards.s_text: And I blessed the seventh day, which is the Sabbath, on which he rested from all his works.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) blessed the seventh day, and sanctified it: because that in it he had rested from all his work which Elohim (God) created and made.

cards.note: Psalms 90:3 — *Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.* The sending of man back whence he was taken echoes the psalmist's word that the Lord turns man to dust and bids him return.
cards.s_text: I said to him: Earth you are, and into the earth whence I took you you shalt go, and I will not ruin you, but send you whence I took you.
cards.t_text: You turn man to destruction; and say, Return, you children of men.

cards.note: Genesis 3:19 — *In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.* The Lord's word "Earth you are, and into the earth... you shalt go" is the dust-to-dust sentence Moses records over fallen Adam.
cards.s_text: I said to him: Earth you are, and into the earth whence I took you you shalt go, and I will not ruin you, but send you whence I took you.
cards.t_text: In the sweat of your face shall you eat bread, till you return unto the ground; for out of it were you taken: for dust you are, and unto dust shall you return.

cards.note: John 1:3 — *All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.* "My wisdom and my word are made" — all forces created by Him, none resisting — is the Word by whom all things were made.
cards.s_text: My thought is my counsellor, my wisdom and my word are made, and my eyes observe all things how they stand here and tremble with terror.
cards.t_text: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.

cards.note: Hebrews 11:3 — *Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of Elohim (God), so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.* The Lord's devising and creating all things "from the uppermost foundation to the lower" is the framing of the worlds by His word that Hebrews confesses.
cards.s_text: And now, Enoch, all that I have told you, all that you have understood, all that you have seen of heavenly things, all that you have seen on earth, and all that I have written in books by my great wisdom, all these things I have devised and created from the uppermost foundation to the lower and to the end, and there is no counsellor nor inheritor to my creations.
cards.t_text: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of Elohim (God), so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

cards.note: Isaiah 45:18 — *For thus saith Yahuah (LORD) that created the heavens; Elohim (God) himself that formed the earth and made it... I am Yahuah (LORD); and there is none else.* The self-eternal Creator of 2 Enoch 33 who alone made all things is Isaiah's Yahuah that created the heavens, beside whom there is none else.
cards.s_text: Give them the books of the handwriting, and they will read them and will know me for the creator of all things, and will understand how there is no other Elohim (God) but me.
cards.t_text: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) that created the heavens; Elohim (God) himself that formed the earth and made it; he has established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am Yahuah (LORD); and there is none else.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 4:39 — *Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that Yahuah (LORD) he is Elohim (God) in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.* The Lord's word that men shall know "there is no other Elohim but me" is the confession Moses set in Israel's heart.
cards.s_text: Give them the books of the handwriting, and they will read them and will know me for the creator of all things, and will understand how there is no other Elohim (God) but me.
cards.t_text: Know therefore this day, and consider it in your heart, that Yahuah (LORD) he is Elohim (God) in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.

cards.note: Revelation 21:1 — *And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.* The endless eighth age, with neither years nor months nor days, is John's new heaven and new earth when the first order has passed away.
cards.s_text: And I appointed the eighth day also, that the eighth day should be the first-created after my work, and that the first seven revolve in the form of the seventh thousand, and that at the beginning of the eighth thousand there should be a time of not-counting, endless, with neither years nor months nor weeks nor days nor hours.
cards.t_text: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.

cards.note: Hebrews 4:9 — *There remaineth therefore a rest to the people of Elohim (God).* The endless time of not-counting at the beginning of the eighth thousand is the sabbath-rest that still remains for the people of Elohim.
cards.s_text: And I appointed the eighth day also, that the eighth day should be the first-created after my work, and that the first seven revolve in the form of the seventh thousand, and that at the beginning of the eighth thousand there should be a time of not-counting, endless, with neither years nor months nor weeks nor days nor hours.
cards.t_text: There remains therefore a rest to the people of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Psalms 90:4 — *For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.* The thousand-year reckoning behind the eighth-day age is the psalmist's word that a thousand years are as a day in the Lord's sight.
cards.s_text: And I appointed the eighth day also, that the eighth day should be the first-created after my work, and that the first seven revolve in the form of the seventh thousand, and that at the beginning of the eighth thousand there should be a time of not-counting, endless, with neither years nor months nor weeks nor days nor hours.
cards.t_text: For a thousand years in your sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

cards.note: 2 Peter 3:8 — *But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with Yahuah (Lord) as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.* The "seventh thousand" and the eighth thousand of 2 Enoch 33:1 rest on the apostle's measure of a day as a thousand years before the Lord.
cards.s_text: And I appointed the eighth day also, that the eighth day should be the first-created after my work, and that the first seven revolve in the form of the seventh thousand, and that at the beginning of the eighth thousand there should be a time of not-counting, endless, with neither years nor months nor weeks nor days nor hours.
cards.t_text: But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with Yahuah (Lord) as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

cards.note: Jasher 4:17 — *And every man made to himself a god, and they robbed and plundered every man his neighbor as well as his relative, and they corrupted the earth, and the earth was filled with violence.* 2 Enoch 34:1's charge that they bowed to vain gods and denied His unity is Jasher's account of the generation that drew down the flood.
cards.s_text: They have rejected my commandments and my yoke, worthless seed has come up, not fearing Elohim (God), and they would not bow down to me, but have begun to bow down to vain gods, and denied my unity, and have laden the whole earth with untruths, offences, abominable lecheries, namely one with another, and all manner of other unclean wickedness, which are disgusting to relate.
cards.t_text: And every man made to himself a god, and they robbed and plundered every man his neighbor as well as his relative, and they corrupted the earth, and the earth was filled with violence.

cards.note: Jubilees 5:4 — *And He said: “I shall destroy man and all flesh upon the face of the earth which I have created.”* The sentence 2 Enoch 34:2 records, to bring the deluge and destroy all men, is the same word Jubilees preserves over the corrupt generation.
cards.s_text: And therefore I will bring down a deluge upon the earth and will destroy all men, and the whole earth will crumble together into great darkness.
cards.t_text: And He said: “I shall destroy man and all flesh upon the face of the earth which I have created.”

cards.note: Genesis 6:17 — *And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.* The deluge the Lord declares in 2 Enoch 34:2 to destroy all men is the very flood of waters Genesis sets down.
cards.s_text: And therefore I will bring down a deluge upon the earth and will destroy all men, and the whole earth will crumble together into great darkness.
cards.t_text: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life, from under heaven; and every thing that is in the earth shall die.

cards.note: Genesis 6:11 — *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* The earth laden with offences and unclean wickedness in 2 Enoch 34:1 is the corrupt, violence-filled earth of Genesis.
cards.s_text: They have rejected my commandments and my yoke, worthless seed has come up, not fearing Elohim (God), and they would not bow down to me, but have begun to bow down to vain gods, and denied my unity, and have laden the whole earth with untruths, offences, abominable lecheries, namely one with another, and all manner of other unclean wickedness, which are disgusting to relate.
cards.t_text: The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.

cards.note: Genesis 6:5 — *And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.* The wickedness 2 Enoch 34:1 says laded the whole earth is the wickedness Moses records before the flood.
cards.s_text: They have rejected my commandments and my yoke, worthless seed has come up, not fearing Elohim (God), and they would not bow down to me, but have begun to bow down to vain gods, and denied my unity, and have laden the whole earth with untruths, offences, abominable lecheries, namely one with another, and all manner of other unclean wickedness, which are disgusting to relate.
cards.t_text: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 81:6 — *One year we will leave thee with thy son, till thou givest thy (last) commands, that thou mayst teach thy children and record (it) for them, and testify to all thy children; and in the second year they shall take thee from their midst.* The year left to Enoch to teach his children and record it for them is the charge behind the books of Enoch's handwriting a later generation reads in 2 Enoch 35:2.
cards.s_text: He who raises that generation, shall reveal to them the books of your handwriting, of your fathers, to them to whom he must point out the guardianship of the world, to the faithful men and workers of my pleasure, who do not acknowledge my name in vain.
cards.t_text: One year we will leave thee with thy son, till thou givest thy (last) commands, that thou mayst teach thy children and record (it) for them, and testify to all thy children; and in the second year they shall take thee from their midst.

cards.note: Psalms 78:4 — *We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of Yahuah (LORD), and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.* The books of the fathers' handwriting revealed to the faithful in 2 Enoch 35:2 are the works not to be hidden but shown to the generation to come.
cards.s_text: He who raises that generation, shall reveal to them the books of your handwriting, of your fathers, to them to whom he must point out the guardianship of the world, to the faithful men and workers of my pleasure, who do not acknowledge my name in vain.
cards.t_text: We will not hide them from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of Yahuah (LORD), and his strength, and his wonderful works that he has done.

cards.note: Psalms 78:6 — *That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children.* The later generation of 2 Enoch 35:3 that reads and tells the next is the generation-to-come the psalm commits the testimony to.
cards.s_text: And they shall tell another generation, and those others having read shall be glorified thereafter, more than the first.
cards.t_text: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 6:2 — *That thou mightest fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all the days of thy life.* That his household always keep His commandments in 2 Enoch 36:2 is the keeping Moses commands across the generations of son and son's son.
cards.s_text: And that they may always keep my commandments, and begin to read and take in the books of your handwriting.
cards.t_text: That you might fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you, you, and your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 6:7 — *And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.* The thirty-day charge to gather the household and teach them in 2 Enoch 36:1 is Moses' command to teach the words diligently to one's children.
cards.s_text: Now, Enoch, I give you the term of thirty days to spend in your house, and tell your sons and all your household, that all may hear from my face what is told them by you, that they may read and understand, how there is no other Elohim (God) but me.
cards.t_text: And you shall teach them diligently unto your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you risest up.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 6:4 — *Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel): Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) is one Yahuah (LORD).* Enoch's charge in 2 Enoch 36:1 that his sons know there is no other Elohim but Him is the Shema's confession of the one Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Now, Enoch, I give you the term of thirty days to spend in your house, and tell your sons and all your household, that all may hear from my face what is told them by you, that they may read and understand, how there is no other Elohim (God) but me.
cards.t_text: Hear, O Yashar'el (Israel): Yahuah Eloheinu (The LORD our God) is one Yahuah (LORD):

cards.note: Exodus 33:20 — *And he said, Thou canst not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.* Enoch's inability to endure the terror of Yahuah in 2 Enoch 37:1 stands within the boundary the Lord set with Moses: no man sees His face and lives.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (Lord) called upon one of the older angels, terrible and menacing, and placed him by me, in appearance white as snow, and his hands like ice, having the appearance of great frost, and he froze my face, because I could not endure the terror of Yahuah (Lord), just as it is not possible to endure a stove’s fire and the sun’s heat, and the frost of the air.
cards.t_text: And he said, You can not see my face: for there shall no man see me, and live.

cards.note: Exodus 34:30 — *And when Aaron and all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.* That no man could behold Enoch's face in 2 Enoch 37:2 is Israel's fear before the shining face of Moses fresh from the mount.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (Lord) said to me: Enoch, if your face be not frozen here, no man will be able to behold your face.
cards.t_text: And when Aaron and all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) saw Moses, behold, the skin of his face shone; and they were afraid to come nigh him.

cards.note: Exodus 34:29 — *And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand... that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.* As Enoch's face had to be frozen lest no man behold it (2 Enoch 37:2), so Moses came down from the glory with a face transfigured.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (Lord) said to me: Enoch, if your face be not frozen here, no man will be able to behold your face.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass, when Moses came down from mount Sinai with the two tables of testimony in Moses’ hand, when he came down from the mount, that Moses wist not that the skin of his face shone while he talked with him.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 31:12 — *Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and observe to do all the words of this law.* That all his household come together to hear in 2 Enoch 38:3 is the assembling-to-hear the law commands.
cards.s_text: And Mathusal expecting my coming, keeping watch by day and by night at my bed, was filled with awe when he heard my coming, and I told him, Let all my household come together, that I tell them everything.
cards.t_text: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and your stranger that is within your gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and observe to do all the words of this law:

cards.note: Genesis 49:1 — *And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.* Enoch's call to gather his household and tell them everything in 2 Enoch 38:3 is Jacob's gathering of his sons before his end.
cards.s_text: And Mathusal expecting my coming, keeping watch by day and by night at my bed, was filled with awe when he heard my coming, and I told him, Let all my household come together, that I tell them everything.
cards.t_text: And Jacob called unto his sons, and said, Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 6:13 — *Thou shalt fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.* The terror of standing before the controller of quick and dead in 2 Enoch 39:8 is the fear of Yahuah the law lays on every soul.
cards.s_text: And now, my children, hear the discourses of the father of the earth, how fearful and awful it is to come before the face of the ruler of the earth, how much more terrible and awful it is to come before the face of the ruler of heaven, the controller of quick and dead, and of the heavenly troops. Who can endure that endless pain?
cards.t_text: You shall fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and serve him, and shall swear by his name.

cards.note: Isaiah 6:5 — *Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).* Enoch's dread of coming before the ruler of heaven (2 Enoch 39:8) is Isaiah's undoing before the King his eyes had seen.
cards.s_text: And now, my children, hear the discourses of the father of the earth, how fearful and awful it is to come before the face of the ruler of the earth, how much more terrible and awful it is to come before the face of the ruler of heaven, the controller of quick and dead, and of the heavenly troops. Who can endure that endless pain?
cards.t_text: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for my eyes have seen the King, Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 12:4 — *How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.* Enoch's beholding of Yahuah's right hand filling heaven (2 Enoch 39:5) is the same order of vision as Paul caught up into paradise to hear unspeakable things.
cards.s_text: You see now, my children, the right hand of a man that helps you, but I have seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) right hand filling heaven as he helped me.
cards.t_text: How that he was caught up into paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

cards.note: John 1:18 — *No man hath seen Elohim (God) at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.* Enoch's seeing of Yahuah's face in 2 Enoch 39:3 is held within the boundary John names — what is beheld is the glory afar, not the unseen Father uncovered.
cards.s_text: For Yahuah (Lord) has let me come to you, you hear therefore the words of my lips, of a man made big for you, but I am one who has seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, like iron made to glow from fire it sends forth sparks and burns.
cards.t_text: No man has seen Elohim (God) at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him.

cards.note: Job 42:5 — *I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.* Enoch contrasting hearing with having seen Yahuah's eyes (2 Enoch 39:4) is Job's passage from hearsay to sight of the Almighty.
cards.s_text: You look now upon my eyes, the eyes of a man big with meaning for you, but I have seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) eyes, shining like the sun’s rays and filling the eyes of man with awe.
cards.t_text: I have heard of you by the hearing of the ear: but now my eye sees you.

cards.note: Isaiah 6:1 — *In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also Yahuah (Lord) sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.* Enoch's testimony that he has seen Yahuah's face (2 Enoch 39:3) is Isaiah's own sight of the Lord enthroned, high and lifted up.
cards.s_text: For Yahuah (Lord) has let me come to you, you hear therefore the words of my lips, of a man made big for you, but I am one who has seen Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, like iron made to glow from fire it sends forth sparks and burns.
cards.t_text: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also Adonai (Lord) sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.

cards.note: Psalms 78:1 — *Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.* Enoch's appeal that his children hear the words of his lips because they come from Yahuah (2 Enoch 39:2-3) is the psalmist's call to incline the ear to the law set in his mouth.
cards.s_text: I have been let come to you to-day, and announce to you, not from my lips, but from Yahuah's (Lord’s) lips, all that is and was and all that is now, and all that will be till judgment-day.
cards.t_text: Give ear, O my people, to my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 18:18 — *I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.* Enoch announcing not from his own lips but from Yahuah's (2 Enoch 39:2) is the prophet whose mouth carries the words Yahuah puts in it.
cards.s_text: I have been let come to you to-day, and announce to you, not from my lips, but from Yahuah's (Lord’s) lips, all that is and was and all that is now, and all that will be till judgment-day.
cards.t_text: I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto you, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 81:2 — *And I observed the heavenly tablets, and read everything which was written (thereon) and understood everything, and read the book of all the deeds of mankind, and of all the children of flesh that shall be upon the earth to the remotest generations.* The works and sentences Enoch writes down in 2 Enoch 40:11 are the works of men he read on the heavenly tablets in his own book.
cards.s_text: And I wrote down all those being judged by the judge, and all their judgment and sentences and all their works.
cards.t_text: And I observed the heavenly tablets, and read everything which was written (thereon) and understood everything, and read the book of all the deeds of mankind, and of all the children of flesh that shall be upon the earth to the remotest generations.

cards.note: Ecclesiastes 12:14 — *For Elohim (God) shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.* Enoch writing down all who are judged with their works and sentences (2 Enoch 40:11) is the bringing of every work into judgment Solomon declares.
cards.s_text: And I wrote down all those being judged by the judge, and all their judgment and sentences and all their works.
cards.t_text: For Elohim (God) shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.

cards.note: 2 Peter 2:4 — *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment.* The prisoners in pain expecting the limitless judgment in 2 Enoch 40:10 are the bound reserved unto judgment Peter describes.
cards.s_text: And I saw how the prisoners are in pain, expecting the limitless judgment.
cards.t_text: For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

cards.note: Psalms 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* Enoch counting the sun's circle and hours in 2 Enoch 40:5 records the appointed courses the psalm gives the sun and moon.
cards.s_text: And I measured the sun’s circle, and measured its rays, counted the hours, I wrote down too all things that go over the earth, I have written the things that are nourished, and all seed sown and unsown, which the earth produces and all plants, and every grass and every flower, and their sweet smells, and their names, and the dwelling-places of the clouds, and their composition, and their wings, and how they bear rain and raindrops.
cards.t_text: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knows his going down.

cards.note: Proverbs 8:27 — *When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth.* Enoch's measuring of the stars and the sun's circle in 2 Enoch 40:3,5 traces the ordered heavens Wisdom watched Yahuah set with the compass.
cards.s_text: I have measured and described the stars, the great countless multitude of them.
cards.t_text: When he prepared the heavens, I was there: when he set a compass upon the face of the depth:

cards.note: Job 38:4 — *Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.* The earth's measures and mountains Enoch writes in 2 Enoch 40:9 are the foundations Yahuah laid before any man could declare them.
cards.s_text: And I measured out the whole earth, its mountains, and all hills, fields, trees, stones, rivers, all existing things I wrote down, the height from earth to the seventh heaven, and downwards to the very lowest hell, and the judgment-place, and the very great, open and weeping hell.
cards.t_text: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if you have understanding.

cards.note: Job 38:5 — *Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?* Enoch measuring out the whole earth and its bounds in 2 Enoch 40:9 records the measures Yahuah asks Job who laid.
cards.s_text: And I measured out the whole earth, its mountains, and all hills, fields, trees, stones, rivers, all existing things I wrote down, the height from earth to the seventh heaven, and downwards to the very lowest hell, and the judgment-place, and the very great, open and weeping hell.
cards.t_text: Who has laid the measures thereof, if you know? or who has stretched the line upon it?

cards.note: Ecclesiastes 7:20 — *For there is not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.* Enoch's longing for the man who shall not sin (2 Enoch 41:3) is set against the preacher's truth that no man on earth is wholly without sin.
cards.s_text: Blessed is the man who has not been born or who has been born and shall not sin before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, that he come not into this place, nor bring the yoke of this place.
cards.t_text: For there is not a just man upon earth, that does good, and sins not.

cards.note: Psalms 1:1 — *Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.* Enoch's blessing on the man who shall not sin before Yahuah's face (2 Enoch 41:3) is the Psalter's opening beatitude on the man who keeps from the way of sinners.
cards.s_text: Blessed is the man who has not been born or who has been born and shall not sin before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, that he come not into this place, nor bring the yoke of this place.
cards.t_text: Blessed is the man that walks not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor stands in the way of sinners, nor sits in the seat of the scornful.

cards.note: Romans 5:12 — *Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned.* Enoch's grief over the forefathers' ruin in 2 Enoch 41:1-2 is the death that passed on all men from the one man's transgression.
cards.s_text: And I saw all forefathers from all time with Adam and Eva, and I sighed and broke into tears and said of the ruin of their dishonour:
cards.t_text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

cards.note: Genesis 3:19 — *In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.* The ruin and dishonour of Adam Enoch weeps over in 2 Enoch 41:1 is the curse of dust and death pronounced in Eden.
cards.s_text: And I saw all forefathers from all time with Adam and Eva, and I sighed and broke into tears and said of the ruin of their dishonour:
cards.t_text: In the sweat of your face shall you eat bread, till you return unto the ground; for out of it were you taken: for dust you are, and unto dust shall you return.

cards.note: Matthew 7:20 — *Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.* That those who lie evilly are known in their works (2 Enoch 42:1) is the Master's rule that men are known by their fruits.
cards.s_text: I saw the key-holders and guards of the gates of hell standing, like great serpents, and their faces like extinguishing lamps, and their eyes of fire, their sharp teeth, and I saw all Yahuah's (Lord’s) works, how they are right, while the works of man are some good, and others bad, and in their works are known those who lie evilly.
cards.t_text: Wherefore by their fruits you shall know them.

cards.note: Psalms 145:17 — *Yahuah (LORD) is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.* Enoch's sight that Yahuah's works are right (2 Enoch 42:1) is the psalm's praise of Him as righteous in all His ways.
cards.s_text: I saw the key-holders and guards of the gates of hell standing, like great serpents, and their faces like extinguishing lamps, and their eyes of fire, their sharp teeth, and I saw all Yahuah's (Lord’s) works, how they are right, while the works of man are some good, and others bad, and in their works are known those who lie evilly.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 32:4 — *He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a Elohim (God) of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.* That all Yahuah's works are right in 2 Enoch 42:1 is the confession of Moses' song, that the Rock's work is perfect and just.
cards.s_text: I saw the key-holders and guards of the gates of hell standing, like great serpents, and their faces like extinguishing lamps, and their eyes of fire, their sharp teeth, and I saw all Yahuah's (Lord’s) works, how they are right, while the works of man are some good, and others bad, and in their works are known those who lie evilly.
cards.t_text: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a Elohim (God) of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.

cards.note: 1 Samuel 2:30 — *...for them that honour me I will honour, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.* That the man who fears Elohim shall be more glorious in time to come (2 Enoch 43:2) is Yahuah's pledge to honour those who honour Him.
cards.s_text: As one year is more honourable than another, so is one man more honourable than another, some for great possessions, some for wisdom of heart, some for particular intellect, some for cunning, one for silence of lip, another for cleanliness, one for strength, another for comeliness, one for youth, another for sharp wit, one for shape of body, another for sensibility, let it be heard everywhere, but there is none better than he who fears Elohim (God), he shall be more glorious in time to come.
cards.t_text: Wherefore Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) says, I said indeed that your house, and the house of your father, should walk before me for ever: but now Yahuah (LORD) says, Be it far from me; for them that honour me I will honour, and they that despise me shall be lightly esteemed.

cards.note: Proverbs 9:10 — *The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.* That the fearer of Elohim is best of all in 2 Enoch 43:2 rests on the proverb that the fear of Yahuah is wisdom's beginning.
cards.s_text: As one year is more honourable than another, so is one man more honourable than another, some for great possessions, some for wisdom of heart, some for particular intellect, some for cunning, one for silence of lip, another for cleanliness, one for strength, another for comeliness, one for youth, another for sharp wit, one for shape of body, another for sensibility, let it be heard everywhere, but there is none better than he who fears Elohim (God), he shall be more glorious in time to come.
cards.t_text: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is the beginning of wisdom: and the knowledge of the holy is understanding.

cards.note: Ecclesiastes 12:13 — *Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear Elohim (God), and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.* Enoch's verdict that none is better than he who fears Elohim (2 Enoch 43:2) is the preacher's conclusion of the whole matter.
cards.s_text: As one year is more honourable than another, so is one man more honourable than another, some for great possessions, some for wisdom of heart, some for particular intellect, some for cunning, one for silence of lip, another for cleanliness, one for strength, another for comeliness, one for youth, another for sharp wit, one for shape of body, another for sensibility, let it be heard everywhere, but there is none better than he who fears Elohim (God), he shall be more glorious in time to come.
cards.t_text: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear Elohim (God), and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.

cards.note: Matthew 25:40 — *And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.* That charity to the needy is weighed for reward at the great judgment (2 Enoch 44:3) is the Master's reckoning of mercy to the least as done unto Him.
cards.s_text: Blessed is the man who does not direct his heart with malice against any man, and helps the injured and condemned, and raises the broken down, and shall do charity to the needy, because on the day of the great judgment every weight, every measure and every makeweight will be as in the market, that is to say they are hung on scales and stand in the market, and every one shall learn his own measure, and according to his measure shall take his reward.
cards.t_text: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as you have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, you have done it unto me.

cards.note: Proverbs 14:31 — *He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.* That helping the broken down and the needy is blessed (2 Enoch 44:3) is the proverb that mercy to the poor honours their Maker.
cards.s_text: Blessed is the man who does not direct his heart with malice against any man, and helps the injured and condemned, and raises the broken down, and shall do charity to the needy, because on the day of the great judgment every weight, every measure and every makeweight will be as in the market, that is to say they are hung on scales and stand in the market, and every one shall learn his own measure, and according to his measure shall take his reward.
cards.t_text: He that oppresses the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him has mercy on the poor.

cards.note: Proverbs 19:17 — *He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto Yahuah (LORD); and that which he hath given will he pay him again.* The blessing on him who does charity to the needy and takes his reward by measure (2 Enoch 44:3) is the proverb that pity to the poor is a loan to Yahuah, repaid.
cards.s_text: Blessed is the man who does not direct his heart with malice against any man, and helps the injured and condemned, and raises the broken down, and shall do charity to the needy, because on the day of the great judgment every weight, every measure and every makeweight will be as in the market, that is to say they are hung on scales and stand in the market, and every one shall learn his own measure, and according to his measure shall take his reward.
cards.t_text: He that has pity upon the poor lendeth unto Yahuah (LORD); and that which he has given will he pay him again.

cards.note: James 3:9 — *Therewith bless we Elohim (God), even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of Elohim (God).* Reviling and abhorring the face of man as despising Yahuah's face (2 Enoch 44:2) is the very contradiction James names — cursing men made after the similitude of Elohim.
cards.s_text: Whoever reviles the ruler’s face, and abhors Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, has despised Yahuah's (Lord's) face, and he who vents anger on any man without injury, Yahuah's (Lord’s) great anger will cut him down, he who spits on the face of man reproachfully, will be cut down at Yahuah's (Lord’s) great judgment.
cards.t_text: Therewith bless we Elohim (God), even the Father; and therewith curse we men, which are made after the similitude of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Genesis 9:6 — *Whoso sheddeth man's blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of Elohim (God) made he man.* That he who spits on or reviles the face of man is cut down at Yahuah's judgment (2 Enoch 44:2) follows the law that reckons violence to man by the image of Elohim he bears.
cards.s_text: Whoever reviles the ruler’s face, and abhors Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, has despised Yahuah's (Lord's) face, and he who vents anger on any man without injury, Yahuah's (Lord’s) great anger will cut him down, he who spits on the face of man reproachfully, will be cut down at Yahuah's (Lord’s) great judgment.
cards.t_text: Whoso sheddeth man’s blood, by man shall his blood be shed: for in the image of Elohim (God) made he man.

cards.note: Genesis 1:26 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea...* The likeness of His own face in which man was made (2 Enoch 44:1) is the image and likeness Elohim purposed at the forming of man.
cards.s_text: Yahuah (Lord) with his hands having created man, in the likeness of his own face, Yahuah (Lord) made him small and great.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth.

cards.note: Genesis 1:27 — *So Elohim (God) created man in his own image, in the image of Elohim (God) created he him; male and female created he them.* That Yahuah made man in the likeness of His own face (2 Enoch 44:1) is the image of Elohim Moses sets at creation.
cards.s_text: Yahuah (Lord) with his hands having created man, in the likeness of his own face, Yahuah (Lord) made him small and great.
cards.t_text: So Elohim (God) created man in his own image, in the image of Elohim (God) created he him; male and female created he them.

cards.note: Proverbs 15:8 — *The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Yahuah (LORD): but the prayer of the upright is his delight.* He who hastens to offer with a false heart gains nothing; Solomon already named the wicked man's sacrifice an abomination.
cards.s_text: Whoever hastens to make offerings before Yahuah's (Lord’s) face, Yahuah (Lord) for his part will hasten that offering by granting of his work.
cards.t_text: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination to Yahuah (LORD): but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

cards.note: Matthew 9:13 — *But go ye and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.* The Messiah sends His hearers back to Hosea's word, the same word Enoch teaches his sons — the heart, not the offering.
cards.s_text: When Yahuah (Lord) demands bread, or candles, or the flesh of beasts, or any other sacrifice, then that is nothing; but Elohim (God) demands pure hearts, and with all that only tests the heart of man.
cards.t_text: But go you and learn what that meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice: for I am not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

cards.note: Hosea 6:6 — *For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of Elohim (God) more than burnt offerings.* Enoch's contrast of pure hearts against the flesh of beasts is the very word Yahuah spoke through Hosea.
cards.s_text: When Yahuah (Lord) demands bread, or candles, or the flesh of beasts, or any other sacrifice, then that is nothing; but Elohim (God) demands pure hearts, and with all that only tests the heart of man.
cards.t_text: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of Elohim (God) more than burnt offerings.

cards.note: Psalms 51:16 — *For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.* That bread and beasts and offerings are "nothing" without the heart is the psalm's own confession that Yahuah does not desire mere sacrifice.
cards.s_text: When Yahuah (Lord) demands bread, or candles, or the flesh of beasts, or any other sacrifice, then that is nothing; but Elohim (God) demands pure hearts, and with all that only tests the heart of man.
cards.t_text: For you desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: you delightest not in burnt offering.
