cards.t_text: Which had the golden censer, and the ark of the covenant overlaid round about with gold, wherein was the golden pot that had manna, and Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tables of the covenant;

cards.note: Hebrews 9:3 — *And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;* — the veil Baruch's angel first removes.
cards.s_text: And I saw him descend into the Holy of Holies, and take from thence the veil, and the holy ark, and the mercy-seat, and the two tables, and the holy raiment of the priests, and the altar of incense, and the forty-eight precious stones, wherewith the priest was adorned and all the holy vessels of the tabernacle.
cards.t_text: And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the Holiest of all;

cards.note: Deuteronomy 32:27 — *...lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and Yahuah (LORD) hath not done all this.* — Elohim guards His own glory against the enemy's boast, the very motive Baruch's angel voices.
cards.s_text: And after these things I heard that angel saying unto those angels who held the lamps: 'Destroy, therefore, and overthrow its wall to its foundations, lest the enemy should boast and say: "We have overthrown the wall of Zion, And we have burnt the place of El Gibbor (the mighty God)."'
cards.t_text: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and Yahuah (LORD) has not done all this.

cards.note: Jeremiah 52:11 — *Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon...* — the same captivity attested by the prophet who lived it.
cards.s_text: And they led the people away captive and slew some of them, and bound Zedekiah the king, and sent him to the king of Babylon.
cards.t_text: Then he put out the eyes of Zedekiah; and the king of Babylon bound him in chains, and carried him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.

cards.note: 2 Kings 25:7 — *...and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.* — the binding and deportation of Zedekiah Baruch records.
cards.s_text: And they led the people away captive and slew some of them, and bound Zedekiah the king, and sent him to the king of Babylon.
cards.t_text: And they slew the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass, and carried him to Babylon.

cards.note: Ezekiel 11:23 — *And the glory of Yahuah (LORD) went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.* — the glory leaves before the enemy enters.
cards.s_text: 'Enter, ye enemies, And come, ye adversaries; For he who kept the house has forsaken (it).'
cards.t_text: And the glory of Yahuah (LORD) went up from the midst of the city, and stood upon the mountain which is on the east side of the city.

cards.note: Ezekiel 10:18 — *Then the glory of Yahuah (LORD) departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.* — the Keeper forsakes the house, exactly as Baruch's voice declares.
cards.s_text: 'Enter, ye enemies, And come, ye adversaries; For he who kept the house has forsaken (it).'
cards.t_text: Then the glory of Yahuah (LORD) departed from off the threshold of the house, and stood over the cherubims.

cards.note: Lamentations 2:10 — *The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth* — Jeremiah's own dirge of rent garments over fallen Zion.
cards.s_text: And we rent our garments, we wept, and mourned, and fasted seven days.
cards.t_text: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, and keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

cards.note: Joel 2:12 — *Therefore also now, saith Yahuah (LORD), turn ye even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning* — the same weeping-and-mourning fast Baruch and Jeremiah hold.
cards.s_text: And we rent our garments, we wept, and mourned, and fasted seven days.
cards.t_text: Therefore also now, says Yahuah (LORD), turn you even to me with all your heart, and with fasting, and with weeping, and with mourning:

cards.note: Joel 1:14 — *Sanctify ye a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and cry unto Yahuah (LORD)* — the appointed fast over a stricken land Baruch keeps.
cards.s_text: And we rent our garments, we wept, and mourned, and fasted seven days.
cards.t_text: Sanctify you a fast, call a solemn assembly, gather the elders and all the inhabitants of the land into the house of Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and cry unto Yahuah (LORD),

cards.note: Jeremiah 9:1 — *Oh that my head were waters, and mine eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!* — Jeremiah's tears over Zion, the grief framing Baruch's whole lament.
cards.s_text: And you, ye virgins, who weave fine linen And silk with gold of Ophir, Take with haste all (these) things And cast (them) into the fire, That it may bear them to Him who made them, And the flame send them to Him who created them, Lest the enemy get possession of them.'
cards.t_text: Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night for the slain of the daughter of my people!

cards.note: Lamentations 2:18 — *Their heart cried unto Yahuah (Lord), O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night* — Zion handed back to the LORD with weeping, Baruch's 'Guard Thy house Thyself.'
cards.s_text: Moreover, ye priests, take ye the keys of the sanctuary, And cast them into the height of heaven, And give them to Yahuah (Lord) and say: "Guard Thy house Thyself, For lo! we are found false stewards."
cards.t_text: Their heart cried unto Adonai (Lord), O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of your eye cease.

cards.note: Lamentations 2:20 — *shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of Yahuah (Lord)?* — the priests of the sanctuary undone, the false-steward grief Baruch voices.
cards.s_text: Moreover, ye priests, take ye the keys of the sanctuary, And cast them into the height of heaven, And give them to Yahuah (Lord) and say: "Guard Thy house Thyself, For lo! we are found false stewards."
cards.t_text: Behold, O Yahuah (LORD), and consider to whom you have done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of Adonai (Lord)?

cards.note: Lamentations 2:20 — *Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long?* — Jeremiah's horror at child and mother in the siege, the grief behind Baruch's 'bear in pain, only to bury in grief.'
cards.s_text: For why should they bear in pain, Only to bury in grief? Or why, again, should mankind have sons?
cards.t_text: Behold, O Yahuah (LORD), and consider to whom you have done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, and children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of Adonai (Lord)?

cards.note: Luke 23:29 — *they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck* — the barren counted glad over a falling Jerusalem, as Baruch's verse 14.
cards.s_text: For the barren shall above all rejoice, And those who have no sons shall be glad, And those who have sons shall have anguish.
cards.t_text: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.

cards.note: Matthew 24:19 — *And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!* — the Messiah's woe over child-bearing in the day of Zion's tribulation, Baruch's lament exactly.
cards.s_text: For the barren shall above all rejoice, And those who have no sons shall be glad, And those who have sons shall have anguish.
cards.t_text: And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days!

cards.note: Luke 23:29 — *For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare* — the Messiah's own lament over a doomed Jerusalem, the same blessing on the unborn.
cards.s_text: 'Blessed is he who was not born, Or he, who having been born, has died.
cards.t_text: For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the paps which never gave suck.

cards.note: Ecclesiastes 4:3 — *Yea, better is he than both they, which hath not yet been, who hath not seen the evil work that is done under the sun* — better never to have been, the very thought of Baruch's verse 6.
cards.s_text: But as for us who live, woe unto us, Because we see the afflictions of Zion, And what has befallen Jerusalem.
cards.t_text: Yea, better is he than both they, which has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

cards.note: Ecclesiastes 4:2 — *Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive* — the Preacher counting the dead happier, as Baruch does.
cards.s_text: 'Blessed is he who was not born, Or he, who having been born, has died.
cards.t_text: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.

cards.note: Job 3:11 — *Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?* — the same wish to have died at birth.
cards.s_text: 'Blessed is he who was not born, Or he, who having been born, has died.
cards.t_text: Why died I not from the womb? why did I not give up the ghost when I came out of the belly?

cards.note: Job 3:3 — *Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived* — Job's curse on his birthday, the root of Baruch's cry.
cards.s_text: 'Blessed is he who was not born, Or he, who having been born, has died.
cards.t_text: Let the day perish wherein I was born, and the night in which it was said, There is a man child conceived.

cards.note: Proverbs 14:32 — *the righteous hath hope in his death* — the fathers who 'went to rest without grief' do not rest in nothing but in hope, guarding Baruch's lament from despair.
cards.s_text: Our fathers went to rest without grief, And lo! the righteous sleep in the earth in tranquillity;
cards.t_text: The wicked is driven away in his wickedness: but the righteous has hope in his death.

cards.note: Ecclesiastes 4:2 — *Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive* — the dead blessed above the living, Baruch's word to Sheol.
cards.s_text: "Blessed are ye more than we who live."'
cards.t_text: Wherefore I praised the dead which are already dead more than the living which are yet alive.

cards.note: Psalm 73:17 — *Until I went into the sanctuary of Elohim (God); then understood I their end* — the resolution of Baruch's 'who will be judge?': their end is known before the LORD.
cards.s_text: Who will be judge regarding these things? Or to whom shall we complain regarding that which has befallen us? O Yahuah (Lord), how hast Thou borne (it)?
cards.t_text: Until I went into the sanctuary of Elohim (God); then understood I their end.

cards.note: Psalm 73:12 — *Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches* — the prospering wicked Baruch sees in prospering Babylon.
cards.s_text: But now, lo! the grief is infinite, And the lamentation measureless, For lo! thou art prospered And Zion desolate.
cards.t_text: Behold, these are the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase in riches.

cards.note: Psalm 73:3 — *For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked* — the Psalmist's grief at Babylon-like prospering, Baruch's complaint exactly.
cards.s_text: But now, lo! the grief is infinite, And the lamentation measureless, For lo! thou art prospered And Zion desolate.
cards.t_text: For I was envious at the foolish, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

cards.note: Psalm 39:5 — *verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity* — even at his brightest the prosperer is vanity, the lesson of the fading noonday.
cards.s_text: The noonday does not always burn, Nor do the rays of the sun constantly give light.
cards.t_text: Behold, you have made my days as an handbreadth; and my age is as nothing before you: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

cards.note: Ecclesiastes 8:13 — *it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before Elohim (God)* — the prosperer's day a fleeting shadow, Baruch's noon that does not always burn.
cards.s_text: The noonday does not always burn, Nor do the rays of the sun constantly give light.
cards.t_text: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he fears not before Elohim (God).

cards.note: 2 Peter 3:9 — *Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward* — the 'long-suffering' that holds the wrath by reins, named by the apostle.
cards.s_text: For assuredly in its own season shall the (divine) wrath awake against thee, Which now in long-suffering is held in as it were by reins.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 32:35 — *their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste* — Moses' word that recompense waits its 'due time,' Baruch's wrath held by reins.
cards.s_text: For assuredly in its own season shall the (divine) wrath awake against thee, Which now in long-suffering is held in as it were by reins.
cards.t_text: To me belongs vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.

cards.note: Habakkuk 2:3 — *For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come* — the wrath that 'in its own season shall the (divine) wrath awake' the appointed delay Baruch describes.
cards.s_text: For assuredly in its own season shall the (divine) wrath awake against thee, Which now in long-suffering is held in as it were by reins.
cards.t_text: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 8:11 — *Beware that thou forget not Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), in not keeping his commandments* — Moses' warning against forgetting the Giver, behind Baruch's 'ungrateful for the beneficence.'
cards.s_text: But now, ye peoples and nations, ye are guilty Because ye have always trodden down the earth, And used the creation unrighteously.
cards.t_text: Beware that you forget not Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command you this day:

cards.note: Romans 1:21 — *when they knew Elohim (God), they glorified him not as Elohim (God), neither were thankful* — the nations ungrateful for the benefit, Baruch's exact charge.
cards.s_text: For I have always benefited you. And ye have always been ungrateful for the beneficence.
cards.t_text: Because that, when they knew Elohim (God), they glorified him not as Elohim (God), neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 8:5 — *as a man chasteneth his son, so Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) chasteneth thee* — Moses' word that the affliction of His sons is fatherly discipline, not enmity.
cards.s_text: On this account he had aforetime no mercy on His own sons, But afflicted them as His enemies, because they sinned,
cards.t_text: You shall also consider in your heart, that, as a man chastens his son, so Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) chastens you.

cards.note: Proverbs 3:12 — *whom Yahuah (LORD) loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth* — the Father's chastening of His sons unto their good, Baruch's 'chastened that they might be sanctified.'
cards.s_text: Then therefore were they chastened That they might be sanctified.
cards.t_text: For whom Yahuah (LORD) loves he corrects; even as a father the son in whom he delights.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 10:17 — *Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God)... regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward* — Moses' word that the LORD shows no partiality, the root of Baruch's impartial Judge.
cards.s_text: For how long? Thou wilt say to them: "Ye who have drunk the strained wine, Drink ye also of its dregs, The judgement of the Lofty One Who has no respect of persons."'
cards.t_text: For Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God) is Elohim (God) of gods, and Adonai (Lord) of lords, a great Elohim (God), a mighty, and a terrible, which regards not persons, nor takes reward:

cards.note: Romans 2:11 — *For there is no respect of persons with Elohim (God)* — the impartial Judge, Baruch's 'Lofty One who has no respect of persons.'
cards.s_text: For how long? Thou wilt say to them: "Ye who have drunk the strained wine, Drink ye also of its dregs, The judgement of the Lofty One Who has no respect of persons."'
cards.t_text: For there is no respect of persons with Elohim (God).

cards.note: Psalm 75:8 — *in the hand of Yahuah (LORD) there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture... the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them* — the cup of wrath whose dregs the nations drink, Baruch's very figure.
cards.s_text: For how long? Thou wilt say to them: "Ye who have drunk the strained wine, Drink ye also of its dregs, The judgement of the Lofty One Who has no respect of persons."'
cards.t_text: For in the hand of Yahuah (LORD) there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he pours out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

cards.note: Genesis 1:26 — *Let us make man in our image... and let them have dominion... over all the earth* — man set as 'administrator of Thy works,' the very stewardship Baruch names.
cards.s_text: And Thou didst say that Thou wouldst make for Thy world man as the administrator of Thy works, that it might be known that he was by no means made on account of the world, but the world on account of him.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth.

cards.note: Isaiah 45:18 — *he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited* — the world made not for itself but for man's dwelling, Baruch's 'the world on account of him.'
cards.s_text: And Thou didst say that Thou wouldst make for Thy world man as the administrator of Thy works, that it might be known that he was by no means made on account of the world, but the world on account of him.
cards.t_text: For thus says Yahuah (LORD) that created the heavens; Elohim (God) himself that formed the earth and made it; he has established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am Yahuah (LORD); and there is none else.

cards.note: Hebrews 11:3 — *Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of Elohim (God)* — the works of creation framed by a spoken word, as Baruch says.
cards.s_text: When of old there was no world with its inhabitants, Thou didst devise and speak with a word, and forthwith the works of creation stood before Thee.
cards.t_text: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of Elohim (God), so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

cards.note: Psalm 33:6 — *By the word of Yahuah (LORD) were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth* — creation that 'stood before Thee' at His word, Baruch's verse 17.
cards.s_text: When of old there was no world with its inhabitants, Thou didst devise and speak with a word, and forthwith the works of creation stood before Thee.
cards.t_text: By the word of Yahuah (LORD) were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.

cards.note: Revelation 14:13 — *Blessed are the dead which die in Yahusha (Lord) from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.* — the righteous departing without fear, their works 'preserved in treasuries.'
cards.s_text: For the righteous justly hope for the end, and without fear depart from this habitation, because they have with Thee a store of works preserved in treasuries.
cards.t_text: And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord from henceforth: Yea, says the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.

cards.note: 1 Peter 1:4 — *To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you* — the promised world the righteous 'hope to receive,' Baruch's treasured hope.
cards.s_text: On this account also these without fear leave this world, and trusting with joy they hope to receive the world which Thou hast promised them.
cards.t_text: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

cards.note: Psalm 39:5 — *mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity* — the fleeting breath of man's nature Baruch laments.
cards.s_text: For as the breath ascends involuntarily, and again dies, so it is with the nature of men, who depart not according to their own will, and know not what will befall them in the end.
cards.t_text: Behold, you have made my days as an handbreadth; and my age is as nothing before you: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

cards.note: Psalm 144:4 — *Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passeth away* — man made like a breath, Baruch's confession exactly.
cards.s_text: For we have all been made like a breath.
cards.t_text: Man is like to vanity: his days are as a shadow that passes away.

cards.note: Job 38:4 — *Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding* — the LORD's rebuke of the creature who would search out His counsel, behind Baruch's questions.
cards.s_text: Or who will be able to think out Thy incomprehensible counsel? Or who of those that are born has ever found The beginning or end of Thy wisdom?
cards.t_text: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if you have understanding.

cards.note: Romans 11:33 — *O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of Elohim (God)! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!* — Baruch's 'who, O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, will comprehend Thy judgement' in the apostle's very words.
cards.s_text: But who, O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, will comprehend Thy judgement, Or who will search out the profoundness of Thy way? Or who will think out the [weight] of Thy path?
cards.t_text: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of Elohim (God)! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

cards.note: James 1:12 — *when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which Yahuah (Lord) hath promised to them that love him* — the 'crown with great glory' promised after the labour.
cards.s_text: For this world is to them a strife and a labour with much trouble; and that accordingly which is to come, a crown with great glory.'
cards.t_text: Blessed is the man that endures temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord has promised to them that love him.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 4:17 — *For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory* — this world's strife against the coming crown, Baruch's two ages.
cards.s_text: For this world is to them a strife and a labour with much trouble; and that accordingly which is to come, a crown with great glory.'
cards.t_text: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, works for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;

cards.note: Romans 7:12 — *Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good* — the law by which the knowing transgressor is justly judged, never abolished but upheld.
cards.s_text: But now, because he transgressed wittingly, yea, just on this ground that he wot (thereof), he shall be tormented.
cards.t_text: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 4:6 — *for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations* — Moses' word that the law is Israel's very understanding, behind Baruch's 'unless he had accepted the law.'
cards.s_text: Man would not rightly have understood My judgement, unless he had accepted the law, and I had instructed him in understanding.
cards.t_text: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.

cards.note: Psalm 19:7 — *The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple* — the law that gives understanding, the LORD's answer to Baruch.
cards.s_text: Man would not rightly have understood My judgement, unless he had accepted the law, and I had instructed him in understanding.
cards.t_text: The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.

cards.note: Psalm 90:12 — *So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom* — the wise reckoning of a 'little time,' the answer to Baruch's question.
cards.s_text: And I answered and said: 'O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, lo! the years of this time are few and evil, and who is able in his little time to acquire that which is measureless?'
cards.t_text: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

cards.note: Psalm 90:10 — *The days of our years are threescore years and ten... yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off* — man's brief and toilsome span, Baruch's 'little time.'
cards.s_text: And I answered and said: 'O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, lo! the years of this time are few and evil, and who is able in his little time to acquire that which is measureless?'
cards.t_text: The days of our years are threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength they be fourscore years, yet is their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.

cards.note: Genesis 47:9 — *few and evil have the days of the years of my life been* — Jacob's word to Pharaoh, the exact phrase of Baruch's 'few and evil' years.
cards.s_text: And I answered and said: 'O Yahuah (LORD), my Lord, lo! the years of this time are few and evil, and who is able in his little time to acquire that which is measureless?'
cards.t_text: And Jacob said unto Pharaoh, The days of the years of my pilgrimage are an hundred and thirty years: few and evil have the days of the years of my life been, and have not attained unto the days of the years of the life of my fathers in the days of their pilgrimage.

cards.note: Prov 6:23 — *For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life* — the commandment itself the lamp Moses lit.
cards.s_text: Or wherein did Moses suffer loss in that he lived only one hundred and twenty years, and, inasmuch as he was subject to Him who formed him, brought the law to the seed of Jacob, and lighted a lamp for the nation of Yashar'el (Israel)?'
cards.t_text: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

cards.note: Ps 119:105 — *Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path* — the law as the lamp Baruch says Moses lighted for Israel.
cards.s_text: Or wherein did Moses suffer loss in that he lived only one hundred and twenty years, and, inasmuch as he was subject to Him who formed him, brought the law to the seed of Jacob, and lighted a lamp for the nation of Yashar'el (Israel)?'
cards.t_text: Your word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

cards.note: Rom 5:14 — *Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression* — death reigning over Adam's seed, as Baruch says his years were cut off.
cards.s_text: Therefore the multitude of time that he lived did not profit him, but brought death and cut off the years of those who were born from him.
cards.t_text: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

cards.note: Rom 5:12 — *Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned* — death entering by the one man's transgression, the same root Baruch names.
cards.s_text: For what did it profit Adam that he lived nine hundred and thirty years, and transgressed that which he was commanded?
cards.t_text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

cards.note: John 1:4 — *In him was life; and the life was the light of men* — the light men have, set against the darkness of Adam.
cards.s_text: But those many whom he has lighted have taken from the darkness of Adam and have not rejoiced in the light of the lamp.'
cards.t_text: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.

cards.note: John 1:17 — *For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Yahusha HaMashiach* — the light that came by Moses, which Baruch says the many would not rejoice in.
cards.s_text: But those many whom he has lighted have taken from the darkness of Adam and have not rejoiced in the light of the lamp.'
cards.t_text: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Yahusha HaMashiach (Jesus Christ).

cards.note: Prov 6:23 — *For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life* — the lamp of the law that few imitate.
cards.s_text: And I answered and said: 'He that lighted has taken from the light, and there are but few that have imitated him.
cards.t_text: For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life:

cards.note: Deut 32:29 — *O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!* — the very weighing of the end, not the beginning, that Baruch is told to make.
cards.s_text: For now it is the consummation of time that should be considered, whether of business, or of prosperity, or of shame, and not the beginning thereof.
cards.t_text: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

cards.note: Deut 32:1 — *Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth* — the abiding heaven-and-earth witness that, Baruch says, testifies against those who transgressed.
cards.s_text: But after his death they sinned and transgressed, Though they knew that they had the law reproving (them), And the light in which nothing could err, Also the spheres which testify, and Me.
cards.t_text: Give ear, O you heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

cards.note: Deut 30:15 — *See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil* — the choice set before the nation that Baruch repeats.
cards.s_text: And He answered and said unto me: 'Wherefore at that time he appointed for them a covenant and said: "Behold I have placed before you life and death," And he called heaven and earth to witness against them.
cards.t_text: See, I have set before you this day life and good, and death and evil;

cards.note: Deut 30:19 — *I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life* — the exact covenant words and witnesses Baruch ascribes to Moses.
cards.s_text: And He answered and said unto me: 'Wherefore at that time he appointed for them a covenant and said: "Behold I have placed before you life and death," And he called heaven and earth to witness against them.
cards.t_text: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both you and your seed may live:

cards.note: Deut 30:14 — *But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it* — the word sealed in the heart that Baruch is told to hold fast.
cards.s_text: Now therefore hold fast in thy heart everything that I command thee, And seal it in the recesses of thy mind.
cards.t_text: But the word is very nigh unto you, in your mouth, and in your heart, that you may do it.

cards.note: 2 Pet 3:9 — *Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise... but is longsuffering to us-ward* — the season's swiftness held in the Most High's longsuffering, as Baruch frames Zion's removal.
cards.s_text: Therefore have I now taken away Zion, That I may the more speedily visit the world in its season.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

cards.note: Hab 2:3 — *For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry* — the appointed end Baruch says will the more speedily come.
cards.s_text: 'Therefore, behold! the days come, And the times shall hasten more than the former, And the seasons shall speed on more than those that are past, And the years shall pass more quickly than the present (years).
cards.t_text: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.

cards.note: 2 Pet 3:9 — *Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward* — the longsuffering mistaken for weakness that Baruch asks be vindicated.
cards.s_text: Command therefore in mercy and accomplish all that Thou saidst Thou wouldst bring, that Thy might may be made known to those who think that Thy long-suffering is weakness.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

cards.note: Rom 4:17 — *Elohim, who quickeneth the dead* — the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob who quickens those who sleep in the earth, as Baruch pleads.
cards.s_text: For there have been many years like those that are desolate from the days of Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, and of all those who are like them, who sleep in the earth, on whose account Thou didst say that Thou hadst created the world.
cards.t_text: (As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even Elohim (God), who quickens the dead, and calls those things which be not as though they were.

cards.note: John 5:21 — *For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickeneth them; even so the Son quickeneth whom he will* — the raising of the dead Baruch asks the treasuries of souls to give back.
cards.s_text: Bring to an end therefore henceforth mortality. And reprove accordingly the angel of death, and let Thy glory appear, and let the might of Thy beauty be known, and let Sheol be sealed so that from this time forward it may not receive the dead, and let the treasuries of souls restore those which are enclosed in them.
cards.t_text: For as the Father raiseth up the dead, and quickens them; even so the Son quickens whom he will.

cards.note: Neh 9:6 — *thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host... and the host of heaven worshippeth thee* — the host that stands and obeys, as in Baruch's prayer.
cards.s_text: Thou that rulest with great thought the hosts that stand before Thee: also the countless holy beings, which Thou didst make from the beginning, of flame and fire, which stand around Thy throne
cards.t_text: You, even you, are Yahuah (LORD) alone; you have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and you preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth you.

cards.note: Isa 40:26 — *behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names* — the host made and ruled by Him whom Baruch addresses.
cards.s_text: Thou that rulest with great thought the hosts that stand before Thee: also the countless holy beings, which Thou didst make from the beginning, of flame and fire, which stand around Thy throne
cards.t_text: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who has created these things, that brings out their host by number: he calls them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one fails.

cards.note: Dan 7:10 — *thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him* — the countless hosts of fire that stand before the throne, as Baruch beholds them.
cards.s_text: Thou that rulest with great thought the hosts that stand before Thee: also the countless holy beings, which Thou didst make from the beginning, of flame and fire, which stand around Thy throne
cards.t_text: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

cards.note: Heb 11:3 — *the worlds were framed by the word of Elohim, so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear* — the firmament fixed by the word, as Baruch prays.
cards.s_text: 'O Thou that hast made the earth, hear me, that hast fixed the firmament by the word, and hast made firm the height of the heaven by the spirit, that hast called from the beginning of the world that which did not yet exist, and they obey Thee.
cards.t_text: Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of Elohim (God), so that things which are seen were not made of things which do appear.

cards.note: Rom 4:17 — *even Elohim, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were* — the very God who calls the non-existent into being whom Baruch invokes.
cards.s_text: 'O Thou that hast made the earth, hear me, that hast fixed the firmament by the word, and hast made firm the height of the heaven by the spirit, that hast called from the beginning of the world that which did not yet exist, and they obey Thee.
cards.t_text: (As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even Elohim (God), who quickens the dead, and calls those things which be not as though they were.

cards.note: 2 Pet 3:9 — *Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise... but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish* — the patient waiting for the full measure that the heavenly voice presses on Baruch.
cards.s_text: Or he who sows the earth, but does not reap its fruit in its season, does he not lose everything?
cards.t_text: Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

cards.note: Hab 2:3 — *For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry* — the appointed season that must be reached, as the harvest that cannot be reaped before its time.
cards.s_text: Or he who sows the earth, but does not reap its fruit in its season, does he not lose everything?
cards.t_text: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.

cards.note: Hab 2:3 — *though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry* — the nearing deliverance that is no longer far distant, as Baruch is told.
cards.s_text: For truly My redemption has drawn nigh, and is not far distant as aforetime.
cards.t_text: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.

cards.note: Rev 6:11 — *they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren... should be fulfilled* — the appointed number that must first be completed before the end, as Baruch says the creature will not live again till the number is fulfilled.
cards.s_text: Before therefore the number aforesaid is fulfilled, the creature will not live again [for My spirit is the creator of life], and Sheol will receive the dead.
cards.t_text: And white robes were given unto every one of them; and it was said unto them, that they should rest yet for a little season, until their fellowservants also and their brethren, that should be killed as they were, should be fulfilled.

cards.note: Rom 5:12 — *as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men* — the decree of death at Adam's sin that Baruch names as the start of the numbering.
cards.s_text: Because when Adam sinned and death was decreed against those who should be born, then the multitude of those who should be born was numbered, and for that number a place was prepared where the living might dwell and the dead might be guarded.
cards.t_text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

cards.note: 2 Pet 3:9 — *Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise... but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance* — the longsuffering through all generations toward sinner and righteous that Baruch will see.
cards.s_text: For it shall come to pass at that time that thou shalt see—and the many that are with thee—the long-suffering of the El Elyon (Most High), which has been throughout all generations, who has been long-suffering towards all who are born, (alike) those who sin and (those who) are righteous.'
cards.t_text: Yahuah (Lord) is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

cards.note: Deut 32:34 — *Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?* — the treasuries where the record is laid up against the day, as Baruch's treasuries of righteousness.
cards.s_text: 'For behold! the days come and the books shall be opened in which are written the sins of all those who have sinned, and again also the treasuries in which the righteousness of all those who have been righteous in creation is gathered.
cards.t_text: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?

cards.note: Rev 20:12 — *and the books were opened... and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works* — the books of sins and the gathered righteousness Baruch names.
cards.s_text: 'For behold! the days come and the books shall be opened in which are written the sins of all those who have sinned, and again also the treasuries in which the righteousness of all those who have been righteous in creation is gathered.
cards.t_text: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.

cards.note: Dan 7:10 — *the judgment was set, and the books were opened* — the very opening of the books at the consummation that Baruch foretells.
cards.s_text: 'For behold! the days come and the books shall be opened in which are written the sins of all those who have sinned, and again also the treasuries in which the righteousness of all those who have been righteous in creation is gathered.
cards.t_text: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

cards.note: Matthew 24:21 — *For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.* The hour when men abandon hope by reason of much tribulation is the great tribulation the Messiah foretold, unmatched since the beginning of the world.
cards.s_text: And it will come to pass when they say in their thoughts by reason of their much tribulation: "The Mighty One doth no longer remember the earth"—yea, it will come to pass when they abandon hope, that the time will then awake.'
cards.t_text: For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be.

cards.note: Daniel 12:1 — *And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* Baruch's many tribulations before the time awakes are Daniel's unequalled time of trouble out of which the people are delivered.
cards.s_text: When a stupor shall seize the inhabitants of the earth, and they shall fall into many tribulations, and again when they shall fall into great torments.
cards.t_text: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which stands for the children of your people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time your people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

cards.note: Matthew 24:6 — *And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.* The tribulations that seize the earth before the time awakes are the Messiah's own sign of the age's close — these things must come, but the end is not yet.
cards.s_text: When a stupor shall seize the inhabitants of the earth, and they shall fall into many tribulations, and again when they shall fall into great torments.
cards.t_text: And you shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that you be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

cards.note: Matthew 24:22 — *And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened.* The answer to whether that necessity embraces many years is the Messiah's word that the days are measured and cut short for the elect's sake.
cards.s_text: And I answered and said: 'Will that tribulation which is to be continue a long time, and will that necessity embrace many years?'
cards.t_text: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.

cards.note: Revelation 6:10 — *And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Yahuah (Lord), holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?* Baruch's question whether the tribulation will continue many years is the same "how long" the martyred souls cry under the altar.
cards.s_text: And I answered and said: 'Will that tribulation which is to be continue a long time, and will that necessity embrace many years?'
cards.t_text: And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Yahuah (Lord), holy and true, do you not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?

cards.note: Daniel 12:10 — *Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.* That the dwellers on the earth shall not understand it is the consummation echoes Daniel — none of the wicked understand, but the wise shall understand.
cards.s_text: For some shall leave out some of their own, and receive (in its stead) from others, and some complete their own and that of others, so that those may not understand who are upon the earth in those days that this is the consummation of the times.
cards.t_text: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.

cards.note: Matthew 24:36 — *But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.* That men on the earth may not understand it is the consummation of the times is the hidden day and hour the Messiah said no man knows.
cards.s_text: For some shall leave out some of their own, and receive (in its stead) from others, and some complete their own and that of others, so that those may not understand who are upon the earth in those days that this is the consummation of the times.
cards.t_text: But of that day and hour knows no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

cards.note: Matthew 24:6 — *And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.* The sending of the sword among the appointed parts is the wars the Messiah said must come to pass before the end.
cards.s_text: And in the fourth part the sending of the sword.
cards.t_text: And you shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that you be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.

cards.note: Revelation 6:8 — *And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.* The fall of many by death and the sending of the sword are John's pale horse, Death given power to slay with sword and with hunger.
cards.s_text: And in the fourth part the sending of the sword.
cards.t_text: And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth, to kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.

cards.note: Mark 13:8 — *For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.* The earthquakes, famine, and terrors of the appointed parts are the earthquakes and famines Mark names as the beginnings of sorrows.
cards.s_text: And in the fifth part famine and the withholding of rain.
cards.t_text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be earthquakes in divers places, and there shall be famines and troubles: these are the beginnings of sorrows.

cards.note: Matthew 24:8 — *All these are the beginning of sorrows.* The twelve parts of woe that mingle one with another and lead to the consummation are the beginning of sorrows the Messiah names.
cards.s_text: And in the sixth part earthquakes and terrors.
cards.t_text: All these are the beginning of sorrows.

cards.note: Matthew 24:7 — *For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.* The famine, withholding of rain, and earthquakes among Baruch's twelve parts are the very famines and earthquakes the Messiah lists in the beginning of sorrows.
cards.s_text: And in the fifth part famine and the withholding of rain.
cards.t_text: For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places.

cards.note: Matthew 24:14 — *And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.* Baruch's question whether the whole earth experiences these things is answered in the Messiah's word that the end comes upon all nations together.
cards.s_text: Is it in one place or in one of the parts of the earth that those things are come to pass, or will the whole earth experience (them)?'
cards.t_text: And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come.

cards.note: Isaiah 34:2 — *For the indignation of Yahuah (LORD) is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.* That the whole earth, not one place, shall experience these things is Isaiah's word that the indignation of Yahuah is upon all nations.
cards.s_text: Is it in one place or in one of the parts of the earth that those things are come to pass, or will the whole earth experience (them)?'
cards.t_text: For the indignation of Yahuah (LORD) is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he has utterly destroyed them, he has delivered them to the slaughter.

cards.note: Matthew 24:33 — *So likewise ye, when ye shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.* The reckoning of the measure of that time, given to be discerned by the wise, is the Messiah's charge to know the season is near when these things appear.
cards.s_text: For the measure and reckoning of that time are two parts a week of seven weeks.'
cards.t_text: So likewise you, when you shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

cards.note: Daniel 12:10 — *Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.* That whosoever understandeth shall then be wise is Daniel's own word — the wicked understand not, but the wise shall understand the reckoning of the time.
cards.s_text: 'Nevertheless, whosoever understandeth shall then be wise.
cards.t_text: Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried; but the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand; but the wise shall understand.

cards.note: *And it shall come to pass at that self-same time that the treasury of manna shall again descend from on high, and they will eat of it in those years, because these are they who have come to the consummation of time.* (2 Baruch 29:8). *And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.* (John 6:35). In the years of the Messiah, 2 Baruch says, the treasury of manna will again descend from on high, and they will eat of it. The bread that came down for the tribes in the wilderness is promised again for the end of time. Yahusha (Jesus) says of himself that he is the bread of life, and that the one who comes to him shall never hunger and the one who believes on him shall never thirst. The bread from on high that Baruch looks for is the one standing before them in John.
cards.s_text: And it shall come to pass at that self-same time that the treasury of manna shall again descend from on high, and they will eat of it in those years, because these are they who have come to the consummation of time.
cards.t_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that comes to me shall never hunger; and he that believes on me shall never thirst.

cards.note: John 6:31 — *Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.* The manna that comes down again at the consummation is the bread from heaven the fathers ate, which the Messiah takes up as the sign of Himself.
cards.s_text: And it shall come to pass at that self-same time that the treasury of manna shall again descend from on high, and they will eat of it in those years, because these are they who have come to the consummation of time.
cards.t_text: Our fathers did eat manna in the desert; as it is written, He gave them bread from heaven to eat.

cards.note: Exodus 16:4 — *Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.* The treasury of manna that descends again is the very bread from heaven Yahuah rained on Israel through Moses.
cards.s_text: And it shall come to pass at that self-same time that the treasury of manna shall again descend from on high, and they will eat of it in those years, because these are they who have come to the consummation of time.
cards.t_text: Then said Yahuah (LORD) unto Moses, Behold, I will rain bread from heaven for you; and the people shall go out and gather a certain rate every day, that I may prove them, whether they will walk in my law, or no.

cards.note: Isaiah 65:21 — *And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.* The earth yielding ten thousandfold in the Messiah's day is Isaiah's restored land where the people plant vineyards and eat the fruit of them.
cards.s_text: The earth also shall yield its fruit ten thousandfold and on each (?) vine there shall be a thousand branches, and each branch shall produce a thousand clusters, and each cluster produce a thousand grapes, and each grape produce a cor of wine.
cards.t_text: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

cards.note: Amos 9:13 — *Behold, the days come, saith Yahuah (LORD), that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.* The vine that bears a thousand clusters and each grape a cor of wine is Amos' day when the mountains drop sweet wine and the harvest overflows.
cards.s_text: The earth also shall yield its fruit ten thousandfold and on each (?) vine there shall be a thousand branches, and each branch shall produce a thousand clusters, and each cluster produce a thousand grapes, and each grape produce a cor of wine.
cards.t_text: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that the plowman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that sows seed; and the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and all the hills shall melt.

cards.note: Revelation 19:17 — *And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great Elohim (God).* The great feast at the Messiah's revealing answers in John's supper of the great Elohim at the day of the Anointed's triumph.
cards.s_text: And Behemoth shall be revealed from his place and Leviathan shall ascend from the sea, those two great monsters which I created on the fifth day of creation, and shall have kept until that time; and then they shall be for food for all that are left.
cards.t_text: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the fowls that fly in the midst of heaven, Come and gather yourselves together unto the supper of the great Elohim (God);

cards.note: Isaiah 25:8 — *He will swallow up death in victory; and Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for Yahuah (LORD) hath spoken it.* The feast at which the monsters become food for the saints is Isaiah's mountain banquet where death itself is swallowed up in victory.
cards.s_text: And Behemoth shall be revealed from his place and Leviathan shall ascend from the sea, those two great monsters which I created on the fifth day of creation, and shall have kept until that time; and then they shall be for food for all that are left.
cards.t_text: He will swallow up death in victory; and Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for Yahuah (LORD) has spoken it.

cards.note: Job 41:1 — *Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which thou lettest down?* The great monster Leviathan that ascends from the sea is the creature no man can draw out, whom only the Most High masters, as Job confesses.
cards.s_text: And Behemoth shall be revealed from his place and Leviathan shall ascend from the sea, those two great monsters which I created on the fifth day of creation, and shall have kept until that time; and then they shall be for food for all that are left.
cards.t_text: Can you draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord which you lettest down?

cards.note: Psalms 74:14 — *Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.* Leviathan ascending to be food for all that are left is the Psalm's own image — Yahuah brake the heads of leviathan and gave him to be meat to His people.
cards.s_text: And Behemoth shall be revealed from his place and Leviathan shall ascend from the sea, those two great monsters which I created on the fifth day of creation, and shall have kept until that time; and then they shall be for food for all that are left.
cards.t_text: You brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gave him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:4 — *But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.* Baruch's revealed Messiah is Isaiah's rod from Jesse who judges in righteousness and slays the wicked with the breath of his lips.
cards.s_text: And it shall come to pass when all is accomplished that was to come to pass in those parts, that the Messiah shall then begin to be revealed.
cards.t_text: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

cards.note: Psalms 2:6 — *Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.* The Messiah who begins to be revealed in his season is the King the Father sets upon His holy hill, the Anointed of the second Psalm.
cards.s_text: And it shall come to pass when all is accomplished that was to come to pass in those parts, that the Messiah shall then begin to be revealed.
cards.t_text: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

cards.note: John 5:29 — *And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.* The wicked wasting away as their torment comes is the Messiah's resurrection of damnation for them that have done evil.
cards.s_text: But the souls of the wicked, when they behold all these things, shall then waste away the more.
cards.t_text: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

cards.note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* That the souls of the wicked waste away the more when they behold these things is Daniel's awakening of some to shame and everlasting contempt.
cards.s_text: But the souls of the wicked, when they behold all these things, shall then waste away the more.
cards.t_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

cards.note: John 5:29 — *And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.* The righteous souls coming forth from the opened treasuries are the Messiah's resurrection of life for them that have done good.
cards.s_text: Then all who have fallen asleep in hope of Him shall rise again. And it shall come to pass at that time that the treasuries will be opened in which is preserved the number of the souls of the righteous, and they shall come forth, and a multitude of souls shall be seen together in one assemblage of one thought, and the first shall rejoice and the last shall not be grieved.
cards.t_text: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

cards.note: Revelation 20:6 — *Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of Elohim (God) and of Messiah (Christ), and shall reign with him a thousand years.* The righteous souls that come forth rejoicing, first and last together, are those John calls blessed in the first resurrection, untouched by the second death.
cards.s_text: Then all who have fallen asleep in hope of Him shall rise again. And it shall come to pass at that time that the treasuries will be opened in which is preserved the number of the souls of the righteous, and they shall come forth, and a multitude of souls shall be seen together in one assemblage of one thought, and the first shall rejoice and the last shall not be grieved.
cards.t_text: Blessed and holy is he that has part in the first resurrection: on such the second death has no power, but they shall be priests of Elohim (God) and of Messiah (Christ), and shall reign with him a thousand years.

cards.note: Revelation 20:4 — *And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Yahusha (Jesus)... and they lived and reigned with Messiah (Christ) a thousand years.* The treasuries opened to bring forth the souls of the righteous are John's souls of the faithful who live and reign with the Messiah in the first resurrection.
cards.s_text: Then all who have fallen asleep in hope of Him shall rise again. And it shall come to pass at that time that the treasuries will be opened in which is preserved the number of the souls of the righteous, and they shall come forth, and a multitude of souls shall be seen together in one assemblage of one thought, and the first shall rejoice and the last shall not be grieved.
cards.t_text: And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them: and I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Yahusha (Jesus), and for the word of Elohim (God), and which had not worshipped the beast, neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Messiah (Christ) a thousand years.

cards.note: John 5:28 — *Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice.* The rising of all who slept in hope is the hour the Messiah named, when all in the graves shall hear His voice and come forth.
cards.s_text: Then all who have fallen asleep in hope of Him shall rise again. And it shall come to pass at that time that the treasuries will be opened in which is preserved the number of the souls of the righteous, and they shall come forth, and a multitude of souls shall be seen together in one assemblage of one thought, and the first shall rejoice and the last shall not be grieved.
cards.t_text: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

cards.note: 1 Thessalonians 4:16 — *For Yahusha (Lord) himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of Elohim (God): and the dead in Messiah (Christ) shall rise first:* That those asleep in hope of Him rise again at His glorious return is Paul's word that at the descent from heaven the dead in Messiah rise first.
cards.s_text: Then all who have fallen asleep in hope of Him shall rise again. And it shall come to pass at that time that the treasuries will be opened in which is preserved the number of the souls of the righteous, and they shall come forth, and a multitude of souls shall be seen together in one assemblage of one thought, and the first shall rejoice and the last shall not be grieved.
cards.t_text: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of Elohim (God): and the dead in Messiah (Christ) shall rise first:

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 15:23 — *But every man in his own order: Messiah (Christ) the firstfruits; afterward they that are Messiah's (Christ's) at his coming.* The sleepers who rise when the Messiah returns are Paul's order of resurrection — they that are Messiah's, raised at His coming.
cards.s_text: Then all who have fallen asleep in hope of Him shall rise again. And it shall come to pass at that time that the treasuries will be opened in which is preserved the number of the souls of the righteous, and they shall come forth, and a multitude of souls shall be seen together in one assemblage of one thought, and the first shall rejoice and the last shall not be grieved.
cards.t_text: But every man in his own order: Messiah (Christ) the firstfruits; afterward they that are Messiah's (Christ’s) at his coming.

cards.note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* That all who fell asleep in hope of Him shall rise again is Daniel's awakening of them that sleep in the dust to everlasting life.
cards.s_text: Then all who have fallen asleep in hope of Him shall rise again. And it shall come to pass at that time that the treasuries will be opened in which is preserved the number of the souls of the righteous, and they shall come forth, and a multitude of souls shall be seen together in one assemblage of one thought, and the first shall rejoice and the last shall not be grieved.
cards.t_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

cards.note: Matthew 24:30 — *And then shall appear the sign of the Son of Adam in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of Adam coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.* That the Messiah shall return in glory is the Messiah's own promise to come in the clouds with power and great glory.
cards.s_text: 'And it shall come to pass after these things, when the time of the advent of the Messiah is fulfilled, that He shall return in glory.
cards.t_text: And then shall appear the sign of the Son of Adam in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of Adam coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory.

cards.note: Daniel 7:13 — *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* The Messiah returning in glory when His advent is fulfilled is Daniel's Son of Adam coming with the clouds to receive dominion.
cards.s_text: 'And it shall come to pass after these things, when the time of the advent of the Messiah is fulfilled, that He shall return in glory.
cards.t_text: I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.

cards.note: Psalm 119:89 — *For ever, O Yahuah (LORD), thy word is settled in heaven* — the word stands though everything that is passes away.
cards.s_text: For lo! the days come, When everything that is shall become the prey of corruption And be as though it had not been.
cards.t_text: For ever, O Yahuah (LORD), your word is settled in heaven.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:20 — *for he is thy life, and the length of thy days* — when all that is becomes corruption, Yahuah and his law remain the abiding portion.
cards.s_text: For lo! the days come, When everything that is shall become the prey of corruption And be as though it had not been.
cards.t_text: That you may love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and that you may obey his voice, and that you may cleave unto him: for he is your life, and the length of your days: that you may dwell in the land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

cards.note: Psalm 74:2 — *Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old... this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt* — the same plea to hold Zion in remembrance amid its desolation.
cards.s_text: Forget not Zion, But hold in remembrance the anguish of Jerusalem.
cards.t_text: Remember your congregation, which you have purchased of old; the rod of your inheritance, which you have redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein you have dwelt.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:1 — *thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath driven thee* — the loss is to be remembered, not forgotten, so it may turn the heart back.
cards.s_text: Forget not Zion, But hold in remembrance the anguish of Jerusalem.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has driven you,

cards.note: Hebrews 12:27 — *Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken... that those things which cannot be shaken may remain* — the shaking that leaves only the abiding kingdom.
cards.s_text: For there will be a greater trial than these two tribulations when the Mighty One will renew His creation.
cards.t_text: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that are made, that those things which cannot be shaken may remain.

cards.note: Haggai 2:6 — *Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land* — the Mighty One shaking the whole creation.
cards.s_text: For there will be a greater trial than these two tribulations when the Mighty One will renew His creation.
cards.t_text: For thus says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts); Yet once, it is a little while, and I will shake the heavens, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry land;

cards.note: Haggai 2:9 — *The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former... and in this place will I give peace* — the rebuilt house renewed in a greater glory.
cards.s_text: And afterwards it must be renewed in glory, and perfected for evermore.]
cards.t_text: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): and in this place will I give peace, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).

cards.note: Psalm 119:165 — *Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them* — the law sown in the heart protects in the time of shaking.
cards.s_text: 'But as for you, if ye prepare your hearts, so as to sow in them the fruits of the law, it shall protect you in that time in which the Mighty One is to shake the whole creation.
cards.t_text: Great peace have they which love your law: and nothing shall offend them.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:14 — *But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it* — the law is to be sown in the heart, exactly as Baruch charges.
cards.s_text: 'But as for you, if ye prepare your hearts, so as to sow in them the fruits of the law, it shall protect you in that time in which the Mighty One is to shake the whole creation.
cards.t_text: But the word is very nigh unto you, in your mouth, and in your heart, that you may do it.

cards.note: Psalm 74:2 — *Remember thy congregation... this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt* — pleading with Yahuah concerning Zion from the ruined holy place.
cards.s_text: And I answered and said unto the people: 'Far be it from me to forsake you or to withdraw from you, but I will only go unto the Holy of Holies to inquire of the Mighty One concerning you and concerning Zion, if in some respect I should receive more illumination: and after these things I will return to you.'
cards.t_text: Remember your congregation, which you have purchased of old; the rod of your inheritance, which you have redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein you have dwelt.

cards.note: Psalm 74:1 — *O Elohim (God), why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?* — the inquiry of the Mighty One over a desolate Zion.
cards.s_text: And I answered and said unto the people: 'Far be it from me to forsake you or to withdraw from you, but I will only go unto the Holy of Holies to inquire of the Mighty One concerning you and concerning Zion, if in some respect I should receive more illumination: and after these things I will return to you.'
cards.t_text: O Elohim (God), why have you cast us off for ever? why does your anger smoke against the sheep of your pasture?

cards.note: Psalm 74:3 — *Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary* — the desolation of the place where the priest once offered.
cards.s_text: Because in that place where I am now prostrate, Of old the high priest offered holy sacrifices, And placed thereon an incense of fragrant odours.
cards.t_text: Lift up your feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy has done wickedly in the sanctuary.

cards.note: Psalm 74:7 — *They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground* — the holy place of sacrifice laid in the dust.
cards.s_text: But now our glorying has been made into dust, And the desire of our soul into sand.'
cards.t_text: They have cast fire into your sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of your name to the ground.
