cards.note: Lamentations 1:2 — *She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks* — the city's unceasing weeping that Baruch makes his own.
cards.s_text: 'O that mine eyes were springs, And mine eyelids a fount of tears.
cards.t_text: She weeps sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks: among all her lovers she has none to comfort her: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.

cards.note: Lamentations 1:1 — *How doth the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow!* — the same mourning over a desolate Jerusalem.
cards.s_text: For how shall I lament for Zion, And how shall I mourn for Jerusalem ?
cards.t_text: How does the city sit solitary, that was full of people! how is she become as a widow! she that was great among the nations, and princess among the provinces, how is she become tributary!

cards.note: Ezekiel 17:24 — *I Yahuah (LORD) have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree* — the proud cedar humbled and the lowly vine exalted by Yahuah's hand.
cards.s_text: Do thou also therefore depart, O cedar, after the forest, which departed before thee, and become dust with it, and let your ashes be mingled together.
cards.t_text: And all the trees of the field shall know that I Yahuah (LORD) have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree to flourish: I Yahuah (LORD) have spoken and have done it.

cards.note: Daniel 7:11 — *I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame* — the cedar's hour come, cast down to become dust.
cards.s_text: But now thy time has sped and thine hour is come.
cards.t_text: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.

cards.note: Daniel 7:8 — *there came up among them another little horn... and a mouth speaking great things* — the last ruler of wickedness, the cedar that uplifted itself.
cards.s_text: And I beheld and lo! that vine opened its mouth and spake and said to that cedar: 'Art thou not that cedar which was left of the forest of wickedness, and by whose means wickedness persisted, and was wrought all those years, and goodness never.
cards.t_text: I considered the horns, and, behold, there came up among them another little horn, before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots: and, behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of man, and a mouth speaking great things.

cards.note: Ezekiel 17:6 — *it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs* — the prophet's vine-and-cedar riddle set before the house of Israel.
cards.s_text: And lo! over against it arose a vine, and from under it there went forth a fountain peacefully.
cards.t_text: And it grew, and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and the roots thereof were under him: so it became a vine, and brought forth branches, and shot forth sprigs.

cards.note: Psalm 80:15 — *the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch that thou madest strong for thyself* — the vine that comes in peace, made strong by Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Also when it had cast it down and had destroyed and rooted out the greater part of that forest, so that nothing was left of it, nor could its place be recognized, then that vine began to come with the fountain in peace and great tranquillity, and it came to a place which was not far from that cedar, and they brought the cedar which had been cast down to it.
cards.t_text: And the vineyard which your right hand has planted, and the branch that you made strong for thyself.

cards.note: Psalm 80:8 — *Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it* — the vine as Yahuah's own planting set over against the nations.
cards.s_text: And lo! over against it arose a vine, and from under it there went forth a fountain peacefully.
cards.t_text: You have brought a vine out of Egypt: you have cast out the heathen, and planted it.

cards.note: Daniel 7:17 — *These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, which shall arise out of the earth* — the forest and its mountains as the succession of earthly kingdoms.
cards.s_text: And lo! a forest of trees planted on the plain, and lofty and rugged rocky mountains surrounded it, and that forest occupied much space.
cards.t_text: These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, which shall arise out of the earth.

cards.note: Daniel 2:35 — *the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth* — the rising power that prevails over the whole forest of kingdoms.
cards.s_text: And the height of the forest began to be made low, and the top of the mountains was made low and that fountain prevailed greatly, so that it left nothing of that great forest save one cedar only.
cards.t_text: Then was the iron, the clay, the brass, the silver, and the gold, broken to pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshingfloors; and the wind carried them away, that no place was found for them: and the stone that smote the image became a great mountain, and filled the whole earth.

cards.note: Daniel 2:34 — *a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet... and brake them to pieces* — the kingdoms overthrown by a power not raised up by man.
cards.s_text: Now that fountain came to the forest and was (stirred) into great waves, and those waves submerged that forest, and suddenly they rooted out the greater part of that forest, and overthrew all the mountains which were round about it.
cards.t_text: You saw till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.

cards.note: Daniel 7:14 — *his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away* — the vine growing with unfading flowers, the Anointed's enduring kingdom.
cards.s_text: And after these things I saw that cedar burning, and the vine growing, itself and all around it, the plain full of unfading flowers. And I indeed awoke and arose.
cards.t_text: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

cards.note: 2 Thessalonians 2:8 — *whom Yahusha (Lord) shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:* — the last wicked one burned away before the reign that grows in peace.
cards.s_text: And after these things I saw that cedar burning, and the vine growing, itself and all around it, the plain full of unfading flowers. And I indeed awoke and arose.
cards.t_text: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

cards.note: Isaiah 11:4 — *he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked* — the Anointed's word that consumes the burning cedar.
cards.s_text: And after these things I saw that cedar burning, and the vine growing, itself and all around it, the plain full of unfading flowers. And I indeed awoke and arose.
cards.t_text: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

cards.note: Psalm 119:51 — *yet have I not declined from thy law* — the lifelong fidelity Baruch claims as he asks for the vision's meaning.
cards.s_text: For Thou knowest that my soul hath always walked in Thy law, and from my (earliest) days I departed not from Thy wisdom.'
cards.t_text: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from your law.

cards.note: Psalm 119:34 — *Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart* — the prayer for understanding from one who walks in the law.
cards.s_text: For Thou knowest that my soul hath always walked in Thy law, and from my (earliest) days I departed not from Thy wisdom.'
cards.t_text: Give me understanding, and I shall keep your law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

cards.note: Psalm 119:105 — *Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path* — the law as the light that enlightens those led by understanding.
cards.s_text: Thy law is life, and Thy wisdom is right guidance.
cards.t_text: Your word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

cards.note: Psalm 119:142 — *thy law is the truth* — the Torah as the right guidance Baruch names wisdom.
cards.s_text: Thy law is life, and Thy wisdom is right guidance.
cards.t_text: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and your law is the truth.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:20 — *for he is thy life, and the length of thy days* — the law of Yahuah held up as Israel's very life, just as Baruch confesses.
cards.s_text: Thy law is life, and Thy wisdom is right guidance.
cards.t_text: That you may love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and that you may obey his voice, and that you may cleave unto him: for he is your life, and the length of your days: that you may dwell in the land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

cards.note: Ps 2:6 — *Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion* — the Anointed installed by the Father, the principate revealed that Baruch names My Messiah.
cards.s_text: And it will come to pass when the time of its consummation that it should fall has approached, then the principate of My Messiah will be revealed, which is like the fountain and the vine, and when it is revealed it will root out the multitude of its host.
cards.t_text: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.

cards.note: Isa 11:1 — *And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots* — the shoot of David's hope, the vine and fountain Baruch sees rise as the Messiah's principate.
cards.s_text: And it will come to pass when the time of its consummation that it should fall has approached, then the principate of My Messiah will be revealed, which is like the fountain and the vine, and when it is revealed it will root out the multitude of its host.
cards.t_text: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:

cards.note: Dan 2:44 — *And in the days of these kings shall the Elohim (God) of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed... it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever* — the kingdom revealed at the empires' end, Baruch's principate of the Messiah.
cards.s_text: And it will come to pass when the time of its consummation that it should fall has approached, then the principate of My Messiah will be revealed, which is like the fountain and the vine, and when it is revealed it will root out the multitude of its host.
cards.t_text: And in the days of these kings shall the Elohim (God) of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.

cards.note: Dan 2:34 — *Thou sawest till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces* — the stone that smites the last kingdom at its hour, as the Messiah roots out the fourth kingdom's host.
cards.s_text: And it will come to pass when the time of its consummation that it should fall has approached, then the principate of My Messiah will be revealed, which is like the fountain and the vine, and when it is revealed it will root out the multitude of its host.
cards.t_text: You saw till that a stone was cut out without hands, which smote the image upon his feet that were of iron and clay, and brake them to pieces.

cards.note: Dan 7:17 — *These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, which shall arise out of the earth* — four kingdoms arising in succession, the frame Baruch's angel interprets.
cards.s_text: Behold! the days come, and this kingdom will be destroyed which once destroyed Zion, and it will be subjected to that which comes after it.
cards.t_text: These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, which shall arise out of the earth.

cards.note: Dan 7:7 — *behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly... it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it* — the fourth beast more evil than all before it, Baruch's fourth kingdom in Daniel's other vision.
cards.s_text: And after these things a fourth kingdom will arise, whose power will be harsh and evil far beyond those which were before it, and it will rule many times as the forests on the plain, and it will hold fast for times, and will exalt itself more than the cedars of Lebanon.
cards.t_text: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth: it devoured and brake in pieces, and stamped the residue with the feet of it: and it was diverse from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.

cards.note: Dan 2:40 — *And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaketh in pieces and subdueth all things... shall it break in pieces and bruise* — the harsh fourth kingdom far beyond the rest, the same Baruch names.
cards.s_text: And after these things a fourth kingdom will arise, whose power will be harsh and evil far beyond those which were before it, and it will rule many times as the forests on the plain, and it will hold fast for times, and will exalt itself more than the cedars of Lebanon.
cards.t_text: And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron: forasmuch as iron breaks in pieces and subdueth all things: and as iron that breaks all these, shall it break in pieces and bruise.

cards.note: Dan 2:39 — *And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth* — the second and third kingdoms succeeding, as Baruch's vision counts them off.
cards.s_text: Moreover, that also again after a time will be destroyed, and another, a third, will arise, and that also will have dominion for its time, and will be destroyed.
cards.t_text: And after you shall arise another kingdom inferior to you, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.

cards.note: Dan 2:44 — *shall the Elohim (God) of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed... and it shall stand for ever* — the kingdom that stands for ever, the very promise Baruch makes of the Messiah's principate.
cards.s_text: And his principate will stand for ever, until the world of corruption is at an end, and until the times aforesaid are fulfilled.
cards.t_text: And in the days of these kings shall the Elohim (God) of heaven set up a kingdom, which shall never be destroyed: and the kingdom shall not be left to other people, but it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand for ever.

cards.note: Dan 7:27 — *whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him* — the enduring kingdom given to the saints under their King, the dominion Baruch says will stand for ever.
cards.s_text: And his principate will stand for ever, until the world of corruption is at an end, and until the times aforesaid are fulfilled.
cards.t_text: And the kingdom and dominion, and the greatness of the kingdom under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the saints of the El Elyon (most High), whose kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.

cards.note: Dan 7:14 — *And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom... his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed* — the principate that stands for ever, Baruch's word for the Messiah's reign.
cards.s_text: And his principate will stand for ever, until the world of corruption is at an end, and until the times aforesaid are fulfilled.
cards.t_text: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

cards.note: Rev 19:20 — *And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet... These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone* — the last leader taken and his host destroyed, as Baruch's vision ends.
cards.s_text: 'The last leader of that time will be left alive, when the multitude of his hosts will be put to the sword, and he will be bound, and they will take him up to Mount Zion, and My Messiah will convict him of all his impieties, and will gather and set before him all the works of his hosts.
cards.t_text: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet that wrought miracles before him, with which he deceived them that had received the mark of the beast, and them that worshipped his image. These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.

cards.note: Dan 7:11 — *I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame* — the last ruler convicted and put to death, Baruch's leader taken up to Zion and slain.
cards.s_text: 'The last leader of that time will be left alive, when the multitude of his hosts will be put to the sword, and he will be bound, and they will take him up to Mount Zion, and My Messiah will convict him of all his impieties, and will gather and set before him all the works of his hosts.
cards.t_text: I beheld then because of the voice of the great words which the horn spake: I beheld even till the beast was slain, and his body destroyed, and given to the burning flame.

cards.note: 2 Thess 2:8 — *And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom Yahusha (Lord) shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:* — the lawless one slain by the Messiah's word, the same convicting-and-slaying Baruch describes.
cards.s_text: And afterwards he will put him to death, and protect the rest of My people which shall be found in the place which I have chosen.
cards.t_text: And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming:

cards.note: Isa 11:4 — *he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked* — the Anointed putting the impious ruler to death, exactly the deed Baruch's Messiah does on Zion.
cards.s_text: And afterwards he will put him to death, and protect the rest of My people which shall be found in the place which I have chosen.
cards.t_text: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

cards.note: Ruth 1:16 — *whither thou goest, I will go... thy people shall be my people, and thy Elohim (God) my Elohim (God)* — the outsider fleeing beneath the wings of Israel's Elohim, Baruch's refuge picture.
cards.s_text: But others again I have seen who have forsaken their vanity, and fled for refuge beneath Thy wings.
cards.t_text: And Ruth said, Intreat me not to leave you, or to return from following after you: for whither you go, I will go; and where you lodgest, I will lodge: your people shall be my people, and your Elohim (God) my Elohim (God):

cards.note: Isa 56:6 — *Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to Yahuah (LORD), to serve him... that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant* — the stranger who takes up the covenant, the ones Baruch sees fled for refuge.
cards.s_text: But others again I have seen who have forsaken their vanity, and fled for refuge beneath Thy wings.
cards.t_text: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to Yahuah (LORD), to serve him, and to love the name of Yahuah (LORD), to be his servants, every one that keeps the sabbath from polluting it, and takes hold of my covenant;

cards.note: Rom 11:17 — *And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree* — the stranger grafted in, Baruch's refugees fled beneath the wings.
cards.s_text: But others again I have seen who have forsaken their vanity, and fled for refuge beneath Thy wings.
cards.t_text: And if some of the branches be broken off, and you, being a wild olive tree, were graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

cards.note: Rom 11:20 — *because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear* — the natural branches broken off, Baruch's people who cast off the yoke of the law.
cards.s_text: For lo! I see many of Thy people who have withdrawn from Thy covenant, and cast from them the yoke of Thy law.
cards.t_text: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:

cards.note: Isa 26:19 — *Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust... and the earth shall cast out the dead* — the earth casting out its dead, the very giving-back Baruch commands of the dust.
cards.s_text: For corruption shall take those that belong to it, and life those that belong to it.
cards.t_text: Your dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, you that dwell in dust: for your dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.

cards.note: Dan 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt* — the dust commanded to give back its dead, Baruch's word that the grave must raise up what it kept.
cards.s_text: And the dust shall be called, and there shall be said to it: "Give back that which is not thine, and raise up all that thou hast kept until its time".'
cards.t_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

cards.note: Rom 11:23 — *And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for Elohim (God) is able to graff them in again* — withdrawal and return both possible, the same weighing of times Baruch describes.
cards.s_text: As for those who were before subject, and afterwards withdrew and mingled themselves with the seed of mingled peoples, the time of these was the former, and was accounted as something exalted.
cards.t_text: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for Elohim (God) is able to graff them in again.

cards.note: Isa 56:3 — *Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to Yahuah (LORD), speak, saying, Yahuah (LORD) hath utterly separated me from his people* — the joiner not cut off and the apostate not secure, the reckoning Baruch sets out.
cards.s_text: As for those who were before subject, and afterwards withdrew and mingled themselves with the seed of mingled peoples, the time of these was the former, and was accounted as something exalted.
cards.t_text: Neither let the son of the stranger, that has joined himself to Yahuah (LORD), speak, saying, Yahuah (LORD) has utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.

cards.note: Exod 12:49 — *One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among you* — one Torah for native and joiner alike, the ground on which Baruch's withdrawn and drawn-near are weighed.
cards.s_text: And as for those who before knew not but afterwards knew life, and mingled (only) with the seed of the people which had separated itself, the time of these (is) the latter, and is accounted as something exalted.
cards.t_text: One law shall be to him that is homeborn, and unto the stranger that sojourns among you.

cards.note: Exod 12:48 — *And when a stranger shall sojourn with thee, and will keep the passover... let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near... and he shall be as one that is born in the land* — the stranger drawn near to the separated people, Baruch's proselytes joined to the covenant.
cards.s_text: And as for those who before knew not but afterwards knew life, and mingled (only) with the seed of the people which had separated itself, the time of these (is) the latter, and is accounted as something exalted.
cards.t_text: And when a stranger shall sojourn with you, and will keep the passover to Yahuah (LORD), let all his males be circumcised, and then let him come near and keep it; and he shall be as one that is born in the land: for no uncircumcised person shall eat thereof.

cards.note: 1 Pet 1:4 — *To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you* — the eternal consolation laid up beyond corruption, the very hope Baruch is told awaits him.
cards.s_text: 'But, do thou, Baruch, direct thy heart to that which has been said to thee, And understand those things which have been shown to thee; For there are many eternal consolations for thee.
cards.t_text: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

cards.note: Matt 5:19 — *whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven* — those who do and teach the commandments inherit greatly, Baruch's heirs of the world to come who kept the law.
cards.s_text: For these are they who shall inherit that time which has been spoken of, And theirs is the inheritance of the promised time.
cards.t_text: Whosoever therefore shall break one of these least commandments, and shall teach men so, he shall be called the least in the kingdom of heaven: but whosoever shall do and teach them, the same shall be called great in the kingdom of heaven.

cards.note: Ps 19:7 — *The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple* — the law that gives wisdom, Baruch's treasures of wisdom and the truth of the law preserved.
cards.s_text: These are they who have acquired for themselves treasures of wisdom, And with them are found stores of understanding, And from mercy have they not withdrawn, And the truth of the law have they preserved.
cards.t_text: The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.

cards.note: Ps 19:11 — *Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward* — great reward bound to keeping the law, the inheritance Baruch gives those who preserved the truth of the law.
cards.s_text: These are they who have acquired for themselves treasures of wisdom, And with them are found stores of understanding, And from mercy have they not withdrawn, And the truth of the law have they preserved.
cards.t_text: Moreover by them is your servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

cards.note: Deut 6:2 — *That thou mightest fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to keep all his statutes and his commandments... that thy days may be prolonged* — enduring in His fear and keeping the law that the times may turn for good, exactly Baruch's promise.
cards.s_text: For if ye endure and persevere in His fear, And do not forget His law, The times shall change over you for good, And ye shall see the consolation of Zion.
cards.t_text: That you might fear Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you, you, and your son, and your son’s son, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.

cards.note: Deut 6:6 — *And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart* — the commandments guarded and not forgotten, Baruch's way of the law admonished to the people who remain.
cards.s_text: But withdraw ye not from the way of the law, But guard and admonish the people which remain, Lest they withdraw from the commandments of the Mighty One.
cards.t_text: And these words, which I command you this day, shall be in your heart:

cards.note: Josh 1:8 — *This book of the law shall not depart out of thy mouth; but thou shalt meditate therein day and night, that thou mayest observe to do according to all that is written therein* — the law not to be withdrawn from, the same charge Baruch lays on his son and the elders.
cards.s_text: But withdraw ye not from the way of the law, But guard and admonish the people which remain, Lest they withdraw from the commandments of the Mighty One.
cards.t_text: This book of the law shall not depart out of your mouth; but you shall meditate therein day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written therein: for then you shall make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.

cards.note: Deut 6:7 — *And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house* — the law diligently taught, Baruch's labour of instructing the people.
cards.s_text: 'Do ye therefore so far as ye are able instruct the people, for that labour is ours. For if ye teach them, ye will quicken them.'
cards.t_text: And you shall teach them diligently unto your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you risest up.

cards.note: Ps 19:7 — *The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple* — the law that quickens the soul, the very life Baruch says teaching gives the people.
cards.s_text: 'Do ye therefore so far as ye are able instruct the people, for that labour is ours. For if ye teach them, ye will quicken them.'
cards.t_text: The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.

cards.note: Ps 19:11 — *Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward* — good coming to those who keep the commandments, the good tidings Baruch promises hearts prepared to obey.
cards.s_text: For if ye do these things, Good tidings shall come unto you. [Which I before told you of; nor shall ye fall into the torment, of which I testified to you before.'
cards.t_text: Moreover by them is your servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

cards.note: Deut 6:24 — *And Yahuah (LORD) commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), for our good always, that he might preserve us alive* — keeping the law for good and life, Baruch's good tidings to those who obey.
cards.s_text: But only prepare ye your hearts, that ye may obey the law, And be subject to those who in fear are wise and understanding; And prepare your souls that ye may not depart from them.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God), for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.

cards.note: Matt 5:17 — *Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil* — the law not failing nor passing, Baruch's son of the law never wanting to Jacob.
cards.s_text: And I said unto them: 'The throne of the Mighty One I cannot resist; Nevertheless, there shall not be wanting to Yashar'el (Israel) a wise man Nor a son of the law to the race of Jacob.
cards.t_text: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.

cards.note: Deut 6:7 — *And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children... when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way* — the law to be passed on lest it be lost, the lack the elders fear and Baruch answers.
cards.s_text: For where again shall we seek the law, Or who will distinguish for us between death and life?'
cards.t_text: And you shall teach them diligently unto your children, and shall talk of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you risest up.

cards.note: Exod 34:28 — *And he was there with Yahuah (LORD) forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water* — Moses fasts at the appointed place before the words of the covenant are given.
cards.s_text: And I came to that place where the word had been spoken unto me, and I sat there, and fasted seven days.
cards.t_text: And he was there with Yahuah (LORD) forty days and forty nights; he did neither eat bread, nor drink water. And he wrote upon the tables the words of the covenant, the ten commandments.

cards.note: Dan 10:3 — *I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled* — the seer fasts in mourning before the vision is unsealed.
cards.s_text: And I came to that place where the word had been spoken unto me, and I sat there, and fasted seven days.
cards.t_text: I ate no pleasant bread, neither came flesh nor wine in my mouth, neither did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.

cards.note: Mal 4:4 — *Remember ye the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Yashar'el (Israel), with the statutes and judgments* — they perish because they remembered not the law of the Mighty One.
cards.s_text: Because each of the inhabitants of the earth knew when he was transgressing. But My Law they knew not by reason of their pride.
cards.t_text: Remember you the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded unto him in Horeb for all Yashar'el (Israel), with the statutes and judgments.

cards.note: Jas 5:9 — *behold, the judge standeth before the door* — the Judge shall come and will not tarry.
cards.s_text: Therefore a fire shall consume their thoughts, And in flame shall the meditations of their reins be tried; For the Judge shall come and will not tarry.
cards.t_text: Grudge not one against another, brethren, lest you be condemned: behold, the judge stands before the door.

cards.note: Mal 4:1 — *behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven... and the day that cometh shall burn them up* — a fire shall consume the thoughts of the proud who knew not His law.
cards.s_text: Therefore a fire shall consume their thoughts, And in flame shall the meditations of their reins be tried; For the Judge shall come and will not tarry.
cards.t_text: For, behold, the day comes, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that comes shall burn them up, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.

cards.note: Ps 103:14 — *For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust* — protect us in Thy compassions, for he is nothing.
cards.s_text: Protect us in Thy compassions, And in Thy mercy help us.
cards.t_text: For he knows our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

cards.note: Ps 90:4 — *For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night* — with Thee hours are as a time, and days as generations.
cards.s_text: But with Thee hours are as a time, And days as generations.
cards.t_text: For a thousand years in your sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

cards.note: Ps 103:15 — *As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth* — in a little time are we born and return.
cards.s_text: For in a little time are we born, And in a little time do we return.
cards.t_text: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

cards.note: Ps 119:89 — *For ever, O Yahuah (LORD), thy word is settled in heaven* — the law amongst us abides; therefore we shall not fall.
cards.s_text: For we are all one celebrated people, Who have received one law from One: And the law which is amongst us will aid us, And the surpassing wisdom which is in us will help us.'
cards.t_text: For ever, O Yahuah (LORD), your word is settled in heaven.

cards.note: Rom 7:12 — *Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good* — the one law received from One is no burden but the people's surpassing wisdom.
cards.s_text: For we are all one celebrated people, Who have received one law from One: And the law which is amongst us will aid us, And the surpassing wisdom which is in us will help us.'
cards.t_text: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

cards.note: Deut 30:11 — *For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not hidden from thee, neither is it far off* — the law is with us, near and able to aid us.
cards.s_text: But I will speak now before Thee, And I will say as my heart thinketh. In Thee do we trust, for lo! Thy law is with us, And we know that we shall not fall so long as we keep Thy statutes.
cards.t_text: For this commandment which I command you this day, it is not hidden from you, neither is it far off.

cards.note: Deut 30:20 — *for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land* — with Him is the law of life; keeping His statutes is life itself.
cards.s_text: But I will speak now before Thee, And I will say as my heart thinketh. In Thee do we trust, for lo! Thy law is with us, And we know that we shall not fall so long as we keep Thy statutes.
cards.t_text: That you may love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and that you may obey his voice, and that you may cleave unto him: for he is your life, and the length of your days: that you may dwell in the land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

cards.note: Rom 4:17 — *even Elohim (God), who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.* — with a word He quickens that which was not.
cards.s_text: With nods of fear and indignation Thou commandest the flames, And they change into spirits, And with a word Thou quickenest that which was not, And with mighty power Thou holdest that which has not yet come.
cards.t_text: (As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even Elohim (God), who quickens the dead, and calls those things which be not as though they were.

cards.note: Neh 9:6 — *thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host... and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee* — the innumerable armies stand and minister before Him.
cards.s_text: Armies innumerable stand before Thee And minister in their orders quietly at Thy nod.
cards.t_text: You, even you, are Yahuah (LORD) alone; you have made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and you preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth you.

cards.note: Ps 104:4 — *Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire* — the flames change into spirits at His command.
cards.s_text: With nods of fear and indignation Thou commandest the flames, And they change into spirits, And with a word Thou quickenest that which was not, And with mighty power Thou holdest that which has not yet come.
cards.t_text: Who makes his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:

cards.note: Job 38:5 — *Who hath laid the measures thereof, if thou knowest? or who hath stretched the line upon it?* — the limit of the heights and the depths belong to the Maker alone.
cards.s_text: Thou explorest the limit of the heights, And Thou scrutinizest the depths of the darkness.
cards.t_text: Who has laid the measures thereof, if you know? or who has stretched the line upon it?

cards.note: Job 38:4 — *Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding* — the LORD answers out of the whirlwind with the very measures Baruch confesses he cannot reach.
cards.s_text: Thou makest known the multitude of the fire, And Thou weighest the lightness of the wind.
cards.t_text: Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if you have understanding.

cards.note: Ps 74:16 — *The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun* — He arranges the method of the seasons, and they obey.
cards.s_text: Thou arrangest the method of the seasons, And they obey Thee.
cards.t_text: The day is yours, the night also is yours: you have prepared the light and the sun.

cards.note: Dan 7:10 — *thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened* — the duration of the generations is in His hand.
cards.s_text: Thou alone knowest the duration of the generations, And Thou revealest not Thy mysteries to many.
cards.t_text: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

cards.note: Dan 2:21 — *And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding* — the ages and seasons obey the Most High alone.
cards.s_text: 'O my Lord, Thou summonest the advent of the times, And they stand before Thee; Thou causest the power of the ages to pass away, And they do not resist Thee;
cards.t_text: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and sets up kings: he gives wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:

cards.note: 1 Cor 15:51 — *Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed* — these things which have been in the world shall be changed, as Baruch wonders.
cards.s_text: Will they then resume this form of the present, And put on these entrammelling members, Which are now involved in evils, And in which evils are consummated, Or wilt Thou perchance change these things which have been in the world As also the world?"'
cards.t_text: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,

cards.note: 1 Cor 15:35 — *But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?* — the identical question: in what shape will the dead live.
cards.s_text: "In what shape will those live who live in Thy day? Or how will the splendour of those who (are) after that time continue?
cards.t_text: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?

cards.note: Dan 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt* — the dust restores both the just and the condemned for judgment.
cards.s_text: For the earth shall then assuredly restore the dead, [Which it now receives, in order to preserve them]. It shall make no change in their form, But as it has received, so shall it restore them, And as I delivered them unto it, so also shall it raise them.
cards.t_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

cards.note: 1 Cor 15:36 — *Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die* — the departed have returned, the sown seed quickened to life again.
cards.s_text: For then it will be necessary to show to the living that the dead have come to life again, and that those who had departed have returned (again).
cards.t_text: You fool, that which you sowest is not quickened, except it die:

cards.note: John 5:29 — *And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation* — they are raised and then judgment grows strong.
cards.s_text: And it shall come to pass, when they have severally recognized those whom they now know, then judgement shall grow strong, and those things which before were spoken of shall come.
cards.t_text: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

cards.note: John 5:28 — *the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice* — the earth restores the dead it received.
cards.s_text: For the earth shall then assuredly restore the dead, [Which it now receives, in order to preserve them]. It shall make no change in their form, But as it has received, so shall it restore them, And as I delivered them unto it, so also shall it raise them.
cards.t_text: Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice,

cards.note: Rom 2:13 — *For not the hearers of the law are just before Elohim (God), but the doers of the law shall be justified.* — the lost stopped their ears against the law and so were condemned.
cards.s_text: For over this above all shall those who come then lament, that they rejected My law, and stopped their ears that they might not hear wisdom or receive understanding.
cards.t_text: (For not the hearers of the law are just before Elohim (God), but the doers of the law shall be justified.

cards.note: Ps 19:7 — *The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple* — to them the law has been a hope and wisdom a confidence.
cards.s_text: But those who have been saved by their works, And to whom the law has been now a hope, And understanding an expectation, And wisdom a confidence, Shall wonders appear in their time.
cards.t_text: The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.

cards.note: 1 Cor 15:42 — *So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption* — time shall no longer age them.
cards.s_text: And time shall no longer age them.
cards.t_text: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

cards.note: 1 Cor 15:49 — *And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly* — they dwell in the heights of that world, ageless.
cards.s_text: For in the heights of that world shall they dwell, And they shall be made like unto the angels, And be made equal to the stars, And they shall be changed into every form they desire, From beauty into loveliness, And from light into the splendour of glory.
cards.t_text: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

cards.note: Phil 3:21 — *Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body* — the form of their face turned into the splendour of glory.
cards.s_text: Also (as for) the glory of those who have now been justified in My law, who have had understanding in their life, and who have planted in their heart the root of wisdom, then their splendour shall be glorified in changes, and the form of their face shall be turned into the light of their beauty, that they may be able to acquire and receive the world which does not die, which is then promised to them.
cards.t_text: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.

cards.note: 1 Cor 15:52 — *In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump... the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed* — they shall respectively be transformed at the appointed day.
cards.s_text: When therefore they see those, over whom they are now exalted, (but) who shall then be exalted and glorified more than they, they shall respectively be transformed, the latter into the splendour of angels, and the former shall yet more waste away in wonder at the visions and in the beholding of the forms.
cards.t_text: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

cards.note: 1 Cor 15:44 — *It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body* — changed into every form they desire, into the splendour of glory.
cards.s_text: For in the heights of that world shall they dwell, And they shall be made like unto the angels, And be made equal to the stars, And they shall be changed into every form they desire, From beauty into loveliness, And from light into the splendour of glory.
cards.t_text: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

cards.note: 1 Cor 15:40 — *There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another* — the risen are clothed with the heavenly glory.
cards.s_text: For in the heights of that world shall they dwell, And they shall be made like unto the angels, And be made equal to the stars, And they shall be changed into every form they desire, From beauty into loveliness, And from light into the splendour of glory.
cards.t_text: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.

cards.note: 1 Cor 15:41 — *There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory* — made equal to the stars, from light into the splendour of glory.
cards.s_text: For in the heights of that world shall they dwell, And they shall be made like unto the angels, And be made equal to the stars, And they shall be changed into every form they desire, From beauty into loveliness, And from light into the splendour of glory.
cards.t_text: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.

cards.note: Matt 22:30 — *For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of Elohim (God) in heaven* — they shall be made like unto the angels.
cards.s_text: For in the heights of that world shall they dwell, And they shall be made like unto the angels, And be made equal to the stars, And they shall be changed into every form they desire, From beauty into loveliness, And from light into the splendour of glory.
cards.t_text: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of Elohim (God) in heaven.

cards.note: Ps 1:2 — *But his delight is in the law of Yahuah (LORD); and in his law doth he meditate day and night* — the root of wisdom planted in the heart is delight in the Torah.
cards.s_text: Also (as for) the glory of those who have now been justified in My law, who have had understanding in their life, and who have planted in their heart the root of wisdom, then their splendour shall be glorified in changes, and the form of their face shall be turned into the light of their beauty, that they may be able to acquire and receive the world which does not die, which is then promised to them.
cards.t_text: But his delight is in the law of Yahuah (LORD); and in his law does he meditate day and night.

cards.note: Matt 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear* — the splendour of those justified in His law, glorified.
cards.s_text: Also (as for) the glory of those who have now been justified in My law, who have had understanding in their life, and who have planted in their heart the root of wisdom, then their splendour shall be glorified in changes, and the form of their face shall be turned into the light of their beauty, that they may be able to acquire and receive the world which does not die, which is then promised to them.
cards.t_text: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who has ears to hear, let him hear.

cards.note: Dan 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever* — the form of their face turned into the light of their beauty.
cards.s_text: Also (as for) the glory of those who have now been justified in My law, who have had understanding in their life, and who have planted in their heart the root of wisdom, then their splendour shall be glorified in changes, and the form of their face shall be turned into the light of their beauty, that they may be able to acquire and receive the world which does not die, which is then promised to them.
cards.t_text: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

cards.note: Matt 5:12 — *Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven* — make ready your soul for that which is reserved.
cards.s_text: Rejoice ye in the suffering which ye now suffer: For why do ye look for the decline of your enemies?
cards.t_text: Rejoice, and be exceeding glad: for great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.

cards.note: 1 Pet 1:4 — *To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you* — the reward which is laid up for you.
cards.s_text: Make ready your soul for that which is reserved for you, And prepare your souls for the reward which is laid up for you.']
cards.t_text: To an inheritance incorruptible, and undefiled, and that fadeth not away, reserved in heaven for you,

cards.note: Rom 5:3 — *we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience* — rejoice ye in the suffering which ye now suffer.
cards.s_text: Rejoice ye in the suffering which ye now suffer: For why do ye look for the decline of your enemies?
cards.t_text: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation works patience;

cards.note: Daniel 2:22 — *he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him* — the dominion-taking light that overcomes the darkness of the last black waters.
cards.s_text: And it took hold of the whole earth, and had dominion over it.
cards.t_text: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.

cards.note: Psalms 36:9 — *For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light* — the healing lightning that illumines the whole earth is the light of Yahuah by which the nations see.
cards.s_text: Now that lightning shone exceedingly, so as to illuminate the whole earth, and it healed those regions where the last waters had descended and wrought devastation.
cards.t_text: For with you is the fountain of life: in your light shall we see light.

cards.note: Amos 4:13 — *he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that maketh the morning darkness... Yahuah (LORD), The Elohim (God) of hosts, is his name* — the One who shows mortals his counsel and turns morning to darkness.
cards.s_text: And when I had said these things I fell asleep there, and I saw a vision, and lo! a cloud was ascending from a very great sea, and I kept gazing upon it, and lo! it was full of waters white and black, and there were many colours in those self-same waters, and as it were the likeness of great lightning was seen at its summit.
cards.t_text: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that makes the morning darkness, and treads upon the high places of the earth, Yahuah (LORD), The Elohim (God) of hosts, is his name.

cards.note: Daniel 2:22 — *He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knoweth what is in the darkness, and the light dwelleth with him* — the same unveiling of black and bright that Baruch receives in the cloud.
cards.s_text: And when I had said these things I fell asleep there, and I saw a vision, and lo! a cloud was ascending from a very great sea, and I kept gazing upon it, and lo! it was full of waters white and black, and there were many colours in those self-same waters, and as it were the likeness of great lightning was seen at its summit.
cards.t_text: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.

cards.note: Daniel 2:21 — *And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and setteth up kings: he giveth wisdom unto the wise* — the twelve alternating rains are the times and seasons the Most High governs.
cards.s_text: Now this was done twelve times, but the black were always more numerous than the bright.
cards.t_text: And he changeth the times and the seasons: he removeth kings, and sets up kings: he gives wisdom unto the wise, and knowledge to them that know understanding:

cards.note: Psalms 19:9 — *the judgments of Yahuah (LORD) are true and righteous altogether* — the consummation when he glorifies the faithful and blots out those who sin is righteous judgement, not caprice.
cards.s_text: For those who are amongst Thine own Thou rulest, And those who sin Thou blottest out from amongst Thine own.'
cards.t_text: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of Yahuah (LORD) are true and righteous altogether.

cards.note: Romans 5:12 — *death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned* — the wickedness that earns vengeance at the consummation is each soul's own, the ground Baruch lays in 54:19.
cards.s_text: For at the consummation of the world vengeance shall be taken upon those who have done wickedness according to their wickedness, And Thou wilt glorify the faithful according to their faithfulness.
cards.t_text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

cards.note: Psalms 19:7 — *The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul* — those who perish are they *who have not loved Thy law* (54:14); the law is the standard each soul is measured by, not a thing passed away.
cards.s_text: And justly do they perish who have not loved Thy law, And the torment of judgement shall await those who have not submitted themselves to Thy power.
cards.t_text: The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 15:22 — *For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah (Christ) shall all be made alive* — the death from the one man, and the life that answers it in the Anointed.
cards.s_text: For though Adam first sinned And brought untimely death upon all, Yet of those who were born from him Each one of them has prepared for his own soul torment to come, And again each one of them has chosen for himself glories to come.
cards.t_text: For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah (Christ) shall all be made alive.

cards.note: Romans 5:12 — *as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned* — Adam brought untimely death upon all, yet all sinned and each answers for himself, exactly Baruch's balance.
cards.s_text: For though Adam first sinned And brought untimely death upon all, Yet of those who were born from him Each one of them has prepared for his own soul torment to come, And again each one of them has chosen for himself glories to come.
cards.t_text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

cards.note: Psalms 36:9 — *in thy light shall we see light* — the One who lights up what is dark and reveals what is prepared to those who fear him.
cards.s_text: (Thou) who revealest to those who fear Thee what is prepared for them, That thenceforth they may be comforted.
cards.t_text: For with you is the fountain of life: in your light shall we see light.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 2:9 — *Eye hath not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which Elohim (God) hath prepared for them that love him* — what is hidden, revealed to the pure who submit to him and his law.
cards.s_text: Thou showest great acts to those who know not; Thou breakest up the enclosure of those who are ignorant, And lightest up what is dark, And revealest what is hidden to the pure, [Who in faith have submitted themselves to Thee and Thy law.]
cards.t_text: But as it is written, Eye has not seen, nor ear heard, neither have entered into the heart of man, the things which Elohim (God) has prepared for them that love him.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 2:10 — *Elohim (God) hath revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of Elohim (God)* — the very depths Baruch says come as the heights to the One who alone knows them.
cards.s_text: (Thou) to whom the depths come as the heights, And whose word the beginnings of the ages serve:
cards.t_text: But Elohim (God) has revealed them unto us by his Spirit: for the Spirit searcheth all things, yea, the deep things of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Deuteronomy 29:29 — *The secret things belong unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God): but those things which are revealed belong unto us... that we may do all the words of this law* — the deep things of the world are the Most High's own secret, revealed for obedience.
cards.s_text: And I besought the Mighty One, and said: 'Thou alone, O Yahuah (Lord), knowest of aforetime the deep things of the world, And the things which befall in their times Thou bringest about by Thy word, And against the works of the inhabitants of the earth Thou dost hasten the beginnings of the times, And the end of the seasons Thou alone knowest.
cards.t_text: The secret things belong unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God): but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.

cards.note: Psalms 19:9 — *the judgments of Yahuah (LORD) are true and righteous altogether* — the majesty's revealing that *shall convict these and cause those to rejoice* is righteous judgement.
cards.s_text: And if thou hast heard tidings of the good and evil things which are then coming and art grieved, What (wilt thou be) when thou shalt behold what the majesty will reveal, Which shall convict these and cause those to rejoice.'
cards.t_text: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of Yahuah (LORD) are true and righteous altogether.

cards.note: Amos 4:13 — *Yahuah (LORD), The Elohim (God) of hosts, is his name* (with v12, *prepare to meet thy Elohim*) — the advent of the day of the Mighty One that Baruch dreads to behold manifestly.
cards.s_text: And if with the expectation wherewith thou dost expect the day of the Mighty One thou art so overcome, What (wilt thou be) when thou shalt come to its advent?
cards.t_text: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, that makes the morning darkness, and treads upon the high places of the earth, Yahuah (LORD), The Elohim (God) of hosts, is his name.

cards.note: Daniel 2:22 — *He revealeth the deep and secret things... the light dwelleth with him* — the true vision is opened by the One who reveals secrets, here through his angel Ramael.
cards.s_text: And when I was pondering on these things and the like, lo! the angel Ramiel who presides over true visions was sent to me, and he said unto me:
cards.t_text: He revealeth the deep and secret things: he knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.

cards.note: 1 Peter 3:20 — *when once the longsuffering of Elohim (God) waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water* — the deluge that destroyed those who dwelt on the earth.
cards.s_text: And those who dwelt on the earth perished together (with them) through the waters of the deluge.
cards.t_text: Which sometime were disobedient, when once the longsuffering of Elohim (God) waited in the days of Noah, while the ark was a preparing, wherein few, that is, eight souls were saved by water.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 6:2 — *the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men* — the watchers' descent the same scene Baruch's vision recalls.
cards.s_text: And some of them descended, and mingled with the women.
cards.t_text: And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: ‘Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.’

cards.note: Genesis 6:2 — *the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose* — the angels who descended and mingled with the women.
cards.s_text: And some of them descended, and mingled with the women.
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 15:21 — *For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead* — death entered by the one man, the very darkness of the first black waters.
cards.s_text: For [since] when he transgressed Untimely death came into being, Grief was named And anguish was prepared, And pain was created, And trouble consummated, And disease began to be established, And Sheol kept demanding that it should be renewed in blood, And the begetting of children was brought about, And the passion of parents produced, And the greatness of humanity was humiliated, And goodness languished.
cards.t_text: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.

cards.note: Genesis 3:19 — *In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground... for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return* — the untimely death, grief, and toil born of the transgression.
cards.s_text: For [since] when he transgressed Untimely death came into being, Grief was named And anguish was prepared, And pain was created, And trouble consummated, And disease began to be established, And Sheol kept demanding that it should be renewed in blood, And the begetting of children was brought about, And the passion of parents produced, And the greatness of humanity was humiliated, And goodness languished.
cards.t_text: In the sweat of your face shall you eat bread, till you return unto the ground; for out of it were you taken: for dust you are, and unto dust shall you return.

cards.note: Genesis 3:6 — *the woman saw that the tree was good for food... she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat* — the transgression itself that Ramael names.
cards.s_text: And as thou didst previously see on the summit of the cloud black waters which descended previously on the earth, this is the transgression wherewith Adam the first man transgressed.
cards.t_text: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.

cards.note: Romans 5:12 — *as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned* — the first black waters, Adam's transgression bringing untimely death.
cards.s_text: And as thou didst previously see on the summit of the cloud black waters which descended previously on the earth, this is the transgression wherewith Adam the first man transgressed.
cards.t_text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

cards.note: Hebrews 11:10 — *For he looked for a city which hath foundations, whose builder and maker is Elohim (God)* — the promise of the life that should come hereafter, implanted in Abraham.
cards.s_text: Because at that time the unwritten law was named amongst them, And the works of the commandments were then fulfilled, And belief in the coming judgement was then generated, And hope of the world that was to be renewed was then built up, And the promise of the life that should come hereafter was implanted.
cards.t_text: For he looked for a city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is Elohim (God).

cards.note: Romans 4:13 — *the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was... through the righteousness of faith* — Baruch's hope of the world that was to be renewed, built up in Abraham.
cards.s_text: Because at that time the unwritten law was named amongst them, And the works of the commandments were then fulfilled, And belief in the coming judgement was then generated, And hope of the world that was to be renewed was then built up, And the promise of the life that should come hereafter was implanted.
cards.t_text: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

cards.note: Galatians 3:6 — *Even as Abraham believed Elohim (God), and it was accounted to him for righteousness* — the unwritten law and works of the commandments fulfilled in the patriarch's faith.
cards.s_text: Because at that time the unwritten law was named amongst them, And the works of the commandments were then fulfilled, And belief in the coming judgement was then generated, And hope of the world that was to be renewed was then built up, And the promise of the life that should come hereafter was implanted.
cards.t_text: Even as Abraham believed Elohim (God), and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

cards.note: Genesis 15:6 — *And he believed in Yahuah (LORD); and he counted it to him for righteousness* — the fount of Abraham, the bright waters of faith that Ramael names.
cards.s_text: 'And after these (waters) thou didst see bright waters: this is the fount of Abraham, also his generations and advent of his son, and of his son's son, and of those like them.
cards.t_text: And he believed in Yahuah (LORD); and he counted it to him for righteousness.

cards.note: Psalms 105:25 — *He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants* — Egypt's subtle dealing that, as Baruch says, perished at last.
cards.s_text: Nevertheless, these also perished at last.
cards.t_text: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

cards.note: Exodus 1:22 — *Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born ye shall cast into the river* — *they made their sons to serve* and worse, the black third waters of the nations' wickedness.
cards.s_text: 'And the black third waters which thou hast seen, these are the mingling of all sins, which the nations afterwards wrought after the death of those righteous men, and the wickedness of the land of Egypt, wherein they did wickedly in the service wherewith they made their sons to serve.
cards.t_text: And Pharaoh charged all his people, saying, Every son that is born you shall cast into the river, and every daughter you shall save alive.

cards.note: Exodus 1:14 — *they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field... was with rigour* — the wickedness of Egypt, the service wherewith they made Israel serve.
cards.s_text: 'And the black third waters which thou hast seen, these are the mingling of all sins, which the nations afterwards wrought after the death of those righteous men, and the wickedness of the land of Egypt, wherein they did wickedly in the service wherewith they made their sons to serve.
cards.t_text: And they made their lives bitter with hard bondage, in morter, and in brick, and in all manner of service in the field: all their service, wherein they made them serve, was with rigour.

cards.note: Hebrews 12:21 — *And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake* — the quaking of Sinai when He took Moses unto Himself and showed him the pattern of Zion.
cards.s_text: For He showed him many admonitions together with the principles of the law and the consummation of the times, as also to thee, and likewise the pattern of Zion and its measures, in the pattern of which the sanctuary of the present time was to be made.
cards.t_text: And so terrible was the sight, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:)

cards.note: Deuteronomy 4:12 — *Yahuah (LORD) spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice* — Moses receiving the principles of the law amid the shaken heavens.
cards.s_text: But also the heavens at that time were shaken from their place, and those who were under the throne of the Mighty One were perturbed, when He was taking Moses unto Himself.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: you heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only you heard a voice.

cards.note: Exodus 19:18 — *mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because Yahuah (LORD) descended upon it in fire... and the whole mount quaked greatly* — the heavens and the mount shaken when Moses was taken up.
cards.s_text: But also the heavens at that time were shaken from their place, and those who were under the throne of the Mighty One were perturbed, when He was taking Moses unto Himself.
cards.t_text: And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because Yahuah (LORD) descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.

cards.note: Exodus 20:1 — *And Elohim (God) spake all these words, saying* — the advent of Moses and the giving of the commandments, the bright waters of Sinai.
cards.s_text: 'And the bright fourth waters which thou hast seen are the advent of Moses and Aaron and Miriam and Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb and of all those like them.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) spake all these words, saying,

cards.note: Psalms 19:8 — *The statutes of Yahuah (LORD) are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) is pure, enlightening the eyes* — the law as light, exactly Baruch's bright fourth waters.
cards.s_text: For at that time the lamp of the eternal law shone on all those who sat in darkness, which announced to them that believe the promise of their reward, and to them that deny, the torment of fire which is reserved for them.
cards.t_text: The statutes of Yahuah (LORD) are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of Yahuah (LORD) is pure, enlightening the eyes.

cards.note: Psalms 19:7 — *The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple* — the lamp of the eternal law shining on those who sat in darkness, counted among the bright waters.
cards.s_text: For at that time the lamp of the eternal law shone on all those who sat in darkness, which announced to them that believe the promise of their reward, and to them that deny, the torment of fire which is reserved for them.
cards.t_text: The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.

cards.note: Judges 2:12 — *they forsook Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers... and followed other gods... and provoked Yahuah (LORD) to anger* — Israel drawn after the Amorites' pollution though they had seen many signs.
cards.s_text: But even Yashar'el (Israel) was then polluted by sins in the days of the judges, though they saw many signs which were from Him who made them.
cards.t_text: And they forsook Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of their fathers, which brought them out of the land of Egypt, and followed other gods, of the gods of the people that were round about them, and bowed themselves unto them, and provoked Yahuah (LORD) to anger.

cards.note: Judges 2:11 — *the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and served Baalim* — Israel polluted by sins in the days of the judges, just as Baruch says.
cards.s_text: But even Yashar'el (Israel) was then polluted by sins in the days of the judges, though they saw many signs which were from Him who made them.
cards.t_text: And the children of Yashar'el (Israel) did evil in the sight of Yahuah (LORD), and served Baalim:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 9:4 — *for the wickedness of these nations Yahuah (LORD) doth drive them out from before thee* — the works of the Amorites, the black fifth waters of incantation and pollution.
cards.s_text: 'And the black fifth waters which thou hast seen raining are the works which the Amorites wrought, and the spells of their incantations which they wrought, and the wickedness of their mysteries, and the mingling of their pollution.
cards.t_text: Speak not you in your heart, after that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has cast them out from before you, saying, For my righteousness Yahuah (LORD) has brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations Yahuah (LORD) does drive them out from before you.

cards.note: 1 Chr 22:9 — *who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Yashar'el (Israel) in his days.* — Solomon, the man of rest, in whose days the land was beloved and glorified, as Baruch tells.
cards.s_text: And the land [which] was then beloved by Yahuah (Lord), And because its inhabitants sinned not, it was glorified beyond all lands, And the city Zion ruled then over all lands and regions.
cards.t_text: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Yashar'el (Israel) in his days.

cards.note: Ps 72:2 — *He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment* — the judgement of the rulers without guile that the bright waters commend.
cards.s_text: And the judgement of the rulers was then seen to be without guile, And the righteousness of the precepts of the Mighty One was accomplished with truth.
cards.t_text: He shall judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with judgment.

cards.note: Ps 72:7 — *In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth* — the peace and tranquillity of the bright waters, the prayer for the king's son.
cards.s_text: And peace and tranquillity existed at that time,
cards.t_text: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endures.
