cards.t_text: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, whither you go over Jordan to possess it.

cards.note: 2 Cor 6:2 — *behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.* — the open day of repentance Baruch says will not return once the age is past, so turn now.
cards.s_text: For lo! when the El Elyon (Most High) will bring to pass all these things, There shall not there be again [a place of repentance, nor] a limit to the times, Nor a duration for the hours, Nor a change of ways, Nor place for prayer, Nor sending of petitions, Nor receiving of knowledge, Nor giving of love, Nor place of repentance for the soul, Nor supplication for offences, Nor intercession of the fathers, Nor prayer of the prophets, Nor help of the righteous.
cards.t_text: (For he says, I have heard you in a time accepted, and in the day of salvation have I succoured you: behold, now is the accepted time; behold, now is the day of salvation.)

cards.note: Eccl 12:14 — *Elohim (God) shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil* — the judgement that exacts its due, for which Baruch says prepare your soul.
cards.s_text: Before therefore judgement exact its own, And truth that which is its due, Let us prepare our soul That we may possess, and not be taken possession of, And that we may hope and not be put to shame, And that we may rest with our fathers, and not be tormented with our enemies.
cards.t_text: For Elohim (God) shall bring every work into judgment, with every secret thing, whether it be good, or whether it be evil.

cards.note: Heb 9:27 — *as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment* — the judgement after death for which Baruch bids them prepare their souls and not be condemned when they depart.
cards.s_text: And again prepare your souls, so that when ye sail and ascend from the ship ye may have rest and not be condemned when ye depart.
cards.t_text: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:

cards.note: Amos 8:12 — *they shall wander... to seek the word of Yahuah (LORD), and shall not find it* — the day with no place for prayer nor prophet that Baruch warns is coming.
cards.s_text: For lo! when the El Elyon (Most High) will bring to pass all these things, There shall not there be again [a place of repentance, nor] a limit to the times, Nor a duration for the hours, Nor a change of ways, Nor place for prayer, Nor sending of petitions, Nor receiving of knowledge, Nor giving of love, Nor place of repentance for the soul, Nor supplication for offences, Nor intercession of the fathers, Nor prayer of the prophets, Nor help of the righteous.
cards.t_text: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, they shall run to and fro to seek the word of Yahuah (LORD), and shall not find it.

cards.note: Amos 8:11 — *I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread... but of hearing the words of Yahuah (LORD)* — the famine of the prophetic word Baruch laments now that the prophets have fallen asleep.
cards.s_text: But now the righteous have been gathered, And the prophets have fallen asleep, And we also have gone forth from the land, And Zion has been taken from us, And we have nothing now save the Mighty One and His law.
cards.t_text: Behold, the days come, says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD), that I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of Yahuah (LORD):

cards.note: Eccl 12:13 — *Fear Elohim (God), and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man* — the conclusion of the whole matter, the law that remains when prophets sleep and Zion is gone.
cards.s_text: But now the righteous have been gathered, And the prophets have fallen asleep, And we also have gone forth from the land, And Zion has been taken from us, And we have nothing now save the Mighty One and His law.
cards.t_text: Let us hear the conclusion of the whole matter: Fear Elohim (God), and keep his commandments: for this is the whole duty of man.

cards.note: Ps 119:89 — *For ever, O Yahuah (LORD), thy word is settled in heaven* — the law that abides though Zion falls, the one thing not taken away from Israel.
cards.s_text: But now the righteous have been gathered, And the prophets have fallen asleep, And we also have gone forth from the land, And Zion has been taken from us, And we have nothing now save the Mighty One and His law.
cards.t_text: For ever, O Yahuah (LORD), your word is settled in heaven.

cards.note: Ps 19:7 — *The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure* — the law that remains to Israel when all else is taken, perfect and sure as Baruch confesses.
cards.s_text: But now the righteous have been gathered, And the prophets have fallen asleep, And we also have gone forth from the land, And Zion has been taken from us, And we have nothing now save the Mighty One and His law.
cards.t_text: The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.

cards.note: Rev 1:3 — *Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein* — the blessing on reading, hearing, and keeping, as Baruch bids them read and meditate.
cards.s_text: And meditate thereon, above all on the days of your fasts.
cards.t_text: Blessed is he that readeth, and they that hear the words of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand.

cards.note: Neh 8:3 — *he read therein... and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law* — the public reading to the assembly Baruch bids them do with his epistle.
cards.s_text: When therefore ye receive this my epistle, read it in your congregations with care.
cards.t_text: And he read therein before the street that was before the water gate from the morning until midday, before the men and the women, and those that could understand; and the ears of all the people were attentive unto the book of the law.

cards.note: Deut 31:12 — *Gather the people together, men, and women, and children... that they may hear, and that they may learn* — the law read before the gathered congregation, the pattern Baruch's epistle follows.
cards.s_text: When therefore ye receive this my epistle, read it in your congregations with care.
cards.t_text: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and your stranger that is within your gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God), and observe to do all the words of this law:

cards.note: Col 4:16 — *when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans* — a letter sent to be read aloud in the assemblies, exactly as Baruch charges the tribes.
cards.s_text: When therefore ye receive this my epistle, read it in your congregations with care.
cards.t_text: And when this epistle is read among you, cause that it be read also in the church of the Laodiceans; and that you likewise read the epistle from Laodicea.

cards.note: Isa 40:31 — *they that wait upon Yahuah (LORD) shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles* — the eagle's wings that carry the captive tribes' hope, as Baruch sends his word by the eagle.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass when I had ended all the words of this epistle, and had written it sedulously to its close, that I folded it, and sealed it carefully, and bound it to the neck of the eagle, and dismissed and sent it.
cards.t_text: But they that wait upon Yahuah (LORD) shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.

cards.note: Deut 32:11 — *As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young... beareth them on her wings* — the eagle of Moses' song that bears Israel, the figure Baruch's eagle-borne letter to the tribes answers to.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass when I had ended all the words of this epistle, and had written it sedulously to its close, that I folded it, and sealed it carefully, and bound it to the neck of the eagle, and dismissed and sent it.
cards.t_text: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreads abroad her wings, takes them, bears them on her wings:

cards.note: Genesis 49:4 — *Unstable as water, thou shalt not excel; because thou wentest up to thy father's bed; then defiledst thou it: he went up to my couch.* Jacob's dying word names the same sin and the lost pre-eminence the testament now laments.
cards.s_text: And behold I call to witness against you this day the Elohim (God) of heaven, that ye walk not in the ignorance of youth and fornication, wherein I was poured out, and defiled the bed of my father Jacob.
cards.t_text: Unstable as water, you shall not excel; because you went up to your father’s bed; then defiledst you it: he went up to my couch.

cards.note: Genesis 35:22 — *And it came to pass, when Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father's concubine: and Yashar'el (Israel) heard it.* The deed Reuben confesses defiling "the bed of my father Jacob" is the very act Moses set down.
cards.s_text: And behold I call to witness against you this day the Elohim (God) of heaven, that ye walk not in the ignorance of youth and fornication, wherein I was poured out, and defiled the bed of my father Jacob.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass, when Yashar'el (Israel) dwelt in that land, that Reuben went and lay with Bilhah his father’s concubine: and Yashar'el (Israel) heard it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve:

cards.note: Proverbs 6:25 — *Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.* — the warning to "pay no heed to the face of a woman" is Solomon's counsel against the strange woman word for word.
cards.s_text: Pay no heed to the face of a woman, Nor associate with another man's wife, Nor meddle with affairs of womankind.
cards.t_text: Lust not after her beauty in your heart; neither let her take you with her eyelids.

cards.note: James 1:15 — *Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.* — Reuben's mind "taking in the thought of the woman's nakedness" until the deed is done is this very sequence.
cards.s_text: For my mind taking in the thought of the woman's nakedness, suffered me not to sleep until I had wrought the abominable thing.
cards.t_text: Then when lust has conceived, it brings forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, brings forth death.

cards.note: Galatians 5:22 — *But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,* — against the spirits of error Reuben sets the love of truth, the same Spirit's fruit Paul commends.
cards.s_text: And now, my children, love the truth, and it will preserve you: hear ye the words of Reuben your father.
cards.t_text: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, longsuffering, gentleness, goodness, faith,

cards.note: Galatians 5:19 — *Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,* — Paul's catalogue of the flesh begins where Reuben begins, with the spirit of fornication seated in the senses.
cards.s_text: First, the spirit of fornication is seated in the nature and in the senses; the second, the spirit of insatiableness, in the belly;
cards.t_text: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are these; Adultery, fornication, uncleanness, lasciviousness,

cards.note: Proverbs 6:19 — *A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.* — the spirit of injustice and concealment from kindred is the abomination Solomon set last in the seven.
cards.s_text: The seventh is the spirit of injustice, with which are thefts and acts of rapacity, that a man may fulfil the desire of his heart; for injustice worketh together with the other spirits by the taking of gifts.
cards.t_text: A false witness that speaks lies, and he that sows discord among brethren.

cards.note: Proverbs 6:17 — *A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,* — the spirit of pride and the spirit of lying Reuben names stand among the things Yahuah hates.
cards.s_text: The fifth is the spirit of pride, that one may be boastful and arrogant. The sixth is the spirit of lying, in perdition and in jealousy, to practise deceits, and concealments from kindred and friends.
cards.t_text: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

cards.note: Galatians 5:16 — *This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and ye shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.* — Reuben's charge to "walk in singleness of heart in the fear of Yahuah" is the same path Paul calls walking in the Spirit.
cards.s_text: Pay no heed, therefore, my children, to the beauty of women, nor set your mind on their affairs; but walk in singleness of heart in the fear of Yahuah (Lord), and expend labour on good works, and on study and on your flocks, until Yahuah (Lord) give you a wife, whom He will, that ye suffer not as I did.
cards.t_text: This I say then, Walk in the Spirit, and you shall not fulfil the lust of the flesh.

cards.note: Genesis 49:22 — *Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:* — the brother Reuben sets up as the pattern of purity is the same Joseph Jacob blessed above his brethren.
cards.s_text: For hear ye regarding Joseph how he guarded himself from a woman, and purged his thoughts from all fornication, and found favour in the sight of Elohim (God) and men.
cards.t_text: Joseph is a fruitful bough, even a fruitful bough by a well; whose branches run over the wall:

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* — the Watchers who abandoned heaven to take women are the angels Jude says are kept in chains.
cards.s_text: For thus they allured the Watchers who were before the flood; for as these continually beheld them, they lusted after them, and they conceived the act in their mind; for they changed themselves into the shape of men, and appeared to them when they were with their husbands.
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 7:2 — *And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells:* — the giants born of the Watchers, reaching "even unto heaven," are Enoch's offspring of the fallen ones.
cards.s_text: And the women lusting in their minds after their forms, gave birth to giants, for the Watchers appeared to them as reaching even unto heaven.
cards.t_text: And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells:

cards.note: 1 Enoch 6:2 — *And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: 'Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.'* — Reuben's Watchers who "lusted after them" are Enoch's angels by name.
cards.s_text: For thus they allured the Watchers who were before the flood; for as these continually beheld them, they lusted after them, and they conceived the act in their mind; for they changed themselves into the shape of men, and appeared to them when they were with their husbands.
cards.t_text: And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: ‘Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.’

cards.note: Genesis 6:4 — *There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.* — that the women "gave birth to giants" is the very offspring Genesis names.
cards.s_text: And the women lusting in their minds after their forms, gave birth to giants, for the Watchers appeared to them as reaching even unto heaven.
cards.t_text: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

cards.note: Genesis 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* — the Watchers "who were before the flood" lusting after women is Moses' record of the sons of Elohim.
cards.s_text: For thus they allured the Watchers who were before the flood; for as these continually beheld them, they lusted after them, and they conceived the act in their mind; for they changed themselves into the shape of men, and appeared to them when they were with their husbands.
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: Galatians 5:14 — *For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.* — Reuben's charge "to do truth each one unto his neighbour and to entertain love each one for his brother" is the one word in which the whole law is summed.
cards.s_text: I adjure you by the Elohim (God) of heaven to do truth each one unto his neighbour and to entertain love each one for his brother.
cards.t_text: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; You shall love your neighbour as thyself.

cards.note: Genesis 49:10 — *The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.* — that the chosen one shall "bless Yashar'el and Yahudah" and be king joins Levi's priesthood to Judah's sceptre and Shiloh.
cards.s_text: For he shall bless Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah), because him hath Yahuah (Lord) chosen to be king over all the nation.
cards.t_text: The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

cards.note: Numbers 24:17 — *there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.* — the "eternal king" before whose seed Reuben bids them bow is the Star and Sceptre Balaam foresaw.
cards.s_text: And bow down before his seed, for on our behalf it will die in wars visible and invisible, and will be among you an eternal king.
cards.t_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

cards.note: Zechariah 6:12 — *Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD):* — the anointed priest of whom Yahuah spake is the Branch the prophet names.
cards.s_text: Therefore I command you to hearken to Levi, because he shall know the law of Yahuah (Lord), and shall give ordinances for judgment and shall sacrifice for all Yashar'el (Israel) until the consummation of the times, as the anointed High Priest, of whom Yahuah (Lord) spake.
cards.t_text: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD):

cards.note: Zechariah 6:13 — *Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD); and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.* — that the chosen one is both priest who sacrifices and "king over all the nation" is the priest upon his throne, the joined hope of Levi and Judah.
cards.s_text: For he shall bless Yashar'el (Israel) and Yahudah (Judah), because him hath Yahuah (Lord) chosen to be king over all the nation.
cards.t_text: Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD); and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

cards.note: Psalm 110:4 — *Yahuah (LORD) hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).* — Levi as "the anointed High Priest, of whom Yahuah spake" sacrificing "until the consummation of the times" is the everlasting priesthood Yahuah swore.
cards.s_text: Therefore I command you to hearken to Levi, because he shall know the law of Yahuah (Lord), and shall give ordinances for judgment and shall sacrifice for all Yashar'el (Israel) until the consummation of the times, as the anointed High Priest, of whom Yahuah (Lord) spake.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) has sworn, and will not repent, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).

cards.note: Prov 27:4 — *Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?* — the unstanding-before-envy that left Simeon five months wrathful until his hand withered.
cards.s_text: And I knew, my children, that because of Joseph this had befallen me, and I repented and wept; and I besought Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) that my hand might be restored, and that I might hold aloof from all pollution and envy, 'and from all folly'.
cards.t_text: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?

cards.note: Gen 37:22 — *And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.* — Reuben's intent to restore Joseph, which the testament preserves: "he wished to restore him to his father."
cards.s_text: And when Reuben heard these things he was grieved, for he wished to restore him to his father.
cards.t_text: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.

cards.note: Gen 37:27 — *Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.* — Judah's counsel that Simeon recalls, "Yahudah (Judah) my brother sold him to the Ishmaelites."
cards.s_text: For when I went to Shechem to bring ointment for the flocks, and Reuben to Dothan, where were our necessaries and all our stores, Yahudah (Judah) my brother sold him to the Ishmaelites.
cards.t_text: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.

cards.note: Prov 14:30 — *A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.* — Solomon's diagnosis of the envious heart that Simeon now repents of.
cards.s_text: For I knew that I had devised an evil thing before Yahuah (Lord) and Jacob my father, on account of Joseph my brother, in that I envied him.
cards.t_text: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

cards.note: 1 Jn 3:12 — *Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.* — the apostle traces brother-murder to envy, just as Simeon traces his plot to "the prince of deceit."
cards.s_text: And I set my mind against him to destroy him, because the prince of deceit sent forth the spirit of jealousy and blinded my mind, so that I regarded him not as a brother, nor did I spare even Jacob my father.
cards.t_text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

cards.note: Gen 37:11 — *And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.* — Moses' one word, "envied," is the seed of Simeon's whole testament.
cards.s_text: For in the time of my youth I was jealous 'in many things' of Joseph, because my father loved him 'beyond all'.
cards.t_text: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.

cards.note: Gen 37:4 — *And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.* — the very father-love and brother-hate Simeon now confesses by name.
cards.s_text: For in the time of my youth I was jealous 'in many things' of Joseph, because my father loved him 'beyond all'.
cards.t_text: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

cards.note: James 3:15 — *This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.* — the "evil spirit" that runneth away when a man flees to the Lord is the devilish wisdom James names.
cards.s_text: For if a man flee to Yahuah (Lord), the evil spirit runneth away from him, and his mind is lightened.
cards.t_text: This wisdom descends not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish.

cards.note: Prov 14:27 — *The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.* — the very deliverance Simeon found: "deliverance from envy cometh by the fear of Elohim (God)."
cards.s_text: Two years 'therefore' I afflicted my soul with fasting in the fear of Yahuah (Lord), and I learnt that deliverance from envy cometh by the fear of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: The fear of Yahuah (LORD) is a fountain of life, to depart from the snares of death.

cards.note: James 3:16 — *For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.* — envy's fruit, the same root Simeon names that "suffereth him 'neither to eat nor to drink', nor to do any good thing."
cards.s_text: For envy ruleth over the whole mind of a man, and suffereth him 'neither to eat nor to drink', nor to do any good thing.
cards.t_text: For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work.

cards.note: Prov 14:30 — *A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.* — the wasting Simeon describes, "he that envieth fadeth away."
cards.s_text: For envy ruleth over the whole mind of a man, and suffereth him 'neither to eat nor to drink', nor to do any good thing.
cards.t_text: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

cards.note: Gal 5:21 — *Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like... they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of Elohim (God).* — the savage works of the flesh, envy that "stirreth up unto deeds of blood."
cards.s_text: For this maketh savage the soul and destroyeth the body; it causeth anger and war in the mind, and stirreth up unto deeds of blood, and leadeth the mind into frenzy, 'and suffereth not prudence to act in men; moreover, it taketh away sleep', [and causeth tumult to the soul and trembling to the body].
cards.t_text: Envyings, murders, drunkenness, revellings, and such like: of the which I tell you before, as I have also told you in time past, that they which do such things shall not inherit the kingdom of Elohim (God).

cards.note: 1 Jn 3:14 — *We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.* — "love each one his brother with a good heart," the proof of life John names.
cards.s_text: Do ye also, my children, love each one his brother with a good heart, and the spirit of envy will withdraw from you.
cards.t_text: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loves not his brother abides in death.

cards.note: Gal 5:14 — *For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.* — the brother-love Simeon commands, the law's one word.
cards.s_text: Do ye also, my children, love each one his brother with a good heart, and the spirit of envy will withdraw from you.
cards.t_text: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; You shall love your neighbour as thyself.

cards.note: Gen 50:21 — *Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.* — Joseph who "gave us riches, and cattle and fruits" and reproached them not.
cards.s_text: All his days he reproached us not concerning this thing, but loved us as his own soul, and beyond his own sons glorified us, and gave us riches, and cattle and fruits.
cards.t_text: Now therefore fear you not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.

cards.note: Gen 45:5 — *Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for Elohim (God) did send me before you to preserve life.* — Joseph comforting the very brothers Simeon confesses to, compassionate and pitiful.
cards.s_text: Now Joseph was a good man, and had the Spirit of Elohim (God) within him: being compassionate and pitiful, he bore no malice against me; but loved me even as the rest of his brethren.
cards.t_text: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me hither: for Elohim (God) did send me before you to preserve life.

cards.note: Gen 50:20 — *But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.* — Joseph's own word, the good man who "bore no malice against me."
cards.s_text: Now Joseph was a good man, and had the Spirit of Elohim (God) within him: being compassionate and pitiful, he bore no malice against me; but loved me even as the rest of his brethren.
cards.t_text: But as for you, you thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

cards.note: Zech 6:13 — *and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.* — the division "in Levi and Yahudah (Judah)," priest and king at peace, that Simeon names.
cards.s_text: And they shall be few in number, divided in Levi and Yahudah (Judah), and there shall be none of you for sovereignty, even as also our father prophesied in his blessings.
cards.t_text: Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD); and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

cards.note: Num 24:17 — *there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel)* — the sovereignty that falls not to Simeon but to the sceptre Balaam foresaw out of Judah.
cards.s_text: And they shall be few in number, divided in Levi and Yahudah (Judah), and there shall be none of you for sovereignty, even as also our father prophesied in his blessings.
cards.t_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

cards.note: Gen 6:11 — *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* — fornication "mother of all evils," filling the earth with corruption as in Noah's day.
cards.s_text: Beware, therefore, of fornication, For fornication is mother of all evils, Separating from Elohim (God), and bringing near to Beliar.
cards.t_text: The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.

cards.note: Gen 6:2 — *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* — the fornication of the Watchers that "bringing near to Beliar," the root Enoch expounds.
cards.s_text: Beware, therefore, of fornication, For fornication is mother of all evils, Separating from Elohim (God), and bringing near to Beliar.
cards.t_text: That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 8:2 — *And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.* — the very "writing of Enoch" Simeon cites that his sons "shall be corrupted in fornication."
cards.s_text: For I have seen it inscribed in the writing of Enoch that your sons shall be corrupted in fornication, and shall do harm to the sons of Levi with the sword.
cards.t_text: And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.

cards.note: Isa 11:10 — *And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.* — the day Simeon shall "arise in joy," the rest of the appearing King.
cards.s_text: Then shall I arise in joy, And will bless the El Elyon (Most High) because of His marvellous works, [Because Elohim (God) hath taken a body and eaten with men and saved men].
cards.t_text: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.

cards.note: Zech 14:11 — *And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.* — "all the earth rest from trouble, and all the world under heaven from war."
cards.s_text: Then shall fail the land of Ham, And all the people shall perish. Then shall all the earth rest from trouble, And all the world under heaven from war.
cards.t_text: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.

cards.note: Zech 14:21 — *in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).* — the spirits of deceit trodden under foot and the Canaanite removed in the day of the Lord.
cards.s_text: Then shall all the spirits of deceit be given to be trodden under foot, And men shall rule over wicked spirits.
cards.t_text: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Yahudah (Judah) shall be holiness unto Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).

cards.note: Gen 9:26 — *Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.* — "the Mighty One of Yashar'el (Israel) shall glorify Shem" and Canaan perish, Noah's blessing fulfilled.
cards.s_text: Then the Mighty One of Yashar'el (Israel) shall glorify Shem, For Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) shall appear on earth, And save the sons of men.
cards.t_text: And he said, Blessed be Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.

cards.note: Zech 14:9 — *And Yahuah (LORD) shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one Yahuah (LORD), and his name one.* — "Yahuah Elohim shall appear on earth" when all the earth rests from war.
cards.s_text: Then the Mighty One of Yashar'el (Israel) shall glorify Shem, For Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) shall appear on earth, And save the sons of men.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one Yahuah (LORD), and his name one.

cards.note: Mal 3:1 — *and Yahuah (Lord), whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant... behold, he shall come, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).* — the Lord appearing on earth to save, the coming Simeon foresees.
cards.s_text: Then the Mighty One of Yashar'el (Israel) shall glorify Shem, For Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) shall appear on earth, And save the sons of men.
cards.t_text: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and Adonai (Lord), whom you seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom you delight in: behold, he shall come, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).

cards.note: Exod 13:8 — *And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which Yahuah (LORD) did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.* — the charge to command one's children that Simeon repeats: "that ye also may command your children."
cards.s_text: Therefore I give you these commands that ye also may command your children, that they may observe them throughout their generations.
cards.t_text: And you shall shew your son in that day, saying, This is done because of that which Yahuah (LORD) did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.

cards.note: Heb 7:25 — *Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto Elohim (God) by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.* — "He shall save all [the Gentiles and] the race of Yashar'el (Israel)," the salvation arising from the two tribes.
cards.s_text: For Yahuah (Lord) shall raise up from Levi as it were a High-priest, and from Yahudah (Judah) as it were a King [Elohim (God) and man], He shall save all [the Gentiles and] the race of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto Elohim (God) by him, seeing he ever lives to make intercession for them.

cards.note: Heb 7:14 — *For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.* — the King out of Judah made a priest, the change Simeon's priest-king foretells.
cards.s_text: For Yahuah (Lord) shall raise up from Levi as it were a High-priest, and from Yahudah (Judah) as it were a King [Elohim (God) and man], He shall save all [the Gentiles and] the race of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

cards.note: Ps 110:4 — *Yahuah (LORD) hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).* — the High-priest from Levi who is also the King at the right hand, David's Lord.
cards.s_text: For Yahuah (Lord) shall raise up from Levi as it were a High-priest, and from Yahudah (Judah) as it were a King [Elohim (God) and man], He shall save all [the Gentiles and] the race of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) has sworn, and will not repent, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).

cards.note: Zech 6:13 — *and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.* — priest and king joined in one, the salvation from Levi and Judah.
cards.s_text: For Yahuah (Lord) shall raise up from Levi as it were a High-priest, and from Yahudah (Judah) as it were a King [Elohim (God) and man], He shall save all [the Gentiles and] the race of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD); and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

cards.note: Num 24:17 — *there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel)* — the King from Judah whom Simeon bids his sons obey.
cards.s_text: For Yahuah (Lord) shall raise up from Levi as it were a High-priest, and from Yahudah (Judah) as it were a King [Elohim (God) and man], He shall save all [the Gentiles and] the race of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

cards.note: Exod 13:21 — *And Yahuah (LORD) went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light* — light for Israel as the Egyptians sat in the darkness the sorcerers foretold at the bones' departure.
cards.s_text: For the sorcerers told them, that on the departure of the bones of Joseph there should be throughout all the land darkness and gloom, and an exceeding great plague to the Egyptians, so that even with a lamp a man should not recognise his brother.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

cards.note: Josh 24:32 — *And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem... and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.* — the bones at last laid in the land, the homecoming the oath promised.
cards.s_text: For the bones of Joseph the Egyptians guarded in the tombs of the Kings.
cards.t_text: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

cards.note: Exod 13:19 — *And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Elohim (God) will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.* — the very departure of Joseph's bones at the Exodus that the testament foresees.
cards.s_text: For the bones of Joseph the Egyptians guarded in the tombs of the Kings.
cards.t_text: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Elohim (God) will surely visit you; and you shall carry up my bones away hence with you.

cards.note: Gen 50:25 — *And Joseph took an oath of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Elohim (God) will surely visit you, and ye shall carry up my bones from hence.* — the oath behind the guarded bones of Joseph the testament names.
cards.s_text: For the bones of Joseph the Egyptians guarded in the tombs of the Kings.
cards.t_text: And Joseph took an oath of the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Elohim (God) will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from hence.

cards.note: Malachi 3:1 — *Yahuah (Lord), whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant.* The Lord appearing among men through Levi's priesthood is the Lord coming to His temple.
cards.s_text: And by thee and Yahudah (Judah) shall Yahuah (Lord) appear among men, [Saving every race of men].
cards.t_text: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and Adonai (Lord), whom you seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom you delight in: behold, he shall come, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).

cards.note: Numbers 24:17 — *there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel).* That by Levi and Judah the Lord shall appear and redeem Israel is Balaam's Star-and-Sceptre — the priest-king hope.
cards.s_text: And by thee and Yahudah (Judah) shall Yahuah (Lord) appear among men, [Saving every race of men].
cards.t_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

cards.note: Numbers 18:2 — *thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi... that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee.* Levi's calling to minister before the Lord is the office Moses assigns the tribe.
cards.s_text: And when thou hast ascended thither, Thou shalt stand near Yahuah (Lord), And shalt be His minister, And shalt declare His mysteries to men, And shalt proclaim concerning Him that shall redeem Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: And your brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, bring you with you, that they may be joined unto you, and minister unto you: but you and your sons with you shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.

cards.note: 2 Enoch 3:1 — *bore him up on to the first heaven and placed him on the clouds ... and showed me a very great Sea, greater than the earthly sea.* Enoch's ascent to the first heaven and its great sea is the same first heaven and "great sea hanging" Levi enters.
cards.s_text: And I entered from the first heaven, and I saw there a great sea hanging.
cards.t_text: It came to pass, when Enoch had told his sons, that the angels took him on to their wings and bore him up on to the first heaven and placed him on the clouds. And there I looked, and again I looked higher, and saw the ether, and they placed me on the first heaven and showed me a very great Sea, greater than the earthly sea.

cards.note: Matthew 3:16 — *the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of Elohim (God) descending like a dove.* The heavens that open over Levi the priest open again over the Anointed at the Jordan.
cards.s_text: And behold the heavens were opened, and an angel of Elohim (God) said to me, Levi, enter.
cards.t_text: And Yahusha (Jesus), when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of Elohim (God) descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 12:2 — *such an one caught up to the third heaven.* Paul's rapture through the heavens matches Levi's ascent past the first and second toward the throne above.
cards.s_text: And behold the heavens were opened, and an angel of Elohim (God) said to me, Levi, enter.
cards.t_text: I knew a man in Messiah (Christ) above fourteen years ago, (whether in the body, I cannot tell; or whether out of the body, I cannot tell: Elohim (God) knows;) such an one caught up to the third heaven.

cards.note: Ezekiel 1:1 — *as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of Elohim (God).* Ezekiel the priest sees the very thing Levi the priest sees — the heavens opened to a vision of God.
cards.s_text: And behold the heavens were opened, and an angel of Elohim (God) said to me, Levi, enter.
cards.t_text: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, in the fifth day of the month, as I was among the captives by the river of Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Isaiah 6:4 — *the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.* That all are shaken when the Lord looks forth — heaven, earth, and the abysses — is the trembling of the temple at His voice.
cards.s_text: When, therefore, Yahuah (Lord) looketh upon us, all of us are shaken; yea, the heavens, and the earth, and the abysses are shaken at the presence of His majesty.
cards.t_text: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.

cards.note: Revelation 4:8 — *they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty.* John's living creatures keep the same ceaseless praise before the throne Levi is shown.
cards.s_text: And in [the heaven next to this] are thrones and dominions, in which always they offer praise to Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.

cards.note: Isaiah 6:3 — *Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): the whole earth is full of his glory.* The thrones and dominions that 'always they offer praise to Elohim (God)' echo the seraphim's unceasing cry.
cards.s_text: And in [the heaven next to this] are thrones and dominions, in which always they offer praise to Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): the whole earth is full of his glory.

cards.note: Isaiah 6:1 — *I saw also Yahuah (Lord) sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.* The Great Glory dwelling above all in Levi's vision is the throne high and lifted up Isaiah beheld.
cards.s_text: And in the highest of all dwelleth the Great Glory, far above all holiness.
cards.t_text: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also Adonai (Lord) sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.

cards.note: Numbers 24:9 — *He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.* 'They that bless Him shall be blessed, and they that curse Him shall perish' is the blessing spoken over Israel.
cards.s_text: Because they that bless Him shall be blessed, And they that curse Him shall perish.
cards.t_text: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesses you, and cursed is he that curses you.

cards.note: Isaiah 9:2 — *The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light.* Levi lighting 'The light of knowledge shalt thou light up in Jacob' and shining 'as the sun shalt thou be to all the seed of Yashar'el (Israel)' is the great light upon the people.
cards.s_text: The light of knowledge shalt thou light up in Jacob, And as the sun shalt thou be to all the seed of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them has the light shined.

cards.note: Matthew 3:12 — *he will throughly purge his floor... but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.* The unbelieving who persist in iniquity are judged as the chaff in the coming One's hand.
cards.s_text: Now, therefore, know that Yahuah (Lord) shall execute judgment upon the sons of men. Because when the rocks are being rent, And the sun quenched, And the waters dried up, And the fire cowering, And all creation troubled, And the invisible spirits melting away, And Hades taketh spoils through the visitations of the El Elyon (Most High), Men will be unbelieving and persist in their iniquity. On this account with punishment shall they be judged.
cards.t_text: Whose fan is in his hand, and he will throughly purge his floor, and gather his wheat into the garner; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.

cards.note: Isaiah 6:11 — *Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate.* The all-creation-troubled day of visitation matches the prophet's desolating judgment.
cards.s_text: Now, therefore, know that Yahuah (Lord) shall execute judgment upon the sons of men. Because when the rocks are being rent, And the sun quenched, And the waters dried up, And the fire cowering, And all creation troubled, And the invisible spirits melting away, And Hades taketh spoils through the visitations of the El Elyon (Most High), Men will be unbelieving and persist in their iniquity. On this account with punishment shall they be judged.
cards.t_text: Then said I, Adonai (Lord), how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,

cards.note: Genesis 34:31 — *Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?* The vengeance for Dinah is the brothers' own answer in Genesis.
cards.s_text: Then the angel brought me down to the earth, and gave me a shield and a sword, and said to me: Execute vengeance on Shechem because of Dinah, thy sister, and I will be with thee because Yahuah (Lord) hath sent me.
cards.t_text: And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?

cards.note: Genesis 34:25 — *two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.* The shield and sword against Shechem is the deed Moses records of Simeon and Levi.
cards.s_text: Then the angel brought me down to the earth, and gave me a shield and a sword, and said to me: Execute vengeance on Shechem because of Dinah, thy sister, and I will be with thee because Yahuah (Lord) hath sent me.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass on the third day, when they were sore, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brethren, took each man his sword, and came upon the city boldly, and slew all the males.

cards.note: Malachi 3:1 — *Yahuah (Lord), whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple.* 'until I come and sojourn in the midst of Yashar'el (Israel)' is the Lord's promised coming to His temple.
cards.s_text: And He said to me: Levi, I have given thee the blessings of the priesthood until I come and sojourn in the midst of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and Adonai (Lord), whom you seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom you delight in: behold, he shall come, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).

cards.note: Numbers 18:7 — *I have given your priest's office unto you as a service of gift.* The blessings of the priesthood the angel gives Levi are the very office the Lord gave the tribe as a gift.
cards.s_text: And He said to me: Levi, I have given thee the blessings of the priesthood until I come and sojourn in the midst of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: Therefore you and your sons with you shall keep your priest’s office for every thing of the altar, and within the vail; and you shall serve: I have given your priest’s office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that comes nigh shall be put to death.

cards.note: Genesis 34:26 — *And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem's house.* That the brothers smote the city with the edge of the sword is set down in Genesis.
cards.s_text: And after this my brothers came and smote that city with the edge of the sword.
cards.t_text: And they slew Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went out.

cards.note: Genesis 34:13 — *And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully... because he had defiled Dinah their sister.* Levi's counsel about the circumcision of Hamor's sons is the deceitful answer Moses records.
cards.s_text: And I kept these words in my heart. And after this I counselled my father, and Reuben my brother, to bid the sons of Hamor not to be circumcised; for I was jealous because of the abomination which they had wrought on my sister.
cards.t_text: And the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, and said, because he had defiled Dinah their sister:

cards.note: Hebrews 7:12 — *For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.* That Levi's seed is divided 'for a sign of the glory of Yahuah (Lord) who is to come' answers to the changed priesthood Hebrews names.
cards.s_text: And they said to me: Levi, thy seed shall be divided into three offices, for a sign of the glory of Yahuah (Lord) who is to come.
cards.t_text: For the priesthood being changed, there is made of necessity a change also of the law.

cards.note: Hebrews 7:14 — *it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.* That a king of Judah establishes a new priesthood is the change of priesthood Hebrews declares.
cards.s_text: And the third shall be called by a new name, because a king shall arise in Yahudah (Judah), and shall establish a new priesthood, after the fashion of the Gentiles [to all the Gentiles].
cards.t_text: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

cards.note: Psalm 110:4 — *Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).* The new priesthood established by the king of Judah is the priest-king sworn after Melchizedek's order.
cards.s_text: And the third shall be called by a new name, because a king shall arise in Yahudah (Judah), and shall establish a new priesthood, after the fashion of the Gentiles [to all the Gentiles].
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) has sworn, and will not repent, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).

cards.note: Exodus 29:9 — *and the priest's office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and thou shalt consecrate Aaron and his sons.* The seventh filling Levi's hands with incense to serve as priest is the perpetual office Moses consecrates.
cards.s_text: The seventh placed on my head a diadem of priesthood, and filled my hands with incense, that I might serve as priest to Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God).
cards.t_text: And you shall gird them with girdles, Aaron and his sons, and put the bonnets on them: and the priest’s office shall be theirs for a perpetual statute: and you shall consecrate Aaron and his sons.

cards.note: Exodus 29:4 — *And Aaron and his sons thou shalt bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shalt wash them with water.* The second washing Levi with pure water is the washing of the priest at his consecration.
cards.s_text: The second washed me with pure water, and fed me with bread and wine (even) the most holy things, and clad me with a holy and glorious robe.
cards.t_text: And Aaron and his sons you shall bring unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall wash them with water.

cards.note: Exodus 29:7 — *Then shalt thou take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.* The first man anointing Levi with holy oil is Aaron's anointing in the Torah.
cards.s_text: And the first anointed me with holy oil, and gave to me the staff of judgment.
cards.t_text: Then shall you take the anointing oil, and pour it upon his head, and anoint him.

cards.note: Exodus 28:4 — *a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments.* The robe, breastplate, ephod, and turban put upon Levi are the very holy garments Moses commanded for the priest.
cards.s_text: And I saw seven men in white raiment saying unto me: Arise, put on the robe of the priesthood, and the crown of righteousness, and the breastplate of understanding, and the garment of truth, and the plate of faith, and the turban of the head, and the ephod of prophecy.
cards.t_text: And these are the garments which they shall make; a breastplate, and an ephod, and a robe, and a broidered coat, a mitre, and a girdle: and they shall make holy garments for Aaron your brother, and his sons, that he may minister unto me in the priest’s office.

cards.note: Leviticus 2:13 — *with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.* 'Every sacrifice thou shalt salt with salt' is the covenant of salt commanded in the law.
cards.s_text: And of all thy first-fruits and of wine offer the first, as a sacrifice to Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God); and every sacrifice thou shalt salt with salt.
cards.t_text: And every oblation of your meat offering shall you season with salt; neither shall you suffer the salt of the covenant of your Elohim (God) to be lacking from your meat offering: with all your offerings you shall offer salt.

cards.note: Leviticus 11:47 — *To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.* Offering 'of every clean beast and bird' keeps the Torah's distinction of clean and unclean.
cards.s_text: And of every clean beast and bird offer a sacrifice to Yahuah (Lord).
cards.t_text: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.

cards.note: Numbers 18:6 — *I have taken your brethren the Levites... to do the service of the tabernacle.* That Jacob renders the tithe 'through me,' Levi, is the Levites set apart to the service the tithe sustains.
cards.s_text: And he rose up early in the morning, and paid tithes of all to Yahuah (Lord) through me.
cards.t_text: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Yashar'el (Israel): to you they are given as a gift for Yahuah (LORD), to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

cards.note: Genesis 28:22 — *of all that thou shalt give me I will surely give the tenth unto thee.* Jacob paying tithes at Bethel through Levi fulfils his own Bethel vow of the tenth.
cards.s_text: And he rose up early in the morning, and paid tithes of all to Yahuah (Lord) through me.
cards.t_text: And this stone, which I have set for a pillar, shall be Elohim's (God’s) house: and of all that you shall give me I will surely give the tenth unto you.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 90:29 — *And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.* The house the Lord shall choose, named from the book of Enoch, is the new house Enoch saw the Lord gather His own into.
cards.s_text: For the house which Yahuah (Lord) shall choose shall be called Jerusalem, as is contained in the book of Enoch the righteous.
cards.t_text: And I saw till Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep brought a new house greater and loftier than that first, and set it up in the place of the first which had been folded up: all its pillars were new, and its ornaments were new and larger than those of the first, the old one which He had taken away, and all the sheep were within it.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:1 — *the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations.* The reproach and curse among the Gentiles is the curse Moses set before Israel.
cards.s_text: And ye shall be scattered as captives among the Gentiles, and shall be for a reproach and for a curse there.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has driven you,

cards.note: Leviticus 26:33 — *And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you.* That they shall be 'scattered as captives among the Gentiles' is the dispersion Moses foretold for transgression.
cards.s_text: And ye shall be scattered as captives among the Gentiles, and shall be for a reproach and for a curse there.
cards.t_text: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

cards.note: Matthew 27:51 — *the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent.* The veil of the temple Levi foresees rent is the veil torn at the death of the Anointed.
cards.s_text: And ye shall deal lawlessly together with Yashar'el (Israel), so He shall not bear with Jerusalem because of your wickedness; but the veil of the temple shall be rent, so as not to cover your shame.
cards.t_text: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

cards.note: Galatians 6:7 — *for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.* 'Sow good things in your souls... but if ye sow evil things, ye shall reap every trouble' is the law of sowing and reaping.
cards.s_text: And sow good things in your souls, That ye may find them in your life. But if ye sow evil things, Ye shall reap every trouble and affliction.
cards.t_text: Be not deceived; Elohim (God) is not mocked: for whatsoever a man sows, that shall he also reap.

cards.note: Matthew 6:20 — *But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust doth corrupt.* 'Work righteousness... That ye may have (it) as a treasure in heaven' is the treasure laid up above.
cards.s_text: Work righteousness, therefore, my children, upon the earth, That ye may have (it) as a treasure in heaven.
cards.t_text: But lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust does corrupt, and where thieves do not break through nor steal:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 6:5 — *And thou shalt love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.* 'Fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the Lord your God) with your whole heart' is the Shema's command of whole-hearted love.
cards.s_text: And now, my children, I command you: Fear Yahuah Elohaychem (the Lord your God) with your whole heart, And walk in simplicity according to all His law.
cards.t_text: And you shall love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might.

cards.note: Isaiah 42:6 — *and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles.* That the law was given to lighten every man, lest the Gentiles live in blindness, is the light of the Gentiles Isaiah foresees.
cards.s_text: But if ye be darkened through transgressions, what, therefore, will all the Gentiles do living in blindness? Yea, ye shall bring a curse upon our race, because the light of the law which was given for to lighten every man, this ye desire to destroy by teaching commandments contrary to the ordinances of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: I Yahuah (LORD) have called you in righteousness, and will hold your hand, and will keep you, and give you for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;

cards.note: John 1:9 — *That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.* 'The light of the law which was given for to lighten every man' is the true Light John names.
cards.s_text: But if ye be darkened through transgressions, what, therefore, will all the Gentiles do living in blindness? Yea, ye shall bring a curse upon our race, because the light of the law which was given for to lighten every man, this ye desire to destroy by teaching commandments contrary to the ordinances of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that comes into the world.

cards.note: Malachi 2:7 — *the priest's lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).* The office the priests forsake when 'puffed up because of your priesthood' is the lips that should keep knowledge.
cards.s_text: And ye shall be puffed up because of your priesthood, lifting yourselves up against men, and not only so, but also against the commands of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth: for he is the messenger of Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).

cards.note: Malachi 2:8 — *ye have caused many to stumble at the law; ye have corrupted the covenant of Levi, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).* The priests robbing the offerings and teaching out of covetousness are the corrupters of the covenant of Levi.
cards.s_text: The offerings of Yahuah (Lord) ye shall rob, and from His portion shall ye steal choice portions, eating (them) contemptuously with harlots.
cards.t_text: But you are departed out of the way; you have caused many to stumble at the law; you have corrupted the covenant of Levi, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:21 — *I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side.* The visiting mercy after the dispersion is the gathering of the two houses Ezekiel foresees.
cards.s_text: And ye shall have no place that is clean; but ye shall be among the Gentiles a curse and a dispersion until He shall again visit you, and in pity shall receive you [through faith and water].
cards.t_text: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:3 — *will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath scattered thee.* 'Until He shall again visit you, and in pity shall receive you' is the Lord turning the captivity and gathering the scattered.
cards.s_text: And ye shall have no place that is clean; but ye shall be among the Gentiles a curse and a dispersion until He shall again visit you, and in pity shall receive you [through faith and water].
cards.t_text: That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn your captivity, and have compassion upon you, and will return and gather you from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has scattered you.

cards.note: Matthew 5:17 — *Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.* That they 'make void the law' and hate the man who reneweth it sets their lawlessness against the One who came to fulfil it.
cards.s_text: And ye shall make void the law, and set at nought the words of the prophets by evil perverseness. And ye shall persecute righteous men, and hate the godly; the words of the faithful shall ye abhor.
cards.t_text: Think not that I am come to destroy the law, or the prophets: I am not come to destroy, but to fulfil.

cards.note: Matthew 27:25 — *Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.* 'Taking innocent blood through wickedness upon your heads' is the blood owned by the people in the Gospel.
cards.s_text: [And a man who reneweth the law in the power of the El Elyon (Most High), ye shall call a deceiver; and at last ye shall rush (upon him) to slay him, not knowing his dignity, taking innocent blood through wickedness upon your heads.]
cards.t_text: Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children.

cards.note: Isaiah 53:3 — *He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief.* The renewer of the law whom they 'call a deceiver' and rush to slay is the despised and rejected one of the prophet.
cards.s_text: [And a man who reneweth the law in the power of the El Elyon (Most High), ye shall call a deceiver; and at last ye shall rush (upon him) to slay him, not knowing his dignity, taking innocent blood through wickedness upon your heads.]
cards.t_text: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

cards.note: Revelation 20:2 — *And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years.* 'Beliar shall be bound by him' is the binding of the adversary the Revelation foresees.
cards.s_text: And Beliar shall be bound by him, And he shall give power to His children to tread upon the evil spirits.
cards.t_text: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

cards.note: Luke 10:19 — *Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy.* 'He shall give power to His children to tread upon the evil spirits' is the authority over the enemy the Lord grants His own.
cards.s_text: And Beliar shall be bound by him, And he shall give power to His children to tread upon the evil spirits.
cards.t_text: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.

cards.note: Revelation 22:2 — *was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits... and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.* The tree of life the saints eat from is the tree in the restored paradise of the Revelation.
cards.s_text: And he shall give to the saints to eat from the tree of life, And the spirit of holiness shall be on them.
cards.t_text: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

cards.note: Revelation 2:7 — *To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God).* 'He shall give to the saints to eat from the tree of life' is the overcomer's promise in the paradise of God.
cards.s_text: And he shall give to the saints to eat from the tree of life, And the spirit of holiness shall be on them.
cards.t_text: He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says unto the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Genesis 3:24 — *he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* 'he shall open the gates of paradise, And shall remove the threatening sword against Adam' undoes the flaming sword that barred Eden.
cards.s_text: And he shall open the gates of paradise, And shall remove the threatening sword against Adam.
cards.t_text: So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:2 — *And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding.* 'The spirit of understanding and sanctification shall rest upon him' is the Spirit resting upon the Branch.
cards.s_text: And the glory of the El Elyon (Most High) shall be uttered over him, And the spirit of understanding and sanctification shall rest upon him [in the water].
cards.t_text: And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD);

cards.note: Matthew 3:17 — *And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.* 'With the Father's voice as from Abraham to Isaac' is the Father's voice from heaven over the beloved Son.
cards.s_text: The heavens shall be opened, And from the temple of glory shall come upon him sanctification, With the Father's voice as from Abraham to Isaac.
cards.t_text: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

cards.note: Matthew 3:16 — *the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of Elohim (God) descending like a dove.* 'The heavens shall be opened, and from the temple of glory shall come upon him sanctification' is the opened heaven at the Jordan.
cards.s_text: The heavens shall be opened, And from the temple of glory shall come upon him sanctification, With the Father's voice as from Abraham to Isaac.
cards.t_text: And Yahusha (Jesus), when he was baptized, went up straightway out of the water: and, lo, the heavens were opened unto him, and he saw the Spirit of Elohim (God) descending like a dove, and lighting upon him:

cards.note: Isaiah 9:2 — *The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light.* 'Lighting up the light of knowledge as the sun the day' is the great light upon those who walked in darkness.
cards.s_text: And his star shall arise in heaven as of a king, Lighting up the light of knowledge as the sun the day, And he shall be magnified in the world.
cards.t_text: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them has the light shined.

cards.note: Malachi 4:2 — *unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings.* That 'he shall shine forth as the sun on the earth, and shall remove all darkness' is the Sun of righteousness arising.
cards.s_text: He shall shine forth as the sun on the earth, And shall remove all darkness from under heaven, And there shall be peace in all the earth.
cards.t_text: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and you shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.

cards.note: Numbers 24:17 — *there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel).* 'His star shall arise in heaven as of a king' is the Star out of Jacob the seer beheld.
cards.s_text: And his star shall arise in heaven as of a king, Lighting up the light of knowledge as the sun the day, And he shall be magnified in the world.
cards.t_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

cards.note: Hebrews 7:11 — *what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek), and not be called after the order of Aaron?* The old priesthood failing so the Lord raises a new priest is the very change Hebrews reasons from.
cards.s_text: And after their punishment shall have come from Yahuah (Lord), the priesthood shall fail.
cards.t_text: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek), and not be called after the order of Aaron?

cards.note: Hebrews 7:24 — *But this man, because he continueth ever, hath an unchangeable priesthood.* That 'there shall none succeed him for all generations for ever' is the unchangeable priesthood of the One who continueth ever.
cards.s_text: For he shall give the majesty of Yahuah (Lord) to His sons in truth for evermore; And there shall none succeed him for all generations for ever.
cards.t_text: But this man, because he continues ever, has an unchangeable priesthood.

cards.note: Psalm 110:4 — *Yahuah (LORD) hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).* The new priest Yahuah (the Lord) raises up, to whom all his words are revealed and who judges the earth for a multitude of days, is the priest Yahuah (the LORD) swore in after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek) — a priesthood not from Levi's line and not for a season.
cards.s_text: Then shall Yahuah (Lord) raise up a new priest. And to him all the words of Yahuah (Lord) shall be revealed; And he shall execute a righteous judgment upon the earth for a multitude of days.
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) has sworn, and will not repent, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:19 — *I call heaven and earth to record this day against you... therefore choose life.* 'Yahuah (Lord) is witness, and His angels are witnesses, and ye are witnesses' is Moses' calling of heaven and earth to record the choice of life.
