cards.s_text: And their father said unto them, Yahuah (Lord) is witness, and His angels are witnesses, and ye are witnesses, and I am witness, concerning the word of your mouth. And his sons said unto him: We are witnesses.
cards.t_text: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both you and your seed may live:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:15 — *See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil.* 'choose, therefore, for yourselves either the light or the darkness, either the law of Yahuah (Lord) or the works of Beliar' is the life-and-death Moses set before Israel.
cards.s_text: And now, my children, ye have heard all; choose, therefore, for yourselves either the light or the darkness, either the law of Yahuah (Lord) or the works of Beliar.
cards.t_text: See, I have set before you this day life and good, and death and evil;

cards.note: Genesis 49:8 — *Yahudah (Judah), thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise: thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies; thy father's children shall bow down before thee.* The royal blessing the testament remembers is exactly the praise and pre-eminence Jacob spoke.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass, when I became a man, that my father blessed me, saying, Thou shalt be a king, prospering in all things.
cards.t_text: Yahudah (Judah), you are he whom your brethren shall praise: your hand shall be in the neck of your enemies; your father’s children shall bow down before you.

cards.note: Genesis 49:10 — *The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.* Jacob's blessing "Thou shalt be a king" is the same scepter Moses sets on Judah's tribe.
cards.s_text: And it came to pass, when I became a man, that my father blessed me, saying, Thou shalt be a king, prospering in all things.
cards.t_text: The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

cards.note: Genesis 29:35 — *And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise Yahuah (LORD): therefore she called his name Yahudah (Judah); and left bearing.* The testament's "I give thanks to Yahuah... He hath given me a fourth son" simply repeats the praise that named him.
cards.s_text: Hearken, my children, to Yahudah (Judah) your father. I was the fourth son born to my father Jacob; and Leah my mother named me Yahudah (Judah), saying, I give thanks to Yahuah (Lord), because He hath given me a fourth son also.
cards.t_text: And she conceived again, and bare a son: and she said, Now will I praise Yahuah (LORD): therefore she called his name Yahudah (Judah); and left bearing.

cards.note: Leviticus 18:24 — *Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you.* The Canaanite "wickedness" Judah names is the defilement the Law commands Israel to shun.
cards.s_text: And I wished to give Shelah also to her, but his mother did not permit it; 'for she wrought evil against Tamar,' because she was not of the daughters of Canaan, as she also herself was.
cards.t_text: Defile not you yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 7:3 — *Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.* The whole tangle springs from the Canaanite alliance the Torah forbids.
cards.s_text: And I wished to give Shelah also to her, but his mother did not permit it; 'for she wrought evil against Tamar,' because she was not of the daughters of Canaan, as she also herself was.
cards.t_text: Neither shall you make marriages with them; your daughter you shall not give unto his son, nor his daughter shall you take unto your son.

cards.note: Genesis 38:10 — *And the thing which he did displeased Yahuah (LORD): wherefore he slew him also.* The testament's "he also died through wickedness" names the same judgment Moses records.
cards.s_text: And when I threatened him he went in unto her, but he spilled the seed on the ground, according to the command of his mother, and he also died through wickedness.
cards.t_text: And the thing which he did displeased Yahuah (LORD): wherefore he slew him also.

cards.note: Genesis 38:9 — *And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother's wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.* The testament repeats the very deed for which Onan died.
cards.s_text: And when I threatened him he went in unto her, but he spilled the seed on the ground, according to the command of his mother, and he also died through wickedness.
cards.t_text: And Onan knew that the seed should not be his; and it came to pass, when he went in unto his brother’s wife, that he spilled it on the ground, lest that he should give seed to his brother.

cards.note: Genesis 38:7 — *And Er, Yahudah's (Judah's) firstborn, was wicked in the sight of Yahuah (LORD); and Yahuah (LORD) slew him.* The testament's "Er was wicked... an angel of Yahuah smote him" is Moses' own verdict.
cards.s_text: Now Er was wicked, and he 'was in need' concerning Tamar, because she was not of the land of Canaan. And on the third night an angel of Yahuah (Lord) smote him.
cards.t_text: And Er, Yahudah's (Judah’s) firstborn, was wicked in the sight of Yahuah (LORD); and Yahuah (LORD) slew him.

cards.note: Proverbs 23:33 — *Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.* Judah's wine-deceived sight of a strange woman is exactly the wine-snare Proverbs describes.
cards.s_text: And when I saw her pouring out wine, owing to the intoxication of wine was I deceived, and took her although my father had not counselled (it).
cards.t_text: Your eyes shall behold strange women, and your heart shall utter perverse things.

cards.note: Proverbs 23:31 — *Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, when it moveth itself aright.* The cup that "deceived" Judah when he saw her pouring out wine is the very snare Proverbs forbids looking upon.
cards.s_text: And when I saw her pouring out wine, owing to the intoxication of wine was I deceived, and took her although my father had not counselled (it).
cards.t_text: Look not you upon the wine when it is red, when it gives his colour in the cup, when it moves itself aright.

cards.note: Leviticus 18:25 — *And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.* Judah's verdict that "the race of the Canaanites was wicked" echoes the Law's judgment on their iniquity.
cards.s_text: And I knew that the race of the Canaanites was wicked, but the impulse of youth blinded my mind.
cards.t_text: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.

cards.note: Proverbs 31:4 — *It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink.* Judah the king-to-be falls precisely where the proverb warns a king not to go.
cards.s_text: Therefore being drunk with wine, I did not recognise her; and her beauty deceived me, through the fashion of her adorning.
cards.t_text: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:

cards.note: Proverbs 23:32 — *At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.* The wine that left Judah unable to recognise Tamar is the very serpent's bite Proverbs warns of.
cards.s_text: Therefore being drunk with wine, I did not recognise her; and her beauty deceived me, through the fashion of her adorning.
cards.t_text: At the last it bites like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.

cards.note: Genesis 38:26 — *And Yahudah (Judah) acknowledged them, and said, She hath been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.* Judah's "she privily sent my pledges, and put me to shame" is the same confession Moses sets down.
cards.s_text: And not knowing what I had done, I wished to slay her; but she privily sent my pledges, and put me to shame.
cards.t_text: And Yahudah (Judah) acknowledged them, and said, She has been more righteous than I; because that I gave her not to Shelah my son. And he knew her again no more.

cards.note: Genesis 38:18 — *And he said, What pledge shall I give thee? And she said, Thy signet, and thy bracelets, and thy staff that is in thine hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived.* The staff and tokens Judah names as his pledge are exactly the pledge Moses records.
cards.s_text: And I turned aside to her, and said: Let me go in unto thee. And she said: What wilt thou give me? And I gave her my staff, and my girdle, and the diadem of my kingdom 'in pledge'. And I went in unto her, and she conceived.
cards.t_text: And he said, What pledge shall I give you? And she said, Your signet, and your bracelets, and your staff that is in your hand. And he gave it her, and came in unto her, and she conceived by him.

cards.note: Genesis 38:14 — *And she put her widow's garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.* The veiled woman by the gate is Moses' own account of Tamar.
cards.s_text: And after these things, while Tamar was a widow, she heard after two years that I was going up to shear my sheep, and adorned herself in bridal array, and sat in the city Enaim by the gate.
cards.t_text: And she put her widow’s garments off from her, and covered her with a vail, and wrapped herself, and sat in an open place, which is by the way to Timnath; for she saw that Shelah was grown, and she was not given unto him to wife.

cards.note: Ephesians 5:18 — *And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit.* The apostle's charge against the very excess that ruined Judah confirms it ain't new.
cards.s_text: And the wine turned aside my eyes, and pleasure blinded my heart.
cards.t_text: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

cards.note: Proverbs 23:33 — *Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.* The wine that "turned aside my eyes" and blinded the heart is the very snare the proverb foresees.
cards.s_text: And the wine turned aside my eyes, and pleasure blinded my heart.
cards.t_text: Your eyes shall behold strange women, and your heart shall utter perverse things.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:2 — *And shalt return unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.* Judah's charge to "keep my sayings to perform all the ordinances of Yahuah" is the Torah's own demand for whole-hearted obedience.
cards.s_text: And now I command you, my children, hearken 'to Yahudah (Judah) your father,' and keep my sayings to perform all the ordinances of Yahuah (Lord), and to obey the commands of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: And shall return unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and shall obey his voice according to all that I command you this day, you and your children, with all your heart, and with all your soul;

cards.note: Ephesians 5:18 — *And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit.* Judah's "be not drunk with wine" is the apostle's command word for word.
cards.s_text: After I had drunk wine I reverenced not the commandment of Elohim (God), and I took a woman of Canaan to wife.
cards.t_text: And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit;

cards.note: Proverbs 23:30 — *They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.* The wine that takes away the mind of man is the lingering cup the proverb names.
cards.s_text: And now, my children, 'I say unto you,' be not drunk with wine; for wine turneth the mind away from the truth, and inspires the passion of lust, and leadeth the eyes into error.
cards.t_text: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.

cards.note: Proverbs 23:29 — *Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?* Judah's drunkard whose eyes are led into error is the very man Proverbs questions.
cards.s_text: And now, my children, 'I say unto you,' be not drunk with wine; for wine turneth the mind away from the truth, and inspires the passion of lust, and leadeth the eyes into error.
cards.t_text: Who has woe? who has sorrow? who has contentions? who has babbling? who has wounds without cause? who has redness of eyes?

cards.note: Proverbs 31:5 — *Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.* Judah forgetting the commandment and losing his glory is the very ruin the proverb foresees for a drinking king.
cards.s_text: For even though a man be a king and commit fornication, he is stripped of his kingship by becoming the slave of fornication, as I myself also suffered.
cards.t_text: Lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the judgment of any of the afflicted.

cards.note: Proverbs 31:4 — *It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink.* The king stripped of his kingship through fornication is the prince the proverb warns away from wine.
cards.s_text: For even though a man be a king and commit fornication, he is stripped of his kingship by becoming the slave of fornication, as I myself also suffered.
cards.t_text: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; nor for princes strong drink:

cards.note: Proverbs 23:32 — *At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.* Judah's counsel to touch wine not at all, lest a man perish before his time, echoes the proverb's serpent at the bottom of the cup.
cards.s_text: But if you would live soberly do not touch wine at all, lest ye sin in words of outrage, and in fightings and slanders, and transgressions of the commandments of Elohim (God), and ye perish before your time.
cards.t_text: At the last it bites like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.

cards.note: Proverbs 23:30 — *They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.* The drunkenness that arises when the fear of Elohim departs is the lingering at wine the proverb forbids.
cards.s_text: If ye drink wine in gladness, be ye modest with the fear of Elohim (God). For if in (your) gladness the fear of Elohim (God) departeth, then drunkenness ariseth and shamelessness stealeth in.
cards.t_text: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.

cards.note: Psalms 89:4 — *Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.* The everlasting establishing of the seed and throne is the same covenant standing behind Judah's confidence.
cards.s_text: And I know that from me shall the kingdom be established.
cards.t_text: Your seed will I establish for ever, and build up your throne to all generations. Selah.

cards.note: 2 Samuel 7:16 — *And thine house and thy kingdom shall be established for ever before thee: thy throne shall be established for ever.* Yahuah's oath establishing David's house, of Judah's tribe, fulfils Judah's word that the kingdom shall be established from him.
cards.s_text: And I know that from me shall the kingdom be established.
cards.t_text: And your house and your kingdom shall be established for ever before you: your throne shall be established for ever.

cards.note: Genesis 49:10 — *The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.* The kingdom "from me shall the kingdom be established" is the scepter Jacob fixed on Judah.
cards.s_text: And I know that from me shall the kingdom be established.
cards.t_text: The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

cards.note: 1 Timothy 6:9 — *But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.* Judah led astray for the sake of money is the man caught in this snare.
cards.s_text: And now I command you, my children, not to love money, nor to gaze upon the beauty of women; because for the sake of money and beauty I was led astray to Bathshua the Canaanite.
cards.t_text: But they that will be rich fall into temptation and a snare, and into many foolish and hurtful lusts, which drown men in destruction and perdition.

cards.note: 1 Timothy 6:10 — *For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.* Judah's twin warning against the love of money names the very root the apostle names.
cards.s_text: And now I command you, my children, not to love money, nor to gaze upon the beauty of women; because for the sake of money and beauty I was led astray to Bathshua the Canaanite.
cards.t_text: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

cards.note: Leviticus 18:24 — *Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you.* The fornication that blinds the soul is the defilement the Law warns withdraws Israel from holiness.
cards.s_text: For these things withdraw you from the law of Elohim (God), And blind the inclination of the soul, And teach arrogance, And suffer not a man to have compassion upon his neighbour.
cards.t_text: Defile not you yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:

cards.note: 1 Timothy 6:10 — *For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.* The money-love that withdraws Judah's sons from the law is the apostle's root that makes men err from the faith.
cards.s_text: For these things withdraw you from the law of Elohim (God), And blind the inclination of the soul, And teach arrogance, And suffer not a man to have compassion upon his neighbour.
cards.t_text: For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

cards.note: Matthew 6:24 — *No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve Elohim (God) and mammon.* The money that draws the heart from Elohim is the rival master the Messiah names.
cards.s_text: My children, the love of money leadeth to idolatry; because, when led astray through money, men name as gods those who are not gods, and it causeth him who hath it to fall into madness.
cards.t_text: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. You cannot serve Elohim (God) and mammon.

cards.note: Colossians 3:5 — *Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry.* Judah's word that the love of money leads to idolatry is the apostle's own equation.
cards.s_text: My children, the love of money leadeth to idolatry; because, when led astray through money, men name as gods those who are not gods, and it causeth him who hath it to fall into madness.
cards.t_text: Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry:

cards.note: Jeremiah 17:9 — *The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?* The spirit of deceit that writes upon the heart is the deceitful heart only Yahuah can know.
cards.s_text: And there is no time at which the works of men can be hid; for on the heart itself have they been written down 'before the Lord'.
cards.t_text: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked: who can know it?

cards.note: Jeremiah 17:10 — *I Yahuah (LORD) search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.* The works written on the heart and known to Yahuah are the very heart the prophet says He searches.
cards.s_text: And the works of truth and the works of deceit are written upon the hearts of men, and each one of them Yahuah (Lord) knoweth.
cards.t_text: I Yahuah (LORD) search the heart, I try the reins, even to give every man according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:15 — *See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil.* The two spirits between which the mind must turn are the two ways Moses set before Israel.
cards.s_text: Know, therefore, my children, that two spirits wait upon man—the spirit of truth and the spirit of deceit.
cards.t_text: See, I have set before you this day life and good, and death and evil;

cards.note: Matthew 7:15 — *Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.* The false prophets who persecute the righteous are the wolves the Messiah warns against.
cards.s_text: And there shall be false prophets 'like' tempests, And they shall persecute all righteous men.
cards.t_text: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

cards.note: Jeremiah 23:21 — *I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.* The false prophets like tempests are the unsent runners the prophet exposes.
cards.s_text: And there shall be false prophets 'like' tempests, And they shall persecute all righteous men.
cards.t_text: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.

cards.note: Hebrews 7:11 — *If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek), and not be called after the order of Aaron?* Yahuah choosing Levi "to draw near to Him" is the priestly nearness the apostle weighs against the greater priest to come.
cards.s_text: For 'the angel of Yahuah (Lord) said unto me': Yahuah (Lord) chose him rather than thee, to draw near to Him, and to eat of His table and to offer Him the first-fruits' of the choice things of the sons of Yashar'el (Israel); but thou shalt be king of Jacob.
cards.t_text: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek), and not be called after the order of Aaron?

cards.note: Hebrews 7:14 — *For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.* The apostle joins the very tribes Judah joins — the King of Judah's line who holds also a priesthood not of Aaron.
cards.s_text: As the heaven is higher than the earth, so is the priesthood of Elohim (God) higher than the earthly kingdom, unless it falls away through sin from Yahuah (Lord) and is dominated by the earthly kingdom.'
cards.t_text: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

cards.note: Psalms 110:4 — *Yahuah (LORD) hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).* The priesthood set above the kingdom finds its head in the king-priest sworn for ever after Melchizedek's order.
cards.s_text: As the heaven is higher than the earth, so is the priesthood of Elohim (God) higher than the earthly kingdom, unless it falls away through sin from Yahuah (Lord) and is dominated by the earthly kingdom.'
cards.t_text: Yahuah (LORD) has sworn, and will not repent, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melek Tsadiq (Melchizedek).

cards.note: Zechariah 6:13 — *Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD); and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.* The joined kingship of Judah and priesthood of Levi is exactly the counsel of peace between them both.
cards.s_text: As the heaven is higher than the earth, so is the priesthood of Elohim (God) higher than the earthly kingdom, unless it falls away through sin from Yahuah (Lord) and is dominated by the earthly kingdom.'
cards.t_text: Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD); and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

cards.note: Psalms 89:36 — *His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.* Yahuah's oath that He would not destroy the kingdom from Judah's seed for ever is the same sworn endurance of David's throne.
cards.s_text: And He shall guard the might of my kingdom for ever; For Yahuah (Lord) sware to me with an oath that He would not destroy the kingdom from my seed for ever.
cards.t_text: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

cards.note: Isaiah 45:21 — *...a just Elohim (God) and a Saviour; there is none beside me.* The "appearing of the Elohim of righteousness" is Isaiah's just God and Saviour beside whom there is none.
cards.s_text: And among men of another race shall my kingdom be brought to an end, Until the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel) shall come, 'Until the appearing of the Elohim (God) of righteousness,' That Jacob [and all the Gentiles] may rest in peace.
cards.t_text: Tell you, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who has declared this from ancient time? who has told it from that time? have not I Yahuah (LORD)? and there is no Elohim (God) else beside me; a just Elohim (God) and a Saviour; there is none beside me.

cards.note: Isaiah 45:17 — *But Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved in Yahuah (LORD) with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.* The coming "salvation of Yashar'el (Israel)" and rest in peace is Isaiah's everlasting salvation.
cards.s_text: And among men of another race shall my kingdom be brought to an end, Until the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel) shall come, 'Until the appearing of the Elohim (God) of righteousness,' That Jacob [and all the Gentiles] may rest in peace.
cards.t_text: But Yashar'el (Israel) shall be saved in Yahuah (LORD) with an everlasting salvation: you shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.

cards.note: Genesis 49:10 — *The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.* The kingdom held "Until the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel) shall come" is the scepter held until Shiloh comes.
cards.s_text: And among men of another race shall my kingdom be brought to an end, Until the salvation of Yashar'el (Israel) shall come, 'Until the appearing of the Elohim (God) of righteousness,' That Jacob [and all the Gentiles] may rest in peace.
cards.t_text: The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:3 — *That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath scattered thee.* The promise that Yahuah will bring them up from captivity is Moses' own promise of gathering.
cards.s_text: Until Yahuah (Lord) visit you, when with perfect heart ye repent and walk in all His commandments, and He bring you up from captivity among the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn your captivity, and have compassion upon you, and will return and gather you from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has scattered you.

cards.note: Leviticus 26:40 — *If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me.* Judah's "when with perfect heart ye repent" is the confession the Law makes the door of return.
cards.s_text: Until Yahuah (Lord) visit you, when with perfect heart ye repent and walk in all His commandments, and He bring you up from captivity among the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: If they shall confess their iniquity, and the iniquity of their fathers, with their trespass which they trespassed against me, and that also they have walked contrary unto me;

cards.note: Leviticus 26:33 — *And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.* The sword, the laying waste, and the enslavement among the Gentiles are the very curse Moses set in the Law.
cards.s_text: For which things' sake Yahuah (Lord) shall bring upon you famine and pestilence, death and the sword, beleaguering by enemies, and revilings of friends, the slaughter of children, the rape of wives, the plundering of possessions, [the burning of the temple of Elohim (God),] the laying waste of the land, the enslavement of yourselves among the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:4 — *But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.* The rod that judges and saves all that call upon Yahuah is the Branch's righteous judgment.
cards.s_text: And from it shall grow a rod of righteousness to the Gentiles, To judge and to save all that call upon Yahuah (Lord).
cards.t_text: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:10 — *And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.* The rod of righteousness "to the Gentiles" is Isaiah's root of Jesse to whom the Gentiles seek.
cards.s_text: And from it shall grow a rod of righteousness to the Gentiles, To judge and to save all that call upon Yahuah (Lord).
cards.t_text: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.

cards.note: Numbers 24:17 — *...a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel)...* The sceptre of Judah's kingdom shining forth is the very Sceptre Balaam saw rise out of Israel.
cards.s_text: Then shall the sceptre of my kingdom shine forth; And from your root shall arise a stem;
cards.t_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

cards.note: Zechariah 6:12 — *...Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD).* Judah's Branch of Elohim is Zechariah's man named The BRANCH.
cards.s_text: [This Branch of Elohim (God) El Elyon (Most High), And this Fountain giving life unto all.]
cards.t_text: And speak unto him, saying, Thus speaks Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), saying, Behold the man whose name is The BRANCH; and he shall grow up out of his place, and he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD):

cards.note: Jeremiah 23:5 — *Behold, the days come, saith Yahuah (LORD), that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.* The Branch Judah names is the righteous Branch raised unto David.
cards.s_text: [This Branch of Elohim (God) El Elyon (Most High), And this Fountain giving life unto all.]
cards.t_text: Behold, the days come, says Yahuah (LORD), that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:1 — *And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots.* "This Branch of Elohim (God) El Elyon (Most High)" is Isaiah's Branch grown from the roots of Jesse.
cards.s_text: [This Branch of Elohim (God) El Elyon (Most High), And this Fountain giving life unto all.]
cards.t_text: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:

cards.note: Joel 2:28 — *And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions.* Judah's "He shall pour out the spirit of grace upon you" is Joel's outpouring upon all flesh.
cards.s_text: And He shall pour out the spirit of grace upon you; And ye shall be unto Him sons in truth, And ye shall walk in His commandments first and last.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:

cards.note: John 1:32 — *And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.* The opened heavens and the Spirit poured upon Him are seen fulfilled when the Spirit descends and abides on Him.
cards.s_text: And the heavens shall be opened unto him, To pour out the spirit, (even) the blessing of the Holy Father;
cards.t_text: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:2 — *And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD).* The heavens opened to pour the spirit upon Him is the Spirit resting on the Branch.
cards.s_text: And the heavens shall be opened unto him, To pour out the spirit, (even) the blessing of the Holy Father;
cards.t_text: And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD);

cards.note: Revelation 22:16 — *I Yahusha (Jesus) have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.* The risen Messiah names Himself the very morning star out of Jacob Judah foretells.
cards.s_text: And after these things shall a star arise to you from Jacob in peace, And a man shall arise [from my seed], like the sun of righteousness, Walking with the sons of men in meekness and righteousness; And no sin shall be found in him.
cards.t_text: I Yahusha (Jesus) have sent my angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.

cards.note: Malachi 4:2 — *But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.* The man "like the sun of righteousness" is Malachi's Sun arising with healing.
cards.s_text: And after these things shall a star arise to you from Jacob in peace, And a man shall arise [from my seed], like the sun of righteousness, Walking with the sons of men in meekness and righteousness; And no sin shall be found in him.
cards.t_text: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and you shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.

cards.note: Numbers 24:17 — *...there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.* Judah's "shall a star arise to you from Jacob" is Balaam's very oracle of the Star and Sceptre.
cards.s_text: And after these things shall a star arise to you from Jacob in peace, And a man shall arise [from my seed], like the sun of righteousness, Walking with the sons of men in meekness and righteousness; And no sin shall be found in him.
cards.t_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

cards.note: Revelation 20:6 — *Blessed and holy is he that hath part in the first resurrection: on such the second death hath no power, but they shall be priests of Elohim (God) and of Messiah (Christ), and shall reign with him a thousand years.* They put to death for Yahuah's sake awaking to life are blessed in the first resurrection.
cards.s_text: And they who have died in grief shall arise 'in joy', 'And they who were poor for Yahuah's (Lord's) sake shall be made rich,' And they who are put to death for Yahuah's (Lord's) sake shall awake 'to life'.
cards.t_text: Blessed and holy is he that has part in the first resurrection: on such the second death has no power, but they shall be priests of Elohim (God) and of Messiah (Christ), and shall reign with him a thousand years.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 15:22 — *For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah (Christ) shall all be made alive.* The dead in grief made to awake to life is the all-made-alive in Messiah.
cards.s_text: And they who have died in grief shall arise 'in joy', 'And they who were poor for Yahuah's (Lord's) sake shall be made rich,' And they who are put to death for Yahuah's (Lord's) sake shall awake 'to life'.
cards.t_text: For as in Adam all die, even so in Messiah (Christ) shall all be made alive.

cards.note: 1 Thessalonians 4:14 — *For if we believe that Yahusha (Jesus) died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Yahusha (Jesus) will Elohim (God) bring with him.* They who died in grief arising in joy is the apostle's hope that Elohim will bring the sleeping with Him.
cards.s_text: And they who have died in grief shall arise 'in joy', 'And they who were poor for Yahuah's (Lord's) sake shall be made rich,' And they who are put to death for Yahuah's (Lord's) sake shall awake 'to life'.
cards.t_text: For if we believe that Yahusha (Jesus) died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Yahusha (Jesus) will Elohim (God) bring with him.

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:12 — *...Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Yashar'el (Israel).* Israel made one people of Yahuah with one tongue is the whole house brought up out of the graves into the land.
cards.s_text: And ye shall be the people of Yahuah (Lord), and have one tongue; And there shall be there no spirit of deceit of 'Beliar', For he shall be cast into the fire for ever.
cards.t_text: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: Revelation 20:3 — *And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled.* Beliar cast into the fire so there is no more spirit of deceit is the deceiver shut up that he deceive the nations no more.
cards.s_text: And ye shall be the people of Yahuah (Lord), and have one tongue; And there shall be there no spirit of deceit of 'Beliar', For he shall be cast into the fire for ever.
cards.t_text: And cast him into the bottomless pit, and shut him up, and set a seal upon him, that he should deceive the nations no more, till the thousand years should be fulfilled: and after that he must be loosed a little season.

cards.note: Matthew 22:32 — *I am the Elohim (God) of Abraham, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac, and the Elohim (God) of Jacob? Elohim (God) is not the Elohim (God) of the dead, but of the living.* Judah's very three fathers arising are the Master's proof of the resurrection.
cards.s_text: And after these things shall Abraham and Isaac and Jacob arise unto life, and I and my brethren shall be chiefs of the tribes 'of Israel': Levi first, I the second, Joseph third, Benjamin fourth, Simeon fifth, Issachar sixth, and so all in order.
cards.t_text: I am the Elohim (God) of Abraham, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac, and the Elohim (God) of Jacob? Elohim (God) is not the Elohim (God) of the dead, but of the living.

cards.note: Isaiah 26:19 — *Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.* The rising of the fathers unto life is Isaiah's dead men living and rising.
cards.s_text: And after these things shall Abraham and Isaac and Jacob arise unto life, and I and my brethren shall be chiefs of the tribes 'of Israel': Levi first, I the second, Joseph third, Benjamin fourth, Simeon fifth, Issachar sixth, and so all in order.
cards.t_text: Your dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, you that dwell in dust: for your dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.

cards.note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The patriarchs arising unto life is Daniel's awakening of them that sleep in the dust.
cards.s_text: And after these things shall Abraham and Isaac and Jacob arise unto life, and I and my brethren shall be chiefs of the tribes 'of Israel': Levi first, I the second, Joseph third, Benjamin fourth, Simeon fifth, Issachar sixth, and so all in order.
cards.t_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

cards.note: Genesis 49:33 — *And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.* Judah finishing his charge and falling asleep follows his father Jacob's very pattern of death.
cards.s_text: And Yahudah (Judah), when he had said these things, fell asleep; and his sons did according to all whatsoever he commanded them, and they buried him in Hebron with his fathers.
cards.t_text: And when Jacob had made an end of commanding his sons, he gathered up his feet into the bed, and yielded up the ghost, and was gathered unto his people.

cards.note: Genesis 49:31 — *There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.* Judah carried up to Hebron to his fathers is laid where Moses records the patriarchs were buried.
cards.s_text: And Yahudah (Judah), when he had said these things, fell asleep; and his sons did according to all whatsoever he commanded them, and they buried him in Hebron with his fathers.
cards.t_text: There they buried Abraham and Sarah his wife; there they buried Isaac and Rebekah his wife; and there I buried Leah.

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 9:7 — *Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for Elohim (God) loveth a cheerful giver.* Bestowing on the poor "in the singleness of my heart" is the cheerful, ungrudging giving the apostle commends.
cards.s_text: For on all the poor and oppressed I bestowed the good things of the earth in the singleness of my heart.
cards.t_text: Every man according as he purposeth in his heart, so let him give; not grudgingly, or of necessity: for Elohim (God) loves a cheerful giver.

cards.note: Proverbs 3:9 — *Honour Yahuah (LORD) with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase.* The husbandman who first honours Yahuah with his increase walks Wisdom's path.
cards.s_text: And my father 'always' rejoiced in my rectitude, because I offered through the priest to Yahuah (Lord) all first-fruits; then to my father also.
cards.t_text: Honour Yahuah (LORD) with your substance, and with the firstfruits of all your increase:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 26:2 — *That thou shalt take of the first of all the fruit of the earth, which thou shalt bring of thy land that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) giveth thee, and shalt put it in a basket, and shalt go unto the place which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall choose to place his name there.* Issachar's offering of all his first-fruits through the priest keeps the Torah's command exactly.
cards.s_text: And my father 'always' rejoiced in my rectitude, because I offered through the priest to Yahuah (Lord) all first-fruits; then to my father also.
cards.t_text: That you shall take of the first of all the fruit of the earth, which you shall bring of your land that Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you, and shall put it in a basket, and shall go unto the place which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall choose to place his name there.

cards.note: Matthew 5:8 — *Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see Elohim (God).* The uprightness and singleness of heart Issachar walked in is the purity of heart the Beatitude crowns.
cards.s_text: When, therefore, I grew up, my children, I walked in uprightness of heart, and I became a husbandman for my father and my brethren, and I brought in fruits from the field according to their season.
cards.t_text: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see Elohim (God).

cards.note: Proverbs 22:9 — *He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.* The single, unenvious eye that grudges no neighbour is Proverbs' bountiful eye, blessed for its open hand.
cards.s_text: And I was not a busybody in my doings, 'nor envious and malicious against my neighbour.'
cards.t_text: He that has a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he gives of his bread to the poor.

cards.note: Matthew 6:22 — *The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.* Issachar's "singleness of eye" is the very single eye the Master makes the lamp of the whole man.
cards.s_text: I never slandered any one, nor did I censure the life of any man, walking as I did in singleness of eye'.
cards.t_text: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore your eye be single, your whole body shall be full of light.

cards.note: Psalms 32:2 — *Blessed is the man unto whom Yahuah (LORD) imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.* The man who waits only for the will of God, unenvying and undeceiving, is the man in whose spirit is no guile.
cards.s_text: He doth not desire to live a long life, But only waiteth for the will of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: Blessed is the man unto whom Yahuah (LORD) imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

cards.note: Matthew 6:21 — *For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.* The single man who covets no gold and longs for no dainties has laid up his treasure where the Master directs the heart.
cards.s_text: 'The single-(minded) man coveteth not gold, He overreacheth not his neighbour, He longeth not after manifold dainties, He delighteth not in varied apparel.
cards.t_text: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

cards.note: Matthew 6:22 — *The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.* The man who beholds all things in uprightness and shuns the evil eye is the man of the single eye, full of light.
cards.s_text: For he walketh in singleness 'of soul', And beholdeth all things in uprightness 'of heart', Shunning eyes (made) evil through the error of the world, Lest he should see the perversion of any of the commandments of Yahuah (Lord).
cards.t_text: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore your eye be single, your whole body shall be full of light.

cards.note: Hebrews 7:14 — *For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.* The Anointed who springs from Judah yet bears a priesthood gathers into himself the two tribes' joined hope — the Messiah of the Levi-Judah line.
cards.s_text: And Levi and Yahudah (Judah) were glorified by Yahuah (Lord) even among the sons of Jacob; for Yahuah (Lord) gave them an inheritance, and to Levi He gave the priesthood, and to Yahudah (Judah) the kingdom.
cards.t_text: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

cards.note: Zechariah 6:13 — *and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.* The priesthood given to Levi and the kingdom given to Judah are joined in the prophet's priest-king, the counsel of peace between the two offices.
cards.s_text: And Levi and Yahudah (Judah) were glorified by Yahuah (Lord) even among the sons of Jacob; for Yahuah (Lord) gave them an inheritance, and to Levi He gave the priesthood, and to Yahudah (Judah) the kingdom.
cards.t_text: Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD); and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

cards.note: Genesis 49:10 — *The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.* "to Yahudah (Judah) the kingdom" is Jacob's own dying word over Judah's sceptre.
cards.s_text: And Levi and Yahudah (Judah) were glorified by Yahuah (Lord) even among the sons of Jacob; for Yahuah (Lord) gave them an inheritance, and to Levi He gave the priesthood, and to Yahudah (Judah) the kingdom.
cards.t_text: The sceptre shall not depart from Yahudah (Judah), nor a lawgiver from between his feet, until Shiloh come; and unto him shall the gathering of the people be.

cards.note: Proverbs 3:10 — *So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.* The promise that with first-fruits Yahuah will bless the husbandman echoes Wisdom's reward for honouring Him with the increase.
cards.s_text: For with the first-fruits of the earth will Yahuah (Lord) bless you, even as He blessed all the saints from Abel even until now.
cards.t_text: So shall your barns be filled with plenty, and your presses shall burst out with new wine.

cards.note: Exodus 23:19 — *The first of the firstfruits of thy land thou shalt bring into the house of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God).* Issachar's "offering gifts to Yahuah with thanksgiving" from the first-fruits keeps the Torah's command.
cards.s_text: Bow down your back unto husbandry, And toil in labours 'in all manner of husbandry, Offering gifts to Yahuah (Lord) with thanksgiving.'
cards.t_text: The first of the firstfruits of your land you shall bring into the house of Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God). You shall not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.

cards.note: Matthew 22:40 — *On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.* Issachar's "Keep, therefore, my children, the law of Elohim (God)" reduced to love of God and neighbour is the very hinge the Master names.
cards.s_text: Keep, therefore, my children, the law of Elohim (God), And get singleness, 'And walk in guilelessness, Not playing the busybody with the business of your neighbour.
cards.t_text: On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.

cards.note: Leviticus 19:18 — *Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).* "Love your neighbour" and "have compassion on the poor and weak" is Torah's royal command set beside the love of God.
cards.s_text: But love Yahuah (Lord) and your neighbour, Have compassion on the poor and weak.'
cards.t_text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Deuteronomy 6:5 — *And thou shalt love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.* "Love Yahuah" is the first great word of the Shema, set first by Issachar as by Moses.
cards.s_text: But love Yahuah (Lord) and your neighbour, Have compassion on the poor and weak.'
cards.t_text: And you shall love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might.

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:21 — *Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land.* The promised return to the land is the prophet's regathering of the scattered house.
cards.s_text: For He is merciful, and will deliver them, even to bring them back into their land.
cards.t_text: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:3 — *That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath scattered thee.* The merciful deliverance that brings them back into their land is Moses' promise of the gathering after return.
cards.s_text: For He is merciful, and will deliver them, even to bring them back into their land.
cards.t_text: That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn your captivity, and have compassion upon you, and will return and gather you from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has scattered you.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 28:64 — *And Yahuah (LORD) shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other.* "They shall be dispersed among the Gentiles, and shall serve their enemies" is the very curse Moses set before the disobedient.
cards.s_text: And leaving' husbandry, 'They will follow after their own 'wicked' devices, And they shall be dispersed among the Gentiles, And shall serve their enemies.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) shall scatter you among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there you shall serve other gods, which neither you nor your fathers have known, even wood and stone.

cards.note: 1 John 4:21 — *And this commandment have we from him, That he who loveth Elohim (God) love his brother also.* Issachar's twin love of Yahuah and of every man is the very command the apostle binds together.
cards.s_text: I loved Yahuah (Lord); Likewise also every man with all my heart.
cards.t_text: And this commandment have we from him, That he who loves Elohim (God) love his brother also.

cards.note: Leviticus 19:18 — *thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).* Loving "every man with all my heart" and sharing bread with the poor is the royal law of love to the neighbour.
cards.s_text: I loved Yahuah (Lord); Likewise also every man with all my heart.
cards.t_text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Deuteronomy 6:5 — *And thou shalt love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.* "I loved Yahuah... with all my heart" is the Shema's first command lived to the end of his days.
cards.s_text: I loved Yahuah (Lord); Likewise also every man with all my heart.
cards.t_text: And you shall love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might.

cards.note: Exodus 20:17 — *Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbour’s.* "I coveted not any desirable thing that was my neighbour's" keeps the tenth word of the Decalogue.
cards.s_text: I drank not wine, to be led astray thereby; I coveted not any desirable thing that was my neighbour's.
cards.t_text: You shall not covet your neighbour’s house, you shall not covet your neighbour’s wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is your neighbour’s.

cards.note: John 1:47 — *Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!* The guileless heart Issachar confesses is the very mark the Master praised in the true Israelite.
cards.s_text: Guile arose not in my heart; A lie passed not through my lips.
cards.t_text: Yahusha (Jesus) saw Nathanael coming to him, and says of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!

cards.note: Psalms 32:2 — *Blessed is the man unto whom Yahuah (LORD) imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.* "Guile arose not in my heart; a lie passed not through my lips" is the very blessedness the psalmist names — the spirit without guile.
cards.s_text: Guile arose not in my heart; A lie passed not through my lips.
cards.t_text: Blessed is the man unto whom Yahuah (LORD) imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

cards.note: Genesis 37:24 — *And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.* Zebulun weeping in secret over Joseph stands beside the bare Genesis record of the pit into which the brothers cast him.
cards.s_text: But I wept 'in secret' many days on account of Joseph, for I feared my brethren, 'because they had all agreed, that if any one should declare the secret, he should be slain'.
cards.t_text: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit was empty, there was no water in it.

cards.note: Genesis 37:21 — *And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.* Zebulun's pleading that they not be guilty of slaying Joseph echoes Reuben's cry to spare him in the same hour.
cards.s_text: But when they wished to kill him, I adjured them much [with tears] not to be guilty of this sin.
cards.t_text: And Reuben heard it, and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.

cards.note: Genesis 50:20 — *But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.* That Yahuah forbade water to rise in the pit so Joseph might be preserved is the same providence turning the brothers' evil to deliverance.
cards.s_text: For for this cause Yahuah (Lord) forbade that water should rise up in them, in order that Joseph should be preserved.
cards.t_text: But as for you, you thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

cards.note: Proverbs 6:17 — *A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood.* The very sin Joseph begs them not to commit is named among the things that are an abomination to Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Pity me, my brethren, have mercy upon the bowels of Jacob our father: lay not upon me your hands 'to shed innocent blood', for I have not sinned against you.
cards.t_text: A proud look, a lying tongue, and hands that shed innocent blood,

cards.note: Genesis 37:22 — *And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands.* Joseph's cry "lay not upon me your hands to shed innocent blood" answers exactly to Reuben's "shed no blood... lay no hand upon him."
cards.s_text: Pity me, my brethren, have mercy upon the bowels of Jacob our father: lay not upon me your hands 'to shed innocent blood', for I have not sinned against you.
cards.t_text: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, but cast him into this pit that is in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.

cards.note: Genesis 37:26 — *And Yahudah (Judah) said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?* The brothers taking the price of Joseph is the trafficking in their brother's blood that Judah first proposed.
cards.s_text: We will not eat of it, for it is the price of our brother's blood, but we will assuredly tread it under foot, because he said that he would be king over us, 'and so let us see what will become of his dreams'.
cards.t_text: And Yahudah (Judah) said unto his brethren, What profit is it if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?

cards.note: Deuteronomy 25:9 — *Then shall his brother's wife come unto him in the presence of the elders, and loose his shoe from off his foot, and spit in his face, and shall answer and say, So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother's house.* This is the very "writing of the law of Moses" Zebulun names: the loosed sandal and the spitting that shame him who will not own his brother.
cards.s_text: Therefore it is written in the writing of the law of Moses, that whosoever will not raise up seed to his brother, his sandal should be unloosed, and they should spit into his face.
cards.t_text: Then shall his brother’s wife come unto him in the presence of the elders, and loose his shoe from off his foot, and spit in his face, and shall answer and say, So shall it be done unto that man that will not build up his brother’s house.

cards.note: Genesis 37:30 — *And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?* Reuben rending his clothes and crying "How shall I look in the face of Jacob my father?" is the same anguish Genesis sets in his mouth.
cards.s_text: And when Reuben heard that while he was away (Joseph) had been sold, he rent his clothes, and mourned, saying: How shall I look in the face of Jacob my father?
cards.t_text: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child is not; and I, whither shall I go?

cards.note: Genesis 37:31 — *And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood.* Dan's counsel to slay a kid and dip the coat is the very deceit Genesis records against Jacob.
cards.s_text: Let us slay a kid of the goats, and dip in it the coat of Joseph; and let us send it to Jacob, saying: Know, is this the coat of thy son? And they did so.
cards.t_text: And they took Joseph’s coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;

cards.note: Genesis 37:23 — *And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him.* Zebulun's note that they stripped Joseph's coat in selling him matches Genesis word for deed.
cards.s_text: 'For they stripped off from Joseph his coat when they were selling him, and put upon him the garment of a slave.'
cards.t_text: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;

cards.note: Micah 6:8 — *He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth Yahuah (LORD) require of thee, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with thy Elohim (God)?* To have compassion in the heart toward all is the love of mercy the prophet sets at the heart of what Yahuah requires.
cards.s_text: Have, therefore, compassion in your hearts, my children, because even as a man doeth to his neighbour, even so also will Yahuah (Lord) do to him.
cards.t_text: He has shewed you, O man, what is good; and what does Yahuah (LORD) require of you, but to do justly, and to love mercy, and to walk humbly with your Elohim (God)?

cards.note: Proverbs 19:17 — *He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto Yahuah (LORD); and that which he hath given will he pay him again.* Zebulun's pity, for which Yahuah blessed and preserved him, is Wisdom's mercy that lends to Yahuah himself.
cards.s_text: And now, my children, I bid you to keep the commands of Yahuah (Lord), 'and to show mercy to your neighbours, and to have compassion towards all, not towards men only, but also towards beasts.
cards.t_text: He that has pity upon the poor lendeth unto Yahuah (LORD); and that which he has given will he pay him again.

cards.note: Matthew 5:7 — *Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.* That the merciful man is dealt with mercifully by Yahuah is the very blessing of the Beatitude.
cards.s_text: Have, therefore, compassion in your hearts, my children, because even as a man doeth to his neighbour, even so also will Yahuah (Lord) do to him.
cards.t_text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

cards.note: Matthew 7:12 — *Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.* "Even as a man doeth to his neighbour, even so also will Yahuah do to him" is the same golden rule the Master calls the law and the prophets.
cards.s_text: Have, therefore, compassion in your hearts, my children, because even as a man doeth to his neighbour, even so also will Yahuah (Lord) do to him.
cards.t_text: Therefore all things whatsoever you would that men should do to you, do you even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

cards.note: Leviticus 19:18 — *Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).* Zebulun's command to keep Yahuah's commands and show mercy to thy neighbour stands on this Torah word.
cards.s_text: And now, my children, I bid you to keep the commands of Yahuah (Lord), 'and to show mercy to your neighbours, and to have compassion towards all, not towards men only, but also towards beasts.
cards.t_text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 29:12 — *Shut up alms in your storehouses: and it shall deliver you from all affliction.* Zebulun's manifold return for sharing is the alms-storehouse that the fathers say profits more than gold.
cards.s_text: Wherefore also Yahuah (Lord) satisfied me with abundance of fish when catching fish; for he that shareth with his neighbour receiveth manifold more from Yahuah (Lord).]
cards.t_text: Shut up alms in your storehouses: and it shall deliver you from all affliction.

cards.note: Proverbs 11:25 — *The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.* That the one who shares receives manifold more is exactly Wisdom's liberal soul made fat.
cards.s_text: Wherefore also Yahuah (Lord) satisfied me with abundance of fish when catching fish; for he that shareth with his neighbour receiveth manifold more from Yahuah (Lord).]
cards.t_text: The liberal soul shall be made fat: and he that watereth shall be watered also himself.

cards.note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 4:4 — *Reject not the supplication of the afflicted; neither turn away your face from a poor man.* Zebulun turning away neither stranger nor sick nor aged keeps the very counsel of the fathers' wisdom.
cards.s_text: And if a man were a stranger, or sick, or aged, I boiled the fish, and dressed them well, and offered them to all men, as every man had need, grieving with and having compassion upon them.
cards.t_text: Reject not the supplication of the afflicted; neither turn away your face from a poor man.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 15:8 — *But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth.* Sharing with every man as he had need is the wide-open hand Torah commands toward the poor brother.
cards.s_text: [And through compassion I shared my catch with every stranger.
cards.t_text: But you shall open your hand wide unto him, and shall surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth.

cards.note: Matthew 25:35 — *For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in.* Zebulun feeding the stranger and the sick from his catch is the very mercy the King counts as done to himself.
cards.s_text: [And through compassion I shared my catch with every stranger.
cards.t_text: For I was an hungred, and you gave me meat: I was thirsty, and you gave me drink: I was a stranger, and you took me in:

cards.note: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 29:8 — *Yet have you patience with a man in poor estate, and delay not to shew him mercy.* Where Zebulun had nothing to give yet kept compassion in bowels of mercy, he keeps the fathers' word to show mercy even in want.
cards.s_text: And if ye have not the wherewithal to give to him that needeth, have compassion for him in bowels of mercy.
cards.t_text: Yet have you patience with a man in poor estate, and delay not to shew him mercy.

cards.note: Leviticus 19:18 — *but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).* Showing compassion and mercy without hesitation to all men is the love of neighbour Torah lays as the rule.
cards.s_text: Do you, therefore, my children, from that which Elohim (God) bestoweth upon you, show compassion and mercy without hesitation to all men, and give to every man with a good heart.
cards.t_text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Matthew 25:36 — *Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.* Zebulun clothing the naked man in winter is the very deed the King receives as done to himself.
cards.s_text: [Now I will declare unto you what I did. I saw a man in distress through nakedness in winter-time, and had compassion upon him, and stole away a garment secretly from my father's house, and gave it to him who was in distress.
cards.t_text: Naked, and you clothed me: I was sick, and you visited me: I was in prison, and you came unto me.

cards.note: Ephesians 4:32 — *And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as Elohim (God) for Messiah's (Christ's) sake hath forgiven you.* Zebulun's charge to be without malice and set down no evil against a brother is the apostle's kindness and mutual forgiveness.
cards.s_text: To whom taking heed, do ye also, my children, 'approve yourselves without malice, and' love one another; and do not set down in account, each one of you, evil against his brother.
cards.t_text: And be you kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as Elohim (God) for Messiah's (Christ’s) sake has forgiven you.

cards.note: Genesis 50:20 — *But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.* Joseph bearing no malice in Egypt is the very forgiveness Genesis records over his brothers.
cards.s_text: And when we went down into Egypt, Joseph bore no malice against us.
cards.t_text: But as for you, you thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

cards.note: Luke 6:36 — *Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.* That in the degree a man has compassion Yahuah has compassion on him is the Father's mercy made the measure of the son's.
cards.s_text: For in the degree in which a man hath compassion upon his neighbours, in the same degree hath Yahuah (Lord) also upon him]
cards.t_text: Be you therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.

cards.note: Matthew 5:7 — *Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.* "Have, therefore, yourselves also, my children, compassion... that Yahuah (Lord) also may have compassion and mercy upon you" is the Beatitude almost word for word.
cards.s_text: Have, therefore, yourselves also, my children, compassion towards every man with mercy, that Yahuah (Lord) also may have compassion and mercy upon you.
cards.t_text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

cards.note: Ephesians 4:8 — *Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.* Yahuah Himself arising and bringing them back from captivity to their own land is the captivity-led-captive the apostle proclaims in the Messiah.
cards.s_text: And after these things shall there arise 'unto you' Yahuah (Lord) Himself, the light of righteousness, And ye shall return unto your own land. And ye shall see Him in Jerusalem, 'for His name's sake'.
cards.t_text: Wherefore he says, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.

cards.note: Isaiah 60:1 — *Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) is risen upon thee.* That ye shall see Him in Jerusalem when the light arises is the glory of Yahuah risen upon Zion as her sons are gathered.
cards.s_text: And after these things shall there arise 'unto you' Yahuah (Lord) Himself, the light of righteousness, And ye shall return unto your own land. And ye shall see Him in Jerusalem, 'for His name's sake'.
cards.t_text: Arise, shine; for your light is come, and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) is risen upon you.

cards.note: Isaiah 9:2 — *The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.* The light of righteousness arising upon Israel is the great light Isaiah says shall shine on the people in darkness — the land of Zebulun named in the verses before.
cards.s_text: And after these things shall there arise 'unto you' Yahuah (Lord) Himself, the light of righteousness, And ye shall return unto your own land. And ye shall see Him in Jerusalem, 'for His name's sake'.
cards.t_text: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them has the light shined.

cards.note: Malachi 4:2 — *But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.* "Yahuah Himself, the light of righteousness" rising upon them is the Sun of righteousness Malachi says shall arise with healing.
cards.s_text: And after these things shall there arise 'unto you' Yahuah (Lord) Himself, the light of righteousness, And ye shall return unto your own land. And ye shall see Him in Jerusalem, 'for His name's sake'.
cards.t_text: But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and you shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:3 — *That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath scattered thee.* Yahuah being merciful and compassionate to the repentant captives is Moses' promise to turn the captivity and gather them.
cards.s_text: And after these things ye shall remember Yahuah (Lord) and repent, And He shall have mercy upon you, for He is merciful and compassionate. And He setteth not down in account evil against the sons of men, Because they are flesh, and are deceived through their own wicked deeds.
cards.t_text: That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn your captivity, and have compassion upon you, and will return and gather you from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has scattered you.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:2 — *And shalt return unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.* "Ye shall remember Yahuah and repent, and He shall have mercy" is the return with all the heart Moses foretold.
cards.s_text: And after these things ye shall remember Yahuah (Lord) and repent, And He shall have mercy upon you, for He is merciful and compassionate. And He setteth not down in account evil against the sons of men, Because they are flesh, and are deceived through their own wicked deeds.
cards.t_text: And shall return unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and shall obey his voice according to all that I command you this day, you and your children, with all your heart, and with all your soul;

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:17 — *And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.* That everything Yahuah made has but one head is mirrored in the two sticks of Judah and Joseph made one in Yahuah's hand.
cards.s_text: Be not ye, therefore, divided into two heads, for everything which Yahuah (Lord) made hath but one head, and two shoulders, two hands, two feet, but all the remaining members.
cards.t_text: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in your hand.

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:22 — *And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.* Zebulun's "Ye shall be divided in Yashar'el (Israel), And ye shall follow two kings" is the very division of the two kingdoms Ezekiel says shall at last be made one.
cards.s_text: For I have learnt in the writing of my fathers, that Ye shall be divided in Yashar'el (Israel), And ye shall follow two kings, And shall work every abomination.
cards.t_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

cards.note: Genesis 49:29 — *I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite.* Zebulun carried up and buried in Hebron with his fathers keeps the same burial among the patriarchs Jacob charged.
cards.s_text: And afterwards they carried him up and buried him in Hebron, with his fathers.
cards.t_text: And he charged them, and said unto them, I am to be gathered unto my people: bury me with my fathers in the cave that is in the field of Ephron the Hittite,

cards.note: Isaiah 26:19 — *Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise.
