Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.* That he shall rise and rejoice in the midst of his tribe is the awaking and singing of the dust Isaiah promised.
cards.s_text: For I shall rise again in the midst of you, 'as a ruler in the midst of his sons'; and I shall rejoice in the midst of my tribe, as many as shall keep the law of Yahuah (Lord), 'and the commandments of Zebulun their father'.
cards.t_text: Your dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, you that dwell in dust: for your dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.

cards.note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* Zebulun's confidence that he shall rise again in the midst of his sons rests on the awaking from the dust Daniel foretold.
cards.s_text: For I shall rise again in the midst of you, 'as a ruler in the midst of his sons'; and I shall rejoice in the midst of my tribe, as many as shall keep the law of Yahuah (Lord), 'and the commandments of Zebulun their father'.
cards.t_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

cards.note: Eph 4:27 — *Neither give place to the devil.* The very surrender Dan repented of when Beliar's spirit handed him the sword.
cards.s_text: But the Elohim (God) of my fathers did not suffer him to fall into my hands, so that I should find him alone and slay him, and cause a second tribe to be destroyed in Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: Neither give place to the devil.

cards.note: Prov 14:30 — *A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.* The envy that made Dan crush at Joseph as a leopard at a kid.
cards.s_text: Now this was the spirit of anger that persuaded me to crush Joseph as a leopard crusheth a kid.
cards.t_text: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

cards.note: John 8:44 — *Ye are of your father the devil... He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth... for he is a liar, and the father of it.* The murderer-and-liar behind the spirit of Beliar that armed Dan against Joseph.
cards.s_text: And one of the spirits of Beliar stirred me up, saying: Take this sword, and with it slay Joseph; so shall thy father love thee when he is dead.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: Jas 1:20 — *For the wrath of man worketh not the righteousness of God.* James, like Dan, sets anger over against the truth that pleases God.
cards.s_text: I have proved in my heart, and in my whole life, that truth with just dealing is good and well pleasing to Elohim (God), and that lying and anger are evil, because they teach man all wickedness.
cards.t_text: For the wrath of man works not the righteousness of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Eph 4:26 — *Be ye angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath.* Paul names the very evil Dan warns of, the wrath that teaches a man wickedness.
cards.s_text: I have proved in my heart, and in my whole life, that truth with just dealing is good and well pleasing to Elohim (God), and that lying and anger are evil, because they teach man all wickedness.
cards.t_text: Be you angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath:

cards.note: Eph 4:25 — *Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.* The same pairing of truth against lying that Dan calls good and well pleasing to God.
cards.s_text: I have proved in my heart, and in my whole life, that truth with just dealing is good and well pleasing to Elohim (God), and that lying and anger are evil, because they teach man all wickedness.
cards.t_text: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

cards.note: Eph 4:31 — *Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice.* The catalogue of the very spirit Dan begs his sons to keep themselves from.
cards.s_text: And now, my children, behold I am dying, and I tell you of a truth, that unless ye keep yourselves from the spirit of lying and of anger, and love truth and longsuffering, ye shall perish.
cards.t_text: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

cards.note: Prov 14:30 — *but envy the rottenness of the bones.* The hatred of heart and envy of a brother that anger ends in, by Dan's own reckoning.
cards.s_text: And wherewith encompasseth it his eyes? With hatred of heart, so as to be envious of his brother.
cards.t_text: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

cards.note: Prov 14:29 — *He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.* The blindness of anger that Dan says cannot see a man's face with truth.
cards.s_text: For anger is blindness, and does not suffer one to see the face of any man with truth.
cards.t_text: He that is slow to wrath is of great understanding: but he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

cards.note: Jas 1:19 — *let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath.* The longsuffering Dan commands against the spirit of anger.
cards.s_text: And now, my children, behold I am dying, and I tell you of a truth, that unless ye keep yourselves from the spirit of lying and of anger, and love truth and longsuffering, ye shall perish.
cards.t_text: Wherefore, my beloved brethren, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, slow to wrath:

cards.note: John 8:44 — *When he speaketh a lie, he speaketh of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.* Beliar's character, who rules the soul that lying and wrath have left to him.
cards.s_text: Moreover, a twofold mischief is wrath with lying; and they assist one another in order to disturb the heart; and when the soul is continually disturbed, Yahuah (Lord) departeth from it, and Beliar ruleth over it.
cards.t_text: You are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father you will do. He was a murderer from the beginning, and abode not in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks of his own: for he is a liar, and the father of it.

cards.note: Eph 4:25 — *Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour.* The lying that, wedded to wrath, makes the twofold mischief Dan warns against.
cards.s_text: And if ye suffer loss voluntarily, or involuntarily, be not vexed; for from vexation ariseth wrath 'with lying'.
cards.t_text: Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another.

cards.note: Eph 4:27 — *Neither give place to the devil.* The very giving-over Dan describes when the disturbed soul yields and Beliar rules over it.
cards.s_text: Moreover, a twofold mischief is wrath with lying; and they assist one another in order to disturb the heart; and when the soul is continually disturbed, Yahuah (Lord) departeth from it, and Beliar ruleth over it.
cards.t_text: Neither give place to the devil.

cards.note: Ezek 37:27 — *My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.* The Lord in the midst of His restored city, exactly as Dan promises Jerusalem.
cards.s_text: And no longer shall Jerusalem endure desolation, Nor Yashar'el (Israel) be led captive; For Yahuah (Lord) shall be in the midst of it [living amongst men], And the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel) shall reign over it [in humility and in poverty; and he who believeth on Him shall reign amongst men in truth].
cards.t_text: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their Elohim (God), and they shall be my people.

cards.note: Ezek 37:22 — *and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.* The end of captivity and division Dan foresees when the Lord dwells in the midst of Jerusalem.
cards.s_text: And no longer shall Jerusalem endure desolation, Nor Yashar'el (Israel) be led captive; For Yahuah (Lord) shall be in the midst of it [living amongst men], And the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel) shall reign over it [in humility and in poverty; and he who believeth on Him shall reign amongst men in truth].
cards.t_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

cards.note: Deut 30:3 — *will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations.* The very return-and-mercy Dan promises when Israel turns back to the Lord.
cards.s_text: And so when ye return to Yahuah (Lord) ye shall obtain mercy, And He shall bring you into His sanctuary, And He shall give you peace.
cards.t_text: That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn your captivity, and have compassion upon you, and will return and gather you from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has scattered you.

cards.note: Isa 65:18 — *for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.* The rejoicing of the righteous in the New Jerusalem that Dan foresees.
cards.s_text: And the saints shall rest in Eden, And in the New Jerusalem will the righteous rejoice, And it shall be unto the glory of Elohim (God) for ever.
cards.t_text: But be you glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

cards.note: Gen 2:9 — *the tree of life also in the midst of the garden.* The Eden in which Dan's saints shall rest, the garden the New Jerusalem brings back.
cards.s_text: And the saints shall rest in Eden, And in the New Jerusalem will the righteous rejoice, And it shall be unto the glory of Elohim (God) for ever.
cards.t_text: And out of the ground made Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.

cards.note: Rev 22:2 — *was there the tree of life... and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.* Eden's tree restored within the city — the rest Dan promises the saints.
cards.s_text: And the saints shall rest in Eden, And in the New Jerusalem will the righteous rejoice, And it shall be unto the glory of Elohim (God) for ever.
cards.t_text: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

cards.note: Rev 21:2 — *And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from Elohim (God) out of heaven*. The very New Jerusalem in which Dan says the righteous shall rejoice.
cards.s_text: And the saints shall rest in Eden, And in the New Jerusalem will the righteous rejoice, And it shall be unto the glory of Elohim (God) for ever.
cards.t_text: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from Elohim (God) out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

cards.note: Rev 20:6 — *but they shall be priests of Elohim (God) and of Messiah (Christ), and shall reign with him a thousand years.* The saints whose captivity is taken from Beliar, reigning in the peace Dan promises them.
cards.s_text: And the captivity shall he take from Beliar [the souls of the saints], And turn disobedient hearts unto Yahuah (Lord), And give to them that call upon him eternal peace.
cards.t_text: Blessed and holy is he that has part in the first resurrection: on such the second death has no power, but they shall be priests of Elohim (God) and of Messiah (Christ), and shall reign with him a thousand years.

cards.note: Rev 20:2 — *And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years.* The binding of Beliar that Dan calls the war the Lord's salvation makes against him.
cards.s_text: And there shall arise unto you from the tribe of [Yahudah (Judah) and of] Levi the salvation of Yahuah (Lord); And he shall make war against Beliar, And execute an everlasting vengeance on our enemies;
cards.t_text: And he laid hold on the dragon, that old serpent, which is the Devil, and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

cards.note: Eph 4:8 — *When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.* The captivity the Lord's salvation takes from Beliar, in Dan's words turning disobedient hearts back to the Lord.
cards.s_text: And the captivity shall he take from Beliar [the souls of the saints], And turn disobedient hearts unto Yahuah (Lord), And give to them that call upon him eternal peace.
cards.t_text: Wherefore he says, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men.

cards.note: Heb 7:14 — *For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.* The very fusion Dan foretells — the King out of Judah made also the priest, after the order of Melchizedek.
cards.s_text: And there shall arise unto you from the tribe of [Yahudah (Judah) and of] Levi the salvation of Yahuah (Lord); And he shall make war against Beliar, And execute an everlasting vengeance on our enemies;
cards.t_text: For it is evident that our Lord sprang out of Juda; of which tribe Moses spake nothing concerning priesthood.

cards.note: Num 24:17 — *there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel)*. Balaam's Sceptre, the king from Judah whom Dan joins with Levi as the salvation of the Lord.
cards.s_text: And there shall arise unto you from the tribe of [Yahudah (Judah) and of] Levi the salvation of Yahuah (Lord); And he shall make war against Beliar, And execute an everlasting vengeance on our enemies;
cards.t_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

cards.note: Zech 6:13 — *and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.* The joined priesthood and kingship — Levi and Judah — from which Dan says salvation arises.
cards.s_text: And there shall arise unto you from the tribe of [Yahudah (Judah) and of] Levi the salvation of Yahuah (Lord); And he shall make war against Beliar, And execute an everlasting vengeance on our enemies;
cards.t_text: Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD); and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

cards.note: Deut 30:4 — *from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:* The Lord's name in every place of Israel and among the Gentiles — the gathering of the scattered Dan foresees.
cards.s_text: And His name shall be in every place of Yashar'el (Israel), 'and among the Gentiles'.
cards.t_text: If any of yours be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather you, and from thence will he fetch you:

cards.note: Ezek 37:23 — *but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people.* The transforming into a nation that does His will, which Dan promises the repentant.
cards.s_text: And it shall be in the time of the lawlessness of Yashar'el (Israel), that Yahuah (Lord) will (not) depart from them, but will transform them into a nation that doeth His will, for none of the angels will be equal unto him.
cards.t_text: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their Elohim (God).

cards.note: Deut 30:2 — *And shalt return unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart*. The day of Israel's repentance on which Dan says the enemy's kingdom ends.
cards.s_text: For he knoweth that on the day on which Yashar'el (Israel) shall repent, the kingdom of the enemy shall be brought to an end.
cards.t_text: And shall return unto Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and shall obey his voice according to all that I command you this day, you and your children, with all your heart, and with all your soul;

cards.note: Heb 7:25 — *seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.* The intercession of the priest-king, exactly the office Dan ascribes to the one who pleads Israel's peace.
cards.s_text: Draw near unto Elohim (God) and to the angel that intercedeth for you, for he is a mediator between Elohim (God) and man, and for the peace of Yashar'el (Israel) he shall stand up against the kingdom of the enemy.
cards.t_text: Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto Elohim (God) by him, seeing he ever lives to make intercession for them.

cards.note: 1 Tim 2:5 — *For there is one Elohim (God), and one mediator between Elohim (God) and men, the man HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus);* The single mediator Dan tells his sons to draw near to — the appointed Anointed, not a co-equal, but the man who stands between God and Israel.
cards.s_text: Draw near unto Elohim (God) and to the angel that intercedeth for you, for he is a mediator between Elohim (God) and man, and for the peace of Yashar'el (Israel) he shall stand up against the kingdom of the enemy.
cards.t_text: For there is one Elohim (God), and one mediator between Elohim (God) and men, the man HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus);

cards.note: Genesis 35:24 — *The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:* — Rachel's prayer for "a brother of thine from mine own womb," whence "Joseph was like unto me in all things," reaches for the sons Rachel herself bore.
cards.s_text: Whence also Joseph was like unto me 'in all things', according to the prayers of Rachel.
cards.t_text: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

cards.note: Genesis 30:7 — *And Bilhah Rachel’s maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.* — "I was born from Bilhah... and she conceived and bare me" is the birth of that second son of Bilhah.
cards.s_text: I was born from Bilhah; 'and' because Rachel dealt craftily, and gave Bilhah in place of herself to Jacob, and she conceived and bare me upon Rachel's knees, 'therefore' she called my name Naphtali.
cards.t_text: And Bilhah Rachel’s maid conceived again, and bare Jacob a second son.

cards.note: Genesis 30:8 — *And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.* — Naphtali's word that Bilhah "conceived and bare me upon Rachel's knees, therefore she called my name Naphtali" is the very naming Moses set down.
cards.s_text: I was born from Bilhah; 'and' because Rachel dealt craftily, and gave Bilhah in place of herself to Jacob, and she conceived and bare me upon Rachel's knees, 'therefore' she called my name Naphtali.
cards.t_text: And Rachel said, With great wrestlings have I wrestled with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called his name Naphtali.

cards.note: John 1:5 — *And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.* — "neither while ye are in darkness can ye do the works of light" is the same parting of light and darkness, of the works of light from the works of Beliar.
cards.s_text: For if thou bid the eye to hear, it cannot; so neither while ye are in darkness can ye do the works of light.
cards.t_text: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.

cards.note: Genesis 1:4 — *And Elohim (God) saw the light, that it was good: and Elohim (God) divided the light from the darkness.* — "as there is a division between light and darkness... so also is there a division between man and man" reaches for the first dividing on the first day.
cards.s_text: And as there is a division between light and darkness, between seeing and hearing, so also is there a division between man and man, and between woman and woman; and it is not to be said that the one is like the other either in face or in mind.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) saw the light, that it was good: and Elohim (God) divided the light from the darkness.

cards.note: Genesis 1:31 — *And Elohim (God) saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.* — "Elohim (God) made all things good in their order" echoes the verdict over the whole creation, that it was very good.
cards.s_text: 'For' Elohim (God) made all things good in their order, the five senses in the head, and He joined on the neck to the head, adding to it the hair also for comeliness and glory, then the heart for understanding, the belly for excrement, and the stomach for grinding, the windpipe for taking in (the breath), the liver for wrath, the gall for bitterness, the spleen for laughter, the reins 'for prudence, the muscles of the loins' for power, the lungs for drawing in, the loins for strength, and so forth.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. And the evening and the morning were the sixth day.

cards.note: Genesis 1:27 — *So Elohim (God) created man in his own image, in the image of Elohim (God) created he him; male and female created he them.* — "He created every man after His own image" is the word of the sixth day repeated.
cards.s_text: For there is no inclination or thought which Yahuah (Lord) knoweth not, for He created every man after His own image.
cards.t_text: So Elohim (God) created man in his own image, in the image of Elohim (God) created he him; male and female created he them.

cards.note: Psalm 139:2 — *Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.* — "there is no inclination or thought which Yahuah knoweth not" is the LORD who understands the thought afar off.
cards.s_text: For there is no inclination or thought which Yahuah (Lord) knoweth not, for He created every man after His own image.
cards.t_text: You know my downsitting and my uprising, you understand my thought afar off.

cards.note: Psalm 139:14 — *I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.* — that the body is made "by weight, and measure, and rule" after the likeness of the spirit is the wonder of being fearfully and wonderfully made.
cards.s_text: And the one does not fall short of the other by a third part of a hair; for by weight, and measure, and rule was all the creation made.
cards.t_text: I will praise you; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are your works; and that my soul knows right well.

cards.note: Jeremiah 18:6 — *O house of Yashar'el (Israel), cannot I do with you as this potter? saith Yahuah (LORD). Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are ye in mine hand, O house of Yashar'el (Israel).* — the potter who "knoweth the use of each vessel" is the LORD who holds Israel as clay in His hand.
cards.s_text: And as the potter knoweth the use of each vessel, what it is meet for, so also doth Yahuah (Lord) know the body, how far it will persist in goodness, and when it beginneth in evil.
cards.t_text: O house of Yashar'el (Israel), cannot I do with you as this potter? says Yahuah (LORD). Behold, as the clay is in the potter’s hand, so are you in my hand, O house of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: Isaiah 64:8 — *But now, O Yahuah (LORD), thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.* — "as the potter knoweth the vessel... so also doth Yahuah make the body" is the very figure of the LORD as potter and man as clay.
cards.s_text: For as the potter knoweth the vessel, how much it is to contain, and bringeth clay accordingly, so also doth Yahuah (Lord) make the body after the likeness of the spirit, and according to the capacity of the body doth He implant the spirit.
cards.t_text: But now, O Yahuah (LORD), you are our father; we are the clay, and you our potter; and we all are the work of your hand.

cards.note: Romans 1:23 — *And changed the glory of the uncorruptible Elohim (God) into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.* — "the Gentiles... obeyed stocks and stones" is Paul's word that they changed the glory of God into an image.
cards.s_text: The Gentiles went astray, and forsook Yahuah (Lord), and changed their order, and obeyed stocks and stones, spirits of deceit.
cards.t_text: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible Elohim (God) into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

cards.note: Jude 1:7 — *Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.* — Naphtali joins Sodom and the Watchers exactly as Jude does, an example of the order of nature changed and judged.
cards.s_text: But ye shall not be so, my children, recognising in the firmament, in the earth, and in the sea, and in all created things, Yahuah (Lord) who made all things, that ye become not as Sodom, which changed the order of nature.
cards.t_text: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.

cards.note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* — the Watchers "whom Yahuah cursed" are the angels Jude says kept not their first estate.
cards.s_text: In like manner the Watchers also changed the order of their nature, whom Yahuah (Lord) cursed at the flood, on whose account He made the earth without inhabitant and fruitless.
cards.t_text: And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 10:8 — *And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.* — "on whose account He made the earth without inhabitant and fruitless" is the corruption of the whole earth that Enoch lays to the Watchers (self-link).
cards.s_text: In like manner the Watchers also changed the order of their nature, whom Yahuah (Lord) cursed at the flood, on whose account He made the earth without inhabitant and fruitless.
cards.t_text: And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’

cards.note: 1 Enoch 7:1 — *And all the others together with them took unto themselves wives, and each chose for himself one, and they began to go in unto them and to defile themselves with them, and they taught them charms and enchantments...* — the Watchers "whom Yahuah cursed at the flood" are the very ones whose defiling and corrupting Enoch records (self-link).
cards.s_text: In like manner the Watchers also changed the order of their nature, whom Yahuah (Lord) cursed at the flood, on whose account He made the earth without inhabitant and fruitless.
cards.t_text: And all the others together with them took unto themselves wives, and each chose for himself one, and they began to go in unto them and to defile themselves with them, and they taught them charms and enchantments, and the cutting of roots, and made them acquainted with plants.

cards.note: Genesis 6:4 — *There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.* — "the Watchers also changed the order of their nature" reaches for the sons of God who came in unto the daughters of men before the flood.
cards.s_text: In like manner the Watchers also changed the order of their nature, whom Yahuah (Lord) cursed at the flood, on whose account He made the earth without inhabitant and fruitless.
cards.t_text: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.

cards.note: Genesis 19:24 — *Then Yahuah (LORD) rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Yahuah (LORD) out of heaven;* — "that ye become not as Sodom, which changed the order of nature" recalls the city the LORD overthrew with fire.
cards.s_text: But ye shall not be so, my children, recognising in the firmament, in the earth, and in the sea, and in all created things, Yahuah (Lord) who made all things, that ye become not as Sodom, which changed the order of nature.
cards.t_text: Then Yahuah (LORD) rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Yahuah (LORD) out of heaven;

cards.note: Romans 1:20 — *For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:* — "recognising in the firmament, in the earth, and in the sea... Yahuah who made all things" is Paul's witness of the Maker read off the created order.
cards.s_text: But ye shall not be so, my children, recognising in the firmament, in the earth, and in the sea, and in all created things, Yahuah (Lord) who made all things, that ye become not as Sodom, which changed the order of nature.
cards.t_text: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

cards.note: Psalm 19:7 — *The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.* — "change not the law of Elohim (God)" rests on the law that is perfect, the same psalm that begins with the ordered heavens.
cards.s_text: Sun and moon and stars change not their order; so do ye also change not the law of Elohim (God) in the disorderliness of your doings.
cards.t_text: The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.

cards.note: Psalm 19:1 — *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork.* — that the unchanging luminaries rebuke the changing of God's law is the same testimony the heavens themselves declare.
cards.s_text: Sun and moon and stars change not their order; so do ye also change not the law of Elohim (God) in the disorderliness of your doings.
cards.t_text: The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament shows his handywork.

cards.note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* — "sun and moon and stars change not their order" is the appointed ordering of the lights on the fourth day.
cards.s_text: Sun and moon and stars change not their order; so do ye also change not the law of Elohim (God) in the disorderliness of your doings.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:

cards.note: Isaiah 11:11 — *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left...* — "after ye have become minished and made few, ye shall return" is the remnant the LORD recovers the second time.
cards.s_text: And after ye have become minished and made few, ye shall return and acknowledge Yahuah Elohaychem (the Lord your God); and He shall bring you back into your own land, according to His abundant mercy.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Adonai (Lord) shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:21 — *Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:* — "Yahuah shall scatter them upon the face of all the earth, until the compassion of Yahuah shall come" looks for the gathering of the scattered house Ezekiel foretells.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (Lord) shall scatter them upon the face of all the earth, until the compassion of Yahuah (Lord) shall come, a man working righteousness and working mercy unto all them that are afar off, and to them that are near.
cards.t_text: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:3 — *That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath scattered thee.* — "ye shall return and acknowledge Yahuah Elohaychem (the Lord your God); and He shall bring you back into your own land, according to His abundant mercy" is the turning of the captivity and the gathering Moses promised.
cards.s_text: And after ye have become minished and made few, ye shall return and acknowledge Yahuah Elohaychem (the Lord your God); and He shall bring you back into your own land, according to His abundant mercy.
cards.t_text: That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn your captivity, and have compassion upon you, and will return and gather you from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has scattered you.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:1 — *And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath driven thee,* — "Yahuah shall bring captivity upon you... ye shall be bowed down with every affliction" is the curse Moses set before Israel among the nations.
cards.s_text: And Yahuah (Lord) shall bring captivity upon you, and 'there' shall ye serve your enemies, and ye shall be bowed down with every affliction and tribulation, until Yahuah (Lord) have consumed you all.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has driven you,

cards.note: *And after that in the sixth week all who live in it shall be blinded, And the hearts of all of them shall godlessly forsake wisdom. And in it a man shall ascend; And at its close the house of dominion shall be burnt with fire, And the whole race of the chosen root shall be dispersed.* (1 Enoch 93:8). 1 Enoch 91 —  — "I have read in the writing of Enoch that ye yourselves also shall depart from Yahuah" reaches for the very book of Enoch that foretells the generation of apostasy (self-link).
cards.s_text: These things I say unto you, my children, for I have read in the writing of Enoch that ye yourselves also shall depart from Yahuah (Lord), walking according to all the lawlessness of the Gentiles, and ye shall do according to all the wickedness of Sodom.
cards.t_text: And after that in the sixth week all who live in it shall be blinded, And the hearts of all of them shall godlessly forsake wisdom. And in it a man shall ascend; And at its close the house of dominion shall be burnt with fire, And the whole race of the chosen root shall be dispersed.

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:22 — *And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel)... and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:* — the captivity of all twelve tribes looks to the day Ezekiel foretells, when the divided house is made one nation again.
cards.s_text: And I saw, for I was there, and behold a holy writing appeared to us, saying: Assyrians, Medes, Persians, [Chaldeans,] Syrians, shall possess in captivity the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:1 — *...thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath driven thee,* — that the nations "shall possess in captivity the twelve tribes of Yashar'el" is the driving among the nations Moses set before them.
cards.s_text: And I saw, for I was there, and behold a holy writing appeared to us, saying: Assyrians, Medes, Persians, [Chaldeans,] Syrians, shall possess in captivity the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has driven you,

cards.note: Zechariah 6:13 — *and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.* — Levi as the sun and Judah as the moon, raised together, is the counsel of peace between priest and king.
cards.s_text: And we all of us ran together, and Levi laid hold of the sun, and Yahudah (Judah) outstripped the others and seized the moon, and they were both of them lifted up with them.
cards.t_text: Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD); and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

cards.note: Numbers 24:17 — *there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.* — that Levi seizes the sun and Judah the moon, both lifted up, is the priest-king hope summed in the Star of Jacob and the Sceptre of Israel.
cards.s_text: And we all of us ran together, and Levi laid hold of the sun, and Yahudah (Judah) outstripped the others and seized the moon, and they were both of them lifted up with them.
cards.t_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

cards.note: Genesis 37:9 — *Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.* — Naphtali's vision "that the sun and the moon were standing still" takes up the very luminaries of Joseph's dream among the brethren.
cards.s_text: For in the fortieth year of my life, I saw a vision on the Mount of Olives, on the east of Jerusalem, that the sun and the moon were standing still.
cards.t_text: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:22 — *And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel)... and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:* — that amid the scattering "Levi and Yahudah were together" foreshadows the priest and king of the one reunited house.
cards.s_text: And Joseph fled away upon a little boat, 'and we all were divided upon nine planks,' and Levi and Yahudah (Judah) were together.
cards.t_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:3 — *...will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath scattered thee.* — that "the ship reached the land, as it were in peace" and the father came and all rejoiced is the gathering home after the scattering.
cards.s_text: And when the storm ceased, the ship reached the land, 'as it were' in peace. And, lo, our father came, and we all rejoiced with one accord.
cards.t_text: That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn your captivity, and have compassion upon you, and will return and gather you from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has scattered you.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:4 — *If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:* — "we were all scattered unto the ends of the earth" is the driving to the outmost parts from which the LORD promised to gather Israel.
cards.s_text: And we were all scattered unto the ends of the earth.
cards.t_text: If any of yours be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gather you, and from thence will he fetch you:

cards.note: Psalm 19:11 — *Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.* — "that Yahuah may love you" through keeping His commandments in due order is the great reward of keeping them.
cards.s_text: Be ye therefore wise in Elohim (God), 'my children,' and prudent, understanding the order of His commandments, and the laws of every word, that Yahuah (Lord) may love you.
cards.t_text: Moreover by them is your servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

cards.note: Psalm 19:7 — *The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.* — "Be ye therefore wise in Elohim (God)... understanding the order of His commandments" rests on the law that is perfect and makes the simple wise.
cards.s_text: Be ye therefore wise in Elohim (God), 'my children,' and prudent, understanding the order of His commandments, and the laws of every word, that Yahuah (Lord) may love you.
cards.t_text: The law of Yahuah (LORD) is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of Yahuah (LORD) is sure, making wise the simple.

cards.note: Matthew 1:23 — *Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.* — that God should appear and dwell among men to save Israel is Immanuel, God with us, born to save his people from their sins.
cards.s_text: For through their tribes shall Elohim (God) appear [dwelling among men] on earth, To save the race of Yashar'el (Israel), And to gather together the righteous from amongst the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.

cards.note: John 1:14 — *And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.* — "Elohim (God) shall appear, dwelling among men on earth" is fulfilled when the Word was made flesh and dwelt among us — the only begotten whom the Father sent, the Formed one walking among men.
cards.s_text: For through their tribes shall Elohim (God) appear [dwelling among men] on earth, To save the race of Yashar'el (Israel), And to gather together the righteous from amongst the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:12 — *And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.* — "to save the race of Yashar'el" is the assembling of the outcasts of Israel and the dispersed of Judah, the two-house gathering.
cards.s_text: For through their tribes shall Elohim (God) appear [dwelling among men] on earth, To save the race of Yashar'el (Israel), And to gather together the righteous from amongst the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:10 — *And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.* — that He gathers "the righteous from amongst the Gentiles" is the root of Jesse to whom the nations seek.
cards.s_text: For through their tribes shall Elohim (God) appear [dwelling among men] on earth, To save the race of Yashar'el (Israel), And to gather together the righteous from amongst the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.

cards.note: Zechariah 2:11 — *And many nations shall be joined to Yahuah (LORD) in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of thee...* — "to gather together the righteous from amongst the Gentiles" is the many nations joined to the LORD when He dwells among His people.
cards.s_text: For through their tribes shall Elohim (God) appear [dwelling among men] on earth, To save the race of Yashar'el (Israel), And to gather together the righteous from amongst the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: And many nations shall be joined to Yahuah (LORD) in that day, and shall be my people: and I will dwell in the midst of you, and you shall know that Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) has sent me unto you.

cards.note: Zechariah 2:10 — *Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of thee, saith Yahuah (LORD).* — "shall Elohim (God) appear [dwelling among men] on earth" is the LORD's own promise to come and dwell in the midst of Zion.
cards.s_text: For through their tribes shall Elohim (God) appear [dwelling among men] on earth, To save the race of Yashar'el (Israel), And to gather together the righteous from amongst the Gentiles.
cards.t_text: Sing and rejoice, O daughter of Zion: for, lo, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of you, says Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Zechariah 6:13 — *and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.* — to "be united to Levi and to Yahudah" is the counsel of peace between priest and king made one in the anointed.
cards.s_text: Do ye also, 'therefore,' charge your children that they be united to Levi and to Yahudah (Judah); For through them shall salvation arise unto Yashar'el (Israel), And in them shall Jacob be blessed.
cards.t_text: Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD); and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

cards.note: Numbers 24:17 — *there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel)...* — "through them shall salvation arise unto Yashar'el, and in them shall Jacob be blessed" is the Star and Sceptre that arise out of Jacob and Israel.
cards.s_text: Do ye also, 'therefore,' charge your children that they be united to Levi and to Yahudah (Judah); For through them shall salvation arise unto Yashar'el (Israel), And in them shall Jacob be blessed.
cards.t_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

cards.note: 1 John 2:11 — *But he that hateth his brother is in darkness, and walketh in darkness, and knoweth not whither he goeth, because that darkness hath blinded his eyes.* That Gad would neither hear nor see Joseph is the blinded eyes John describes.
cards.s_text: And the spirit of hatred was in me, and I wished not either to hear of Joseph with the ears, or to see him with the eyes, because he rebuked us to our faces 'saying' that we were eating of the flock without Yahudah (Judah). For whatsoever things he told our father, he believed him.
cards.t_text: But he that hates his brother is in darkness, and walks in darkness, and knows not whither he goes, because that darkness has blinded his eyes.

cards.note: 1 John 2:9 — *He that saith he is in the light, and hateth his brother, is in darkness even until now.* Gad's spirit of hatred toward his brother is exactly the darkness John exposes.
cards.s_text: And the spirit of hatred was in me, and I wished not either to hear of Joseph with the ears, or to see him with the eyes, because he rebuked us to our faces 'saying' that we were eating of the flock without Yahudah (Judah). For whatsoever things he told our father, he believed him.
cards.t_text: He that says he is in the light, and hates his brother, is in darkness even until now.

cards.note: Genesis 37:4 — *And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.* The grudge Gad confesses is the brethren's hatred Moses names.
cards.s_text: And the spirit of hatred was in me, and I wished not either to hear of Joseph with the ears, or to see him with the eyes, because he rebuked us to our faces 'saying' that we were eating of the flock without Yahudah (Judah). For whatsoever things he told our father, he believed him.
cards.t_text: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.

cards.note: Genesis 37:2 — *These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.* The very scene Gad describes — Joseph with the sons of Bilhah, carrying their report to their father.
cards.s_text: And Joseph told our father that the sons of 'Zilpah and' Bilhah were slaying the best 'of the flock' and eating them against the judgment of Reuben and Yahudah (Judah).
cards.t_text: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad was with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father’s wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.

cards.note: Genesis 50:20 — *But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.* That God delivered Joseph from their hands lest they work great lawlessness is the very providence Joseph names to his brethren.
cards.s_text: Thus the Elohim (God) of our fathers delivered him from our hands, that we should not work great lawlessness in Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: But as for you, you thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

cards.note: Genesis 37:27 — *Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.* The selling Gad confesses is Judah's counsel Moses records.
cards.s_text: And Yahudah (Judah) sold him secretly to the Ishmaelites.
cards.t_text: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he is our brother and our flesh. And his brethren were content.

cards.note: 1 John 3:15 — *Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.* Gad's wish to kill the brother he hated from the heart is the very murder John says hatred already is.
cards.s_text: I confess now my sin, my children, that oftentimes I wished to kill him, because I hated him from my heart.
cards.t_text: Whosoever hates his brother is a murderer: and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.

cards.note: Genesis 37:8 — *And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.* The dreams that inflamed Gad's hatred are the same dreams Moses says the brethren hated.
cards.s_text: Moreover, I hated him yet more for his dreams; and I wished to lick him out of the land of the living, even as an ox licketh up the grass of the field.
cards.t_text: And his brethren said to him, Shall you indeed reign over us? or shall you indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.

cards.note: Proverbs 10:12 — *Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covereth all sins.* That the hater dispraiseth truth and envieth the prosperous is the strife-stirring hatred Solomon sets against covering love.
cards.s_text: He dispraiseth the truth, he envieth him that prospers, he welcometh evil-speaking, he loveth arrogance, for hatred blindeth his soul; as I 'also then' looked on Joseph.
cards.t_text: Hatred stirreth up strifes: but love covers all sins.

cards.note: Leviticus 19:17 — *Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.* The spirit of hatred Gad warns against is the heart-hatred Moses forbids by name.
cards.s_text: And now, my children, hearken to the words of truth to work righteousness, and all the law of the El Elyon (Most High), and go not astray through the spirit of hatred, for it is evil in all the doings of men.
cards.t_text: You shall not hate your brother in your heart: you shall in any wise rebuke your neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

cards.note: Leviticus 19:18 — *...but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).* That love would quicken even the dead, working with the law of God, points to this love-of-neighbour at the heart of Torah.
cards.s_text: For as love would quicken 'even' the dead, and would call back them that are condemned to die, so hatred would slay the living, and those that had sinned venially it would not suffer to live.
cards.t_text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: 1 John 3:14 — *We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loveth not his brother abideth in death.* Gad's spirit of love unto salvation and spirit of hatred unto death is John's passage from death to life by love.
cards.s_text: For the spirit of hatred worketh together with Satan, through hastiness of spirit, in all things unto men's death; but the spirit of love worketh together with the law of Elohim (God) in long-suffering unto the salvation of men.
cards.t_text: We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loves not his brother abides in death.

cards.note: Leviticus 19:18 — *Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).* The commandment concerning loving one's neighbour that hatred refuses to hear is this very word of Moses.
cards.s_text: For it will not hear 'the words of' His commandments concerning the loving of one's neighbour, and it sinneth against Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: 1 John 3:11 — *For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.* That his children should drive forth hatred and cleave to the love of God is the message John says was from the beginning.
cards.s_text: These things, 'therefore', I say to you from experience, my children, that ye may drive forth hatred, which is of the devil, and cleave to the love of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: For this is the message that you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

cards.note: Ephesians 4:31 — *Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:* Hatred that kindleth wrath and stirreth war, which Gad bids his sons drive forth, is the very brood Paul commands put away.
cards.s_text: 'Hatred, therefore, is evil,' for it constantly mateth with lying, speaking against the truth; and it maketh small things to be great, and causeth the light to be darkness, and calleth the sweet bitter, and teacheth slander, and 'kindleth' wrath, and 'stirreth' up war, and violence and all covetousness; it filleth the heart with evils and devilish poison.
cards.t_text: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:

cards.note: Leviticus 19:18 — *Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people...* That by the same thing a man transgresseth he is punished follows on Gad's grudge against Joseph, the very grudge Moses forbids.
cards.s_text: For by what things a man transgresseth, by the same also is he punished.
cards.t_text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Proverbs 14:30 — *A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.* Gad's liver, set in envy against Joseph and then mercilessly diseased, is Solomon's envy that rots the bones.
cards.s_text: Righteousness casteth out hatred, humility destroyeth envy. For he that is just and humble is ashamed to do what is unjust, being reproved not of another, but of his own heart, because Yahuah (Lord) looketh on his inclination.
cards.t_text: A sound heart is the life of the flesh: but envy the rottenness of the bones.

cards.note: *Remember the commandments, and bear no malice to your neighbour: remember the covenant of the Highest, and wink at ignorance.* (Ecclesiasticus 28:7). *But if he be shameless and persisteth in his wrong-doing, even so forgive him from the heart, and leave to Elohim (God) the avenging.* (Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 100:7). Sirach says remember the commandments and bear no malice to your neighbour, and overlook what was done in ignorance. The patriarch's testament goes further down the same road: even if the man is shameless and keeps on in his wrong, forgive him from the heart and leave the avenging to Elohim (God). Both are the commandment of Leviticus 19:18 lived out, no vengeance and no grudge. Forgiving the shameless is simply bearing no malice when it costs the most.
cards.s_text: But if he be shameless and persisteth in his wrong-doing, even so forgive him from the heart, and leave to Elohim (God) the avenging.
cards.t_text: Remember the commandments, and bear no malice to your neighbour: remember the covenant of the Highest, and wink at ignorance.

cards.note: Sirach 28:2 — *Forgive your neighbour the hurt that he has done to you, so shall your sins also be forgiven when you prayest.* Gad's counsel to forgive the brother who sins is Ben Sira's own word on forgiving thy neighbour.
cards.s_text: Love ye one another from the heart; and if a man sin against thee, speak peaceably to him, and in thy soul hold not guile; and if he repent and confess, forgive him.
cards.t_text: Forgive your neighbour the hurt that he has done to you, so shall your sins also be forgiven when you prayest.

cards.note: Romans 12:19 — *Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith Yahuah (Lord).* To leave to God the avenging is exactly Paul's charge to leave vengeance to the Lord.
cards.s_text: But if he be shameless and persisteth in his wrong-doing, even so forgive him from the heart, and leave to Elohim (God) the avenging.
cards.t_text: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, says Yahuah (Lord).

cards.note: Matthew 18:35 — *So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if ye from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.* Gad's 'forgive him from the heart' is the heart-forgiveness the Messiah requires.
cards.s_text: But if he be shameless and persisteth in his wrong-doing, even so forgive him from the heart, and leave to Elohim (God) the avenging.
cards.t_text: So likewise shall my heavenly Father do also unto you, if you from your hearts forgive not every one his brother their trespasses.

cards.note: Ephesians 4:32 — *And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as Elohim (God) for Messiah's (Christ’s) sake hath forgiven you.* To forgive even the shameless from the heart is Paul's tenderhearted forgiveness.
cards.s_text: But if he be shameless and persisteth in his wrong-doing, even so forgive him from the heart, and leave to Elohim (God) the avenging.
cards.t_text: And be you kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as Elohim (God) for Messiah's (Christ’s) sake has forgiven you.

cards.note: Luke 17:4 — *And if he trespass against thee seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to thee, saying, I repent; thou shalt forgive him.* That the one who repents so as not to wrong thee again is to be received is the repeated forgiveness Yahusha enjoins.
cards.s_text: And though he deny it and yet have a sense of shame when reproved, give over reproving him. For he who denieth may repent so as not again to wrong thee; yea, he may also honour thee, and [fear and] be at peace with thee.
cards.t_text: And if he trespass against you seven times in a day, and seven times in a day turn again to you, saying, I repent; you shall forgive him.

cards.note: Luke 17:3 — *Take heed to yourselves: If thy brother trespass against thee, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.* Gad's exact sequence — rebuke, then if he repents, forgive — is the Lord's word in Luke.
cards.s_text: Love ye one another from the heart; and if a man sin against thee, speak peaceably to him, and in thy soul hold not guile; and if he repent and confess, forgive him.
cards.t_text: Take heed to yourselves: If your brother trespass against you, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him.

cards.note: Matthew 18:22 — *Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto him, I say not unto thee, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.* That if he repent thou shalt forgive him is the boundless forgiveness the Messiah commands.
cards.s_text: Love ye one another from the heart; and if a man sin against thee, speak peaceably to him, and in thy soul hold not guile; and if he repent and confess, forgive him.
cards.t_text: Yahusha (Jesus) says unto him, I say not unto you, Until seven times: but, Until seventy times seven.

cards.note: Matthew 18:15 — *Moreover if thy brother shall trespass against thee, go and tell him his fault between thee and him alone: if he shall hear thee, thou hast gained thy brother.* Gad's rule to speak peaceably and rebuke the brother who sins is the Lord's own counsel.
cards.s_text: Love ye one another from the heart; and if a man sin against thee, speak peaceably to him, and in thy soul hold not guile; and if he repent and confess, forgive him.
cards.t_text: Moreover if your brother shall trespass against you, go and tell him his fault between you and him alone: if he shall hear you, you have gained your brother.

cards.note: 1 John 3:11 — *For this is the message that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.* Gad's charge to love one another in deed and word is the very message John says is from the beginning.
cards.s_text: And now, my children, 'I exhort you,' love ye each one his brother, and put away hatred from your hearts, love one another in deed, and in word, and in the inclination of the soul.
cards.t_text: For this is the message that you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.

cards.note: Leviticus 19:17 — *Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart...* That Gad spake peaceably to Joseph before his father while hatred secretly darkened his soul is the very heart-hatred Moses forbids.
cards.s_text: For in the presence of my father I spake peaceably to Joseph; and when I had gone out, the spirit of hatred darkened my mind, and stirred up my soul to slay him.
cards.t_text: You shall not hate your brother in your heart: you shall in any wise rebuke your neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.

cards.note: Leviticus 19:18 — *Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).* To love one another from the heart and put away hatred is the very love-of-neighbour Moses commands.
cards.s_text: Love ye one another from the heart; and if a man sin against thee, speak peaceably to him, and in thy soul hold not guile; and if he repent and confess, forgive him.
cards.t_text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Psalms 37:36 — *Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.* To wait for the end of the Lord upon the unrepentant rich is the psalm's very picture of the wicked passing away.
cards.s_text: And though a man become rich by evil means, even as Esau, the brother of my father, be not jealous; 'but' wait for the end of Yahuah (Lord).
cards.t_text: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

cards.note: Psalms 37:35 — *I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.* The man grown rich by evil means whom Gad bids us not envy is the flourishing wicked the psalmist beholds.
cards.s_text: And though a man become rich by evil means, even as Esau, the brother of my father, be not jealous; 'but' wait for the end of Yahuah (Lord).
cards.t_text: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

cards.note: Psalms 37:7 — *Rest in Yahuah (LORD), and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way...* To put away jealousy and rest in God is the patient waiting the psalm commands toward the prosperous.
cards.s_text: Put away, therefore, jealousy from your souls, and love one another with uprightness of heart.
cards.t_text: Rest in Yahuah (LORD), and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who brings wicked devices to pass.

cards.note: Psalms 37:1 — *Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.* Gad's 'do not be vexed... be not envious' when another prospers is David's own counsel against envy.
cards.s_text: If a man prospereth more than you, do not be vexed, but pray also for him, that he may have perfect 'prosperity.' For so it is expedient for you.
cards.t_text: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be you envious against the workers of iniquity.

cards.note: Zechariah 6:13 — *...and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.* That salvation arises from Judah and Levi together is Zechariah's priest-king on one throne, the peace between kingship and priesthood.
cards.s_text: Do ye also therefore tell these things to your children, that they honour Yahudah (Judah) and Levi, for from them shall Yahuah (Lord) raise up salvation to Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: Even he shall build the temple of Yahuah (LORD); and he shall bear the glory, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and he shall be a priest upon his throne: and the counsel of peace shall be between them both.

cards.note: Numbers 24:17 — *...there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.* The salvation Gad says the Lord shall raise up from Judah is Balaam's Star and Sceptre of Israel's royal line.
cards.s_text: Do ye also therefore tell these things to your children, that they honour Yahudah (Judah) and Levi, for from them shall Yahuah (Lord) raise up salvation to Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Yashar'el (Israel), and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:6 — *And Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all thine heart;* the soul that casts away wickedness and cleaves to righteousness is the heart God circumcises to love and obey.
cards.s_text: For, having its thoughts set upon righteousness, and casting away wickedness, it straightway overthroweth the evil, and uprooteth the sin.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your seed, to love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) with all your heart, and with all your soul, that you may live.

cards.note: James 1:15 — *Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.* The evil spirit filling the treasure of the inclination forces every issue into evil, just as conceived lust ends in death.
cards.s_text: For whenever it beginneth to do good, he forces the issue of the action into evil for him, seeing that the treasure of the inclination is filled with an evil spirit.
cards.t_text: Then when lust has conceived, it brings forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, brings forth death.

cards.note: James 1:14 — *But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.* The evil inclination that drives away the good is the lust that draws a man away.
cards.s_text: Therefore if the soul take pleasure in the good (inclination), all its actions are in righteousness; and if it sin it straightway repenteth.
cards.t_text: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.

cards.note: Matthew 7:14 — *Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.* The narrow way unto life is the good inclination in which all the soul's actions are in righteousness.
cards.s_text: Therefore if the soul take pleasure in the good (inclination), all its actions are in righteousness; and if it sin it straightway repenteth.
cards.t_text: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leads unto life, and few there be that find it.

cards.note: Matthew 7:13 — *Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:* the two ways of good and evil drawn as the two gates.
cards.s_text: 'For' there are two ways of good and evil, and 'with these are the two inclinations in our breasts discriminating them'.
cards.t_text: Enter you in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leads to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:19 — *I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:* Moses's charge to choose between the two is the choice Asher lays on his children.
cards.s_text: 'For' there are two ways of good and evil, and 'with these are the two inclinations in our breasts discriminating them'.
cards.t_text: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both you and your seed may live:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:15 — *See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;* the very two ways Asher says God hath given to the sons of men.
cards.s_text: Two ways hath Elohim (God) given to the sons of men, and two inclinations, 'and two kinds of action, and two modes (of action)', and 'two' issues.
cards.t_text: See, I have set before you this day life and good, and death and evil;

cards.note: Matthew 6:16 — *Moreover when ye fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast.* The man who commits fornication yet fasts and "doeth evil" is the hypocrite whose fast is a face put on, not a single heart.
cards.s_text: Another committeth adultery and fornication, and abstaineth from meats, and when he fasteth he doeth evil, and by the power of his wealth overwhelmeth many; and notwithstanding his excessive wickedness he doeth 'the' commandments: this, too, hath a twofold aspect, but the whole is evil.
cards.t_text: Moreover when you fast, be not, as the hypocrites, of a sad countenance: for they disfigure their faces, that they may appear unto men to fast. Verily I say unto you, They have their reward.

cards.note: Leviticus 11:44 — *For I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God): ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy;* the holiness of the Lord who commandeth the law that the defrauder "setteth at nought and provoketh."
cards.s_text: He who defraudeth his neighbour provoketh Elohim (God), and sweareth falsely against the El Elyon (Most High), and yet pitieth the poor: Yahuah (Lord) who commandeth the law he setteth at nought and provoketh, and yet he refresheth the poor.
cards.t_text: For I am Yahuah Elohaychem (the LORD your God): you shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and you shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall you defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creeps upon the earth.

cards.note: Leviticus 11:47 — *To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.* This is what God "in the tables of the commandments hath thus declared" — the difference between clean and unclean Asher invokes as his standard.
cards.s_text: For Elohim (God) in the tables of the commandments hath thus declared.
cards.t_text: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 14:7 — *Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.* The same hare, half-marked yet unclean, repeated in the second giving of the law Asher appeals to.
cards.s_text: Such men are hares; for they are half clean, but in very deed are unclean.
cards.t_text: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.

cards.note: Leviticus 11:6 — *And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.* Asher's "half clean, but in very deed are unclean" hare is the very creature Moses names: it answers one mark of cleanness and fails the other, like the double-faced man.
cards.s_text: Such men are hares; for they are half clean, but in very deed are unclean.
cards.t_text: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divides not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.

cards.note: James 4:8 — *Draw nigh to Elohim (God), and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.* The cure for two-facedness is James's call to the double-minded to purify the heart and cleave to God alone.
cards.s_text: But from wickedness flee away, destroying the (evil) inclination by your good works; for they that are double-faced serve not Elohim (God), but their own lusts, so that they may please Beliar and men like unto themselves.
cards.t_text: Draw nigh to Elohim (God), and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double minded.

cards.note: James 1:8 — *A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.* The double-faced soul that serves its own lusts is James's double-minded man, unstable because he is not single toward God.
cards.s_text: But from wickedness flee away, destroying the (evil) inclination by your good works; for they that are double-faced serve not Elohim (God), but their own lusts, so that they may please Beliar and men like unto themselves.
cards.t_text: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.

cards.note: Matthew 6:24 — *No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve Elohim (God) and mammon.* To wear two faces is to attempt the two masters the Messiah forbids; one must cleave to goodness only.
cards.s_text: But do not ye, my children, wear two faces like unto them, of goodness and of wickedness; but cleave unto goodness only, for Elohim (God) hath His habitation therein, and men desire it.
cards.t_text: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. You cannot serve Elohim (God) and mammon.

cards.note: Leviticus 11:47 — *To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.* The clean who "abstain from what Elohim (God) also hateth and forbiddeth by His commandments" keep this very difference Moses commanded.
cards.s_text: For such men are like to stags and to hinds, because in the manner of wild animals they seem to be unclean, but they are altogether clean; because 'they walk' in zeal for Yahuah (Lord) and abstain from what Elohim (God) also hateth and forbiddeth by His commandments, warding off the evil from the good.
cards.t_text: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
