cards.note: Leviticus 11:3 — *Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.* The stag and the hind that "seem to be unclean, but they are altogether clean" are the cloven-hoofed cud-chewing beasts Moses declares clean — the very mark the single-faced keep.
cards.s_text: For such men are like to stags and to hinds, because in the manner of wild animals they seem to be unclean, but they are altogether clean; because 'they walk' in zeal for Yahuah (Lord) and abstain from what Elohim (God) also hateth and forbiddeth by His commandments, warding off the evil from the good.
cards.t_text: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall you eat.

cards.note: Matthew 6:22 — *The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.* The man of single face is the man of the single eye, full of light and just before God.
cards.s_text: For good men, even they that are of single face, though they be thought by them that are double-faced to sin, are just before Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore your eye be single, your whole body shall be full of light.

cards.note: Matthew 6:22 — *The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.* To walk "with singleness of face unto that which is good" is to walk with the single eye, the whole body full of light.
cards.s_text: All these things, therefore, I proved in my life, and I wandered not from the truth of Yahuah (Lord), and I searched out the commandments of the El Elyon (Most High), walking according to all my strength with singleness of face unto that which is good.
cards.t_text: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore your eye be single, your whole body shall be full of light.

cards.note: James 1:25 — *But whoso looketh into the perfect law of liberty, and continueth therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.* Asher's singleness of face, searching out and keeping the commandments, is the doer who continues in the perfect law.
cards.s_text: All these things, therefore, I proved in my life, and I wandered not from the truth of Yahuah (Lord), and I searched out the commandments of the El Elyon (Most High), walking according to all my strength with singleness of face unto that which is good.
cards.t_text: But whoso looks into the perfect law of liberty, and continues therein, he being not a forgetful hearer, but a doer of the work, this man shall be blessed in his deed.

cards.note: James 1:12 — *Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which Yahuah (Lord) hath promised to them that love him.* The soul that meets the angel of peace and is led into eternal life receives the crown of life promised to the faithful.
cards.s_text: But if he is peaceful with joy he meeteth the angel of peace, and he leadeth him into eternal life.
cards.t_text: Blessed is the man that endures temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord has promised to them that love him.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:19 — *I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:* the peaceful soul led "into eternal life" has chosen the life Moses set before Israel.
cards.s_text: But if he is peaceful with joy he meeteth the angel of peace, and he leadeth him into eternal life.
cards.t_text: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both you and your seed may live:

cards.note: James 4:8 — *Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and purify your hearts, ye double minded.* The double-faced "guilty of a twofold sin" are James's double-minded, called to purify the divided heart.
cards.s_text: For they that are double-faced are guilty of a twofold sin; 'for they both do the evil thing and they have pleasure in them that do it', following the example of the spirits of deceit, and striving against mankind.
cards.t_text: Draw nigh to Elohim (God), and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double minded.

cards.note: James 1:22 — *But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.* To "keep the law of Yahuah (Lord)" and look unto the thing really good is to be the doer Asher's single face requires.
cards.s_text: Do ye, 'therefore, my children', keep the law of Yahuah (Lord), and give not heed unto evil as unto good; but look unto the thing that is really good, and keep it in all commandments of Yahuah (Lord), having your conversation therein, and resting therein.
cards.t_text: But be you doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves.

cards.note: Revelation 12:9 — *And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world;* the dragon whose head is broken is the old serpent at last cast down.
cards.s_text: Until the El Elyon (Most High) shall visit the earth, coming Himself [as man, with men eating and drinking], and breaking the head of the dragon in the water. He shall save Yashar'el (Israel) and all the Gentiles [Elohim (God) speaking in the person of man].
cards.t_text: And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world: he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:10 — *And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek:* that the Most High "shall save Yashar'el (Israel) and all the Gentiles" is the root of Jesse to whom the nations are drawn.
cards.s_text: Until the El Elyon (Most High) shall visit the earth, coming Himself [as man, with men eating and drinking], and breaking the head of the dragon in the water. He shall save Yashar'el (Israel) and all the Gentiles [Elohim (God) speaking in the person of man].
cards.t_text: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.

cards.note: Isaiah 27:1 — *In that day Yahuah (LORD) with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.* Asher's "breaking the head of the dragon in the water" is Isaiah's slaying of the dragon in the sea.
cards.s_text: Until the El Elyon (Most High) shall visit the earth, coming Himself [as man, with men eating and drinking], and breaking the head of the dragon in the water. He shall save Yashar'el (Israel) and all the Gentiles [Elohim (God) speaking in the person of man].
cards.t_text: In that day Yahuah (LORD) with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.

cards.note: Isaiah 11:12 — *And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.* The gathering from the four corners is Isaiah's second-ingathering of both houses.
cards.s_text: But Yahuah (Lord) will gather you together in faith through His tender mercy, 'and' for the sake of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.]
cards.t_text: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Yashar'el (Israel), and gather together the dispersed of Yahudah (Judah) from the four corners of the earth.

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:21 — *Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:* those scattered "as Gad and Dan" are the very houses Ezekiel sees gathered and made one again.
cards.s_text: And therefore shall ye be scattered as Gad and Dan my brethren, and ye shall know not your own lands, tribe, and tongue.
cards.t_text: And say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:3 — *That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath scattered thee.* The Lord gathering His people "in faith through His tender mercy" is the compassion and gathering Moses promised the scattered.
cards.s_text: But Yahuah (Lord) will gather you together in faith through His tender mercy, 'and' for the sake of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.]
cards.t_text: That then Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) will turn your captivity, and have compassion upon you, and will return and gather you from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) has scattered you.

cards.note: Genesis 19:24 — *Then Yahuah (LORD) rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Yahuah (LORD) out of heaven;* Asher's warning, "Become not, my children, as Sodom, which knew not the angels of Yahuah (Lord), and perished for ever," recalls the city that rejected the two angels and was destroyed.
cards.s_text: Become not, my children, as Sodom, which knew not the angels of Yahuah (Lord), and perished for ever.
cards.t_text: Then Yahuah (LORD) rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from Yahuah (LORD) out of heaven;

cards.note: Leviticus 26:33 — *And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.* The land made desolate and the people scattered for not giving heed to the law is the sanction of Leviticus 26.
cards.s_text: For I have known that ye shall assuredly be disobedient, and assuredly act ungodly, not giving heed to the law of Elohim (God), but to the commandments of men, being corrupted through wickedness.
cards.t_text: And I will scatter you among the heathen, and will draw out a sword after you: and your land shall be desolate, and your cities waste.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 28:64 — *And Yahuah (LORD) shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other;* the scattering "unto the four corners of the earth" Asher foresees is the very curse Moses pronounced for disobedience.
cards.s_text: For I know that ye shall sin, and be delivered into the hands of your enemies; and your land shall be made desolate, and your holy places destroyed, and ye shall be scattered unto the four corners of the earth. And ye shall be set at nought in the dispersion as useless water,
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) shall scatter you among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there you shall serve other gods, which neither you nor your fathers have known, even wood and stone.

cards.note: Genesis 39:2 — *And Yahuah (LORD) was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.* The refrain of the whole testament — "Yahuah (Lord) loved me... the Elohim (God) of my fathers guarded me" — is Moses' own refrain over Joseph.
cards.s_text: These my brethren hated me, but Yahuah (Lord) loved me: They wished to slay me, but the Elohim (God) of my fathers guarded me: They let me down into a pit, and the El Elyon (Most High) brought me up again.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

cards.note: Psalm 105:19 — *Until the time that his word came: the word of Yahuah (LORD) tried him.* The trying and deliverance Joseph recounts is exactly how the Psalmist frames his ordeal.
cards.s_text: I was sold into slavery, and Yahuah (Lord) of all made me free: I was taken into captivity, and His strong hand succoured me. I was beset with hunger, and Yahuah (Lord) Himself nourished me.
cards.t_text: Until the time that his word came: the word of Yahuah (LORD) tried him.

cards.note: Psalm 105:18 — *Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron.* Joseph's "I was taken into captivity" and "in bonds" is the very binding the Psalm records.
cards.s_text: I was sold into slavery, and Yahuah (Lord) of all made me free: I was taken into captivity, and His strong hand succoured me. I was beset with hunger, and Yahuah (Lord) Himself nourished me.
cards.t_text: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

cards.note: Psalm 105:17 — *He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant.* The Psalmist names the same selling Joseph here confesses, and reads it as God's own sending.
cards.s_text: These my brethren hated me, but Yahuah (Lord) loved me: They wished to slay me, but the Elohim (God) of my fathers guarded me: They let me down into a pit, and the El Elyon (Most High) brought me up again.
cards.t_text: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 10:13 — *Elohim (God) is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape.* That God departs "for a little space... to try the inclination of the soul" yet gives protection in all things is Paul's same doctrine of the faithful God in temptation.
cards.s_text: But in all these things doth He give protection, And in divers ways doth He comfort, (Though) for a little space He departeth to try the inclination of the soul.
cards.t_text: There has no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but Elohim (God) is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that you are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that you may be able to bear it.

cards.note: James 1:12 — *Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which Yahuah (Lord) hath promised to them that love him.* Joseph's "in ten temptations He showed me approved, and in all of them I endured" is the very blessing James pronounces.
cards.s_text: In ten temptations He showed me approved, And in all of them I endured; For endurance is a mighty charm, And patience giveth many good things.
cards.t_text: Blessed is the man that endures temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord has promised to them that love him.

cards.note: Genesis 39:21 — *But Yahuah (LORD) was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.* Joseph's "Yahuah granted me to find mercy in the sight of the keeper of the prison" quotes Moses almost word for word.
cards.s_text: I was cast into prison, I was beaten, 'I was mocked'; but Yahuah (Lord) granted me to find mercy in the sight of the keeper of the prison.
cards.t_text: But Yahuah (LORD) was with Joseph, and shewed him mercy, and gave him favour in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

cards.note: Genesis 39:9 — *how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against Elohim (God)?* The reason Joseph here gives — the God of Israel delivered him — is the same reason he gave the woman in Genesis.
cards.s_text: And I struggled against a shameless woman, urging me to transgress with her; but the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) my father delivered me from the burning flame.
cards.t_text: There is none greater in this house than I; neither has he kept back any thing from me but you, because you are his wife: how then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against Elohim (God)?

cards.note: Genesis 39:8 — *But he refused, and said unto his master's wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he hath committed all that he hath to my hand.* Joseph's struggle "against a shameless woman, urging me to transgress" is the refusal Moses sets down.
cards.s_text: And I struggled against a shameless woman, urging me to transgress with her; but the Elohim (God) of Yashar'el (Israel) my father delivered me from the burning flame.
cards.t_text: But he refused, and said unto his master’s wife, Behold, my master wotteth not what is with me in the house, and he has committed all that he has to my hand;

cards.note: 2 Timothy 2:22 — *Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on Yahusha (Lord) out of a pure heart.* Joseph's weeping, praying, and fasting is exactly the fleeing of youthful lust by calling on the Lord that Paul charges Timothy.
cards.s_text: But I remembered the words of my father, and going into my chamber, 'I wept and' prayed unto Yahuah (Lord).
cards.t_text: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

cards.note: Genesis 39:7 — *his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.* Her offer here — "Thou shalt be lord of me... if thou wilt give thyself unto me" — is the same solicitation Moses records.
cards.s_text: Thou shalt be lord of me, and all that is in mine house, if thou wilt give thyself unto me, and thou shalt be as our master.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass after these things, that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.

cards.note: Genesis 39:10 — *And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.* The woman's repeated threatening "How often did the Egyptian woman threaten me with death!... and then call me back and threaten me" is Moses' "day by day."
cards.s_text: How often did the Egyptian woman threaten me with death! How often did she give me over to punishment, and then call me back and threaten me, and when I was unwilling to company with her, she said to me:
cards.t_text: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

cards.note: Genesis 39:10 — *as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her.* Joseph giving himself "yet more to fasting and prayer" against her renewed pleas is the persistence of the refusal Moses records.
cards.s_text: And I gave myself yet more to fasting and prayer, that Yahuah (Lord) might deliver me from her.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

cards.note: Proverbs 6:25 — *Lust not after her beauty in thine heart; neither let her take thee with her eyelids.* That Yahuah "willeth not that those that reverence Him should be in uncleanness" is Wisdom's same charge against the adulteress's snare.
cards.s_text: And I said unto her: Yahuah (Lord) willeth not that those that reverence Him should be in uncleanness, nor doth He take pleasure in them that commit adultery, 'but in those that approach Him with a pure heart and undefiled lips'.
cards.t_text: Lust not after her beauty in your heart; neither let her take you with her eyelids.

cards.note: Proverbs 6:24 — *To keep thee from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.* Joseph's resistance to her flattering, idol-trading pleas is the very deliverance the lamp of the commandment works.
cards.s_text: And I said unto her: Yahuah (Lord) willeth not that those that reverence Him should be in uncleanness, nor doth He take pleasure in them that commit adultery, 'but in those that approach Him with a pure heart and undefiled lips'.
cards.t_text: To keep you from the evil woman, from the flattery of the tongue of a strange woman.

cards.note: James 1:12 — *Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which Yahuah (Lord) hath promised to them that love him.* Joseph eating the enchanted food in faith, unharmed, is the man tried and approved whom James blesses.
cards.s_text: But that thou mayest learn that the wickedness of the ungodly hath no power over them that worship Elohim (God) with chastity, behold I will take of it and eat before thee. And having so said, I prayed thus: The Elohim (God) of my fathers and the angel of Abraham, be with me; and ate.
cards.t_text: Blessed is the man that endures temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord has promised to them that love him.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 10:13 — *Elohim (God) is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.* That "the wickedness of the ungodly hath no power over them that worship Elohim with chastity" is Paul's faithful God who makes the way of escape.
cards.s_text: But that thou mayest learn that the wickedness of the ungodly hath no power over them that worship Elohim (God) with chastity, behold I will take of it and eat before thee. And having so said, I prayed thus: The Elohim (God) of my fathers and the angel of Abraham, be with me; and ate.
cards.t_text: There has no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but Elohim (God) is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that you are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that you may be able to bear it.

cards.note: 1 Corinthians 10:13 — *Elohim (God) is faithful... but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.* Joseph singing praises "in the abode of darkness" because he was delivered from her desire is the escape borne with thanksgiving.
cards.s_text: And when I was in bonds, the Egyptian woman was oppressed with grief, and she came and heard how I gave thanks unto Yahuah (Lord) and sang praises in the abode of darkness, and with glad voice rejoiced, glorifying my Elohim (God) that I was delivered from the lustful desire of the Egyptian woman.
cards.t_text: There has no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but Elohim (God) is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that you are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that you may be able to bear it.

cards.note: Genesis 39:20 — *And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners were bound.* The false accusation by the garment and the casting into Pharaoh's prison is the very outcome Moses records.
cards.s_text: And holding fast to the garment she falsely accused me, and when her husband came he cast me into prison in his house; and on the morrow he scourged me and sent me into Pharaoh's prison.
cards.t_text: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

cards.note: Genesis 39:12 — *And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.* Joseph's "she laid hold of my garments... I left it behind, and fled away naked" is Moses' scene, told from within.
cards.s_text: At last, then, she laid hold of my garments, forcibly dragging me to have connection with her.
cards.t_text: And she caught him by his garment, saying, Lie with me: and he left his garment in her hand, and fled, and got him out.

cards.note: James 1:12 — *Blessed is the man that endureth temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life.* Her offer to release him from his bonds for consent, and his not inclining "even in thought," is endurance under trial whose end is the crown.
cards.s_text: And often hath she sent unto me saying: Consent to fulfil my desire, and I will release thee from thy bonds, 'and I will free thee from the darkness'.
cards.t_text: Blessed is the man that endures temptation: for when he is tried, he shall receive the crown of life, which the Lord has promised to them that love him.

cards.note: Genesis 39:10 — *as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.* Her baring of arms and breasts "that I might lie with her" while Yahuah guarded him is the persistent solicitation refused that Moses records.
cards.s_text: 'For' when I was in her house she was wont to bare her arms, and breasts, and legs, 'that I might lie with her; for she was' very beautiful, 'splendidly adorned' in order to beguile me. And Yahuah (Lord) guarded me from her devices.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass, as she spake to Joseph day by day, that he hearkened not unto her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

cards.note: 2 Timothy 2:22 — *Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on Yahusha (Lord) out of a pure heart.* That God loves him "who in a den of darkness combines fasting with chastity" over the man of luxury and licence is Paul's same preference of righteousness over youthful lust.
cards.s_text: And not even in thought did I incline unto her. For Elohim (God) loveth him who in a den of darkness combines fasting with chastity, rather than the man who in kings' chambers combines luxury with licence.
cards.t_text: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

cards.note: 1 Peter 2:23 — *Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously.* Joseph's patience under slavery, slander and envy — committing his cause to Yahuah who dwells in the chaste — is the Messiah's own pattern of suffering.
cards.s_text: So ye too, 'if ye follow after chastity and purity with patience and prayer with fasting in humility of heart, Yahuah (Lord) will dwell among you, because He loveth chastity.
cards.t_text: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judges righteously:

cards.note: Genesis 50:20 — *But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.* That he would not raise himself against his brethren "with evil intent" is the same spirit that forgave them at the last.
cards.s_text: And I did not raise myself (against them) with evil intent, but I honoured my brethren; and out of respect for them, even when I was being sold, I refrained from telling the Ishmaelites that I was the son of Jacob, a great man and a mighty.
cards.t_text: But as for you, you thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

cards.note: Genesis 50:20 — *ye thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.* Saying "I was a home-born slave" rather than expose those who sold him is the same refusal to requite evil that Genesis crowns with forgiveness.
cards.s_text: And when I came to the Indocolpitae with the Ishmaelites, they asked me, saying: Art thou a slave? And I said that I was a home-born slave, that I might not put my brethren to shame.
cards.t_text: But as for you, you thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

cards.note: Leviticus 19:18 — *Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).* That "every one who doeth the law of Yahuah shall be loved by Him" and Joseph's shielding of his brethren is the royal commandment itself.
cards.s_text: Do ye also, therefore, my children, 'have the fear of Elohim (God) in all your works before your eyes, and' honour your brethren. For every one who doeth the law of Yahuah (Lord) shall be loved by Him.
cards.t_text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: 1 Peter 2:23 — *Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judgeth righteously.* Joseph swallowing his grief and not betraying his brethren is the Messiah's silent endurance under suffering.
cards.s_text: 'When I heard this my bowels were dissolved and my heart melted', and I desired greatly to weep, but I restrained myself, that I should not put my brethren to shame. 'And I said unto them, I know not, I am a slave'.
cards.t_text: Who, when he was reviled, reviled not again; when he suffered, he threatened not; but committed himself to him that judges righteously:

cards.note: Genesis 45:1 — *Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me.* That Joseph here "desired greatly to weep, but I restrained myself" is the same overflowing heart Moses records breaking forth before his brethren.
cards.s_text: 'When I heard this my bowels were dissolved and my heart melted', and I desired greatly to weep, but I restrained myself, that I should not put my brethren to shame. 'And I said unto them, I know not, I am a slave'.
cards.t_text: Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

cards.note: Leviticus 19:18 — *Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).* "love one another, and with long-suffering hide 'ye one another's faults'" is the royal commandment in plain words.
cards.s_text: Do ye also, therefore, love one another, and with long-suffering hide 'ye one another's faults'.
cards.t_text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Genesis 50:21 — *Now therefore fear ye not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.* Joseph loving his brethren "more abundantly" after Jacob's death, suffering them not to be afflicted, is exactly Moses' scene of comfort after the father's burial.
cards.s_text: And after the death of Jacob my father I loved them 'more abundantly', and all things whatsoever he commanded I did 'very abundantly' for them.
cards.t_text: Now therefore fear you not: I will nourish you, and your little ones. And he comforted them, and spake kindly unto them.

cards.note: Genesis 45:5 — *Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for Elohim (God) did send me before you to preserve life.* That he "upbraided them not, and comforted them" is the very comfort Joseph spoke when he made himself known.
cards.s_text: And when my brethren came into Egypt they learnt that I had returned their money unto them, and upbraided them not, and comforted them.
cards.t_text: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that you sold me hither: for Elohim (God) did send me before you to preserve life.

cards.note: Proverbs 25:21 — *If thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink.* Wisdom long before commanded the very kindness to an enemy that Joseph here urges and lived.
cards.s_text: 'And if any one seeketh to do evil unto you, do well unto him, and pray for him, and ye shall be redeemed of Yahuah (Lord) from all evil'.
cards.t_text: If your enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and if he be thirsty, give him water to drink:

cards.note: Romans 12:21 — *Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.* To answer those who seek your harm with well-doing is Paul's same overcoming of evil with good.
cards.s_text: 'And if any one seeketh to do evil unto you, do well unto him, and pray for him, and ye shall be redeemed of Yahuah (Lord) from all evil'.
cards.t_text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

cards.note: Matthew 5:44 — *But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you.* "If any one seeketh to do evil unto you, do well unto him, and pray for him" is the Messiah's command in the same breath.
cards.s_text: 'And if any one seeketh to do evil unto you, do well unto him, and pray for him, and ye shall be redeemed of Yahuah (Lord) from all evil'.
cards.t_text: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:22 — *And I will make them one nation in the land... and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.* The three harts becoming lambs and gathering with the nine into twelve flocks is the two houses made one nation again.
cards.s_text: And I saw that the three harts became three lambs, and they cried to Yahuah (Lord), and He brought them forth into a flourishing and well-watered place, yea He brought them out of darkness into light.
cards.t_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

cards.note: Daniel 7:14 — *his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* "For his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, which shall not pass away" is Daniel's everlasting dominion of the Son of Adam, word for word.
cards.s_text: For his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, which shall not pass away; but my kingdom among you shall come to an end as a watcher's hammock, which after the summer disappeareth.
cards.t_text: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

cards.note: Revelation 5:6 — *And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne... stood a Lamb as it had been slain.* The Lion and the Lamb seen as one in Joseph's vision are the Lion and the slain Lamb John beholds in the throne-room.
cards.s_text: And I saw that [from Yahudah (Judah) was born] a virgin [wearing a linen garment, and from her] was born a lamb, [without spot]; and on his left hand there was as it were a lion; and all the beasts rushed against him, and the lamb overcame them, and destroyed them and trod them under foot.
cards.t_text: And I beheld, and, lo, in the midst of the throne and of the four beasts, and in the midst of the elders, stood a Lamb as it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of Elohim (God) sent forth into all the earth.

cards.note: Revelation 5:5 — *behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, hath prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.* That from Levi and Judah shall arise the one who saves is John's Lion of the tribe of Judah who prevailed.
cards.s_text: Do ye therefore, my children, observe the commandments of Yahuah (Lord), and honour Levi and Yahudah (Judah); for from them shall arise 'unto you' [the Lamb of Elohim (God), who taketh away the sin of the world] one who saveth [all the Gentiles and] Yashar'el (Israel).
cards.t_text: And one of the elders says unto me, Weep not: behold, the Lion of the tribe of Juda, the Root of David, has prevailed to open the book, and to loose the seven seals thereof.

cards.note: Isaiah 53:7 — *he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.* The spotless lamb against whom all the beasts rush is Isaiah's silent suffering lamb.
cards.s_text: And I saw that [from Yahudah (Judah) was born] a virgin [wearing a linen garment, and from her] was born a lamb, [without spot]; and on his left hand there was as it were a lion; and all the beasts rushed against him, and the lamb overcame them, and destroyed them and trod them under foot.
cards.t_text: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he opens not his mouth.

cards.note: John 1:29 — *Behold the Lamb of Elohim (God), which taketh away the sin of the world.* The spotless lamb born of the virgin, and named in v11 as the one who saves Israel and the Gentiles, is John's Lamb of God.
cards.s_text: And I saw that [from Yahudah (Judah) was born] a virgin [wearing a linen garment, and from her] was born a lamb, [without spot]; and on his left hand there was as it were a lion; and all the beasts rushed against him, and the lamb overcame them, and destroyed them and trod them under foot.
cards.t_text: The next day John sees Yahusha (Jesus) coming unto him, and says, Behold the Lamb of Elohim (God), which takes away the sin of the world.

cards.note: Genesis 49:9 — *Yahudah (Judah) is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?* The lion at the lamb's hand, born of Judah, is Jacob's own blessing of the lion of Judah.
cards.s_text: And I saw that [from Yahudah (Judah) was born] a virgin [wearing a linen garment, and from her] was born a lamb, [without spot]; and on his left hand there was as it were a lion; and all the beasts rushed against him, and the lamb overcame them, and destroyed them and trod them under foot.
cards.t_text: Yahudah (Judah) is a lion’s whelp: from the prey, my son, you are gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?

cards.note: Matthew 1:23 — *Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.* Matthew names the very virgin and son this vision saw, fulfilling Isaiah's sign.
cards.s_text: And I saw that [from Yahudah (Judah) was born] a virgin [wearing a linen garment, and from her] was born a lamb, [without spot]; and on his left hand there was as it were a lion; and all the beasts rushed against him, and the lamb overcame them, and destroyed them and trod them under foot.
cards.t_text: Behold, a virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son, and they shall call his name Emmanuel, which being interpreted is, Elohim (God) with us.

cards.note: Isaiah 7:14 — *Therefore Yahuah (Lord) himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.* The virgin from whom the lamb is born is the sign Isaiah gave the house of David.
cards.s_text: And I saw that [from Yahudah (Judah) was born] a virgin [wearing a linen garment, and from her] was born a lamb, [without spot]; and on his left hand there was as it were a lion; and all the beasts rushed against him, and the lamb overcame them, and destroyed them and trod them under foot.
cards.t_text: Therefore Adonai (Lord) himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.

cards.note: Genesis 50:20 — *ye thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.* Joseph's dying confidence that "Elohim will avenge you, and will bring you into that which He promised to your fathers" rests on the same faith that read his whole affliction as God's saving purpose.
cards.s_text: 'For' I know that after my death the Egyptians will afflict you, but Elohim (God) will avenge you, and will bring you into that which He promised to your fathers.
cards.t_text: But as for you, you thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

cards.note: Joshua 24:32 — *And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem... and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.* That at the Exodus they took up his bones and buried him with his fathers is the burial Joshua records.
cards.s_text: And when the children of Yashar'el (Israel) went out of Egypt, they took with them the bones of Joseph, and they buried him in Hebron with his fathers, and the years of his life were one hundred and ten years.
cards.t_text: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Yashar'el (Israel) brought up out of Egypt, buried they in Shechem, in a parcel of ground which Jacob bought of the sons of Hamor the father of Shechem for an hundred pieces of silver: and it became the inheritance of the children of Joseph.

cards.note: Exodus 13:19 — *And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Elohim (God) will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.* Joseph's charge "ye shall carry up my bones with you" is the very oath Moses kept at the Exodus.
cards.s_text: But ye shall carry up my bones with you; 'for when my bones are being taken up thither, Yahuah (Lord) shall be with you in light, and Beliar shall be in darkness with the Egyptians'.
cards.t_text: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Yashar'el (Israel), saying, Elohim (God) will surely visit you; and you shall carry up my bones away hence with you.

cards.note: Gen 35:24 — *The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin.* — the two sons of Rachel set side by side, the brotherhood that drives the whole testament.
cards.s_text: Therefore was I called Benjamin, that is, a son of days.
cards.t_text: The sons of Rachel; Joseph, and Benjamin:

cards.note: Gen 35:18 — *And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.* — Rachel's death in birth that Benjamin mourns, "since Rachel my mother died in giving me birth."
cards.s_text: And since Rachel my mother died in giving me birth, I had no milk; therefore I was suckled by Bilhah her handmaid.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass, as her soul was in departing, (for she died) that she called his name Ben-oni: but his father called him Benjamin.

cards.note: Gen 30:24 — *And she called his name Joseph; and said, Yahuah (LORD) shall add to me another son.* — Rachel's own prayer for a second son, which the testament says Jacob also prayed, "that he might see two sons born from her."
cards.s_text: For Rachel remained barren for twelve years 'after she had borne Joseph'; and she prayed Yahuah (Lord) with fasting twelve days, and she conceived and bare me.
cards.t_text: And she called his name Joseph; and said, Yahuah (LORD) shall add to me another son.

cards.note: Gen 30:22 — *And Elohim (God) remembered Rachel, and Elohim (God) hearkened to her, and opened her womb.* — the hearkened-to prayer Benjamin recalls, that his mother "prayed Yahuah with fasting twelve days, and she conceived."
cards.s_text: For Rachel remained barren for twelve years 'after she had borne Joseph'; and she prayed Yahuah (Lord) with fasting twelve days, and she conceived and bare me.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) remembered Rachel, and Elohim (God) hearkened to her, and opened her womb.

cards.note: Gen 37:28 — *and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.* — the very sale Joseph names, "they gave me to the Ishmaelites."
cards.s_text: And he said unto me: Even so, brother, when they had stripped me of my coat they gave me to the Ishmaelites, and they gave me a loin cloth, and scourged me, and bade me run.
cards.t_text: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty pieces of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.

cards.note: Gen 37:23 — *they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him.* — the stripping Joseph recalls, "when they had stripped me of my coat."
cards.s_text: And he said unto me: Even so, brother, when they had stripped me of my coat they gave me to the Ishmaelites, and they gave me a loin cloth, and scourged me, and bade me run.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, his coat of many colours that was on him;

cards.note: Gen 37:31 — *And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood.* — the bloodied coat Benjamin describes, "they dabbled thy coat with blood and sent it."
cards.s_text: And I said 'unto him', They dabbled thy coat with blood and sent it, and said: Know whether this be thy son's coat.
cards.t_text: And they took Joseph’s coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;

cards.note: *In thee shall be fulfilled the prophecy of heaven [concerning the Lamb of Elohim (God), and Saviour of the world], that a blameless one shall be delivered up for lawless men, and a sinless shall die for ungodly men [in the blood of the covenant, for the salvation of the Gentiles and 'of Israel', and shall destroy Beliar and his servants].* (Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 133:8). *For Messiah (Christ) also hath once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to Elohim (God), being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:* (1 Peter 3:18). Jacob, embracing Joseph, says that in him the prophecy of heaven will be fulfilled: a blameless one delivered up for lawless men and a sinless one dying for ungodly men. Peter says it of the Messiah (Christ), who suffered once for sins, the just for the unjust, so that He might bring us to Elohim (God). The two lines carry the same shape, the righteous one giving himself for those who are not, and the end of it is bringing the lost home to the Father.
cards.s_text: In thee shall be fulfilled the prophecy of heaven [concerning the Lamb of Elohim (God), and Saviour of the world], that a blameless one shall be delivered up for lawless men, and a sinless shall die for ungodly men [in the blood of the covenant, for the salvation of the Gentiles and 'of Israel', and shall destroy Beliar and his servants].
cards.t_text: For Messiah (Christ) also has once suffered for sins, the just for the unjust, that he might bring us to Elohim (God), being put to death in the flesh, but quickened by the Spirit:

cards.note: Isa 49:6 — *I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.* — the salvation reaching to the Gentiles that the prophecy names, "for the salvation of the Gentiles and of Israel."
cards.s_text: In thee shall be fulfilled the prophecy of heaven [concerning the Lamb of Elohim (God), and Saviour of the world], that a blameless one shall be delivered up for lawless men, and a sinless shall die for ungodly men [in the blood of the covenant, for the salvation of the Gentiles and 'of Israel', and shall destroy Beliar and his servants].
cards.t_text: And he said, It is a light thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give you for a light to the Gentiles, that you may be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

cards.note: *For Joseph also besought our father 'that he would pray for his brethren', that 'the Lord' would not impute to them as sin whatever evil they had done unto him.* (Testaments of the Twelve Patriarchs 133:6). *But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;* (Matthew 5:44). His brothers had done Joseph evil, and Joseph asked their father to pray for them and that Yahuah (the Lord) would not count it to them as sin. That is Matthew 5:44 lived before it was spoken: praying for those who despitefully use you and persecute you. Benjamin hands the story to his sons as proof that loving an enemy can be done, even when the enemy is your own brother.
cards.s_text: For Joseph also besought our father 'that he would pray for his brethren', that 'the Lord' would not impute to them as sin whatever evil they had done unto him.
cards.t_text: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you;

cards.note: Gen 50:20 — *But as for you, ye thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.* — the good-man's word turning his brothers' evil to salvation, the keystone of Joseph's mercy.
cards.s_text: For Joseph also besought our father 'that he would pray for his brethren', that 'the Lord' would not impute to them as sin whatever evil they had done unto him.
cards.t_text: But as for you, you thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

cards.note: Gen 50:17 — *Forgive, I pray thee now, the trespass of thy brethren, and their sin; for they did unto thee evil... And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.* — the forgiveness Benjamin recalls, that Joseph asked the sin not be imputed to them.
cards.s_text: For Joseph also besought our father 'that he would pray for his brethren', that 'the Lord' would not impute to them as sin whatever evil they had done unto him.
cards.t_text: So shall you say unto Joseph, Forgive, I pray you now, the trespass of your brethren, and their sin; for they did unto you evil: and now, we pray you, forgive the trespass of the servants of the Elohim (God) of your father. And Joseph wept when they spake unto him.

cards.note: Matt 5:8 — *Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see Elohim (God).* — the pure mind that "seeth all things rightly," shielded by the fear of God.
cards.s_text: How many men wished to slay him, and Elohim (God) shielded him! For he that feareth Elohim (God) and loveth his neighbour cannot be smitten by the spirit of Beliar, being shielded by the fear of Elohim (God).
cards.t_text: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see Elohim (God).

cards.note: Lev 19:18 — *thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).* — the neighbour-love Benjamin couples to the fear of God as the shield against Beliar.
cards.s_text: Fear ye Yahuah (Lord), and love your neighbour; and even though the spirits of Beliar claim you to afflict you with every evil, yet shall they not have dominion over you, even as they had not over Joseph my brother.
cards.t_text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Deut 30:16 — *to love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live.* — the love-and-keep Moses set before Israel, which Benjamin repeats to his sons.
cards.s_text: Do ye also, therefore, my children, love Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) of heaven and earth, and keep His commandments, following the example of the good and holy man 'Joseph'.
cards.t_text: In that I command you this day to love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that you may live and multiply: and Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall bless you in the land whither you go to possess it.

cards.note: Prov 14:31 — *He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him hath mercy on the poor.* — the mercy on the poor and compassion on the weak that marks the good man.
cards.s_text: If any one is glorified, he envieth him not; if any one is enriched, he is not jealous; if any one is valiant, he praiseth him; the virtuous man he laudeth; 'on the poor man he hath mercy; on the weak he hath compassion; unto Elohim (God) he singeth praises'.
cards.t_text: He that oppresses the poor reproacheth his Maker: but he that honoureth him has mercy on the poor.

cards.note: Rom 12:15 — *Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.* — the un-envying heart that praises the valiant and laughs not at another's good.
cards.s_text: If any one is glorified, he envieth him not; if any one is enriched, he is not jealous; if any one is valiant, he praiseth him; the virtuous man he laudeth; 'on the poor man he hath mercy; on the weak he hath compassion; unto Elohim (God) he singeth praises'.
cards.t_text: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

cards.note: Rom 12:21 — *Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.* — the very overcoming Benjamin names, "by doing good he overcometh evil."
cards.s_text: 'And though they devise with evil intent concerning him, by doing good he overcometh evil, being shielded by God'; and he loveth the righteous as his own soul.
cards.t_text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

cards.note: Lev 19:18 — *thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).* — the love of the righteous "as his own soul" that crowns the good man's mercy.
cards.s_text: If any one is glorified, he envieth him not; if any one is enriched, he is not jealous; if any one is valiant, he praiseth him; the virtuous man he laudeth; 'on the poor man he hath mercy; on the weak he hath compassion; unto Elohim (God) he singeth praises'.
cards.t_text: You shall not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people, but you shall love your neighbour as thyself: I am Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Matt 5:7 — *Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.* — the mercy to all, even to sinners, that the good man shows.
cards.s_text: For the good man hath not a 'dark eye'; for he showeth mercy to all men, even though they be sinners.
cards.t_text: Blessed are the merciful: for they shall obtain mercy.

cards.note: Matt 6:22 — *The light of the body is the eye: if therefore thine eye be single, thy whole body shall be full of light.* — the single eye against the "dark eye" Benjamin names as the mark of the good man.
cards.s_text: For the good man hath not a 'dark eye'; for he showeth mercy to all men, even though they be sinners.
cards.t_text: The light of the body is the eye: if therefore your eye be single, your whole body shall be full of light.

cards.note: Isa 49:7 — *to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth... Kings shall see and arise.* — the despised one lifted to honour, the Servant-pattern of humbled-then-glorious.
cards.s_text: And if any one betrayeth a righteous man, the righteous man prayeth: though for a little he be humbled, yet not long after he appeareth far more glorious, as was Joseph my brother.
cards.t_text: Thus says Yahuah (LORD), the Redeemer of Yashar'el (Israel), and his Holy One, to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of Yahuah (LORD) that is faithful, and the Holy One of Yashar'el (Israel), and he shall choose you.

cards.note: Gen 50:20 — *ye thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good... to save much people alive.* — Joseph humbled by betrayal yet raised to save, the example Benjamin names, "as was Joseph my brother."
cards.s_text: And if any one betrayeth a righteous man, the righteous man prayeth: though for a little he be humbled, yet not long after he appeareth far more glorious, as was Joseph my brother.
cards.t_text: But as for you, you thought evil against me; but Elohim (God) meant it unto good, to bring to pass, as it is this day, to save much people alive.

cards.note: 1 Pet 3:9 — *Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing.* — the holy man's mercy to his reviler, that he "holdeth his peace."
cards.s_text: 'For' if any one does violence to a holy man, he repenteth; for 'the holy man' is merciful to his reviler, and holdeth his peace.
cards.t_text: Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that you are thereunto called, that you should inherit a blessing.

cards.note: Matt 5:37 — *But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these cometh of evil.* — the single, guileless speech of the uncorrupt mind.
cards.s_text: The good mind hath not two tongues, of blessing and of cursing, of contumely and 'of honour', of sorrow and of joy, of quietness and of confusion, of hypocrisy and of truth, [of poverty and of wealth]; but it hath one 'disposition', uncorrupt and pure, concerning all men.
cards.t_text: But let your communication be, Yea, yea; Nay, nay: for whatsoever is more than these comes of evil.

cards.note: Ps 73:26 — *My flesh and my heart faileth: but Elohim (God) is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.* — the Lord as the good man's portion, that he covets no corruptible thing.
cards.s_text: He delighteth not in pleasure, '[he grieveth not his neighbour], he sateth not himself with luxuries, he erreth not in the uplifting of the eyes', for Yahuah (Lord) is his portion.
cards.t_text: My flesh and my heart fails: but Elohim (God) is the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.

cards.note: Jas 3:10 — *Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.* — the tongue "of blessing and of cursing" the good mind refuses.
cards.s_text: The good mind hath not two tongues, of blessing and of cursing, of contumely and 'of honour', of sorrow and of joy, of quietness and of confusion, of hypocrisy and of truth, [of poverty and of wealth]; but it hath one 'disposition', uncorrupt and pure, concerning all men.
cards.t_text: Out of the same mouth proceeds blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.

cards.note: Jas 1:8 — *A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.* — the very doubleness Benjamin condemns, the mind with "two tongues" and "double sight."
cards.s_text: The good mind hath not two tongues, of blessing and of cursing, of contumely and 'of honour', of sorrow and of joy, of quietness and of confusion, of hypocrisy and of truth, [of poverty and of wealth]; but it hath one 'disposition', uncorrupt and pure, concerning all men.
cards.t_text: A double minded man is unstable in all his ways.

cards.note: 1 Jn 3:15 — *Whosoever hateth his brother is a murderer: and ye know that no murderer hath eternal life abiding in him.* — the judgment on "those who are like unto Cain in envy and hatred of brethren."
cards.s_text: Because for ever those who are like unto Cain 'in envy and hatred of brethren', shall be punished with the same judgment'.
cards.t_text: Whosoever hates his brother is a murderer: and you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him.

cards.note: 1 Jn 3:12 — *Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.* — the Cain-pattern of envy and brother-hatred the testament warns against.
cards.s_text: Because for ever those who are like unto Cain 'in envy and hatred of brethren', shall be punished with the same judgment'.
cards.t_text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

cards.note: Gen 4:24 — *If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.* — the very measure the testament names, "but Lamech with seventy times seven."
cards.s_text: And when he was two hundred years old he began to suffer, and in the nine-hundredth year he was destroyed. For on account of Abel, his brother, with all the evils was he judged, but Lamech with seventy times seven.
cards.t_text: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.

cards.note: Gen 4:15 — *whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold.* — the sevenfold vengeance Benjamin recalls, "Cain also delivered over to seven vengeances."
cards.s_text: Therefore was Cain also delivered over to seven vengeances by Elohim (God), for in every hundred years Yahuah (Lord) brought one plague upon him.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah (LORD) said unto him, Therefore whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And Yahuah (LORD) set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.

cards.note: Matt 5:8 — *Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see Elohim (God).* — the purity of heart on which the Spirit of God rests.
cards.s_text: He that hath a pure mind in love, looketh not after a woman with a view to fornication; for he hath no defilement in his heart, because the Spirit of Elohim (God) resteth upon him.
cards.t_text: Blessed are the pure in heart: for they shall see Elohim (God).

cards.note: Matt 5:28 — *whosoever looketh on a woman to lust after her hath committed adultery with her already in his heart.* — the very looking the pure mind refuses, "looketh not after a woman with a view to fornication."
cards.s_text: He that hath a pure mind in love, looketh not after a woman with a view to fornication; for he hath no defilement in his heart, because the Spirit of Elohim (God) resteth upon him.
cards.t_text: But I say unto you, That whosoever looks on a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

cards.note: Joel 2:28 — *I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh.* — the Spirit poured forth "as fire" and passing to the Gentiles.
cards.s_text: And the veil of the temple shall be rent, and the Spirit of Elohim (God) shall pass on to the Gentiles as fire poured forth.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions:

cards.note: 1 Pet 3:19 — *By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison.* — the One who passed through Hades, the same descent into the lower parts.
cards.s_text: And He shall ascend from Hades and shall pass from earth into heaven. And I know how lowly He shall be upon earth, and how glorious in heaven.]
cards.t_text: By which also he went and preached unto the spirits in prison;

cards.note: Eph 4:10 — *He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.* — "how lowly He shall be upon earth, and how glorious in heaven."
cards.s_text: And He shall ascend from Hades and shall pass from earth into heaven. And I know how lowly He shall be upon earth, and how glorious in heaven.]
cards.t_text: He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.)

cards.note: Eph 4:9 — *Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?* — the descent and ascent Benjamin names, "He shall ascend from Hades and shall pass from earth into heaven."
cards.s_text: And He shall ascend from Hades and shall pass from earth into heaven. And I know how lowly He shall be upon earth, and how glorious in heaven.]
cards.t_text: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

cards.note: Matt 27:51 — *And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom.* — the very rending of the veil Benjamin prophesies, "the veil of the temple shall be rent."
cards.s_text: And the veil of the temple shall be rent, and the Spirit of Elohim (God) shall pass on to the Gentiles as fire poured forth.
cards.t_text: And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in twain from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent;

cards.note: Gal 3:13 — *Messiah (Christ) hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree.* — the Anointed lifted up upon a tree, bearing the curse for the salvation Benjamin foresees.
cards.s_text: [And He shall enter into the [first] temple, and there shall Yahuah (Lord) be treated with outrage, and He shall be lifted up upon a tree.
cards.t_text: Messiah (Christ) has redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us: for it is written, Cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree:

cards.note: Deut 21:23 — *for he that is hanged is accursed of Elohim (God)* — the Torah's word on the one hanged on a tree, the curse the lifted-up Lord bears.
cards.s_text: [And He shall enter into the [first] temple, and there shall Yahuah (Lord) be treated with outrage, and He shall be lifted up upon a tree.
cards.t_text: His body shall not remain all night upon the tree, but you shall in any wise bury him that day; (for he that is hanged is accursed of Elohim (God);) that your land be not defiled, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) gives you for an inheritance.

cards.note: Ezek 37:22 — *And I will make them one nation in the land... and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all.* — the twelve tribes gathered together as one, the two-house reunion.
cards.s_text: Nevertheless the temple of Elohim (God) shall be in your portion, and the last (temple) shall be more glorious than the first. And the twelve tribes shall be gathered together there, and all the Gentiles, until the El Elyon (Most High) shall send forth His salvation in the visitation of an 'only-begotten prophet'.
cards.t_text: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Yashar'el (Israel); and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:

cards.note: Isa 2:2 — *And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD'S house shall be established in the top of the mountains... and all nations shall flow unto it.* — the gathering of the tribes and all the Gentiles to the house of God.
cards.s_text: Nevertheless the temple of Elohim (God) shall be in your portion, and the last (temple) shall be more glorious than the first. And the twelve tribes shall be gathered together there, and all the Gentiles, until the El Elyon (Most High) shall send forth His salvation in the visitation of an 'only-begotten prophet'.
cards.t_text: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the LORD’S house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.

cards.note: Hag 2:9 — *The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): and in this place will I give peace.* — the latter temple "more glorious than the first" Benjamin foresees.
cards.s_text: Nevertheless the temple of Elohim (God) shall be in your portion, and the last (temple) shall be more glorious than the first. And the twelve tribes shall be gathered together there, and all the Gentiles, until the El Elyon (Most High) shall send forth His salvation in the visitation of an 'only-begotten prophet'.
cards.t_text: The glory of this latter house shall be greater than of the former, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): and in this place will I give peace, says Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts).

cards.note: Jude 1:7 — *Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example.* — the fornication of Sodom set forth as warning, exactly as Benjamin invokes it.
cards.s_text: And I believe that there will be also evil-doings among you, from the words of Enoch the righteous: that ye shall commit fornication with the fornication of Sodom, and shall perish, all save a few, and shall renew wanton deeds with women; and the kingdom of Yahuah (Lord) shall not be among you, for straightway He shall take it away.
cards.t_text: Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 9:8 — *And they have gone to the daughters of men upon the earth, and have slept with the women, and have defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins.* — the wanton deeds with women Benjamin warns his sons they will renew.
cards.s_text: And I believe that there will be also evil-doings among you, from the words of Enoch the righteous: that ye shall commit fornication with the fornication of Sodom, and shall perish, all save a few, and shall renew wanton deeds with women; and the kingdom of Yahuah (Lord) shall not be among you, for straightway He shall take it away.
cards.t_text: And they have gone to the daughters of men upon the earth, and have slept with the women, and have defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins.

cards.note: 1 Enoch 8:2 — *And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.* — the fornication Enoch foretold, which Benjamin draws from "the words of Enoch the righteous."
cards.s_text: And I believe that there will be also evil-doings among you, from the words of Enoch the righteous: that ye shall commit fornication with the fornication of Sodom, and shall perish, all save a few, and shall renew wanton deeds with women; and the kingdom of Yahuah (Lord) shall not be among you, for straightway He shall take it away.
cards.t_text: And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.

cards.note: Rom 11:25 — *blindness in part is happened to Yashar'el (Israel), until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.* — the chosen Gentiles brought in to convict and gather Israel.
cards.s_text: And He shall convict Yashar'el (Israel) through the chosen ones of the Gentiles, even as he reproved Esau through the Madianites, who deceived their brethren, [so that they fell into fornication, and idolatry; and they were alienated from Elohim (God),] becoming therefore children in the portion of them that fear Yahuah (Lord).
cards.t_text: For I would not, brethren, that you should be ignorant of this mystery, lest you should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Yashar'el (Israel), until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.

cards.note: Acts 13:46 — *It was necessary that the word of Elohim (God) should first have been spoken to you: but seeing ye put it from you... lo, we turn to the Gentiles.* — judgment of Israel first, then the turning to the Gentiles.
cards.s_text: And then shall He judge all the Gentiles, [as many as believed Him not when He appeared upon earth].
cards.t_text: Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word of Elohim (God) should first have been spoken to you: but seeing you put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles.

cards.note: Rom 11:11 — *through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.* — Israel convicted and provoked through the believing Gentiles, exactly as Benjamin foresees.
cards.s_text: And He shall convict Yashar'el (Israel) through the chosen ones of the Gentiles, even as he reproved Esau through the Madianites, who deceived their brethren, [so that they fell into fornication, and idolatry; and they were alienated from Elohim (God),] becoming therefore children in the portion of them that fear Yahuah (Lord).
cards.t_text: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? Elohim (God) forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.

cards.note: Rev 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God)... and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* — all men risen and judged, as Benjamin foresees.
cards.s_text: Then also all men shall rise, some unto glory and some unto shame. And Yahuah (Lord) shall judge Yashar'el (Israel) first, for their unrighteousness; [for when He appeared as Elohim (God) in the flesh to deliver them they believed Him not].
cards.t_text: And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.

cards.note: John 5:29 — *And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.* — the two resurrections, to glory and to shame.
cards.s_text: Then also all men shall rise, some unto glory and some unto shame. And Yahuah (Lord) shall judge Yashar'el (Israel) first, for their unrighteousness; [for when He appeared as Elohim (God) in the flesh to deliver them they believed Him not].
cards.t_text: And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation.

cards.note: Dan 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* — the very words behind "all men shall rise, some unto glory and some unto shame."
cards.s_text: Then also all men shall rise, some unto glory and some unto shame. And Yahuah (Lord) shall judge Yashar'el (Israel) first, for their unrighteousness; [for when He appeared as Elohim (God) in the flesh to deliver them they believed Him not].
cards.t_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

cards.note: Ezek 37:12 — *Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves.* — the raising of Israel and her fathers from the grave.
cards.s_text: 'And' then shall ye see Enoch, Noah, and Shem, and Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, rising on the right hand in gladness.
cards.t_text: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus says Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: Matt 19:28 — *ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).* — the twelve set "each one over our tribe," as Benjamin foresees.
cards.s_text: Then shall we also rise, each one over our tribe, worshipping the King of heaven, [who appeared upon earth in the form of a man in humility. And as many as believe on Him on the earth shall rejoice with Him].
cards.t_text: And Yahusha (Jesus) said unto them, Verily I say unto you, That you which have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, you also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: Matt 22:32 — *I am the Elohim (God) of Abraham, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac, and the Elohim (God) of Jacob? Elohim (God) is not the Elohim (God) of the dead, but of the living.* — the fathers who live to God, who Benjamin sees "rising on the right hand in gladness."
cards.s_text: 'And' then shall ye see Enoch, Noah, and Shem, and Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, rising on the right hand in gladness.
cards.t_text: I am the Elohim (God) of Abraham, and the Elohim (God) of Isaac, and the Elohim (God) of Jacob? Elohim (God) is not the Elohim (God) of the dead, but of the living.

cards.note: Acts 13:47 — *I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles, that thou shouldest be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.* — the apostles' citation of the same promise, salvation to the Gentiles.
cards.s_text: For all these things they gave us for an inheritance, saying: Keep the commandments of Elohim (God), until Yahuah (Lord) shall reveal His salvation to all Gentiles.
cards.t_text: For so has Yahuah (Lord) commanded us, saying, I have set you to be a light of the Gentiles, that you should be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

cards.note: Isa 49:6 — *I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.* — the salvation revealed "to all Gentiles" that the fathers' charge waits for.
cards.s_text: For all these things they gave us for an inheritance, saying: Keep the commandments of Elohim (God), until Yahuah (Lord) shall reveal His salvation to all Gentiles.
cards.t_text: And he said, It is a light thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Yashar'el (Israel): I will also give you for a light to the Gentiles, that you may be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

cards.note: Deut 30:16 — *to love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live.* — the very keeping Benjamin leaves "instead of inheritance."
cards.s_text: Do ye, therefore, truth each one to his neighbour, and keep the law of Yahuah (Lord) and His commandments.
cards.t_text: In that I command you this day to love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that you may live and multiply: and Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) shall bless you in the land whither you go to possess it.

cards.note: Acts 13:47 — *I have set thee to be a light of the Gentiles.* — the beloved "enlightening the Gentiles" in their synagogues, as Benjamin foresees.
cards.s_text: Until the consummation of the age shall he be in the synagogues of the Gentiles, and among their rulers, as a strain of music in the mouth of all.
cards.t_text: For so has Yahuah (Lord) commanded us, saying, I have set you to be a light of the Gentiles, that you should be for salvation unto the ends of the earth.

cards.note: Rom 11:1 — *For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.* — the apostle naming his own tribe, the beloved arisen in the latter days.
cards.s_text: And there shall arise in the latter days] one beloved of Yahuah (Lord), [of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah) and Levi], a doer of His good pleasure in his mouth, [with new knowledge enlightening the Gentiles].
cards.t_text: I say then, Has Elohim (God) cast away his people? Elohim (God) forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

cards.note: Phil 3:5 — *of the stock of Yashar'el (Israel), of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews.* — Paul, the man of Benjamin's seed, the beloved who enlightened the Gentiles.
cards.s_text: And there shall arise in the latter days] one beloved of Yahuah (Lord), [of the tribe of Yahudah (Judah) and Levi], a doer of His good pleasure in his mouth, [with new knowledge enlightening the Gentiles].
cards.t_text: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Yashar'el (Israel), of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
