cards.s_text: The tyrant himself and his whole council admired their endurance, whereby they now do both stand beside the throne of Elohim (God) and live the blessed age.
cards.t_text: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 33:3 — *Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words* — Moses' word the writer cites, the sanctified ones *under thy hands.*
cards.s_text: For Moses says, ‘All also who have sanctified themselves are under thy hands.
cards.t_text: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in your hand: and they sat down at your feet; every one shall receive of your words.

cards.note: Isaiah 53:5 — *But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed* — the Suffering Servant whose wounded blood truly delivers, which the martyrs' death only pointed toward.
cards.s_text: And these men, therefore, having sanctified themselves for Elohim's (God’s) sake, not only have received this honour, but also the honour that through them the enemy had no more power over our people, and the tyrant suffered punishment, and our country was purified, they having as it were become a ransom for our nation’s sin; and through the blood of these righteous men and the propitiation of their death, the divine Providence delivered Yashar'el (Israel) that before was evil entreated.
cards.t_text: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

cards.note: Isaiah 53:10 — *when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days* — the soul given as an offering for sin, the propitiation the martyrs' death dimly figures but cannot accomplish.
cards.s_text: And these men, therefore, having sanctified themselves for Elohim's (God’s) sake, not only have received this honour, but also the honour that through them the enemy had no more power over our people, and the tyrant suffered punishment, and our country was purified, they having as it were become a ransom for our nation’s sin; and through the blood of these righteous men and the propitiation of their death, the divine Providence delivered Yashar'el (Israel) that before was evil entreated.
cards.t_text: Yet it pleased Yahuah (LORD) to bruise him; he has put him to grief: when you shall make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of Yahuah (LORD) shall prosper in his hand.

cards.note: Isaiah 53:11 — *by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities* — the righteous Servant bearing the iniquities of the many, the true ransom the type points toward.
cards.s_text: And these men, therefore, having sanctified themselves for Elohim's (God’s) sake, not only have received this honour, but also the honour that through them the enemy had no more power over our people, and the tyrant suffered punishment, and our country was purified, they having as it were become a ransom for our nation’s sin; and through the blood of these righteous men and the propitiation of their death, the divine Providence delivered Yashar'el (Israel) that before was evil entreated.
cards.t_text: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.

cards.note: Isaiah 53:12 — *he hath poured out his soul unto death... and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors* — the One who pours out his soul and bears the nation's sin, the one whom the martyrs' blood foreshadows.
cards.s_text: And these men, therefore, having sanctified themselves for Elohim's (God’s) sake, not only have received this honour, but also the honour that through them the enemy had no more power over our people, and the tyrant suffered punishment, and our country was purified, they having as it were become a ransom for our nation’s sin; and through the blood of these righteous men and the propitiation of their death, the divine Providence delivered Yashar'el (Israel) that before was evil entreated.
cards.t_text: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he has poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

cards.note: Daniel 9:24 — *to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness* — the reconciliation appointed, which no martyr's blood but only the Anointed brings to pass.
cards.s_text: And these men, therefore, having sanctified themselves for Elohim's (God’s) sake, not only have received this honour, but also the honour that through them the enemy had no more power over our people, and the tyrant suffered punishment, and our country was purified, they having as it were become a ransom for our nation’s sin; and through the blood of these righteous men and the propitiation of their death, the divine Providence delivered Yashar'el (Israel) that before was evil entreated.
cards.t_text: Seventy weeks are determined upon your people and upon your holy city, to finish the transgression, and to make an end of sins, and to make reconciliation for iniquity, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal up the vision and prophecy, and to anoint the most Holy.

cards.note: Romans 3:25 — *Whom Elohim hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins* — the true propitiation that fulfils the type; the martyrs' *propitiation of their death* foreshadows, the Messiah's effects.
cards.s_text: And these men, therefore, having sanctified themselves for Elohim's (God’s) sake, not only have received this honour, but also the honour that through them the enemy had no more power over our people, and the tyrant suffered punishment, and our country was purified, they having as it were become a ransom for our nation’s sin; and through the blood of these righteous men and the propitiation of their death, the divine Providence delivered Yashar'el (Israel) that before was evil entreated.
cards.t_text: Whom Elohim (God) has set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of Elohim (God);

cards.note: Hebrews 9:14 — *the blood of Messiah, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to Elohim, purge your conscience from dead works* — the blood that truly cleanses the people, which the martyrs' blood only pointed toward.
cards.s_text: And these men, therefore, having sanctified themselves for Elohim's (God’s) sake, not only have received this honour, but also the honour that through them the enemy had no more power over our people, and the tyrant suffered punishment, and our country was purified, they having as it were become a ransom for our nation’s sin; and through the blood of these righteous men and the propitiation of their death, the divine Providence delivered Yashar'el (Israel) that before was evil entreated.
cards.t_text: How much more shall the blood of Messiah (Christ), who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without spot to Elohim (God), purge your conscience from dead works to serve the living Elohim (God)?

cards.note: Hebrews 11:35 — *others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection* — the NT's own allusion to this very martyrdom, the tortured who looked beyond death to the better resurrection.
cards.s_text: And these men, therefore, having sanctified themselves for Elohim's (God’s) sake, not only have received this honour, but also the honour that through them the enemy had no more power over our people, and the tyrant suffered punishment, and our country was purified, they having as it were become a ransom for our nation’s sin; and through the blood of these righteous men and the propitiation of their death, the divine Providence delivered Yashar'el (Israel) that before was evil entreated.
cards.t_text: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

cards.note: Genesis 2:21 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof* — the rib the mother says she kept guard over, the very building-block of woman.
cards.s_text: “ I was a pure maiden, and I strayed not from my father’s house, and I kept guard over the rib that was builded into Eve.
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof;

cards.note: Genesis 2:22 — *And the rib, which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man* — the rib *builded into Eve,* the womanhood the mother guarded in purity.
cards.s_text: “ I was a pure maiden, and I strayed not from my father’s house, and I kept guard over the rib that was builded into Eve.
cards.t_text: And the rib, which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.

cards.note: Genesis 2:23 — *This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man* — the first marriage the mother honours, having lived with her husband all the days of her youth.
cards.s_text: “ I was a pure maiden, and I strayed not from my father’s house, and I kept guard over the rib that was builded into Eve.
cards.t_text: And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.

cards.note: Genesis 3:1 — *Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had made* — the *false, beguiling Serpent* whose subtilty the mother says never sullied her maidenhood.
cards.s_text: nor did the false, beguiling Serpent sully the purity of my maidenhood; I lived with my husband all the days of my youth; but when these my sons were grown up, their father died.
cards.t_text: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, has Elohim (God) said, You shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

cards.note: Genesis 3:4 — *And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die* — the deceiver's lie that beguiled the first Eve, which this daughter of Eve refused.
cards.s_text: nor did the false, beguiling Serpent sully the purity of my maidenhood; I lived with my husband all the days of my youth; but when these my sons were grown up, their father died.
cards.t_text: And the serpent said unto the woman, You shall not surely die:

cards.note: Genesis 3:6 — *and when the woman saw that the tree was good for food... she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband* — the fall the mother did not repeat; the Serpent could not *sully the purity of my maidenhood.*
cards.s_text: nor did the false, beguiling Serpent sully the purity of my maidenhood; I lived with my husband all the days of my youth; but when these my sons were grown up, their father died.
cards.t_text: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.

cards.note: Genesis 4:8 — *and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him* — *Abel who was slain by Cain,* the first righteous martyr the father set before his sons.
cards.s_text: Who, while he was yet with us, taught you the Law and the prophets. He read to us of Abel who was slain by Cain, and of Isaac who was offered as a burnt-offering, and of Joseph in the prison.
cards.t_text: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

cards.note: Genesis 22:9 — *and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood* — *Isaac who was offered as a burnt-offering,* the Akedah that is the martyrs' own charter.
cards.s_text: Who, while he was yet with us, taught you the Law and the prophets. He read to us of Abel who was slain by Cain, and of Isaac who was offered as a burnt-offering, and of Joseph in the prison.
cards.t_text: And they came to the place which Elohim (God) had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

cards.note: Genesis 22:13 — *and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son* — the burnt-offering provided in Isaac's stead, the binding the father read to his children.
cards.s_text: Who, while he was yet with us, taught you the Law and the prophets. He read to us of Abel who was slain by Cain, and of Isaac who was offered as a burnt-offering, and of Joseph in the prison.
cards.t_text: And Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and behold behind him a ram caught in a thicket by his horns: and Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering in the stead of his son.

cards.note: Genesis 39:20 — *And Joseph's master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king's prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison* — *Joseph in the prison,* the righteous one wrongly chained yet kept by Yahuah.
cards.s_text: Who, while he was yet with us, taught you the Law and the prophets. He read to us of Abel who was slain by Cain, and of Isaac who was offered as a burnt-offering, and of Joseph in the prison.
cards.t_text: And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, a place where the king’s prisoners were bound: and he was there in the prison.

cards.note: Numbers 25:11 — *Phinehas... hath turned my wrath away from the children of Yashar'el (Israel), while he was zealous for my sake among them* — *Phineas, the zealous priest,* whose zeal for the Law the father held up to his sons.
cards.s_text: And he spake to us of Phineas, the zealous priest, and he taught you the song of Ananias, Azarias, and Mishael in the fire.
cards.t_text: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Yashar'el (Israel), while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Yashar'el (Israel) in my jealousy.

cards.note: Numbers 25:13 — *and he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his Elohim (God)* — the everlasting covenant given for zeal, the reward of the priest the father named.
cards.s_text: And he spake to us of Phineas, the zealous priest, and he taught you the song of Ananias, Azarias, and Mishael in the fire.
cards.t_text: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his Elohim (God), and made an atonement for the children of Yashar'el (Israel).

cards.note: Daniel 3:25 — *Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt* — the song of *Ananias, Azarias, and Mishael in the fire,* the three children unhurt in the furnace.
cards.s_text: And he spake to us of Phineas, the zealous priest, and he taught you the song of Ananias, Azarias, and Mishael in the fire.
cards.t_text: He answered and said, Lo, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they have no hurt; and the form of the fourth is like the Son of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Daniel 3:27 — *upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed... nor the smell of fire had passed on them* — the deliverance the father taught, the fire that could not touch the faithful three.
cards.s_text: And he spake to us of Phineas, the zealous priest, and he taught you the song of Ananias, Azarias, and Mishael in the fire.
cards.t_text: And the princes, governors, and captains, and the king’s counsellors, being gathered together, saw these men, upon whose bodies the fire had no power, nor was an hair of their head singed, neither were their coats changed, nor the smell of fire had passed on them.

cards.note: Song of the Three Holy Children 1:66 — *O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless you Yahuah (God)... for he has delivered us... out of the midst of the fire* — the very song the father *taught you,* sung by the three in the furnace (self-link).
cards.s_text: And he spake to us of Phineas, the zealous priest, and he taught you the song of Ananias, Azarias, and Mishael in the fire.
cards.t_text: O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless you Yahuah (God): praise and exalt him above all for ever: for he has delivered us from hell, and saved us from the hand of death, and delivered us out of the midst of the furnace and burning flame: even out of the midst of the fire has he delivered us.

cards.note: Daniel 6:22 — *My Elohim (God) hath sent his angel, and hath shut the lions' mouths, that they have not hurt me* — *Daniel in the den of lions,* whom the father *glorified... and blessed,* preserved among the beasts.
cards.s_text: And he glorified also Daniel in the den of lions, and blessed him;
cards.t_text: My Elohim (God) has sent his angel, and has shut the lions’ mouths, that they have not hurt me: forasmuch as before him innocency was found in me; and also before you, O king, have I done no hurt.

cards.note: Daniel 6:23 — *So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his Elohim (God)* — Daniel delivered unhurt, the faith the father set before the seven sons.
cards.s_text: And he glorified also Daniel in the den of lions, and blessed him;
cards.t_text: Then was the king exceeding glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no manner of hurt was found upon him, because he believed in his Elohim (God).

cards.note: Isaiah 43:2 — *when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee* — the saying of Isaiah the father quoted, the promise the three children and the martyrs leaned upon.
cards.s_text: and he called to your minds the saying of Isaiah, “ Yea even though thou pass through the fire, the flame shall not hurt thee.”
cards.t_text: When you passest through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow you: when you walk through the fire, you shall not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon you.

cards.note: Psalm 34:19 — *Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but Yahuah (LORD) delivereth him out of them all* — the words of David the father sang, the just man afflicted yet always delivered.
cards.s_text: He sang to us the words of David the psalmist, “ Many are the afflictions of the just.”
cards.t_text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but Yahuah (LORD) delivers him out of them all.

cards.note: Proverbs 3:18 — *She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her* — the proverb of Solomon the father quoted, wisdom-and-Law the tree of life for them that do His will.
cards.s_text: He quoted to us the proverb of Solomon, “ He is a tree of life to all them that do his will.’
cards.t_text: She is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy is every one that retaineth her.

cards.note: Ezekiel 37:3 — *Son of Adam, can these bones live? And I answered, O Yahuah (Lord) GOD, thou knowest* — *Shall these dry bones live?* the resurrection-question the father confirmed, the hope of the whole house of Yashar'el.
cards.s_text: He confirmed the words of Ezekiel, “Shall these dry bones live?”
cards.t_text: And he said unto me, Son of Adam, can these bones live? And I answered, O Adonai (Lord) GOD, you know.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 32:39 — *I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand* — the song of Moses the father remembered, *I will slay and I will make alive,* the Author of death and resurrection.
cards.s_text: For he forgat not the song that Moses taught, which teaches, “I will slay and I will make alive. This is your life and the blessedness of your days.”’
cards.t_text: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:19 — *I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live* — the life Moses set before Yashar'el, *this is your life,* chosen by the sons in dying for the Law.
cards.s_text: For he forgat not the song that Moses taught, which teaches, “I will slay and I will make alive. This is your life and the blessedness of your days.”’
cards.t_text: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both you and your seed may live:

cards.note: Deuteronomy 30:20 — *for he is thy life, and the length of thy days* — *this is your life and the blessedness of your days,* the very phrase the father drew from Moses' song.
cards.s_text: For he forgat not the song that Moses taught, which teaches, “I will slay and I will make alive. This is your life and the blessedness of your days.”’
cards.t_text: That you may love Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God), and that you may obey his voice, and that you may cleave unto him: for he is your life, and the length of your days: that you may dwell in the land which Yahuah (LORD) sware unto your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

cards.note: Hebrews 11:35 — *and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection* — the NT's own allusion to this very martyrdom; the sons gathered to their fathers awaited the better resurrection.
cards.s_text: But the sons of Abraham, with their victorious mother, are gathered together unto the place of their ancestors, having received pure and immortal souls from Elohim (God), to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
cards.t_text: Women received their dead raised to life again: and others were tortured, not accepting deliverance; that they might obtain a better resurrection:

cards.note: Hebrews 11:39 — *and these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise* — the cloud of witnesses, the sons of Abraham gathered to the place of their ancestors in hope.
cards.s_text: But the sons of Abraham, with their victorious mother, are gathered together unto the place of their ancestors, having received pure and immortal souls from Elohim (God), to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
cards.t_text: And these all, having obtained a good report through faith, received not the promise:

cards.note: Hebrews 11:40 — *Elohim (God) having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect* — the better thing reserved, the immortal souls the martyrs received from Elohim awaiting consummation.
cards.s_text: But the sons of Abraham, with their victorious mother, are gathered together unto the place of their ancestors, having received pure and immortal souls from Elohim (God), to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
cards.t_text: Elohim (God) having provided some better thing for us, that they without us should not be made perfect.

cards.note: Luke 16:22 — *and it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom* — *gathered together unto the place of their ancestors,* the faithful received to Abraham among the fathers.
cards.s_text: But the sons of Abraham, with their victorious mother, are gathered together unto the place of their ancestors, having received pure and immortal souls from Elohim (God), to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
cards.t_text: And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham’s bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;

cards.note: Daniel 12:2 — *and many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life* — the resurrection of the just, the *pure and immortal souls* the sons of Abraham received from Elohim.
cards.s_text: But the sons of Abraham, with their victorious mother, are gathered together unto the place of their ancestors, having received pure and immortal souls from Elohim (God), to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
cards.t_text: And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.

cards.note: Daniel 12:3 — *and they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever* — the starlike glory of the victorious mother and her sons, set among the everlasting righteous.
cards.s_text: But the sons of Abraham, with their victorious mother, are gathered together unto the place of their ancestors, having received pure and immortal souls from Elohim (God), to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
cards.t_text: And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.

cards.note: Daniel 12:1 — *and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book* — the day of deliverance and judgement, when the wretch is pursued but the faithful are gathered.
cards.s_text: For which cause the judgement of Elohim (God) pursued, and shall pursue, the accursed wretch.
cards.t_text: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which stands for the children of your people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time your people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

cards.note: Jubilees 4:1 — *And in the third week in the second jubilee she gave birth to Cain, and in the fourth she gave birth to Abel, and in the fifth she gave birth to her daughter ’Âwân.* The book of the fathers keeps the same two births, Cain then Abel, that Adam & Eve sets at its head.
cards.s_text: This is the story of Adam and Eve after they had gone out of Paradise. And Adam knew his wife Eve and went upwards to the sun-rising and abode there eighteen years and two months. And Eve conceived and bare two sons; Adiaphotos, who is called Cain and Amilabes who is called Abel.
cards.t_text: And in the third week in the second jubilee she gave birth to Cain, and in the fourth she gave birth to Abel, and in the fifth she gave birth to her daughter ’Âwân.

cards.note: Genesis 4:2 — *And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.* The two sons Eve bears in Adam and Eve 1:1, Cain and Abel, are the same pair Moses names in their birth order.
cards.s_text: This is the story of Adam and Eve after they had gone out of Paradise. And Adam knew his wife Eve and went upwards to the sun-rising and abode there eighteen years and two months. And Eve conceived and bare two sons; Adiaphotos, who is called Cain and Amilabes who is called Abel.
cards.t_text: And she again bare his brother Abel. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

cards.note: Genesis 4:1 — *And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from Yahuah (LORD).* The opening of Adam & Eve, the man knowing his wife after the expulsion, is the very verse with which Moses begins the generations of Adam.
cards.s_text: This is the story of Adam and Eve after they had gone out of Paradise. And Adam knew his wife Eve and went upwards to the sun-rising and abode there eighteen years and two months. And Eve conceived and bare two sons; Adiaphotos, who is called Cain and Amilabes who is called Abel.
cards.t_text: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Matthew 23:35 — *That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom ye slew between the temple and the altar.* The Messiah dates the shed blood of the righteous from this first murder of Abel.
cards.s_text: And they both went and found Abel murdered. I by the hand of Cain his brother. And Elohim (God) saith to Michael the archangel: 'Say to Adam: " Reveal not the secret that thou knowest to Cain thy son, for he is a son of wrath. But grieve not, for I will give thee another son in his stead; he shall show (to thee) all that thou shalt do. Do thou tell him nothing."' Thus spake the archangel to Adam. But he kept the word in his heart, and with him also Eve, though they grieved concerning Abel their son.
cards.t_text: That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom you slew between the temple and the altar.

cards.note: 1 John 3:12 — *Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous.* The hand of Cain in Adam and Eve 3:1 is the very fratricide John sets as the warning against hatred.
cards.s_text: And they both went and found Abel murdered. I by the hand of Cain his brother. And Elohim (God) saith to Michael the archangel: 'Say to Adam: " Reveal not the secret that thou knowest to Cain thy son, for he is a son of wrath. But grieve not, for I will give thee another son in his stead; he shall show (to thee) all that thou shalt do. Do thou tell him nothing."' Thus spake the archangel to Adam. But he kept the word in his heart, and with him also Eve, though they grieved concerning Abel their son.
cards.t_text: Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

cards.note: Hebrews 11:4 — *By faith Abel offered unto Elohim (God) a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, Elohim (God) testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaketh.* The murdered Abel of Adam and Eve 3:1 is the righteous one whose blood still speaks.
cards.s_text: And they both went and found Abel murdered. I by the hand of Cain his brother. And Elohim (God) saith to Michael the archangel: 'Say to Adam: " Reveal not the secret that thou knowest to Cain thy son, for he is a son of wrath. But grieve not, for I will give thee another son in his stead; he shall show (to thee) all that thou shalt do. Do thou tell him nothing."' Thus spake the archangel to Adam. But he kept the word in his heart, and with him also Eve, though they grieved concerning Abel their son.
cards.t_text: By faith Abel offered unto Elohim (God) a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous, Elohim (God) testifying of his gifts: and by it he being dead yet speaks.

cards.note: Genesis 4:10 — *And he said, What hast thou done? the voice of thy brother's blood crieth unto me from the ground.* The blood Eve sees poured out in her dream is the blood that cries from the ground in Moses' account.
cards.s_text: And they both went and found Abel murdered. I by the hand of Cain his brother. cards.t_text: And he said, What have you done? the voice of your brother’s blood cries unto me from the ground.

cards.note: Genesis 4:8 — *And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.* Abel found murdered by his brother's hand in Adam and Eve 3:1 is the slaying Moses records in the field.
cards.s_text: And they both went and found Abel murdered. I by the hand of Cain his brother. And Elohim (God) saith to Michael the archangel: 'Say to Adam: " Reveal not the secret that thou knowest to Cain thy son, for he is a son of wrath. cards.t_text: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

cards.note: Luke 3:38 — *Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of Elohim (God).* The son given in Abel's place stands in the Messiah's own genealogy, the line from Adam preserved through Seth.
cards.s_text: And after this, Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare Seth. And Adam said to Eve: 'See! we have begotten a son in place of Abel, whom Cain slew, let us give glory and sacrifice to Elohim (God).'
cards.t_text: Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Genesis 4:26 — *And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).* Adam's resolve to give glory and sacrifice to Elohim through the new son is the very calling on the Name that returns with Seth's line.
cards.s_text: And after this, Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare Seth. And Adam said to Eve: 'See! we have begotten a son in place of Abel, whom Cain slew, let us give glory and sacrifice to Elohim (God).'
cards.t_text: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of Yahuah (LORD).

cards.note: Genesis 5:3 — *And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth.* The Seth born to Adam in Adam and Eve 4:1 is the son begotten in Adam's own likeness who heads the book of the generations.
cards.s_text: And after this, Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare Seth. And Adam said to Eve: 'See! we have begotten a son in place of Abel, whom Cain slew, let us give glory and sacrifice to Elohim (God).'

cards.note: Genesis 4:25 — *And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For Elohim (God), said she, hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.* Adam's word in Adam and Eve 4:1, a son in place of Abel whom Cain slew, is Moses' account verbatim of the appointed seed.
cards.s_text: And after this, Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bare Seth. And Adam said to Eve: 'See! we have begotten a son in place of Abel, whom Cain slew, let us give glory and sacrifice to Elohim (God).'
cards.t_text: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For Elohim (God), said she, has appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.

cards.note: Hebrews 9:27 — *And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment.* The sickness that falls on Adam before he dies is the once-appointed death that came upon him and passed to all his seed.
cards.s_text: And Adam begat thirty sons and thirty daughters and Adam lived nine hundred and thirty years; and he fell sick and cried with a loud voice and said, 'Let all my sons come to me that I may see them before I die.'
cards.t_text: And as it is appointed unto men once to die, but after this the judgment:

cards.note: Genesis 5:5 — *And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.* The nine hundred and thirty years and the sickness unto death in Adam and Eve 5:1 are the exact span Moses sets down for the first man.
cards.s_text: And Adam begat thirty sons and thirty daughters and Adam lived nine hundred and thirty years; and he fell sick and cried with a loud voice and said, 'Let all my sons come to me that I may see them before I die.'
cards.t_text: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

cards.note: Genesis 3:3 — *But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, Elohim (God) hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.* The charge Adam recalls is the same one Eve repeated to the serpent before she ate.
cards.s_text: And Adam said to him: 'When Elohim (God) made us, me and your mother, through whom also I die, He gave us power to eat of every tree which is in paradise, but, concerning that one only, He charged us not to eat of it, and through this one we are to die. And the hour drew nigh for the angels who were guarding your mother to go up and worship Yahuah (Lord), and I was far from her, and the enemy knew that she was alone and gave to her, and she ate of the tree of which she had been told not to eat.
cards.t_text: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of the garden, Elohim (God) has said, You shall not eat of it, neither shall you touch it, lest you die.

cards.note: Genesis 2:17 — *But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.* The one tree forbidden and the death through it in Adam and Eve 7:1 are the single command and its sentence Moses set down.
cards.s_text: And Adam said to him: 'When Elohim (God) made us, me and your mother, through whom also I die, He gave us power to eat of every tree which is in paradise, but, concerning that one only, He charged us not to eat of it, and through this one we are to die. And the hour drew nigh for the angels who were guarding your mother to go up and worship Yahuah (Lord), and I was far from her, and the enemy knew that she was alone and gave to her, and she ate of the tree of which she had been told not to eat.
cards.t_text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you shall not eat of it: for in the day that you eat thereof you shall surely die.

cards.note: Genesis 2:16 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) commanded the man, saying, Of every tree of the garden thou mayest freely eat.* Adam's words, that he was given power to eat of every tree, are Moses' grant of the whole garden but for one.

cards.note: Psalms 139:12 — *Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.* The house cannot hide from its builder, says Adam and Eve 8:1; no darkness hides the creature from the Maker, says the psalm.
cards.s_text: 'And Elohim (God) was wroth with us, and Yahuah (Lord) came into paradise and called me in a terrible voice and said: "Adam, where art thou And why hidest thou from my face Shall the house be able to hide itself from its builder" And he saith to me: "Since thou hast abandoned my covenant, I have brought upon thy body seventy-two strokes; the trouble of the first stroke is a pain of the eyes, the second stroke an affection of the hearing, and likewise in turn all the strokes shall befall thee."'
cards.t_text: Yea, the darkness hides not from you; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to you.

cards.note: Psalms 139:7 — *Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?* Adam's hiding face and the maker's question, can the house hide from its builder, are answered by the psalmist: there is no fleeing the presence of the One who formed us.
cards.s_text: 'And Elohim (God) was wroth with us, and Yahuah (Lord) came into paradise and called me in a terrible voice and said: "Adam, where art thou And why hidest thou from my face Shall the house be able to hide itself from its builder" And he saith to me: "Since thou hast abandoned my covenant, I have brought upon thy body seventy-two strokes; the trouble of the first stroke is a pain of the eyes, the second stroke an affection of the hearing, and likewise in turn all the strokes shall befall thee."'
cards.t_text: Whither shall I go from your spirit? or whither shall I flee from your presence?

cards.note: Genesis 3:9 — *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where art thou?* The terrible call "Adam, where art thou" in Adam and Eve 8:1 is the very word Moses records first after the Fall.
cards.s_text: 'And Elohim (God) was wroth with us, and Yahuah (Lord) came into paradise and called me in a terrible voice and said: "Adam, where art thou And why hidest thou from my face Shall the house be able to hide itself from its builder" And he saith to me: "Since thou hast abandoned my covenant, I have brought upon thy body seventy-two strokes; the trouble of the first stroke is a pain of the eyes, the second stroke an affection of the hearing, and likewise in turn all the strokes shall befall thee."'
cards.t_text: And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) called unto Adam, and said unto him, Where are you?

cards.note: Genesis 3:8 — *And they heard the voice of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) amongst the trees of the garden.* Yahuah coming into paradise and the man hiding in Adam and Eve 8:1 is Moses' scene of the voice in the garden.
cards.s_text: 'And Elohim (God) was wroth with us, and Yahuah (Lord) came into paradise and called me in a terrible voice and said: "Adam, where art thou And why hidest thou from my face Shall the house be able to hide itself from its builder" And he saith to me: "Since thou hast abandoned my covenant, I have brought upon thy body seventy-two strokes; the trouble of the first stroke is a pain of the eyes, the second stroke an affection of the hearing, and likewise in turn all the strokes shall befall thee."'
cards.t_text: And they heard the voice of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) amongst the trees of the garden.

cards.note: Romans 5:12 — *Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned.* The sorrow and death come upon Adam by Eve's own account are the sin and death the apostle traces to the one man, passing upon all.
cards.s_text: As he said this to his sons, Adam groaned sore and said: 'What shall I do I am in great distress.' And Eve wept and said: 'My lord Adam, rise up and give me half of thy trouble and I will endure it; for it is on my account that this hath happened to thee, on my account thou art beset with toils and troubles.' But Adam said to Eve, 'Arise and go with my son Seth near to paradise, and put earth upon your heads and weep and pray Elohim (God) to have mercy upon me and send his angel to paradise, and give me of the tree out of which the oil floweth, and bring it me, and I shall anoint myself and shall have rest from my complaint.'
cards.t_text: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

cards.note: Genesis 3:19 — *In the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread, till thou return unto the ground; for out of it wast thou taken: for dust thou art, and unto dust shalt thou return.* The trouble that beset Adam ends in the return to dust Moses pronounced over the first man.

cards.note: Genesis 3:16 — *Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children; and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.* Eve's word that the trouble is on her account reaches for the sorrow Moses appointed the woman at the Fall.

cards.note: Romans 8:22 — *For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.* Seth's "until the day of Judgment" is the same horizon the apostle gives the groaning creation.
cards.s_text: Then Seth speaketh to the beast, 'Close thy mouth and be silent and stand off from the image of Elohim (God) until the day of Judgment.' Then saith the beast to Seth: 'Behold, I stand off from the image of Elohim (God).' And he went to his lair.
cards.t_text: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

cards.note: Romans 8:21 — *Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of Elohim (God).* The risen "rule of the beasts" waits, like Seth's day of Judgment, to be delivered.
cards.s_text: Then Seth speaketh to the beast, 'Close thy mouth and be silent and stand off from the image of Elohim (God) until the day of Judgment.' Then saith the beast to Seth: 'Behold, I stand off from the image of Elohim (God).' And he went to his lair.
cards.t_text: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of Elohim (God).

cards.note: Romans 8:20 — *For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope.* The beast's transformed nature is creation subjected to vanity through man's sin.

cards.note: Genesis 9:2 — *And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air... into your hand are they delivered.* The subjection of the beasts, fractured in Eden so that the beast now "fights with the image of Elohim," is the dominion renewed to Noah.
cards.s_text: Then Seth and Eve went towards paradise, and Eve saw her son, and a wild beast assailing him, and Eve wept and said: 'Woe is me; if I come to the day of the Resurrection, all those who have sinned will curse me saying: Eve hath not kept the commandment of Elohim (God).' And she spake to the beast: 'Thou wicked beast, fearest thou not to fight with the image of Elohim (God) How was thy mouth opened How were thy teeth made strong How didst thou not call to mind thy subjection For long ago wast thou made subject to the image of Elohim (God).' Then the beast cried out and said:
cards.t_text: And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth, and upon every fowl of the air, upon all that moves upon the earth, and upon all the fishes of the sea; into your hand are they delivered.

cards.note: Genesis 1:28 — *And Elohim (God) blessed them... and have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over every living thing that moveth upon the earth.* The plea that the beast "was made subject to the image of Elohim" recalls the dominion granted at creation.

cards.note: Genesis 1:27 — *So Elohim (God) created man in his own image, in the image of Elohim (God) created he him; male and female created he them.* The repeated phrase "the image of Elohim" is taken straight from this verse.
cards.s_text: Then Seth speaketh to the beast, 'Close thy mouth and be silent and stand off from the image of Elohim (God) until the day of Judgment.' Then saith the beast to Seth: 'Behold, I stand off from the image of Elohim (God).' And he went to his lair.
cards.t_text: So Elohim (God) created man in his own image, in the image of Elohim (God) created he him; male and female created he them.

cards.note: Genesis 1:26 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.* The "image of Elohim" Seth bids the beast stand off from is Moses' man made in the image, given dominion over every beast.
cards.s_text: Then Seth speaketh to the beast, 'Close thy mouth and be silent and stand off from the image of Elohim (God) until the day of Judgment.' Then saith the beast to Seth: 'Behold, I stand off from the image of Elohim (God).' And he went to his lair.
cards.t_text: And Elohim (God) said, Let us make man in our image, after our likeness: and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the fowl of the air, and over the cattle, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth.

cards.note: Revelation 22:2 — *In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life... and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.* The oil-flowing tree of paradise, barred from Adam now, is the tree of life restored when "the delights of paradise be given" at the great day.
cards.s_text: Then shall all flesh be raised up from Adam till that great day,-all that shall be of the holy people. Then shall the delights of paradise be given to them and Elohim (God) shall be in their midst. And they shall no longer sin before his face, for the evil heart shall be taken from them and there shall be given them a heart understanding the good and to serve Elohim (God) only. But do thou go back to thy father. For the term of his life hath been fulfilled and he will live three days from to-day and will die. But when his soul is departing, thou shalt behold the awful (scene of) his passing.'
cards.t_text: In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

cards.note: Psalm 45:7 — *Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore Elohim (God), thy Elohim (God), hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.* The tree "which floweth with oil" is fulfilled in the Anointed One anointed with the oil of gladness.
cards.s_text: And Seth went with Eve near paradise, and I they wept there, and prayed Elohim (God) to send his angel and give them the oil of mercy. And Elohim (God) sent the archangel Michael and he spake to Seth: 'Seth, man of Elohim (God), weary not thyself with prayers and entreaties concerning the tree which floweth with oil to anoint thy father Adam. For it shall not be thine now, but in the end of the times.
cards.t_text: You love righteousness, and hate wickedness: therefore Elohim (God), your Elohim (God), has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

cards.note: Isaiah 61:3 — *To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness.* "The oil of joy for mourning" is the oil of mercy Seth and Eve weep for, deferred to the day it is poured out.
cards.s_text: And Seth went with Eve near paradise, and I they wept there, and prayed Elohim (God) to send his angel and give them the oil of mercy. And Elohim (God) sent the archangel Michael and he spake to Seth: 'Seth, man of Elohim (God), weary not thyself with prayers and entreaties concerning the tree which floweth with oil to anoint thy father Adam. For it shall not be thine now, but in the end of the times.
cards.t_text: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of Yahuah (LORD), that he might be glorified.

cards.note: Isaiah 61:1 — *The Spirit of Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) is upon me; because Yahuah (LORD) hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound.* The oil of mercy "in the end of the times" is the anointing the prophet announces — mercy come for the broken.

cards.note: Genesis 2:17 — *But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.* The "death" Eve brought is the sentence attached to the one command from the beginning.
cards.s_text: Thus spake the angel and departed from them. And Seth and Eve came to the hut where Adam was laid. And Adam saith to Eve: 'Eve, what hast thou wrought in us Thou hast brought upon us great wrath which is death, [lording it over all our race].' And he saith to her, 'Call all our children and our children's children and tell them the manner of our transgression.'
cards.t_text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you shall not eat of it: for in the day that you eat thereof you shall surely die.

cards.note: Romans 5:12 — *Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned.* Adam's "great wrath which is death... lording it over all our race" is the death that passed upon all men through one transgression.

cards.note: Genesis 2:17 — *But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, thou shalt not eat of it: for in the day that thou eatest thereof thou shalt surely die.* Eve's reply, that of the one tree "on the day on which ye eat of it, ye shall die the death," repeats the one command and its death sentence.
cards.s_text: And instantly he hung himself from the wall of paradise, and when the angels ascended to worship Elohim (God), then Satan appeared in the form of an angel and sang hymns like the angels. And I bent over the wall and saw him, like an angel. But he saith to me: "Art thou Eve" And I said to him, "I am." 'What art thou doing in paradise" And I said to him, "Elohim (God) set us to guard and to eat of it." The devil answered through the mouth of the serpent: 'Ye do well but ye do not eat of every plant." And I said: "Yea, we eat of all. save one only, which is in the midst of paradise, concerning which, Elohim (God) charged us not to eat of it: for, He said to us, on the day on which ye eat of it, ye shall die the death."
cards.t_text: But of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, you shall not eat of it: for in the day that you eat thereof you shall surely die.

cards.note: Genesis 3:1 — *Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, hath Elohim (God) said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?* The devil answering "through the mouth of the serpent" with "ye do not eat of every plant" is Moses' subtil serpent and its opening question.
cards.s_text: And instantly he hung himself from the wall of paradise, and when the angels ascended to worship Elohim (God), then Satan appeared in the form of an angel and sang hymns like the angels. And I bent over the wall and saw him, like an angel. But he saith to me: "Art thou Eve" And I said to him, "I am." 'What art thou doing in paradise" And I said to him, "Elohim (God) set us to guard and to eat of it." The devil answered through the mouth of the serpent: 'Ye do well but ye do not eat of every plant." And I said: "Yea, we eat of all. save one only, which is in the midst of paradise, concerning which, Elohim (God) charged us not to eat of it: for, He said to us, on the day on which ye eat of it, ye shall die the death."
cards.t_text: Now the serpent was more subtil than any beast of the field which Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) had made. And he said unto the woman, Yea, has Elohim (God) said, You shall not eat of every tree of the garden?

cards.note: 2 Corinthians 11:14 — *And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.* Satan appearing "in the form of an angel" and singing hymns at the wall of paradise is the very transformation the apostle warns of.
cards.s_text: And instantly he hung himself from the wall of paradise, and when the angels ascended to worship Elohim (God), then Satan appeared in the form of an angel and sang hymns like the angels. And I bent over the wall and saw him, like an angel. But he saith to me: "Art thou Eve" And I said to him, "I am." 'What art thou doing in paradise" And I said to him, "Elohim (God) set us to guard and to eat of it." The devil answered through the mouth of the serpent: 'Ye do well but ye do not eat of every plant." And I said: "Yea, we eat of all. save one only, which is in the midst of paradise, concerning which, Elohim (God) charged us not to eat of it: for, He said to us, on the day on which ye eat of it, ye shall die the death."
cards.t_text: And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.

cards.note: Genesis 3:5 — *For Elohim (God) doth know that in the day ye eat thereof... ye shall be as gods.* The serpent's slander that Elohim "envied you" and so said "Ye shall not eat of it" is this same insinuation — that the Maker forbids the fruit out of jealousy of the godhood it gives.
cards.s_text: But Elohim (God) perceived this that ye would be like Him, so he envied you and said, Ye shall not eat of it. Nay, do thou give heed to the plant and thou wilt see its great glory." Yet I feared to take of the fruit. And he saith to me: "Come hither, and I will give it thee. Follow me."
cards.t_text: For Elohim (God) does know that in the day you eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and you shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

cards.note: Genesis 3:5 — *For Elohim (God) doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.* "Ye too shall be as Elohim, in that ye shall know good and evil" is this verse almost word for word.
cards.s_text: But I said to him, " I fear lest Elohim (God) be wroth with me as he told us." And he saith to me: "Fear not, for as soon as thou eatest of it, ye too shall be as Elohim (God), in that ye shall know good and evil.
cards.t_text: For Elohim (God) does know that in the day you eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and you shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

cards.note: Genesis 3:4 — *And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die.* The serpent's "Fear not" is Moses' "Ye shall not surely die" — the flat denial of the death sentence of Genesis 2:17.
cards.s_text: But I said to him, " I fear lest Elohim (God) be wroth with me as he told us." And he saith to me: "Fear not, for as soon as thou eatest of it, ye too shall be as Elohim (God), in that ye shall know good and evil.
cards.t_text: And the serpent said unto the woman, You shall not surely die:

cards.note: 1 John 2:16 — *For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.* John, like the book, makes lust the world's enticing root, not of the Father.
cards.s_text: And I opened to him and he walked a little way, then turned and said to me: "I have changed my mind and I will not give thee to eat until thou swear to me to give also to thy husband." (And) I said. "What sort of oath shall I swear to thee Yet what I know, I say to thee: By the throne of the Master, and by the Cherubim and the Tree of Life! I will give also to my husband to eat." And when he had received the oath from me, he went and poured upon the fruit the poison of his wickedness, which is lust, the root and beginning of every sin, and he bent the branch on the earth and I took of the fruit and I ate.
cards.t_text: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world.

cards.note: James 1:15 — *Then when lust hath conceived, it bringeth forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, bringeth forth death.* James spells out the chain Adam and Eve 19:1 names lust 'the root and beginning of every sin' that ends in death.
cards.s_text: And I opened to him and he walked a little way, then turned and said to me: "I have changed my mind and I will not give thee to eat until thou swear to me to give also to thy husband." (And) I said. "What sort of oath shall I swear to thee Yet what I know, I say to thee: By the throne of the Master, and by the Cherubim and the Tree of Life! I will give also to my husband to eat." cards.t_text: Then when lust has conceived, it brings forth sin: and sin, when it is finished, brings forth death.

cards.note: James 1:14 — *But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.* The lust the serpent pours on the fruit is exactly the bait by which James says a man is drawn away.
cards.s_text: And I opened to him and he walked a little way, then turned and said to me: "I have changed my mind and I will not give thee to eat until thou swear to me to give also to thy husband." (And) I said. "What sort of oath shall I swear to thee Yet what I know, I say to thee: By the throne of the Master, and by the Cherubim and the Tree of Life! I will give also to my husband to eat." And when he had received the oath from me, he went and poured upon the fruit the poison of his wickedness, which is lust, the root and beginning of every sin, and he bent the branch on the earth and I took of the fruit and I ate.
cards.t_text: But every man is tempted, when he is drawn away of his own lust, and enticed.

cards.note: Romans 3:23 — *For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of Elohim (God);* The glory Eve says she was stripped of is the glory Paul says all have since come short of.
cards.s_text: And in that very hour my eyes were opened, and forthwith I knew that I was bare of the righteousness with which I had been clothed (upon), and I wept and said to him: "Why hast thou done this to me in that thou hast deprived me of the glory with which I was clothed" But I wept also about the oath, which I had sworn. But he descended from the tree and vanished.
cards.t_text: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of Elohim (God);

cards.note: Genesis 3:7 — *And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.* Eve's eyes opened and her flight to leaves (Adam and Eve 20:1,4-5, the fig tree alone) is this very verse told from within.
cards.s_text: And in that very hour my eyes were opened, and forthwith I knew that I was bare of the righteousness with which I had been clothed (upon), and I wept and said to him: "Why hast thou done this to me in that thou hast deprived me of the glory with which I was clothed" But I wept also about the oath, which I had sworn. But he descended from the tree and vanished.
cards.t_text: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.

cards.note: Genesis 3:4 — *And the serpent said unto the woman, Ye shall not surely die:* Eve's 'Fear not' answer to Adam's dread of Elohim's wrath echoes the serpent's first denial that death would follow.
cards.s_text: And I cried out in that very hour, 'Adam, Adam, where art thou Rise up, come to me and I will show thee a great secret." But when your father came, I spake to him words of transgression [which have brought us down from our great glory]. For, when he came, I opened my mouth and the devil was speaking, and I began to exhort him and said, "Come hither, my lord Adam, hearken to me and eat of the fruit of the tree of which Elohim (God) told us not to eat of it, and thou shalt be as a Elohim (God)." And your father answered and said, "I fear lest Elohim (God) be wroth with me." And I said to him, "Fear not, for as soon as thou hast eaten thou shalt know good and evil." And speedily I persuaded him, and he ate and straightway his eyes were opened and he too knew his nakedness.
cards.t_text: And the serpent said unto the woman, You shall not surely die:

cards.note: Genesis 3:5 — *For Elohim (God) doth know that in the day ye eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and ye shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.* 'Thou shalt be as a Elohim' is the serpent's promise of Genesis 3:5, now spoken through Eve to Adam.
cards.s_text: And I cried out in that very hour, 'Adam, Adam, where art thou Rise up, come to me and I will show thee a great secret." But when your father came, I spake to him words of transgression [which have brought us down from our great glory]. For, when he came, I opened my mouth and the devil was speaking, and I began to exhort him and said, "Come hither, my lord Adam, hearken to me and eat of the fruit of the tree of which Elohim (God) told us not to eat of it, and thou shalt be as a Elohim (God)." And your father answered and said, "I fear lest Elohim (God) be wroth with me." And I said to him, "Fear not, for as soon as thou hast eaten thou shalt know good and evil." And speedily I persuaded him, and he ate and straightway his eyes were opened and he too knew his nakedness.
cards.t_text: For Elohim (God) does know that in the day you eat thereof, then your eyes shall be opened, and you shall be as gods, knowing good and evil.

cards.note: 1 Thessalonians 4:16 — *For Yahusha (Lord) himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of Elohim (God): and the dead in Messiah (Christ) shall rise first:* The archangel and trumpet heralding Yahuah's coming in Eden is the same figure Paul uses for the descent at the last day.
cards.s_text: And in that same hour, we heard the archangel Michael blowing with his trumpet and calling to the angels and saying: "Thus saith Yahuah (Lord), Come with me to Paradise and hear the judgement with which I shall judge Adam."
cards.t_text: For the Lord himself shall descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with the trump of Elohim (God): and the dead in Messiah (Christ) shall rise first:

cards.note: Psalm 50:4 — *He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.* Michael's call to the angels to come and hear the judgement matches the Psalm's summons of heaven and earth to the judgment.
cards.s_text: And in that same hour, we heard the archangel Michael blowing with his trumpet and calling to the angels and saying: "Thus saith Yahuah (Lord), Come with me to Paradise and hear the judgement with which I shall judge Adam."
cards.t_text: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

cards.note: Psalm 50:3 — *Our Elohim (God) shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.* The summons to 'hear the judgement' is the Psalmist's coming Elohim who will not keep silence.
cards.s_text: And in that same hour, we heard the archangel Michael blowing with his trumpet and calling to the angels and saying: "Thus saith Yahuah (Lord), Come with me to Paradise and hear the judgement with which I shall judge Adam."
cards.t_text: Our Elohim (God) shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

cards.note: Genesis 3:8 — *And they heard the voice of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) amongst the trees of the garden.* Elohim's appearing in paradise to judge Adam (Adam and Eve 22:1–2) is this coming of Yahuah into the garden, dramatised with trumpet and chariot.
cards.s_text: And when Elohim (God) appeared in paradise, mounted on the chariot of his cherubim with the angels proceeding before him and singing hymns of praises, all the plants of paradise, both of your father's lot and mine, broke out into flowers. And the throne of Elohim (God) was fixed where the Tree of Life was.
cards.t_text: And they heard the voice of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) walking in the garden in the cool of the day: and Adam and his wife hid themselves from the presence of Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) amongst the trees of the garden.

cards.note: Genesis 3:12 — *And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.* Adam turning to Eve, 'Why hast thou done this,' is the blame Genesis records him passing to the woman.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) called Adam saying, "Adam, where art thou Can the house be hidden from the presence of its builder "Then your father answered; "It is not because we think not to be found by thee, Yahuah (Lord), that we hide, but I was afraid, because I am naked, and I was ashamed before thy might, (my) Master." Elohim (God) saith to him, "Who showed thee that thou art naked, unless thou hast forsaken my commandment, which I delivered thee to keep (it)." Then Adam called to mind the word which I spake to him, (saying) "I will make thee secure before Elohim (God)"; and he turned and said to me: "Why hast thou done this" And I said, "The serpent deceived me."
cards.t_text: And the man said, The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.

cards.note: Genesis 3:11 — *And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?* Elohim's 'Who showed thee that thou art naked, unless thou hast forsaken my commandment' is this question.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) called Adam saying, "Adam, where art thou Can the house be hidden from the presence of its builder "Then your father answered; "It is not because we think not to be found by thee, Yahuah (Lord), that we hide, but I was afraid, because I am naked, and I was ashamed before thy might, (my) Master." Elohim (God) saith to him, "Who showed thee that thou art naked, unless thou hast forsaken my commandment, which I delivered thee to keep (it)." Then Adam called to mind the word which I spake to him, (saying) "I will make thee secure before Elohim (God)"; and he turned and said to me: "Why hast thou done this" And I said, "The serpent deceived me."
cards.t_text: And he said, Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded you that you should not eat?

cards.note: Genesis 3:10 — *And he said, I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.* Adam's plea that he hid for fear and nakedness is this answer.
cards.s_text: And Elohim (God) called Adam saying, "Adam, where art thou Can the house be hidden from the presence of its builder "Then your father answered; "It is not because we think not to be found by thee, Yahuah (Lord), that we hide, but I was afraid, because I am naked, and I was ashamed before thy might, (my) Master."
